You mean for these past few days… right?
My first glimpse of the scenery of the outside world in a while dazzles my eyes, having grown accustomed to the darkness of my room.

The way I am now, having been abandoned by the world for a while, the hustle and bustle of the city intimidates me greatlyーbe it the unruly noise across town or the speed of the pedestrians passing by me.
…Well, it didn't take even an hour of going out before I was fortunately released from walking in Urashima Taro's shoes, though.
And a couple of hours have passed since then…
The sky, which was blinding despite the gentle sunlight that was shining from above, gradually turned black with the passage of time.
After having walked around aimlessly, and when I felt rehabilitated enough to interact with the outside world again, this was the first place my feet took me.
I've been standing outside watching my busy coworkers working inside the restaurant the whole time.

The number of customers is slightly lower than usual, thoughーlikely because both Houjou University and its affiliate high school have entered winter break, as the number of employees on shift is also accordingly lower.
I don't see anyone resting in either the kitchen or the hallーnot Satou, Nakagawa-san, or any of the remaining staff.
So if I'm here… perhaps my rehabilitation may move on to the next stage.
Once I'm used to brushing up against the edges of the outside world, I need to begin my rehabilitation to actually step out into it.
Since the university is on winter vacation, this is the last thing I can do right now…
"Could you please not loiter in front of the restaurant? To tell you the truth, you're hurting our business."
"And please don't pronounce my name in such a rhythmical way. Are you making fun of me?"
I wasn't trying to make fun of you; I actually just stuttered.
"You don't have work today, do you? Didn't the acting manager drive that into your head?"
"Because I'm the one who set the shifts up like that. Seeing as you had some private matters to deal with during the end of the year, Senpai."
"…I had a feeling that was the case. You never seem to betray my expectations."
The architect who had set up the moat around my schedule last week to be filled in is right here…
"Well, I've been working hard to meet the expectations of everyone around me ever since I was little."
"…You're trying to change the topic on purpose, right? That's not what I meant, and you know it."
"I was forced not to work because of your scheme, Sugiura."
"Do you have that little faith in me? The testing period is over, and I'm pretty confident that I'm doing well."
"The issue is that people can come to trust you too much."
"Even though I told you not to come again this year. Come to think of it, Senpai, aren't you supposed to be…?"
"That's none of your business. Let's make it clear that I'm your senior here… Rather, I'm your senior in every situation."
"You've already talked things through, right? You've already settled things, right? With her, I mean."
I was finally starting to lighten up the conversation, but all it took was a sentence from her to abruptly stop it.
"If you're here to brag about it, I'll gladly hear you out. Although it'll probably bore me to death, I'll still listen to what you have to say."
The moment I let the words leave my lips, Sugiura's eyes widen…
"W-What happened? Did I make some sort of fatal mistake!?"
It appears I've delivered quite the shock to her sense of responsibility.
"Please allow me to confirm your order. A seafood risotto with a drink set, as well as a Caesar salad. Will that be all?"
"Thank you very much! Please wait a moment."
"I've got the order for Table 7! …Well, Senpai, go on."
"…It's not like it was your fault, Sugiura. There's no need for you to feel responsible for it."
"…Isn't it obvious? It's a problem between her and me."
"Senpai… Don't tell me you ran away again. From Ogiso-senpai…"
"How long do you plan to drag the past along with you? If you don't work harder to overcome this obstacle…"
"Look, Table 1 is calling for service. And while you're at it, take this cheese Hamburg steak to Table 12."
"…Um, Kitahara-san. Well, I must say I'm glad that you were able to come and help, but…"
"Spare me, Satou. I never thought it'd turn out like this either…"
This is the last form of rehabilitation I can see through to the end for now.
It took me an hour to get used to the work I've abandoned for almost a week.
It's just that my original intent was to give up on this little bit of rehabilitation once Sugiura caught me.
"Table 1 has made another order! …If you don't work hard to overcome this obstacle, Senpai, you won't be able to fall in love again, you know?"
"…Please hurry up and refute me. I'm busy too."
"…The problem's what happened before all that."
"Whether I run away or not doesn't matter. The wound I've inflicted on her has worsened to the point where it can no longer be healed."
"It's only natural. Just think about everything I've done up until now…"
"Makes you wonder, doesn't it…? The fact that a certain duo's so brazenly whispering to each other during work."
"Look, I apologize, alright? I'll remind Sugiura to keep that in mind the next time she arrives."
"Make sure you tell her, okay? Tell her to speak loud enough so the rest of us can hear too, or we'll feel quite bothered by it."
Even amidst being busy at work, Sugiura, who had entered her usual meddlesome state of mind, refuses to abandon either of the two responsibilities.
After she brought me into the restaurant and threw me into the kitchen, her processing speed must have increased by around 50%.
…Said 50% being used for the sole sake of talking to me.
"I take it that everything you've ordered is to your liking? In that case, please enjoy your meal."
"That girl ought to slow down a little and take it easy…"
"Please hurry up on Table 18's dessert! …Then? What did she say to you, Senpai?"
Her questions are too rushed, too impolite, and always seem to hit me where it hurts, though.
Sugiura leans her upper body over the counter and properly adjusts her profile closer to me.
Her small right ear, to be exact.
From her demeanor to the situation itself, it all seems so work-focused that one couldn't possibly think we're talking about something serious.
But under the pressure of Sugiura's seriousness, I decide to loosen my tongue rather than to allow my mood to worsen.
"Pretty much. I can't say I disagree."
Given that the restaurant closed early because it's the end of the year, I only ended up helping for less than two hours.
And given the fact that we never managed to finish our private conversation in the middle of work, Sugiura "earnestly" volunteered to take up clean-up duty after closing hours.
It's thus no surprise that the two of us were the ones that remained in the end.
"Believing that I could wash away my sins just by apologizing at this point… I was so incredibly selfish to have thought about it that way, wasn't I?"
"But… you're not the one at fault. Senpai, you haven't done anything wrong at all!"
"…Thank you, Sugiura. But it seems that it's too late for me."
Supporting her chin with the handle of the mop, Sugiura lets out a sigh.
"It's because Setsuna's never blamed anyone up until now that I know that she truly meant it this time."
After she digests my narration of our painful experience, she appears as if her chest is burning a little.
"And it was then that I painfully realized just how badly I've been hurting her to this day."
"But, Senpai, you… Haven't you been through a lot of pain yourself?"
"…Please don't blame yourself like that. It's painful to watch."
"I'm sorry. I guess I was blaming myself to feel better. Yeah, it really is pathetic."
"…You're changing the topic on purpose, aren't you? That's not what I meant, and you know it."
"I'm sorry. It's not very good for you to start defending me right now. I'll start believing I deserve it…"
In response to Sugiura unexpectedly siding with me, I take a slightly more defiant stance with her.
"The things I've done… have hurt more people than just Setsuna."
After all, Sugiura's failed to notice because she's just that straightforward.
"She grew distant from others because of me… Those around her accidentally got dragged into this mess thanks to me."
Her support toward me, and her denial toward Setsuna…
"Close friends from the past, friends from university, fellow part-timers, and also… an important junior of mine."
The way I am now, it's admittedly quite painful.
"I've hurt many people and caused pain to those around them as well. It's such a terrible spiral of misfortune."
"You too, Sugiura. I've caused you pain too; don't you also fit into two of those categories?"
The best friend of an important former student of mine, who's also a colleague from work.
"Right now, I think that I'm hurt because I fit into three of those categories, actually."
Someone who's already surpassed being a mere colleague, I'd add.
Sugiura, who's so important to me, started voicing her resentment, making me choke up a bit too.
"Do you… regret it that much? Not just the issue concerning Ogiso-senpai, but also the other…"
"I do. For all the things I've done, I'm the absolute worst."
"Why should I tell something like that to a total stranger?"
"Why couldn't she understand? Why couldn't she hate me…?"
Back then, Sugiura was completely in line with what everyone else had told her. I understand that she's only just now starting to form her own opinion.
That's why I chose to put it differently compared to how I did the first time we met.
…I believe that I've finally been able to say it to her honestly.
"I see now… You've been regretting it. You've been reflecting on what you said back then."
"I said something terrible to you, didn't I? I wasn't acting mature at all."
"The same goes for me. After all, I've said plenty of terrible things to you too, Senpai."
"You've simply retaliated whenever I started it. You've done nothing wrong."
"You too, Senpai… the same could be…"
"I couldn't forgive you back then, Senpai… But I think it's about time you received forgiveness!"
"That's just because you're biased. It's just the result of the two of us having worked together for a while."
"But haven't you already reflected on what you've done, Senpai? That means… you're planning to change, right?"
"If you ask me, as long as you can move forward, that's all that matters. If someone is willing to work hard and down to the bone, then I don't see myself ever hating them."
Just like the cold, cloudless night sky above us, the eyes looking at me are transparently clear.
"…Thank you. If you say so, Sugiura, then maybe it's true."
Her faith in me instills an optimistic feeling within me, suggesting that I'm still capable of moving forward.
Was it the chicken or the egg that came first in this case?
"Could you… help me make a phone call right now?"
I've got this feeling for the first time since I was born, so I can't let it go to waste now.
"I'm sorry… for calling you out so late."
"Ah, r-right! Hey, want to order another helping of cake? I'm getting a little hungry."
"And also, thank you for coming. To be honest, I thought you'd never want to see me again."
"Or maybe we should get a parfait instead? Ah, what time is it already? If we eat past midnight, we might get fat…"
"There's something I have to talk to you about no matter what… Though perhaps it's selfish of me to ask this of you after saying something so cruel to you."
"U-Um… before that, please tell me one thing."
"Hmm～ I'm so stuck… Hey, what do you guys think?"
"Why are you together with Koharu-chan, Sensei?"
Without reservation, Yada-san casts a doubtful gaze at me as I sit opposite her, as well as at Sugiura, who's sitting right next to her.
Sugiura called her phone over twenty times, and when she finally answered, she paused for another 30 seconds before giving any reply after hearing my voice.
But even so, she still came to see me… Even though I suggested meeting up tomorrow given the late hour, she showed up in a mere ten minutes…
"Why are you two together so late at night…?"
Most likely, she didn't do it out of goodwill.
"We both work part-time at the same place. And it's simply a coincidence and nothing more."
But at this point, no matter what her reason is, it's fine so long as I get to see her.
If I could have just one more chance.
"Sugiura's working part-time to fund her graduation trip, and that place just happened to be where I used to work… That's all there is to it."
"Still, I'm grateful to Sugiura. For giving me another chance to talk to you, Yada-san, and because she did many things to help and encourage me."
"However, what I need to talk about now has nothing to do with Sugiura. It's between you, me… and another person, Yada-san."
And it's not about me alone.
I must use this chance to resolve the misunderstandings that have piled up between these two as well.
"…If that's what Senpai says, then don't you think it is?"
"Ugh…! Ah, ahh… yeah, well… I'm sorry, Mihoko, I should've told you before."
"How could… But all this time, I've been so terrible to you, Koharu-chan…"
"It's really no problem at all. The fact that we've been able to continue on like this is because we're able to be honest with what we want to talk about."
Yada-san's eyes, behind her glasses, finally turn toward the person she's been avoiding until now.
As for Sugiura, after being stared at directly, she becomes embarrassed and looks upward.
"In any case, I apologize. For causing such a misunderstanding between you two, and for acting so terribly toward you, Yada-san. I'm very sorry."
"At that time, I was afraid of letting others get too close to me. …The closer we were, the stronger my fear became."
"But of course, there's a reason I became like that. It might take some time to explain, but could you please hear me out?"
Yada-san stares at me as I lower my head, the same way she stared at Sugiura earlier…
"Nothing to do with me… You don't have to be so direct about it."
I told her about that beautiful period of my life that lasted half a year, dating back three years ago.

Of the girl who delivered her affections to me, of the two girls for whom I harbored equally sincere affections for, and the performance during the school festival, where the three of us together enjoyed ourselves like fools.
And then there was the severe reckoning I'd received, having failed to make a single, albeit crucial choice despite being so immersed in a dream like that.
I was the one that should have been punished for itーand yet it was one of the girls that had ended up shouldering all of the pain.
And a thorn piercing her heart has still not been removed for three years to this day, unfeeling blood pouring continuously from her wound with every instance I approach her, even now.
"Falling in love with someone and having someone fall in love with me… I was scaredーreally scaredーof that…"
"That's why I treated everyone equally. I didn't have any inclinations toward any particular person. That way, I could maintain the status of not being liked or hated by others."
It was an attempt that was supposed to protect my own heart, one devised by my previous self who had found human relationships to be terrifying and troublesome.
"Because you work hard for everyone, you're strict to everyone, and you're also kind to everyone."
"You're only ever strict to me, though…"
"Well, that's the obvious thing to do… It's my job, after all."
"Most university students working as part-time tutors wouldn't go so far, normally speaking. Nor would they spend more than an hour trying to answer all my questions."
"If I had been a good teacher, I would have been able to finish it in ten minutes. That's just a sign that I'm not good enough."
"Even so, I was very happy. Up until then, Koharu-chan was the only one who would go so far to help me."
I don't want to say something cruel to her for the second time, so what I just thought to say will never leave my mouth.
But that doesn't mean I'll readily accept her overly biased view of me.
"Even so, Yada-san, it's the undeniable truth that I said terrible things to you, even though you believed in me."
"I'm sorry. I'm really sorry. Even though I know it's not something that a simple apology can solve…"
"M-Mihoko! This is fine, right? This is enough, right?"
"Kitahara-senpai really regrets what he has done. The pain he experienced is no less than yours. I can tell, after all these days I've spent working with him."
"It's fine, Sugiura. You don't need to speak up for me…"
I lower my head before the two, while Sugiura tries her best to defend me.
Even though to Yada-san, her attitude might cause the opposite effect.
Sugiura herself must know that too.
While remaining silent, Yada-san looks both at me, lowering my head, and Sugiura, who continues to defend me.
"What I want to know isn't what happened three years ago."
"What I want to know is now… after apologizing to me, what your feelings are now, Senpai."
Before the wound could be sown together, she confronts me once again.
"I thought you were a wonderful girl, Yada-san. No, even now, I still think that's true."
Something shocking enough to make her stop going to school… I don't think I'd ever understand how painful that must be.
"You tried your best to understand my terrible teaching. So much that even I felt I was making progress."
"I-I'm not talking about that, it's… how you look at me, as a girl…"
"I'm sorry… I already have someone I like."
But this is something that I have to tell Yada-san no matter what.
"I've been hurting her for three years now, and she finally dumped me one week ago."
After all, I went out of my way to resolve myself to see her again, just so I could tell her all about this.
Apologizing to her would simply be making excuses.
"That's why, I'm sorry… I can't accept your feelings."
I just want to… tell this girl the true reason why I rejected her.
"…Oh, who am I kidding… I'm sorry for having it end like this."
"Ah… you don't need to apologize to me… It's… not your fault, Koharu-chan. It has nothing… to do with you, Koharu-chan."
"Hey, Mihoko… Wanna go to karaoke or something after this?"
"…That's… impossible… How could I sing now…?"
"You don't have to sing. Just go there to cry your heart out."
"Let's go throw away all the painful things that have happened this year… And then, when winter vacation is over, let's go back to school together, okay?"
"To celebrate us making up, I'll pay for it. Hey, come on… let's go, Mihoko."
"Uu… uu… Ko-Koharu-chan… I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I…"
"The truth is… I want a chance to cry a bit, myself…"
"But like, right now…? It's not even 7 PM yet, you know?"
Takeya had called me just before I could place the soba noodles I would have for dinner into the pot.

"There's actually three parts to it… First up, a year-end party! Then, at midnight, when the New Year's bell rings, we'll visit the shrine. After that, we'll do an all-nighter New Year's celebration!"
"No, no, I was actually really depressed until a moment ago, you know? Even though it's New Year's Eve, I can't get a single girl to spend it with me."
"I see. So you reached out to me in desperation, basically."
"Two of them went back home to the countryside, and one of them broke up with me because I ditched her on Christmas. Another one said okay, but then she…"
"Then why didn't you just go with that last girl?"
"But listen, she said she was going to wear a furisode kimono, man… How can I possibly suppress my urges the entire night when she's wearing that?"
"If anything, I think that she should be more frustrated for being rejected over such a superficial reason."
"Well, stop worrying about the details and just come with me. Even though a lot of things happened this year, I think we should just forget about everything, yeah?"
"The usual gang, obviously. Io, me, and…"
In a way, I had a feeling that would be the case. …In terms of those who would be present and absent, I mean.
I doubt Setsuna would appear somewhere where there's a chance of crossing paths with me right now. I know she's not one to show up that easily.
Because of that, even though it's a little sad, I feel a little relieved.
It's not like… I'm completely free.
Yesterday, I received a letter in my mail, and it's just sitting there on my table.
Mari-san sent it; a ticket to Touma Youko's New Year concert…
It starts at 8 o'clock. If I head out now, I can still make it.
But that would mean openly rejecting Takeya's invitation.
"…Hey, Haruki. Are you… really okay right now?"
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't interested.
A live concert by a world-class pianist. A premium seat. It also happens to be a special invitation that's a result of the recognition that I'd gained through my first real assignment.
"It's a rare chance, so why don't you try getting backstage? If you tell them you're from Ensemble, they'll let you in for sure."
…But if I were to come face to face with Touma Youko herself and her performance, I'm sure it'd end up making me recall some of my past memories, even if I don't want to.

Having succeeded her bloodline and talents, I'm sure that I'd see a certain someone playing on her own stage on the opposite side of the world much like her mother, and much like her, she'd also grab the attention of her audience in a single sweep…
"Just maybe… you might see Touma Kazusa there too, you know?"
No, what I'd be seeing again are memories pertaining to a certain someone.
"Um… Could it be that… what we did had the opposite effect?"
"Not really… Is that a yes or a no?"
Could it be that Touma Youko still remembers me?
Even if she forgot, if I pushed my way to the waiting rooms and told them I was the one that wrote that article, I might get a chance to meet her.
And she might remember the moment she recognizes me.
And would she tell her daughter about me if that were to happen?
"The truth is, you want to see her, don't you?"
It's another link between Kazusa and me… a potential path that may lead me to meeting with Kazusa again…
"Hey, Haruki. On the night of the 24th, what happened between you…"
"What do you mean, what…? I'm asking where we'll meet up. Isn't that why you called in the first place?"
It's time to give it up.
I have no right to even remember the name "Touma" when I can't even have proper closure with Setsuna.
"Well, I won't go if you won't tell me where you are."
"Wait! I'll be at Onjuku Station's east exit, near the ticket booth! 30 minutes from now!"
"You could've just said so to begin with, you know. You always get caught up in pointless conversation."
Those two will most likely corner me and force me to tell them the truth about what happened that day.
But right now, I don't plan on hiding my sins, nor do I plan on running away.
I'll tell them the truth, let them yell at me… and accept their judgement.
The beer glass that she had raised to lead our toast just minutes ago slammed down on the table, as if brought down by an iron fist.
"Why… Why is Setsuna saying something like that now!?"
"Like I said, don't be so loud! Haruki is pretty hurt himse… Wait, Setsuna-chan?"
I predicted that Io would be angry, but I was wrong about who she'd be angry with.
"She knows… She knows full well that Haruki can't forget about Touma! Shouldn't she understand more than anyone that you'll never be able to let her go!?"
"She knew, but even so, she still loves you, Haruki. That was why I wanted to help her out, and yet…"
"Yeah, that's right. That's why we were always on Setsuna-chan's side…"
"But just as Haruki makes his decision to be with her, Setsuna brings up something so obvious and slaps Haruki's hand aside? What the hell is she thinking!?"
I can only gawk at Io and her furious expression, unable to comprehend the rationale behind her anger.

Even so, I'm not the only one who's perplexed about it despite being the actual one involved; Takeya, who's sitting right next to me, feels the same way, which means her current way of thinking is probably one that guys like us can't understand.
"Just how bitter is she? Just how troublesome can she be…?"
"That's… You know, it's my fault. Setsuna's become like that because of me…"
"If you ask me, this is just her trying to take some petty form of revenge! It's nothing but a meaningless grudge that she wants to get back at you for!"
"That's impossible… She's the only girl I know that's actually worthy of being called an angel, and I don't mean that just as a pick-up line, you know."
"Even so, what Setsuna did this time was the worst. Even if she's an angel, what she did was something only a fallen angel would do!"
"She just got dragged down to Earth. By Haruki, that is."
Compared to Io, who's completely on my side, it's easier for me to understand what Takeya is saying, given that he's completely berating me for the issue.
"Why are you speaking up for Setsuna? If we're only talking about this case, it's definitely Setsuna's fault. Do you understand how terrible she was to Haruki?"
After all, I never even dreamed that someone would actually speak up for me. Let alone that someone like Io would be the first to do it.
"Well, it was unavoidable. She was always… always bottling up those feelings inside of her. Setsuna was simply too kind, so she really didn't say anything up until now."
"If she's just going to explode at the end, then she might as well point it out from the very beginning! Yell at him! Make Haruki admit that it was his fault!"
I know I'm slow at understanding women's feelings, but even Takeya can't seem to process this one…
Is it because Io's mentality is that much different from the rest? Or is it simply because neither of us understand how women think…?
Or maybe it's because… both of these statements are true?
"I mean, Setsuna… she absolutely refused to yield about this until now. Always saying that it wasn't Haruki's fault, that it definitely wasn't his fault."
"But… what happened in the past, no matter how we look at it, was undeniably Haruki's fault. There's no denying that he did something terrible to Setsuna."
The betrayal from three years ago. Avoiding her for two years. And the lie from one week ago.
Io didn't mention anything specific, and even Takeya didn't admit it openly, but I'm the one most aware of all the sins I've committed.
There's only one person among the four of us that's not aware of them, or rather, said person doesn't want to accept them…
"Setsuna should've told him sooner, she should've admitted that Haruki was at fault and blamed him for the things he'd done. Haruki needed her to do that, too."
"Well, she ended up admitting all that, didn't she? It just… took her a little time."
"It took her way too much time… In all the time she took moping around like that, Haruki never once forgot about Touma."
The topic they're discussing now. It hurts.
"It's because Setsuna refused to let go. That's what's forced them into this situation where they can't move on or go back, either!"
It's not because what they're saying is close to the truth, nor because they're bringing up our past…
It's because their words are filled with such sincerity, that I feel so ashamed of myself.
I'm ashamed because I've become incapable of acting sincerely when it comes to Setsuna.
With an extremely irritated look on her face, Io stands up and puts on her jacket as if to say she doesn't want to speak with us any longer.
"I'm going to Setsuna's house right now. If worse comes to worst, I'll be cutting all ties with her."
"Come on, just cut it out already. Haruki never wished for something like that to happen, either."
"This time… This time alone, it's definitely Setsuna's fault."
"Even so, the one who's suffering over this right now is most likely Setsuna-chan herself."
"Even though she just dumped Haruki? Even though she kept leading him on all this time?"
"Then again… Isn't it more painful to dump someone than to be dumped?"
"Oh, my. I suppose you may have a point, given that you've got plenty of experience on either side!"
"No, of course I don't understand! After all, I've never dumped anyone."
"…Maybe you were just too dense to realize it?"
"Would you two stop it already!? What's the point in arguing here now!?"
This was supposed to be a party where these two would scold me, but at some point or another, it turned into me trying to calm them both down.
I seriously think I just heard Takeya's temple making a popping sound.
I take a glimpse at my cell phone. 23:55.
I can hear the New Year's bell sounding the countdown already.
"What now… How about we call it a day?"
"…Now listen here, have you two already forgotten your main objective for today?"
I'm sure Takeya mentioned a New Year's shrine visit in his invitation.
…Then again, at the time, we hadn't gotten into that huge fight yet.
In the end, with the tense atmosphere enveloping us, we all kept on pouring alcohol down our throats in silence.
I don't know how, but I had to get in the middle of these two who were supposed to scold and encourage me tonight, keeping their emotions in check while I ordered three people's worth of drinks.
…Still, I managed to find my old self again as I found myself taking care of them.
I wonder if they've realized that I'm starting to look less and less like a man who just got dumped.
They kept a subtle distance from each other, and not knowing whether we were heading to the shrine or back to the station, I chose to simply follow behind them…
And eventually, we found ourselves in front of Onjuku Art and Culture Hall's entrance.
Guests came pouring out of the hall and down the stairs, and a massive wave of people suddenly appeared before my very eyes.
In any case, it appears that the concert just ended. Looking at the clock on my phone, I see that it's 23:59 right now.
…Seems like the New Year's Concert was just a little short of the new year.
Swallowed up by the wave of people heading toward the station, my hastened pace slows down.
The people coming out of the hall have their faces flushed with excitement as they talk about how amazing the concert was.
The crowd's excitement floods my surroundings as it drowns out the sound of the New Year's bell meant for the first night of the year, bringing me the slightest bit of discomfort.
It must have been an absolutely amazing concert. …And I feel the slightest bit of regret for missing out on it.
As we were drifting through the bustling sea of people around us…
It was at that very moment that the new year had arrived.
"Happy New Year, Haruki. Let's get along this year too."
"Come on, both of you… You guys should realize that there's someone else apart from me and yourselves here."
Even though we've already fulfilled the conditions for a truce, it seems that the cold war that broke out earlier won't come to an end so easily.
Why did these two meet up in the first place? …Why did they call me out?
Whose fault is it that they've gotten into this fight? …What should I do to make them go back to normal?
…I swear, these two always put the cart before the horse.
"There's a small… favor I'd like to ask of you."
"Eh? What? My impressions? …You really want to hear that from me?"
"I get it. I don't want to admit it, but it doesn't seem like I'll beat you any time soon."
"Anyway, I'll be heading back to the hotel. Are you going to… Huh?"
"That's right. The seat on your left. Was no one there?"
"…Now that you mention it, it was empty the whole time."
"Why? Did you invite someone you know?"
"You could say that… So he decided not to show up, then."
"Your first husband? Your second husband? Or… my father?"
"Stop joking around. I have no idea how to react even if I met him right now."
"I see… It didn't work, huh… I see…"
"Hey, want to go drinking after we're back at the hotel… Kazusa?"
"What are you saying all of a sudden?"
"Nothing wrong with that, right…? You're past twenty already. It's always been a dream of mine to go drinking with my daughter～"
"…I'm pretty sure you drink every day back home anyway."
"Being in Japan is what makes it special. We don't often get a chance to come back like this, so I want to try heating up a pot of it the old-fashioned way."
"Your age is showing… Even though your piano still sounds so wild and full of life."
"Did you have something you wanted to do? …Someone you wanted to meet?"
"There's no longer a place in this country meant for me."
"Okay, I got it. It's been a while since I've listened to you grumbling, Mom. That's fine. Let's drink until morning, then?"
"What are you talking about～? It was a huge success, wasn't it? Tonight calls for a celebration! All right, I'm not letting you sleep tonight～!"
"You're right… Congratulations. And here's hoping for another great year together, Mom."
"Yeah. Well, I'll see you at the hotel. I'll be heading over after I take care of some formalities."
"…What a depressing chime. I guess I really am back in Japan."
"Hey… I wonder if you're doing okay?"
"Happy New Year. Here's to another great year."
"…Though it's not like we're ever going to meet again, are we?"
"Ah, ah… (Happy New Year)! Happy New Year～!"
"Yeah… Let's get along this year too."
"T-Thank goodness～! You answered! My heart felt like it was going to burst～!"
"You sound so excited… Have you been drinking?"
"Aaaah, well yeah, I was drinking until just a little while ago. To be honest, I was on the floor until just a moment ago."
"Is that so… Are you outside now?"
"Yeah, I'm heading to the shrine to pay a visit. How about you, Setsuna?"
"I'm at home. I just finished eating soba with my family while watching Red and White, and now I'm back in my room."
"I'm sorry. You went out of your way to invite me too…"
"It's all right, we understand. We know that it's the Ogiso family's tradition."
"By the way, there's… actually something I need to apologize to you for."
"I'm sorry, Setsuna. You might resent me for this, but… here, this is for you."
"Don't hang up! Please, give me a minute, just hear me out…"
Just as I expected… No, far exceeding my expectations, Setsuna becomes flustered the moment she hears my voice through the phone.
"I asked Io to do this. I figured you wouldn't answer if I tried calling you myself."
"No way, that's unfair… That's so unfair, Haruki-kun…"
"No, actually, I'm the one who's unfair… I'm the one who did all those terrible things."
"Why would you want to talk to a terrible woman like me…? You're so weird, Haruki-kun…"
Setsuna's voice is slowly falling apart.
She's quite clearly upset, confused… sad and panicking, all at the same time.
But… there is also a small hint of excitement in her voice.
"Because… I must apologize to you, no matter what."
"Why would you need to apologize, Haruki-kun…!?"
This reaction from Setsuna puts me on the verge of tears.
"After all, just like you said, I lied to you, Setsuna. I never managed to forget about Kazusa."
Setsuna most likely has the exact same expression on her face as I do now.
"And I think that… even after today, I won't ever be able to forget about Kazusa."
But right now, I have to keep my wits about me.
I definitely won't yield on what comes next. I can't afford to lose to her in this.
"And then, besides that… there's something I must apologize to you for above all other things."
A certain someone gave me courage.
"You still love her nevertheless? Still can't give up?"
A certain someone taught me the answer.
"If you ask me, as long as you can move forward, that's all that matters. If someone is willing to work hard and down to the bone, then I don't see myself ever hating them."
A certain someone… showed me the right path.
"Despite everything, I… I still love you, Setsuna."
"I'm sorry. Even though you totally dumped me… I just couldn't give up."
I can no longer hear any sounds or breathing from the other side of the line.
…After hearing the loud noise of two objects colliding.
"Anyway, good night. And also… Happy New Year."
I don't know how much of what I just said reached Setsuna.
"If at all possible… let's get along this year, too."
Because right now, I only need the determination to resolve my own feelings.
If I wished to resolve Setsuna's feelings about this, she would also have to be present.
"Uuu… uuu… haah… Ah… nn… Haruki-kun… aahhh…!"
I attempt to return the cell phone I borrowed, but Io doesn't seem like she's planning on taking it back. She's just standing there gawking at my face in disbelief.
Until a moment ago, Io was keeping her distance from Takeya, but now they're right next to each other and both staring at me.
"All right, what's next? Wanna visit the shrine as we planned? Or… should we just call it a day here?"
"What's the matter? Is there something on my face?"
That said… it's not as if I don't know why these two are looking so absolutely dumbfounded.
Honestly, even I thought I went a little overboard there.
"Happy New Year, Takeya, Io. …Now all that's left is for you two to say it to each other, right?"
"You, you, you damn…! How dare you make us worry so much～!?"
"That was so disgusting, man! You know how many goosebumps I just got!?"
"Hey, hey, hey! Calm down, you drunks!"
With Io and Takeya putting two people's worth of weight on my head, we lose balance and stumble left and right in the middle of the sidewalk.
To those around us, we definitely look like a bunch of stupid, drunken students. Not that that image is completely wrong…
"Haruki, Haruki… Don't let her go again! Don't you ever let her go again!"
"I'm the one who got dumped, though…"
"Screw it all, we'll be drinking until morning now, got it? Man, she's such a waste on you!"
"I thought we were calling it a day? Well, not that I mind."
But now, since it's New Year's, everyone around us will most likely let it slide this time.
…If anything, they're probably enjoying the sight of us, who were in a quarrel just a moment ago, get along.
Here's to all the people who have supported me in the past year. And to all of those who I have no doubt will keep supporting me in this following year.
Here's to the reliable ones who supported me, to the not-so-reliable ones who supported me, and to those who supported me even when asked not to.
Here's to all my cherished friends.
And to the one most beloved person who stayed by my side, despite all the grief I put her through…
To all of you, I wish a Happy New Year.
And I hope it'll be a great year indeed.
"…Come to think of it, how many times have you seen Setsuna this year?"
"Ugh… How long are you gonna let this drag on, you idiot!?"
"I know I'm an idiot, you idiot!"
Humans tend to become even more aggressive and irritated than usual when our mistakes are clearly pointed out.
And not too long after answering a phone call from Takeya, who I hadn't heard from in a while, my voice became charged with such a negative tone.
"Then you haven't met for over two months now. What are you still hesitating about?"
"There's nothing I can do about that! I was dumped! …There's no way I can take the initiative and approach her now."
On a certain day during winter break, Setsuna sent me a text.
The subject was 'Happy New Year,' sounding like something any ordinary friend would send.
However, the content was anything but something a normal friend would have sent. It was filled with regret and hesitation, like she was trying to approach me, who she had abandoned.
After that, we texted each other more and more often, but it just felt like we were miserably trying to disguise the fact that we broke up by staying friendly.
…We haven't made any promises since then.
"There's a limit to how much I can watch over you guys. Actually, that was the main reason you two wouldn't give a proper reply to this skiing trip idea, right?"
"Look, I've been telling you that my work schedule hasn't been set yet and…"
Takeya and Io ended up inviting us to a skiing trip two weeks before final exams were over, probably because they've lost their patience after watching us not make any progress.
"And didn't I say that we'd match the schedule to fit the both of you? All right, what's your next excuse?"
"Whenever you'd like is okay, got it? And it's almost March, you know?"
"It's about time you made up your mind, Haruki. The snow will melt if you don't hurry."
Winter is almost over. The season of White Album is coming to an end.
"I'll think about it for now. I'll contact you once I've made up my mind."
"And when exactly do you plan on contacting me?"
The change of seasons always gives me something to look forward to, while also bringing about a particular feeling of fear.
After all, whenever there was a change in our relationship, it would always be during this season.
"By the end of the week? Tomorrow? Or maybe in an hour?"
"Uhh… I'll give it my best effort."
We would grow closer during a snowy day, but would hurt each other during a snowy night.
We would embrace each other while shivering in the cold, but our frozen hearts would make us pass each other by without realizing it.
If I don't make a move now, nothing will happen. But if something does happen, I'm not confident enough to say that we'll still be able to smile.
And so, for this year's winter, I'll probably…
"It's fine, already. I knew that if I were to let you make the call, you'd never be able to finalize your schedule, anyway…"
"Well, that'll be all for today. I'll get in touch with you soon."
I apologize to Takeya in my heart one more time, hang up the phone, and…
The moment I opened the door…
I became speechless after seeing the unexpected guest.
"And with that in mind, I made the call for you. We're heading out right now! Hurry up and pack your stuff."
"You're not planning on refusing, are you? Considering you're just staying home doing absolutely nothing right now, and we've already made reservations in the hotel for tomorrow."
"Io will have grabbed a hold of Setsuna-chan by right about now, too. Come on, get to packing!"
"There's nothing you need to apologize for, Setsuna. We're both victims here…"
"B-But… I was just wondering if any of this was bothering you."
"Bothered…? No, it's more like I'm at a loss… B-But I guess you're feeling the same way, aren't you, Setsuna?"
"I-I'm, uh… I think I feel more or less the same way about this, yeah."
"Does our commentator, Mizusawa-san, have anything to say about that exchange just now?"
"Hmmm, it's so pure and innocent that it even made me a little embarrassed! It almost makes me want to butt in and ask them how long they've known each other, you know?"
"It feels like a situation where total newbies went on a blind date and somehow ended up alone with each other, then made a big fuss inside the car!"
"And whose fault do you think that is, huh!?"
"We're about to get on the highway, but let's find a place to have a late-night snack before that."
"Ah, I'd like some Chinese food. I think there's a place that's open even late at night around here."
Even if I complained to the driver or the person by his side, they'd both just shrug my complaints off without a care.

It's been over an hour since I got dragged into this car. And the date has already changed, so it's the last day of February. We still haven't been able to catch up with how fast things have been developing.
After being hurried by Takeya to get ready for the trip, and being forced into his car, we traveled to a familiar place…
"…Come to think of it, I can't believe you got Setsuna's family to agree to this, Io."
When we picked up the girls in front of the Ogiso residence, I could tell that Setsuna had been rushed to pack just like I was, and she looked as if she were bound to Io.
"I told them we were planning on going skiing in advance. I wouldn't make a silly mistake about something like that."
"Even so, it's so sudden… Wouldn't her parents be mad?"
"I just told them that Setsuna had completely forgotten about the planned date, then her mother started apologizing to me. That was pretty embarrassing…"
"Doesn't that mean you lied to the entire Ogiso family!? How could you do that with such a clear conscience!?"
I can't believe these two… Would they really go so far as to cause trouble for their friend's family to achieve their goals?
"Setsuna, is this really okay? You haven't lied to your family once until now…"
"There was nothing I could have done… She said that they'd already reserved our accommodation. I'd feel bad if I refused."
"You don't have to feel bad for them. They just rushed into this headfirst without even asking us anything…"
"Mizusawa-san, any comments on that statement just now?"
"Hmm, it's just one of those things someone who can't read the mood would say."
"Would you two just keep quiet for a second!?"
"It's fine, Haruki-kun. I don't mind it, really."
"I… don't mind traveling together with everyone like this."
"Haruki-kun, does it bother you? Or did you have something you had to do, maybe?"
That's right. It has happened before. Setsuna has lied to her family before.
Three years ago, for the hot spring trip during Christmas. Three months ago, when we couldn't even start a quarrel at the park.
Ahh… Seems like it was my fault every time.
And I imagine Setsuna didn't refuse this extremely rushed trip this time because…
"…It would appear that the problem is resolved, huh?"
"Let's just enjoy the trip. It's been a while since all four of us spent some quality time together."
The two perpetrators turn their heads around and smile at us.
The smiles of these terrorists are far too overbearing and self-centered, stabbing at the weak spots in our hearts.
Nevertheless, we know that their true intentions are earnest, and for that, it's not like we can say anything harsh to them either.
Following Setsuna's line of vision, the sight of countless snowflakes descending from the sky fills my vision.
We've been on the highway, in the car of an amateur driver for three hours now. Tokyo is already far behind us, we're now at Yamanashi and will be at Nagano soon…
I suppose this place is called "snow country" for a reason. Before we knew it, the snow began to coat our surroundings, and it's only going to get stronger by the looks of it.
Between us talking about the snow and making noncommittal replies, we continue our awkward conversation, as usual.
But to the two of us, the things we said probably shared hundreds of words' worth of information.
Watching snow fall through a car's windows, no matter when, will without fail evoke that day from our memories.
The view from three years ago… Back then, the three of us stared at the sky together.
Although we're at a distance so close that our shoulders are almost touching, neither of us tries to take the initiative to touch the other.
Without a doubt, we're reliving the same memory right now…
No, it's exactly because we're thinking of that same memory right now that an invisible wall has come to form between us.
"The snowflakes are pretty big. It might even be wet snow."
It seems we're fine with normal conversations like these now. We no longer lower our heads, and we can look at each other and smile…
"You two should go to sleep for now. We're hitting the ski tracks as soon as we arrive!"
"You mean we don't need to take turns driving?"
"It's fine, no worries. Considering Takeya's the one who forcefully dragged you guys out, let him take responsibility."
"I… was hoping that you would help out a little, at least…"
The clock on the dashboard went past 5 o'clock before we knew it.
"Here, if you're cold, use this blanket. There's only one, but it sure beats having nothing."
Setsuna seems hesitant and apologetic, and I don't know if the way she's looking at me with a troubled expression is something that I should have expected.
"They're right. You should get some sleep, Setsuna."
I took the blanket from Io, spread it with my hands and laid it on Setsuna.
"When you wake up, the world will be blanketed in white all around you."
This time, even if just a little, is the first time I've touched Setsuna today.
In the dim light, Setsuna stares at my profile.
I pretend not to notice, and let go after putting the blanket onto Setsuna's lap.
But even after I let go, Setsuna doesn't break her gaze away from me.
The glint in her eyes makes me feel as if… she's both blaming me and worrying about me.
Although we were at a distance so close that our shoulders were almost touching, neither of us tried to take the initiative to touch the other.
…But now, that's no longer the case.
As soon as she fell asleep, Setsuna leaned her head on my shoulder.
But I couldn't even bring myself to embrace her, I only supported her with my body.
The blanket that was meant for Setsuna somehow ended up on me as well, and now we're sharing it.
Setsuna must have done this on purpose. It's like she's frustrated at me for hesitating, that's why she's doing something so pushy.
Soon after our distance was reduced to zero by force, Setsuna's head leaned onto my shoulder, and soon enough, she leaned on me completely.
Setsuna's body is warming me up.
We're simply using the most efficient way for the two of us to stay warm and nothing moreーby sharing a blanket between the two of us.
…Who am I kidding. We're not just keeping each other warm, and I'm sure everyone here knows that as well as I do.
Long eyelashes arch from her closed eyes. Sweet breath spills out from her wet lips. Not a man in this world could deny that Setsuna's face is adorable right now.
Any man would love to take on the task of being her pillow, without a doubt, and I'm sure that anyone would feel bliss at this moment.
Even… me. In fact, it's exactly because it's me that this feeling is all the more intense.
Because Setsuna… is a very precious girl to me.
No matter how many times we've clashed. No matter how many times we've hurt each other.
And no matter how many times we've bid each other farewell.
The snow piles up outside the window, slowly becoming thicker.
Winter isn't over yet. Our own season of White Album still continues on.
Setsuna's hand and my hand overlap.
Right now, I neither want to let go of it, nor do I have the courage to hold it tight.
But it's winter now, and I'm sure that time will start moving again for the two of us soon enough.
Upon a snowy day we grew closer; upon a snowy night we hurt each other.
And so later today, when the snowy daybreak arrives…I wonder what our relationship will turn out to be like.
As always, the chill of the wind outside the window prickles my skin.
It's been three days since winter break ended. I've come to the lab after my lecture, and even though it's indoors, the piercing cold remains relentless.
I haven't seen anyone from the seminar for the past three days.
It's been like this since winter break because the fourth-year students and the graduate students are reviewing their theses with their professors, so they all gather at the seminar room instead.
And today, as expected, there doesn't seem to be a single third-year student that's crazy enough to come to this lab which has since lost its purpose, either.
…I thought that at times like this, I'd be able to catch a certain lazy one snoozing in a sleeping bag in here.
In the past two days, I've seen Izumi neither in the lecture hall nor in the lab.
Well, I'm not sure what should be considered normal in her case, but given that she barely managed to submit her winter paper in time, I wouldn't be surprised if she went right back to square one.
I need to apologize for something I did at the end of last year, as well as thank her.
Come to think of it, did she even manage to graduate to the next year?
As I look over to something that appeared in the corner of my eye, my vision is blocked by a familiar face.
"What's up? You're totally spacing out there, man. Did a really cute girl pass by just now?"
Really cute would be undeniably apt if it were truly her, though…
But I probably got the wrong person.
Because the moment we made eye contact, it was like nothing had happened, and I was magnificently ignored.
"Can I come over to your place, then? It'd be nice to have an alibi for onc… I mean, um… Getting some quality bonding time as two friends for once sounds like a good idea, yeah?"
"Sure, that's fine. I'm off work today anyway."
"Oh, nothing… It's just that it's been a while since you gave me an okay on my first try."
"Ahh, is that right…? I guess I've been treating everyone pretty terribly. Sorry, it's just that I had a lot going on…"
"No, this is a great sign. It was all because you were gloomy to the core and shutting yourself in, but it seems like you've reflected on all the things you've done."
"Right, bye, I'll be heading home first."
"Wait! That was a compliment, you should be happy!"
"There's no way I could be happy so openly. In any case, I'm quite gloomy, after all."
"In any case, let's go buy some beers and snacks along the way, yeah? And drink to our heart's content today? It's fine if I stay over as well, right?"
"It's fine, but no matter how much we drink, I have to wake up by 6:30 AM and head out by 8 AM. My first lecture is the earliest of the day."
"…As usual, sleeping over at your place is like living in a Buddhist temple. Well, whatever. Let's get going!"
"…What's the matter? Was she really that cute?"
Following Takeya, I turned my head to try to catch a glimpse of that girl once more.
But with no one there anymore, all that remained was a long shadow cast by the sunset.
That couldn't have been… Setsuna, right?
The way she panicked and looked away while running… Was that just me imagining things?
"Why are you acting like some middle schooler going through puberty?"
"Just now… you were staring at Haruki the whole time, weren't you? And the moment you two made eye contact, you ran away, didn't you?"
"Wha-Wha-What are you saying? I just… Um, I forgot something in the lecture hall."
"Could it be that you still haven't talked to Haruki? Even though it's been two weeks since that happened?"
"I'm telling you, I just forgot something…"
"Do you hate being together with Haruki now? Don't you ever want to see him anymore?"
"Ugh, no way! Why are you saying something so cruel, Io!?"
"You're the cruel one here, Setsuna. Haruki already clearly conveyed his feelings to you, hasn't he? So why aren't you giving him an answer?"
"Come with me right now! It's time for us to talk!"
"Eh, eh, eh…!? Wait, Io… Le-Le-Let me go…! Ahhh～!"
"What's going on now? I thought you two made up your minds long ago…"
"Should I go tell Haruki, then? Tell him that there's nothing to be said anymore? Tell him that your relationship is completely over?"
"Don't! Don't do that! Don't make up your mind about me so easily…"
"…Then why are you still hesitating so much? Aren't there supposed to be two choices, either okay or no good?"
"Because I'm the one who dumped Haruki-kun, all right? I'm the one who… decided to break up with him."
"You're not serious about that, right? Everyone knows that."
"But I meant what I said. So why…? How could Haruki-kun still possibly love me…?"
"Don't they say you like someone simply because you like them? That's already set in stone…"
"I really meant it when I did that horrible thing to Haruki-kun. I led him to the hotel, then dumped him at the very last moment, you know?"
"…That's what you did? Haruki didn't describe it in such detail, but that's actually pretty awful of you…"
"That's why I don't understand. He's supposed to be mad at me. He should be hating me for it. And yet, why is he…"
"You'll never know unless you ask Haruki in person. That's why I want you to talk to him."
"Even though you were on the offense so many times before? What's the problem now…?"
"What I can do is chase after him when he's running away from me. But I don't know how to deal with him when he's approaching me…"
"…What in the world? Are you two playing some cruel game of tag?"
"I'm worried that I'll fail once again… That we'll be hurt even worse than before… And just like that, my legs refuse to move."
"It might sound weird… but up until this point, I could only feel at ease when Haruki-kun was running away from me."
"…It's weird, all right. Just like you said."
"If my feelings couldn't reach him, then we wouldn't be hurt any deeper. The pain from three years ago wouldn't repeat itself either."
"So if I could just watch him from a bit of a distance… Even though it'd be painful, I would still feel happy all the same, and that's why I could keep holding on."
"But whenever our distance closed a little, I couldn't help but want to be even closer to him."
"I was under the delusion that it was possible that he could belong to me and me alone."
"No, it's a delusion for sure. Haruki-kun will never be able to forget about Kazusa."
"When I realized that, my body just instinctively refused him…"
"That's what happened during Christmas… Do you understand now? That's why he shouldn't have any reason to like me anymore."
"…In that case, what do you plan to do?"
"What should I do, huh…? Hey, how about the four of us just stay together?"
"Haruki-kun with Takeya-kun, Takeya-kun with you, and you with me, Io. Just like that, we'd be together without being directly connected, wouldn't we?"
"…If that kind of indirect relationship is what you want, how about you go ahead?"
"Io, you'll keep being friends with us, right? With both Takeya-kun and me, I mean."
"If you think that after Haruki gets a girlfriend, has a family and children, and talks to us about his family, you can still be there talking with a smile, that is."
"Look at how shocked you are over a mere hypothetical statement… So was everything you just said a lie? Setsuna, you can only push yourself so far."
"In my opinion, if you just acted normally, I wouldn't have to be here saying this, you know?"
"During these past three years, over a hundred guys have approached you. If you had been moved by any of them or at least became friends with any of them, I wouldn't be saying this either."
"Okay, I'm going to call you out there. I said 'during these past three years'. Friends you made before that don't count."
"Why… Why are you being so mean, Io!?"
"I'm not wrong, and I didn't do anything wrong! Why can't you admit that!?"
"Because you are wrong. At least, I think you've got everything wrong right now, Setsuna."
"Listen, Setsuna. It's definitely Haruki's fault that you became all twisted like this."
"But if you can't be honest with yourself… If you don't use your own power to get a hold of yourself, your wish will never be granted, you know?"
"…That's about it. I'm sorry for saying some harsh things, but I won't apologize for pointing out your mistakes."
"Goodbye, then. After you calm your head a little, try to think it through again."
"Tell me that I haven't done anything wrong…"
"I really know that all of this is wrong! Still, I want someone to validate me! Someone, please tell me… that I'm absolutely right…!"
"…So it was just like that all along! Gimme another!"
"You're drinking too fast, Io. Drink or talk, you've got to choose one."
"Gah, we're all out of beer. You wouldn't happen to have any more in stock, would you, Haruki?"
"Go to sleep if you're drunk. That's the best outcome for my finances, as well as my physical and mental health."
An hour ago, Io called me and came over without a second thought when she found out Takeya was here, then nonchalantly drank all of the beer that we'd bought.
"Ugh, I feel so frustrated and pathetic. Where in the world did that innocent, three-year-streak Miss Houjou High beauty go to…?"
"That was just a false image to begin with."
"She was a touch too mischievous to be considered innocent."
"Despite that, she was stubborn and could be selfish at the strangest times. The same goes for her friendsーyou'd think she'd have plenty, yet she barely had any."
"And she actually gets scared pretty easily. During the school festival rehearsal, her legs wouldn't stop shaking and she couldn't even make a sound."
"But once she gets started, she's really strong. During the actual concert, she could sing with no problems in front of such a large crowd… Setsuna was amazing back then."
"That's enough, you two. Leave the past behind and stop reminiscing already. I'm talking about the current Setsuna."
It seems that the illusory glimpse of Setsuna I caught earlier really was her…
And from Io's perspective, Setsuna's regressed; she's become really weak.
"Hey, Haruki… haven't you tried to get in touch with Setsuna since that time?"
"Even though during the toll of the bell on New Year's Eve, you said, 'I still love you, Setsuna!' right in front of us."
"You don't need to describe it in such detail…"
At the same time, back then, I must have appeared unusually direct to everyone…
"…That was the last time. After that, I didn't try calling or texting her. Of course, neither did she."
"Why? You've already confessed, now's the time to set things in motion. Why aren't you taking the initiative?"
It's impossible to set things in motion so easily.
We're far too roundabout to push ahead simply because we like each other.
Because even though we like each other, it's still not enough. We've tried the same thing countless times already.
That's why, despite the fact that we both have feelings for each other, a simple reason like that isn't enough for us to draw close to one another.
Between Setsuna and me, there's a gap that's small, yet endlessly deep.
It seems like we could easily jump over it, but if we failed and fell down, we'd probably never be able to climb back up again.
"What are you going to do, then…? She's completely shut herself off."
"Just leave it at this for now… and until Setsuna asks for you two to support her, please don't force things. Just watch over her."
"Why? You want to go back to how it used to be, right? You want to make up with Setsuna-chan, right?"
"The problem is that we don't know if that's what Setsuna wants right now, too. I have a feeling even Setsuna herself isn't sure about what she wants."
"But the answer is clear as day, isn't it? She hasn't given up on the amazingly dense, unfaithful, terrible man that you've been for the past three years now."
"…In that case, you two are on my side, right? You would prioritize my feelings, wouldn't you?"
Though the way I'm saying this doesn't seem very friendly, now is not the time to pick on such details.
"That's wrong. We're on both your sides. We prioritize getting you two back together."
"Thank you… but whether that's good or bad for Setsuna is up to her to decide, right?"
"Besides… I'm the only one who can convince Setsuna right now."
"…And! Didn't I make that embarrassing confession while the New Year's bell was ringing in front of you two!?"
I know it's embarrassing to say this myself, but after hearing that, both of their faces turned red.
"If you had said that sooner, Haruki…"
"We wouldn't have had to jump through all those hoops…"
"…There's still a bottle of wine I use for cooking on that shelf."
It's past 2 o'clock, and we're out of booze…
Our eyelids are getting heavy, and our reactions have slowed down.
"After spring break, how about the four of us go somewhere to hang out?"
"Aah, sounds good. I'd like to go skiing. But I imagine someone here would probably hate it."
"In that case, there's the option of going along with that pretty girl with unusually old-fashioned tastes to the hot springs she likes so much."
"Once we're in our fourth year, we won't have so much free time. Since there's the graduation thesis and job-hunting coming up…"
This casual topic popped up amid the stagnating atmosphere around us…
Honestly, I couldn't wrap my mind around what they were talking about for a moment.
Or maybe I should say, I couldn't wrap my mind around who the four of us would include.
"It'd be nice… if we could go."
Because what I see right now is… just the three of us.
From right to left, Kazusa, Setsuna and myself.
It had been just a few minutes before we stepped onto the stage. A committee member took it, and it's the only photo we have that's not on-stage.
Setsuna wasn't holding a microphone, nor was Kazusa playing her keyboard, saxophone or bass.
Even though it was just a simple snapshot, I alone couldn't read the mood and tried to act cool…
Takeya's voice is finally becoming murky.
I look over to my bed and realize that Io had already seized it a long time ago.
For the first time in several years, I take the item that I'm holding in the photo into my arms.
This one's different from the one at school; it's just a cheap acoustic guitar.
"After all, it was just a tool I used to attract girls. I figure if I've got the time to practice now, I might as well go to mixers; it's much more efficient."
"You do seem to be the kind of guy who'd do that…"
When he asked me to join the club, it was for the exact same reason. In a way, this guy really hasn't strayed from his path until the end.
"Come to think of it, you said something weird back then…"
"Something about wanting to leave proof that you once attended that school. Thinking about it now, it sounds freaking hilarious… In fact, I'm pretty sure I laughed my ass off even back then."
Now that he mentions it, I may have indeed said that…
Back when I first started playing the guitar, or when I took an interest in writing lyrics, or when I held on and refused to let go of the club that was falling apart.
Or when I received hellish training during summer vacation, or when I forcefully dragged the songstress on board, or when I took the stage with less than a month of practice…
From the very beginning, it was all because of that reason, that immature attempt of mine to play tough.
"You… were always pretty terrible at this, but now that you're playing again after a hiatus, you sound like a total amateur."
"Quiet. I just haven't tuned it properly yet."
Just as Takeya said, I picked up this totally out-of-tune guitar and slowly started playing.
But it's not for that defiant reason from the past. In fact, it's very common for guys who take up the guitar to have a very simple and pure intention.
Because to us, the guitar is, after all…
Simply a tool we use to impress the girl we like, isn't it?
"Nagase Shouko-san…? I've never heard of her before."
"Hmm, we have a lot of students in the economics department. Maybe you could try asking at the Student Affairs office?"
"I already went there and asked, but I was told that there was no one with that name…"
"Then that just means she's just not here, doesn't it?"
"Still… she told me she was an economics department student herself…"
"In any case, I don't know her. Sorry I wasn't able to help you."
"No, it's fine… Thank you very much."
"Oh, well. I guess I'll give up for tod…"
"…What's the matter? You seem awfully disappointed."
"Eh? N-No, I'm really not… Hello there, Yanagihara-san."
"So what's going on? The peerless Ogiso Setsuna, all the way out here, so far from your own department's building? …Fishing for men now, are we?"
"…!? Not really. Sorry if I bothered you. I'll be leaving now."
"Ah, please just wait a second. It's rare seeing you here at Building 1, so let's chat for a bit, shall we?"
"I'm sorry, but I'm in a hurry…"
"Come on～ don't be like that. Aren't we upperclassman and underclassman of the same high school?"
"You were at Arumi Integral Hotel on Christmas Eve, right? And with a man, at that."
"Aaah～ So that rumor was true! Ooooh? So the unconquerable Ogiso Setsuna has finally found herself a special man, huh?"
"I wonder what he's like? He must not be your ordinary university student if he's to be considered a match for you, Ogiso-san."
"I suppose he's either a young businessman or some doctor or lawyer? Or perhaps even the scion of a wealthy family～?"
"Ah, wait a second! To tell you the truth, I was there at the same time. I was invited by someone I met during a photo shoot."
"I'm very sorry. I'm really in a hurry."
"Do you know who was with me? I imagine he's quite famous."
"Not at all, I don't care who you were with. Besides, I don't plan on talking to other people about it anyway…"
"…Hold on, what was all that supposed to mean? You just insulted me twice in that sentence, didn't you?"
"You mean to say that you're not interested in me at all, and you think I talk too much compared to you… Is that it?"
"N-Not at all… I never thought of you that way."
"…High and mighty as always, I see. You don't even want to talk with someone as low-class as me, huh?"
"I swear, you've constantly been looking down on others since back then! It pisses me off…"
"I'm sorry, I apologize, all right? So please, excuse me…"
"W-Wait a second! Are you seriously planning on ignoring me!?"
"Oh, no… it flipped over. Uwaah… it's such a mess now."
"…What do you intend to do about this? It fell because you hit it, Ogiso-san. Isn't that right?"
"I've finally got a hold of you! Hey, Izumi!"
"What in the world have you been up to with the way you've been skipping all your seminars and lectures!?"
I see the first thing you have to say to me is "Ah, crap," when you've realized that I'm the one calling you, huh…
"I messed up～ I should've hung up the moment I saw the incoming call."
"I've got so many things I want to say to you, but I'll cut to the chase. …Where are you right now?"
And the second thing she says is "I messed up," huh…
"If you had been coming to the lectures and seminars regularly, I might have let you do that."
Now that the thesis review was finished, the professors and upperclassmen all returned to the bustling Ogishima lab, making thesis recital their next goal.
A lot of people have gone through here this past week, with the exception of a certain student who hasn't showed up even once.
"The professor noticed it too. Since you at least showed up a few times last month…"
"Eh, um… that's right! You happened to dump me so heartlessly, Haruki, so I decided I'd go on a trip out of heartbreak…"
"…Oh, is that so? Just tell me where you are then, and I'll come chasing right after you."
"I'm just more open-minded now. But listen, even if it's a joke, don't use that kind of excuse."
I was planning on getting this over with quickly, but what she said was so close to what had really happened at the end of last year that it actually stung a bit.
…Besides, with the professors and upperclassmen around me, "I'll chase after you" was probably a little bit too much.
"I wasn't joking, though. I really think you've gotten stronger, Haruki. I'm sure you won't waver in your beliefs anymore."
Even though it sounds sarcastic, I'm grateful from the bottom of my heart.
If I can hold onto my beliefs now, then without a doubt, it's thanks to Izumi.
"Hmm, you're more like the main character with the way you are now, Haruki. Yeah, you might be able to get that happy ending now."
"Right, back to my original question, where are you now? If you're really on a trip, I'll seriously drag you back. And of course, nothing will happen during that trip."
"I'm close by. In fact, I'm inside the university."
I thought she would shrug it off with a joke, but she answered honestly, somehow making it hurt even more.
"Well, show up, then. Since your paper passed, isn't this a waste?"
"There's an exam after next week, you know? Are you even preparing for it?"
"Well, I can help you out with preparing for the exam. Since you helped me out a lot too…"
"No matter how hard you try to cheer me on, I'll still feel pain when my feelings are hurt."
Izumi seems off today… No, she's been acting really strangely recently.
She's no longer that friend I couldn't see as a woman. She's no longer that carefree person who's always smiled and relied on me.
"I'll start attending the seminar again in April. So I want you to leave me alone for a while."
"That's why… when that time comes, please take care of me again… Senpai."
"Well, you see… it's kind of a pain to explain it."
The current Izumi isn't the person I've known up until now.
"The way I see it, university is just a place for me where I need to get enough credits to graduate."
"…I'm not sure I completely understand what you just said."
She's withheld that lazy tone of hers…
Instead, she's delivering her words with a vigor that suggests a sense of optimism on her end, somehow, even though the way she's actually explaining herself is rather nonchalant.
"People who gather here all have different goals in their lives. You can't say for sure that the only path possible is for everyone to move onto the next grade and graduate."
"The very fact that you're actually talking to me about your life and your goals right now is difficult for me to digest…"
Izumi seems to be even more confusing and ambiguous, even when she finally seems persuasive for once.
I really want to ask just how little faith she has in me…
"…Of course you don't get it. Not when you only know the Izumi Chiaki in your head…"
"In that case, please speak in a way that I can understand."
"Well, I guess… How about I tell you everything at the end of March? Will two sheets of paper be enough?"
"That's enough, Izumi… It just means that we aren't close enough for me to understand what you're saying, right?"
"The one thing I do know is that you're living your life to its fullest now. …Right?"
"If you ask me, I haven't wasted a single day of my university life, you know?"
"…That's quite hard to believe, but I'll take your word for it."
Izumi's optimistic demeanor is something that's completely different from what I'm used to seeing from her up until now, and it provides me with the slightest sense of relief.
And the way she's uncharacteristically putting me at a distance also gives me the slightest feeling of loneliness.
"That's about it, Haruki. See you in spring."
"When winter comes to an end, right?"
The last sentence Izumi mumbled should've meant the same thing as the one before.
But the way she worded it made me feel a special kind of encouragement from her.
…Then again, maybe it's just an embarrassing misunderstanding on my part.
"When winter comes to an end, huh…"
I have to put the winter to an end this time. And with it, I must call upon spring.
I feel that was what she was trying to say somehow.
"Thank you for waiting. Here are the mixed pizza, honey toast, iced coffee, and oolong tea."
"Alright～! Please put everything except the oolong tea onto this side～"
"It's here, it's here～! Alright, time to relax and start eating～!"
"We could've just gone to a regular restaurant instead of a place like this…"
"Well, it's not that… It's just that I don't come here often."
"So you don't like to be in a place where commoners have fun? Really, every single sentence that comes out of your mouth sounds condescending…"
"N-No…! I used to come here all the time before. I really did. It's just…"
"Well, whatever. I should really be eating right now, though. My meal's way overdue at this point, after all."
"I'm sorry. I really didn't mean to make you drop your bento box…"
"You really are a troublemaker. Well～ I'm hungry."
"What? I won't share, got it? If you want some, just order something yourself."
"Ah, that's not it… I was just wondering if you make your own bento box every day."
"In order to keep my body in shape, I must pay the price. The food served when eating out is too high in calories."
"Is that so… That's amazing. I never really paid attention to things like that."
"…You have a body like that without even caring, huh."
"You truly are blessed in more ways than one, Ogiso Setsuna. I even have to skip dinner because of this little outing!"
"In that case, you shouldn't be eating this…"
"Um, then… I think it's about time I go. I'll pay at the desk on my way out, okay?"
"Well, I mean… isn't this me repaying you for ruining your lunch?"
"You think just paying for my food is enough!? You can't even keep me company until I finish!?"
"Because… it feels like I'm sitting on pins and needles here…"
"I swear, you must have been born naturally arrogant. Ever since high school, you've always…"
"I don't really recall speaking to you in high school or anything…"
"During Miss Houjou High and in the Light Music Club, you were always there to one-up me, and now you have the nerve to say something like that…"
"Always trampling on others in order to stand out… Even my debut was late because of you."
"O-Oh yeah, I heard you were releasing a DVD soon, right? Congratulations."
"That's just a stepping stone. I want to become a host on a TV show after I graduate. That's why I fought for the title of Miss Houjou."
"Is that so… Yanagihara-san, you have a clear goal for your future. That's amazing."
"You're a year above me, and you're graduating next year, so what's your plan?"
"I just told you my plans for the future, so now it's your turn to tell me yours."
"I don't have any. I can't see anything in my future."
"You're trying to hide things again… Perhaps you're trying to move a step ahead of me again? Maybe you really are aiming for the same field I'm aiming for…"
"No, it's not like that. I don't have any plans, really."
"That's why it's pointless to ask me now. Because I don't particularly enjoy doing anything."
"What is this… Are you really the Ogiso Setsuna I know? How could the woman I've never once defeated fall so low?"
"Don't screw around with me! A woman like you doesn't even deserve pity! Just how long do you plan to make a fool of me…!?"
"Why won't you say anything? Even at this point, you're still keeping silent?"
"I'm very sorry I didn't meet your expectations. But I really am this kind of person now… I'm not worthy of being seen as your rival."
"If you can't put it into words, why don't you put it in a song?"
"Just like on the stage during the high school festival, when you shamelessly let your short skirt flutter around～"
"All of the guys present seemed to have their gazes locked on you back then. That's just cheating, you know～"
"Come on, isn't this supposed to be your specialty? Aren't you excited to sing like back then?"
"All right, time to start singing～ Ogiso Setsuna-san's White Album!"
"Ah! H-Hey! Why did you stop it?"
"It doesn't matter if you sing it poorly. It's not like anyone other than me is going to hear."
"No… I just really can't sing anymore."
"I don't ever want to stand in such a bright place again… It's simply too blindingly bright for someone like me now."
"Hng! Y-You, are you… Are you really the Ogiso Setsuna that I know!?"
"…Last, but not least, even though it's only been a short while, you've done a great deal helping me out, everyone. Thank you all very much."
As I finish my speech, I slightly bow my head and receive a warm applause.
"Hey, Kitahara-san～ Do you really have to leave～?"
"Ahh… Now the weekends are gonna be like hell again… I was hoping you could stay until we got more people."
And at the same time, the complaints start pouring out toward me.
It's currently 5 PM. It's a point in the evening where both the morning shift and the evening shift are present.
Deciding that it would be a good time given that most of the staff is present, I announced that I would be resigning from my position at Goodies.
However, since it's still during business hours, I could only invite a few of the core employees for a small-scale meeting.
"It'd be great if you could just be present here. If you're around to watch us, everyone works at least 20% harder."
"Ah～ that's a great idea. For example, just be a customer who stays here to spectate from dawn till dusk."
"No way, that would make me an unbearable customer."
"But it could work. And no one would have any complaints… because they'd be too scared."
"I know, right? Imagine a customer that even the acting manager doesn't dare deal with…"
"What do you guys take me for…?"
"Okay, okay, everyone. Remember we're still in the middle of business hours. Let's finish bidding our farewells and get back to work quickly!"
Just then, the newest employee here drags the two clingy managers away from me.
…Even though this was something intended for the core employees, the newest one, Sugiura, just waltzes in nonchalantly.
"B-But… won't you be lonely, Koharucchi? The one who raised you is leaving you behind, you know."
"Senpai is busy. Starting in April, he'll be in his last year of university. Also, please don't address me so casually."
"W-Wait a second, don't push me so hard… K-Kitahara-san, take care～!"
