The newcomer not only chased the managers out of the office, but even dealt them the final blow. I'm at a loss for words.
…It's almost like I'm looking at my former self.
This cheeky, stubborn, brutal newcomer stares at me without even blinking…
"Thank you for everything you've shown me so far, I am very grateful. Thank you for your hard work!"
I don't know why, but I find myself bowing very politely.
…Something is very wrong with the hierarchy of this place.
"Even though the managers said all that, Senpai, you don't need to worry about this restaurant any longer."
"Because it's been settled already that I'll be able to take over and handle your job perfectly after you're gone."
"I thought you said it was just a short-term part-time job to save up money for your graduation trip?"
And what's with the "it's been settled already" part?
"Well, let's just say it's a long story… but I'll still be working here after April."
For one reason or another, on the day I've decided to quit, I could clearly imagine the restaurant closing down…
Since Sugiura is so responsible, tearful pleading must have proved an effective strategy on her… After it had failed on me, that is.
"That's why you don't need to worry about this place, Senpai. Please focus on finding a job, writing your graduation thesis… and other things."
Hearing the emphasis that she put on "other things," I realized that Sugiura was sincerely trying to encourage me.
Up until now, she's held numerous responsibilities in different communities…
And she will most likely have to take on a new responsibility here in this restaurant, as well.
"I don't really understand why you're apologizing."
And that's probably… for the sake of a certain someone who won't be showing up here anymore.
"Is that so… Yada-san is going to school properly, after all."
"It was just a temporary shock that she needed to recover from. I went out with her several times during winter break."
It's been ten minutes since the managers were chased out.
This cheeky newcomer is still sitting in the branch manager's office, and it doesn't seem like she's planning on going back to work anytime soon.
"I truly apologize for everything I've done. I just wish I'd worded some things more carefully…"
"You did the right thing by being frank with her. Things would've only ended up dragging out otherwise. …And this goes not just for Mihoko."
But since I no longer work here, I don't have the right to complain about her skipping work.
After all, I'm far from thinking about ending this conversation myself.
"Also, Mihoko and I have already received our recommendations. We'll actually become your underclassmen starting next spring, Senpai."
If you're aiming for the Literature Department, you should know that "We'll be Senpai's underclassman soon" makes no sense. Though I won't be so boorish as to actually point that out.
…I've learned enough about female psychology the past few days to know better than that.
"Well, after you guys enroll, I'll let you have my notes. I know it sounds weird coming from me, but it should help on your exams."
"I'm happy that you brought it up… but I'd like to try my best and see how it goes first. If I find that I can't handle it, then I'll ask for help."
"I'll leave you my notes exactly because you're this type of person. Congratulations on graduating, Sugiura."
"Thank you very much. Starting from spring, please take care of me, Senpai."
After everything we've been through up until now, Sugiura says that and… gives me the most adorable smile I've ever seen on her face so far.
"I'm supposed to be home before sunset. But you…"
"What about me? You ruined my bento box. You didn't even sing the song I requested. What a terrible day."
"Hey, how about we go and grab a drink now? I still haven't heard about what happened during Christmas. Who was that man you were with then?"
"As if… As if I'd talk about that."
"Even though I already told you so many things about myself? You're not being fair at all～!"
"Yanagihara-san, you're the one who keeps going on and on. You even got mad when I refused to listen."
"Anyway, let's head toward Asadabashi. A girl from my agency recommended a place. The atmosphere there is grea…"
"Spare me already… please! Did I really do something that terrible to you?"
"…What do you want me to spare you from? Are you implying I'm being too mean to you?"
"Why do your answers always sound so indecisive…? If you hate me, just say it. If you don't make it clear that you have a quarrel with me, I can't get serious either, you know?"
"Come on, try saying it. Say that you hate people like me more than anything. …I've been waiting for you to say that for some time now."
"Y-You… Just what kind of grudge do you hold against me…?"
"Hey～ hey～ you two! Wanna go hang out somewhere?"
"Both of you are very refined. Are you two celebrities? Or some sort of models?"
"Eh～? No way! Do we really look like that～?"
"How about we hang out together? We have a car, so… we can go anywhere you'd like, yeah?"
"No, it's fine. I'm planning on going home now."
"Don't be like that! The night is still young! There shouldn't be any problems, let's go～!"
"We can grab some drinks somewhere～ Or we could go to a karaoke box～ Ah, the atmosphere at the beach during winter is pretty nice as well～"
"All right then, we'll take you home. Come on, get in, get in!"
"We were actually planning on getting some dinner now. There's a great place around Asadabashi."
"You sure can talk, missy. We can make it there in fifteen minutes."
"Well, which car is yours～? Just so you know, I don't plan on getting into some gaudy vehicle, got it?"
"No problem, no problem, it's a one-box. You'll have plenty of space."
"What now～? Don't make such a gloomy expression～"
"No, we can't follow them this easily. We don't even know who these guys are or where they're from."
"…Why are you holding on to those old-fashioned values? It's like you're a granny or something."
"B-But… for a girl to do this alone…"
"What are you saying? Obviously you'll be coming with us, right?"
"Or what? Are you telling me to go along alone? …With these two men who we don't even know?"
"Here, right here, right here. Come, get in～"
"Whoa～! It's brand new! How much was it?"
"Around 3.5 million yen… We just got it last month."
"Come on, Setsuna, Setsuna! You sit in the back! I'll ride shotgun～!"
"Ooh～! So you're Setsuna-chan, huh? All right, hop in."
"Mari-san, the proofreading is done. I've marked the parts I changed in red."
"Ah, sorry. Could you please just put it in the to-do box?"
"I'm finished here too～! Damn it, I couldn't beat Kitahara-kun to the punch today either～"
"No, the amount you have to handle is completely different from what a part-timer like me has to work with, Suzuki-san."
"Well, I suppose you do have a point, but…"
"Oh, it's quite different indeed. Kitahara did fifteen pages, while Suzuki did twelve."
"…Thanks for just making me feel worse. I finally understand how Macchan feels now!"
"…No, simple work like this isn't really a gauge of our skill as editors."
This is my fifth time coming to Kaiousha for my part-time job since New Year's.
"Well, let's leave that aside for now… Will that do for today, Mari-san?"
"Yeah, let's finish up around here. Thanks for your hard work. I'll stop here today as well. …And thank you too, Kitahara."
It's already been a month since we had that embarrassing conversation…
Right after New Year's, whenever we saw each other, our faces always turned bright red, but I guess we've gotten past it.
"Now I can finally leave carefree next week. Might as well book the ticket tomorrow."
"Yeah, pretty much. I've got a lot of work to do there, too. I'll probably have to stay for at least half a month this time."
As for Mari-san, she just came back from Guam at the beginning of the year, though she needs to go to America again in less than a month.
"Putting it like that isn't wrong, but it's not right either… Saying that I love it from the bottom of my heart would be correct."
"If you could just use 10% of that passion on romance, you could get any man in an instant…"
Just like Suzuki-san says, Mari-san doesn't leave any openings for men to approach her at all right now.
Even though she's so capable and beautiful… it's such a waste.
"…What? Why are you staring at me too, Kitahara?"
"If you want to say something, just come out and say it. You guys always treat me like a fool… What's wrong with falling in love with your work, huh?"
"Um… can we really just come out and say it?"
"Okay, how about… 'She's so capable and beautiful, too. What a shame.'?"
"Whoa, Kitahara-kun, that was way too direct!"
"Weren't you the one who started it though, Suzuki-san? I just followed along."
"That's not the problem here. You should tread more lightly, boy! I can't tell if you're just dense, a feminist, or just a terrible man, but you're gonna suffer if you keep that up…"
"Ca-Calm… Calm down… He already has a girl he likes…"
"But you seem like you've changed a little since New Year's, don't you think, Kitahara-kun?"
The three of us left the Kaiousha Building and started walking home earlier than usual, and Suzuki-san just wouldn't stop talking the whole time.
"You've become a bit more cheerful, I guess? Or perhaps I should say you're not as reserved around us anymore?"
"What do you mean, more cheerful? Is it that fun to make fun of your boss? Always making a fool of me…"
Rather than being more reserved, it's better to say that there's no longer a wall dividing me from them.
"What? Did something happen during winter break? Did you get a girlfriend and have many first experiences?"
"But I did become a little more optimistic."
"I've realized that I have to take action for things to change… Like 'It's so stupid to give up after I've come so far,' I started thinking like that…"
"I-Is that so… It's like that, huh…"
I just said that in such a carefree way, so I do believe that I've changed a little.
After all, I was never the type to engage in frivolous talk like this; I was always someone who avoided it and lectured others instead.
"Well, a lot of things did happen during winter break. That's how I ended up like this. But rather than what happened then, it's more thanks to the people who encouraged me afterward."
"What? What does that mean? Kitahara-kun, did you really hook up with a girl?"
…And one of the people who encouraged me strikes me with a glare, perhaps not hearing all that I just said.
"Well then, I'll take my leave now. I probably won't be coming for a while, so everyone, please take care of yourselves."
"Hey, when's the next time you'll be coming? Will you be with us again right after your exams?"
"For now… I'm not really sure yet. There's something that I have to deal with immediately."
"There's something you have to deal with immediately… Does that mean you're not planning to come until after you're hired?"
"No, it's something even more important than getting hired."
"Um, you see… What I want to say is…"
"Say, how about we grab a drink together? It'd be our little celebration to bid Kitahara-kun farewell and to wish Mari-san a safe trip. Come on, it won't take long."
"…Is what you want to say… right, Mari-san?"
"But I'm very sorry, I really have to leave for today."
"Why? You have to start studying already? Isn't your exam the week after next?"
"That's a secret. Now, if you'll excuse me…"
Even though I'm thankful for their consideration…
There's something very important I have to do right now.
That's why even though I used up my savings and had to bow my head before my mother to ask for money, I have to prioritize that thing above everything else.
That's right… At the very least, I have to do it before winter comes to an end.
"…How about the two of us go and grab a drink?"
"Suzuki… are you misunderstanding something? It's not like I'm sad or anything…"
"Who cares if I'm misunderstanding or not. I can stay with you until tomorrow morning, alright?"
"…I'm sorry. It'll be my treat tonight."
"Ah, right around here. Stop the car, stop～!"
"Eh, here? There's nothing around here though, is there?"
"Didn't you say it was around Asadabashi? There's still a ways to go there, you know?"
"Thanks for taking me home～ You were a great help～"
"W-Wait a second, that's not what you said, though? Didn't you say we were going to eat dinner?"
"I'm sorry～ I just remembered I've got something to do. Besides, I'm the type who doesn't eat dinner. So I wasn't planning on eating in the first place～"
"Wh-What's going on Tomo-chan? Why are you so cold all of a sudden? Things are just starting to get exciting, you know."
"Yeah, that's right. If you don't want to eat, we can just drive around. We'll be lonely if you just leave, you know?"
"Ah～ you don't have to worry about that. …Setsuna will keep you guys company from now on."
"Eh-heh～? Well, we're fine with that, but won't Setsuna-chan be lonely in that case?"
"Well, I guess. But she just broke up with her boyfriend recently. …So I was hoping you two could comfort her a little."
"Is that so～ poor girl… It must be hard on you, Setsuna-chan."
"That's about it, so thanks for everything～ I'll leave the rest to you, yeah? See you～"
"M-Me too! I need to go home! I have to go home now!"
"Eh～ but Setsuna, you can't get out here even if that's the case. Your house is in the opposite direction."
"Bye bye～ Hope everyone enjoys themselves. …Goodbye, Ogiso Setsuna-chan."
"Whoa there～! Setsuna-chan, you can't just get out of the car here, you know?"
"I see～! So that's why you were so down since the beginning. We'll hear you out, but let's find a different spot first, okay?"
"Come on, it'll be fine, now, won't it? Let's go crazy and forget about those annoying things, what do you say?"
"No, it's not like that! That's not what I want!"
"It's fine, let's just go first. We'll talk as we go."
"You girls are the ones who wanted to get in our car. If the two of you don't stay with us, we'll be troubled."
"Noo… Stop, let me go… I don't want this…!"
"Like I said～ you don't have to be so scared～!"
"Just forget about the man you broke up with and… Hm?"
"Sorry～! I was lying earlier. Come on, Setsuna, let's go home."
"W-What? Wait a second, what's the meaning of this!?"
"To tell you the truth, we were having a bit of a quarrel. So I decided to play a prank on her. Come on, Setsuna, hurry and get out of the car."
"W-Wait! Come on, we've already come this far!"

"We might start taking desperate measures in resisting you guys if you keep being persistent, you know? It'd be a shame if that new car of yours got some scratches, now, wouldn't it? Ever done this? You take a 100 yen coin and begin scratching like this…!"
"Just as the white snow softly fills the city's streets～♪"
"Let's fill all of the empty white pages of our album～♪"
"Eh… or was it the second one?"
"…Ugh, you're so annoying. Haven't you cried enough already?"
"Isn't it fine now? Didn't I save you?"
"I-I… I… If they drove off with me…!"
"I'm telling you, it's fine～! I took a picture of their license plate and sent it to my friends. Even if they tried to abduct me too, the cops would have been notified already."
"My shoulder… he touched it over and over…"
"That's not a big deal, now, is it? You were always being targeted by all the guys after all, Ogiso-san."
"How sheltered of a woman are you… Wait, are you being serious?"
"Hey, are you happy now? Does messing with me like that make you happy?"
"Quiteーthe best fun I've had in a while…"
"Because I'll never stop hating you, Ogiso Setsuna. That's why I won't miss the moment when you completely fall apart."
"B-But why…? What did I do to make you hate me this much…?"
"Ah, speaking of which, I just remembered… The one you cried out for just now was Haruki-kun… wasn't it?"
"That upperclassman from the Light Music Club called Kitahara… His first name was Haruki, wasn't it?"
"Wasn't he the one who dumped you three years ago? That rumor's spread already, you know? Even in our grade."
"…Hey, what's the matter? You still haven't gotten over being dumped three years ago?"
"That's unbelievable… This is 'The' Ogiso Setsuna? That's all it takes to bring you down?"
"…What do you mean, 'that's all it takes'?"
"Even though you say that I look down on others, you're the one that keeps doing it, aren't you?"
"There, that expression! You always look down on others like that…"
"Have you ever even suffered over a relationship with the way you've been living your life all this time? Have you ever actually had feelings for another person before!?"
"Come on, what's so funny… You've been smirking since the beginning… What the hell is so funny!?"
"That's it, that's it, come back at me like this! You're not the type of woman who goes down without a fight… if you're still the Ogiso Setsuna I know."
"It's about time you stop making a fool out of me…"
"These three years since I graduated from high school… I've been living such a boring everyday life."

"Going to university without any goal or aspiration, rejecting invitations from friends over and over again… No, there's only a handful of people who can even be called my friends in the first place."

"I'm just going back and forth between university and my home, and I don't even have a job. I don't know what to do even if I go out, so I just stay home, but then my brother jokes about me being a shut-in…"
"That's why, every now and then, I lie and tell everyone I'm going on a date, then go and watch a movie by myself…"
"Because I hate being hit on by men, I deliberately wear plain clothes, braid my hair, and put on glasses…"
"I endure the boredom and kill time until evening, drinking when I don't even want to, going home drunk, pretending that our relationship is great…"
"Shut up! It is, okay!? I know it's disgusting! Of course I know that!"
"Just thinking about one person all this time… I know it's depressing! And even if he does pay attention to me, I can't accept it… It's like I'm schizophrenic or something!"
"Someone like you… Someone like you could never possibly understand how I feel!"
"Of course I wouldn't understand. Not the heart of such a disgusting woman, no."
"Ehehe… This is some great stuff～ So this is the true self of the former Houjou idolーOgiso Setsuna!"
"No man could have ever imagined that you have demons that are so dark, gloomy and disgusting. I wonder what everyone would think if they knew the truth?"
"…Well, why don't you go and spread the word? Unlike me, you seem to love running your mouth."
"Who in their right mind would believe me if I said something like this? If anything, I'd be the one taking the heat. Everyone would think that I'm making up lies because I'm jealous."
"Well, wouldn't that be great… After all, that's the true face of the current Houjou idolーYanagihara Tomo!"
"…Finally, you finally called me by my name, Tomo, huh?"
"I hate the way you keep calling me 'Ogiso Setsuna.'"
"That's great news. I kept doing that on purpose just so you would hate me."
"Well, it's about time you took a taxi home. You live at Suetsugu-chou, right?"
"You even know that… It's like you're a stalker."
"Well, it's not too close or too far, right? Come on, let's walk to the main street."
As the cotton stick soaked in disinfectant touched the tips of my fingers, my face twisted as a result of the sharp pain.
I've had to go through this process almost every day for the past week and I still haven't gotten used to the pain yet.
Despite the transparent medicine on them, my fingers are still red and swollen, and I can't help but let out a sigh at how pathetic I am.
Back then, I could last two to three days before I needed this. At worst, I could last over twenty hours.

My wrist has become weaker due to the lack of practice, and my skin has become more fragile… These factors put together make me realize the awful truth. I sigh once again and flinch in pain when air reaches my fingers.
Will I be able to return to my prime at this rate?
Even when I was at my prime, I wasn't that amazing, so now I'm just a terrible beginner.
…Who am I kidding. I didn't really have a choice but to lament and not take any initiative up until last year.
The way I am now, I might complain about the pain on my fingers, but after that, I'll just put a bandage over them and keep practicing as if nothing happened.
…At the very least, I have to cross this first hurdle today.
Just as I finish preparing, at the perfect time… or rather, the worst possible time, something interrupts me.
My cell phone that's on the charger starts ringing and vibrating, as if to urge me to pick up the call.
I carefully pick up the phone in a way so as to not hurt my bandaged fingers and answer the call without looking at the caller ID.
After all, in the past few days, Takeya has been the only one to call me, either to offer his support and advice or to try to cheer me up…
"You're annoying! Don't call so late at night!"
"Idiot, idiot, idiot… Haruki-kun… Haruki-kun, you… idiot…"
"Why are you apologizing…? I'm the one who called you first, and I said something terrible, so why are you apologizing!?"
Setsuna is obviously very drunk right now.

"Even though I dumped you, you're still there bowing your head and apologizing, saying that you still love me, that you still haven't given up on me…! You're irritating me so much right now, Haruki-kun!"
The usual overbearing restraint and reluctance is gone, and instead, I'm faced with an equally overbearing outburst of all her bottled-up emotions.
"And then, when I was in pain, you didn't do anything for me… I swear, I swear, you're so absolutely worthless!"
"Did something happen? Could you please tell me?"
And that's when I realize this is a side of Setsuna I've seen quite recently; her troublesome side, one that's three times more selfish than usual, even over the phone.
"Why didn't you come to save me…? Even though I called… Even though I called for you over and over!"
"I… It's your fault, it's all your fault… that a man other than you touched me! It was so terrifying it made my hair stand on end!"
"I'm thinking about ripping him to shreds."
"Liar… You're saying that in such an indifferent tone… Just imagining your uncaring face makes me want to cry again…!"
I'm not lying, though. My cell phone is just about to crack because of how hard I'm gripping it.
But I can't let myself get swept away by emotions. I still don't have the right to do this in front of Setsuna.
"I've had enough… Why do I have to keep enduring all this pain?"
She must be like this because of the alcohol.
And at the same time, she must have had an unpleasant encounter today.
"It's your fault, Haruki-kun… You're always so close, yet so far from me…"
It's likely that when she sobers up after waking up tomorrow, her reddened face from just a few hours ago will turn ghastly pale, and she'll definitely feel terribly regretful about calling me.
"You won't run away, but you won't approach me either… It's because you're always following my whims and doing exactly what I want you to…"
But now, I'm thankful for that glass and bottle of wine that's with her. And I'm even thankful for that unpleasant encounter, because it led her to reach out to me.
…Though I really want to get my hands on that disgusting man.
Because ever since New Year's Eve, I haven't once heard Setsuna's voice until now.
Because in the past three years, Setsuna never once yelled at me like this.
"I didn't do anything wrong at all… you know?"
This is the same Setsuna whose purity I stole. The same Setsuna whom I so heartlessly destroyed.
This is the real Setsuna, whom I erased from the world.
"Because you betrayed me, you tricked me… As a result, I became such a gloomy and disgusting woman… you know?"
My tears are threatening to spill out from this nostalgia. Noーthey already are.
I've been hoping for a day when Setsuna could be like this without relying on alcohol, hoping that I could see Setsuna like this once again.
I want her to be selfish. I want her to be self-centered. I want her to put me on the spot.
I want her to have me spoil her like a fool.
As for everything I've lost… and everything that was lost because of me, I want to take it all back.
"Say… something. Scold me, yell at me…"
"The Haruki-kun who doesn't point out others' faults isn't the real Kitahara Haruki at all…!"
"Um… it's not a big deal. It's just that I'd like to call you with my home phone."
"…Why can't you do it with your cell phone?"
"You say that now, but the truth is, you won't call back, will you!? …You don't want to talk to me anymore, do you!?"
"You'll turn your cell phone off, then pull the cable out of your home phone…!"
"Of course not. How could I even bring myself to do that…?"
"How many times have you already betrayed me!? How many times have you avoided me, always keeping your distance!?"
"I don't believe you… I absolutely… absolutely… won't hang up!"
"…Just this time. Just this once, please believe me."
"Just because you tell me that… doesn't mean my worries will go away…!"
"At least stop to consider that for a second…!"
"Sorry… my home phone is the only one with a handsfree function."
Through the speaker mode of my home phone, I can hear Setsuna on the other side.
But since the quality of the sound is terrible, I can't tell if she's sighing, laughing or crying, at all.
But compared to the feeling of sadness and insecurity from a moment ago, this is completely different.
"I just started playing again last week, so I'm still pretty terrible at the moment…"
"But… you were never really that great to begin with."
As I grip the string with my right hand, I can still feel the pain.
Thanks to these few days' "ten hours per day" practice sessions, the first layer of my skin has already peeled off, to the point where my nerves feel completely exposed.
Even though I'm going to be a fourth year student soon. Even though I should be looking for a job soon. Even though I have final exams soon…
What the hell am I doing?
"What are you doing, Haruki-kun… It's almost time for exams."
"Yeah, I'm an idiot. And it's pointless."
But comparing this Setsuna, who's at a loss for words, with the Setsuna from before, there are some obvious differences.
Her words are no longer emotionally charged, her temper has calmed down, and I can barely hear her.
"I… love you so much. But I also hate you so much…"
"I love you, Setsuna. And I suppose that's about it."
"After all, Haruki-kun… I know everything there is to know about you…"
It's 8:20. I enter the front gates of the university today, punctually, as always.
I woke up at 6:30 AM, took a hot shower, got dressed, ate my breakfast, and then slowly made other preparations before leaving my room, as I always do.
Such is the unchanging cycle of my life that I've been maintaining for the past three years.
Another normal Monday. Another instance of the first day beginning the cycle of another new week.
…At least, that's what it was supposed to be.
"I have no right to judge others if this is what I'm like… It's like I'm a stalker."
"I'm sorry. It seems I've startled you."
Setsuna ran back into her department building, and her defenseless back faced toward me.
Perhaps it's better to say that it's difficult for me to have not noticed her.
She's behaving exactly the same way as Io reported on the phone a few days ago, after all.
…I'm pretty sure that the people around us are quite bewildered by her behavior right now.
After all, the unusually well-known name of "Ogiso Setsuna" is associated with "that third-year Public Policy student who doesn't belong to any club."
We're also in Building 3. This is the Literature Department's building, which is located on the exact opposite side to where the Public Policy Department's building is on the southern edge.
…Actually, I don't think I even need to ask.
"Uh, um… About last Friday night… I'm so sorry!"
"I don't think you need to apologize for anything."
I knew the real reason Setsuna was here the moment I saw her.
"I… I… want to pretend it never happened.
So, um… please take this as a token of my apology."
She forces a paper bag into my hands, and it feels like there's a little box inside.
She still hasn't changed, always so formal with these things. It's most likely fruit sent from the countryside or something.
"Honestly, I don't know how I should apologize…"
Her reaction after waking up from that night is pretty much exactly as I expected it would be.
"When I woke up in the morning, I realized that there was an empty wine bottle next to me… My head hurt so much that I couldn't get out of bed for the whole day."
Her face is pale, cold sweat is dripping from her skin, and her vision wanders as she attempts to apologize to me.
"That was terrible of me… You didn't do anything wrong, Haruki-kun, and yet I…"
Because what she's doing is so cute, and because she's behaving exactly as I expected, I can't help but smile.
To be honest, the way Setsuna used to avoid me was actually bad for me.
We're able to talk again after half a month now, all because of the fact that she got drunk.
We're actually capable of seeing each other for the first time in a month all because Setsuna snapped at me.
That's why I have something to tell Setsuna…
…But the sight of Setsuna's expression made me realize that it would've come off as way too conceited.
"You hit a bunch of nails on the head. So it did hurt a little."
I've realized that even though she's apologizing now, the drunk Setsuna from before is much more representative of the true feelings in her heart.
"But could you please forget about it? Because that's not how I really felt…"
"Well, I was hoping that that was how you truly felt."
The more I accept what happened that night, the more fearful and apologetic Setsuna looks…
"Why do you think that way, Haruki-kun?"
Yet contrary to her words and expression, she can't resist prying further.
"Because if it's like that, then I can work harder."
"Because if I'm currently the worst, I can try my best to become better."
Setsuna must have hoped for this deep down.
She hoped that I could change.
"And then, this time, just maybe, I can become a man that you won't reject, Setsuna…"
She'd hoped that I would be able to change myself for the better after I couldn't bring myself to destroy our existing relationship.
"That's why I won't forget the things that happened the day before yesterday, and I'll continue to care about what you said. I'll try not to make you want to say it ever again, Setsuna."
"How could you… How could you do that for someone like me…?"
"These are just assumptions I've made up on my own. I'm simply doing my best to make you like me regardless of how you feel."
"That's why I won't listen to your opinion, Setsuna. No matter what, I won't do as you say."
Setsuna lets out an expression that… basically amounts to her lips opening ever so slightly.
It's as if she's trying to ask for or answer something, only for her sense of reason to stop her by the thinnest margin.
I'm sure that the words that she almost spilled out would have contained her true feelings.
"Setsuna, I want you to go on thinking whatever terrible things you want. I want you to think of me as the worst guy you've ever known."
"How could I…? I can't bring myself to do that."
"…Well, I suppose you're free to decide not to listen to me, just like I chose not to for you."
"…Well then, it's about time for me to go to my lecture."
But I won't ask for an answer immediately. As long as it's before "winter comes to an end," it's fine.
As I turn my back on Setsuna and look down the hall, I immediately realize that numerous people are staring at us.
As I start walking, their gazes start to follow me and the person behind me, and they proceed to give us funny looks.
This is bad… Even I'm well aware of how popular Setsuna is at this university.
Just as I was thinking about how not to make things any worse…
"Le-Let… me hear it once again! Your guitar, Haruki-kun… Please let me hear it again!"
She didn't even notice the people around staring at us, so she said it a little too loudly.
"Th-That, huh… um. Sure. But let me get a little better at it first…"
"It's fine even if you're not that great! It's fine even if you miss notes! Just please, let me listen to you practice every day!"
"Yes! Every day! Brag to me about how you improve slowly but surely!"
"You have to do it! It's a promise, right!?"
Well then, I guess it's impossible to hide anymore…
Setsuna stared straight at me and waved her hand at me with an undeniably happy expression before she left the building with a skip in her step.
Although my situation so far this term has already been grim, I'm now in a truly hopeless situation, but I still manage to let out a dry laugh.
Because I've made a new promise with her. I'm allowed to talk to her every day.
I've managed to share something with her that we're both happy about.
There's nothing that could make me happier than this.
And then I found yet another surprise. Another thing that would make me happy.
Inside the bag that she handed me was a handmade bento box from her.
"A bento box. I made it when I woke up early today."
"Last week, I accidentally made you drop your bento. So I wanted to make it up to you no matter what."
"I already made sure to calculate the calories. …If anything, it might actually be less than it should be."
"Why are you doing this? No matter what you do, I'll still hate you, you know?"
"…I feel the same way. But that's exactly why I don't want to owe you anything."
"I won't apologize for the things I did after we went to karaoke. We both hurt each other about the same, and I also felt terrible about it all."
"I had plenty of fun myself, though."
"…! Well, even so… the bento box incident was my fault entirely. That's why I want to put an end to everything with this."
"You said you wanted to see me fall with your own eyes, but I won't let you see that happen. …No, I don't plan to fall at all anymore."
"…Did something happen between you and Haruki-kun?"
"…That has nothing to do with you, does it?"
"That's why I want you to take this without any reservation. You don't have to return the bento box to me either. We're done with each other once and for all now."
"Well, I'll accept it without worrying too much, then. But if it tastes bad, I'll just throw it away."
"I don't think there's much we can say to each other anymore, but work hard, Yanagihara… Tomo-san. I wish you good luck and hope you achieve success."
"Your cell phone is ringing, isn't it?"
"Can't you hear it? Listen, the ringtone. It's different from mine."
"Just take a look at it. I'm sure it was ringing."
"Let me see for a bit… See, there's an incoming call… Oh, what's this…?"
"Wait, wait… I'm sure I heard something. Your phone made a sound…"
"See, there's an incoming call… Ah, my bad, that's my cell phone!"
"Sorry, I got the wrong one. Here's your phone back."
"Calling your own phone with my cell phone, just what are you trying to do…?"
"Well, don't get mad, don't get mad now～ Here, take this as a token of my apology."
"Y-You always do things as you see fit! …Eh, what is this?"
"Please wash it before you return it. That's my favorite one."
"W-What is this? Just what are you trying to…"
"Bye bye～! I'll call you later, Setsuna!"
Setsuna mutters that question around the third time I was playing White Album.
"Let's see… I might be able to do Romance de Amor…"
"I've heard that one before! Apparently, it's a song that all beginners learn."
"…You're exactly right. I am currently around that level, after all."
I can't tell if she's tired of hearing the same song over and over again or if she's worried that I'm fed up with only playing the same song, though.
"My repertoire will slowly increase as I continue playing. For now, though, I want to finish this song without missing any notes first."
That being said, Setsuna really doesn't need to be concerned about that, in a way…
Even though I can now play this song from start to finish, I still tend to pause in two or three places, so I'm far from the point where I can actually feel tired of playing this song.
"Well, for the next song, can I make a particular request?"
"That's fine… but a new song would take too much time. If it's something I've played before, then it should be fine."
"You say that, but there are only a handful of songs you've played in front of me anyway, Haruki-kun."
After all, Setsuna has only listened to my guitar playing for about a month or so.
"Ah! Come to think of it, can you still play that?"
"Remember, Sound of Destiny! The solo part right after the song ends!"
"You practiced that like your life was on the line, Haruki-kun. Even though it was so hard, you still managed to master it in a week!"
"You didn't miss any notes on stage either. The truth is, I was so busy worrying about you back then that I didn't even remember how I sang myself, Haruki-kun… Ah."
"N-No, I can't play something like that on an acoustic guitar!"
"You'll have to wait another year for me to get back into playing the electric guitar. It's been a little too long since I've practiced, after all."
"Yeah… I guess. That was unreasonable of me. I'm sorry."
"N-No, it's fine… I'm the one who should apologize."
Whenever we drop our guard for a bit during a conversation, we always manage to shift the topic to that particular time somehow.
And then, before we even realize it, we both end up slightly hurt and fall into silence.
That's why Setsuna wants to hear the sound of my guitar. That's why whenever I finish a song, she immediately wants to hear the next one.
"Can you please listen to me for a bit? You can just listen, you don't have to reply. Just focus on playing your guitar."
"Okay, you can say anything you want. I'll be listening."
It's likely because the music will break the silence and ease our fears a little when the both of us go silent, just like what happened a moment ago.
We can continue on as if nothing happened.
"Hmm, well… where should I start? Can you please wait for a bit? I want to put my thoughts in order first."
"It's fine, take your time. I'll wait no matter how long it takes."
Our conversation feels as if we were a young couple who just started dating three days ago, and even though we're not good at it, we still slowly continue our conversation.
Sometimes we'd get too excited and make mistakes, then we'd be sad for a bit, but our spirits would be back up fairly soon and we'd continue on to the next topic.
"Ah, by the way… did you hear about what happened to Takahiro?"
"He should be taking his entrance exam soon, right? He must be a hard worker if he's going out of his way to take the general exam."
"…I'm not sure if you're being sarcastic or sincere when you say that, Haruki-kun."
In the end, however, we're simply repeating the same mistakes over and over again.
Even though it's a little painful, we're still very happy.
We're hoping that this utterly pointless chatter and this terrible guitar music will slowly melt away the snow that's been piling up between us.
"You're blocking the entrance. Move out of the way if you're not heading in."
"N-No, wait… this isn't the best time!"
"What? Is there a fight going on inside? Did your Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday girlfriends happen to meet each other?"
"If only it were something that simple…"
"I thought I told you that I didn't want to see you anymore… Why are you sitting here on purpose, Yanagihara-san?"
"Because I'd feel sorry for you if you had to eat lunch alone, Setsuna…"
"It's because you're here that my friends are hesitant to have lunch with me! Also, I don't want to be called by my name by a second-year. Please call me Ogiso-san as usual."
"Ah, looks delicious. Can I have one?"
"Well then, I'll trade it with something from my lunch that has the same amount of calories."
"No, thanks. The bento box you gave me before didn't exactly taste great."
"Yeah～ yeah～ As for your bento though, it tasted amazingly good. …Good to the point it nearly made me angry."
"It's no big deal. I just used whatever ingredients we had. You don't have to force yourself to praise me either."
"The nimono in particular was really well-seasoned."
"How did you make that? Was it the broth, or maybe the specific combination of seasonings…?"
"That's something I learned from my mom. I suppose I'm a little confident in it."
"Speaking of which, the ratio of soy sauce to sugar to cooking wine is two to one to…
Wait, why should I teach you the secret recipe of the Ogiso household?"
"Being so narrow-minded is why people antagonize you. Really, you're so snobby～"
"I don't really mind being hated by you at all…"
"You're doing it again, Secchan～ You're not being honest at all."
"Who's Secchan supposed to be!? How many times do I have to tell you not to address me so casually!?"
"…I hope that makes you understand what I was trying to tell you earlier."
"That's Yanagihara Tomo, remember? She was one grade lower than us in high school. That devil of a girl who caused our Light Music Club to disband…"
"No, I'm not talking about her. I'm talking about the rude, foul-mouthed replica of Setsuna who's talking to her. Who's that supposed to be?"
"Ahh～! I've had it! Just remembering it makes me mad…"
"You've been mad about that for quite a while now."
"I know that! But still, hear me out, Haruki-kun… Yanagihara-san was so terrible to me, you know?"
"…You've told me that several times already too."
"And come on, what's with that 'Secchan'…? I've only been called that by my aunt back when I was little and still went to elementary school, you know?"
Setsuna seems to be quite excited today.
Rather than someone awful… it's more appropriate to say that someone's appeared in her life who's managed to rile her up.
"Ahh… what a terrible mistake on my part. I should've just ignored her when she started bugging me last year…"
"It seems she bears a lot of grudges toward you, Setsuna."
"Why did it turn out like this, though… I'm supposed to have nothing to do with her. If she's being mean just because she doesn't like me, then this is too harsh…"
I don't really think the person in question thinks that way, though…
She's always been extremely ambitious, even since our high school days. It's no wonder that Setsuna was a frequent target of her animosity, given that she had always been the thorn in her side.
"In the first place, I knew nothing about her back when we were still in high school, you know? I mean it!"
"That's… I suppose I understand why you'd be mad about that."
"I know, right!? Ugh, lunchtime will be really depressing for me starting tomorrow. Maybe I should find a different place to eat."
I understand why she'd be mad about that… though that goes for the other person in question as well.
Back in high school, she suffered overwhelming defeats two years in a row in terms of the votes she got for the Miss Houjou High contest.
And even how they each valued their respective rankings was night and day.
Moreover, there's also the fact that the sense of rivalry between the two was quite detached… Or at least, she was made aware of the fact that it had been completely one-sided on that particular day.
Perhaps it's because "the" Ogiso Setsuna finally acknowledges her now that she's basking in the glory of it.
"Then again… if you think about it, you could say that the two of us managed to get together because of her…"
"I told you this before, right? The reason why the old Light Music Club was disbanded…"
The club got pulled into her unparalleled ambitions and was used to promote her for the school festival, only to fall apart in an instant. I was merely a stand-in guitarist for the club back then.
With only guitarists in the groupーwithout a bassist, a drummer, or a singerーI had no idea where to even start. I spent the day wandering aimlessly and was just about ready to give up.
But in that hopeless situation, Setsuna's beautiful singing voice reached my ears…
"S-Still, still… I really don't like having a cupid with such a mean personality…"
"I've been keeping an eye on you since then, Setsuna. It's also one of the reasons why I asked you to take her spot."
"That's not my fault, though. She's such a pain! Always causing trouble for other people…"
"This is probably the first time I've heard you saying something so terrible about anyone."
To put it more accurately, the fact that she's described me with words like this before makes this the second time.
"That's… probably because I've never run into people like that until now, I'm sure."
"Is that so? But the truth is, you're actually quite interested in her, aren't you?"
"After all, Setsuna… you'd never met anyone that made you speak ill of them like that up until now, right? I suppose you could say she's a bad influence on you…"
"D-Don't say that, jeez! You just gave me the chills! I'd rather not have to deal with people who I can speak ill of nonchalantly like that!"
"U-Uh, well… I suppose if you're the one who says it, Haruki-kun, maybe it's fine…"
"…It made my heart skip a beat."
Setsuna is quite excited today. …And the way I see it, she seems to be pretty happy.
"Well, I can just borrow these notes, right?"
"The French exam is on Thursday, so as long as you return them by Tuesday, it'll be fine."
"Thank you～! It's a good thing we're learning the same language. I'm most familiar with your notes, after all."
"…I'd prefer you start getting used to taking your own notes, though."
Today's a day off right before exam week. Takeya's visit now hardly comes as a surprise.
"No way! I've been using this product for the past six years, so I can guarantee its quality. When I'm using these notes, I feel like I'm guaranteed to graduate!"
Even though our courses and specializations are different, his habit of borrowing my notes before an exam hasn't changed since the first year of high school.

During our first year in university, this guy borrowed the paper I wrote, copied it word for word, and turned it in. When the professor called us in and gave us a failing grade, I considered ending our friendship once and for all…
"Speaking of which, what have you been doing over there? You didn't even bring tea for your guest."
"Uh, I'm looking for something. Also, if you wanted to be treated as a guest, you should have brought a gift."
"What are you looking for? And since I have no choice, here's some hand-made cookies. My Friday girlfriend is getting married, so she gave me this as a parting gift…"
"I don't want something so emotionally loaded!"
"See, she told me she was tired of me making her wait for so long. But the thing is, I don't recall making her wait for me at all, so I had no idea how to react…"
"Anyway, could you answer my question already? What are you looking for?"
As I answer him, I pause my search for a moment and take out a bottle of green tea from the fridge to put on the table.
"Yeah, it's the one I used during high school. I'd just started looking for it a moment before you arrived…"
I tried my best to avoid looking at it… The snack he ate with his tea, the bag with the pink ribbon on it…
"You sure it's not at your old place?"
"That's impossible. When I moved here, I made sure I brought absolutely everything."
"…How bad is your relationship with your family, anyway?"
"It's not that bad. It's just that we're not interested in each other."
"Doesn't seem like a lack of interest to me. This is more like complete apathy."
"I'm grateful that they're willing to pay for my tuition. When I become independent, I plan on paying them back. And when they need someone to take care of them, I plan on going back too."
"You do that for everyone, acting like you have some obligation to do things. Even though you always butt into others' problems, why are you so cold to your own family…?"
"It should be here… Seriously, where is it?"
A question I ask about my sheet music and my parental bond…
"Fine～! I get it already! I'll go take a bath in a bit. And don't just barge into my room～!"
"But didn't it take you until dawn to do it yesterday? When I tried using the water to do the laundry this morning, it was still warm…"
"Wait! Don't say something like that when I'm on the phone!"
"Besides, don't you have exams next week? You've been staying up late on the phone for days now…"
"I'm studying perfectly fine, so don't you worry about that. Okay now, get out, just get out already."
"Just make sure you hang up earlier today, okay? Our phone bill was quite expensive."
"I can decide that for myself! I'm the one paying for it anyway, so you don't have to worry about it!"
"…Paying with the money your dad gave you. In any case, don't pull an all-nighter again, okay?"
"Jeez～! Just give me a break! …Ah, I'm sorry, Haruki-kun! I got interrupted."
"No, it's fine… More importantly, is that really okay?"
"…! N-No problem. I'm properly taking baths every day!"
"But if you leave it on, the gas bill will…"
"Like I said, don't worry about that. …And also, you shouldn't talk about girls taking baths so casually."
"No, I'm the one who should apologize. Sorry for making you hear something so embarrassing."
"Well then, please entertain me again today, Kitahara-sensei."
"Today, I'd like to try playing a different song… To tell you the truth, I only just found my old sheet music."
"Eh～ which one is it? I'm so excited～"
There is this one place where familial love is abundant.
"My goodness… Setsuna's become so selfish all of a sudden. It feels like she's back to how she used to be."
"I was studying until 4 AM yesterday. When I went to sleep, she was still on the phone, you know?"
"It's true. When I went to the bathroom before going to sleep, there was still light and voices coming out of her room."

"Speaking of which, I wonder if Setsuna is getting enough sleep."
"I guess this is what they call the honeymoon period… Those two are always so close."
"Well, I'm just glad that she's cheerful again."
"If this keeps up, maybe they'll get married right after graduating from university, huh?"
"Sure, you might be fine with it, but Dad might be annoying to deal with."
"I'd really prefer she spoke to me like she does now rather than hiding all the time and crying like she used to."

"That's amazing～! It's hard to imagine you just started practicing this song today."

…And I bet she'd say something like, that's not nearly enough effort yet.
"Do you know any other songs? It'd be nice if it was a song I know."
"Well then, please look forward to the performances to come starting tomorrow. Seeing as I just found sheet music for over twenty songs."

"You won't have time to study anymore, Haruki-kun. Especially if you practice so hard on these new songs."
"I can't make you do this knowing that you have exams next week."
"I'm sorry, I… I'm always being selfish and inconsiderate of you, Haruki-kun."
"I can't force this on you anymore until the exams end, right?"
"To call you… so that I can hear your voice…"
Although we were having a wonderful conversation just now, like on cue, we suddenly fell into a slump, overwhelmed by our emotions and memories.
"Being on the phone this late is bad, right? We still have to go to university tomorrow."
"Playing the guitar so late would cause trouble for your neighbors, right?"
"We should probably hang up now… If we have such long phone calls every day, your phone bill will be terrible, right, Haruki-kun…?"
It's the same thing, every single day…
As she realizes how much pressure I'm putting on myself to fulfill her wish, Setsuna's caring heart starts crying out.
Anyone with even a bit of compassion would fall into this dilemma, but for Setsuna, it ends up being a true pitfall.
I've already thought of a way to fix this.
"Can't I call you during exam week? Can't I say I want to hear your voice either, Setsuna?"
"T-That's… I mean, I don't mind at all, but Haruki-kun, don't you…"
Well, it's not much of a solution. It's more like I'm holding my ground.
"It's not a problem for me. Because whether you listen or not, Setsuna, I'm not planning on giving up my practicing."
"There's no reason in particular. I just get really rusty really fast with musical instruments unless I practice daily."
This isn't Setsuna's fault, after all.
"It's finally coming back to me after that three-year hiatus. If I just stop practicing now, everything will go to waste."
The reason why I'll work hard. The reason why I slacked off. The reason why I continue this unproductive guitar practice…
I've tried to tell her so many times that none of this is her fault.
"Anyway, it's just something I've decided to do on my own."
"In the end, it's still for me… right?"
And then I can only honestly admit my intent.
Even though it's not Setsuna's fault, I'm doing this for Setsuna.
I want to get Setsuna's attention. Because I love Setsuna…
"You're practicing so hard because you want me to listen to you play, right, Haruki-kun?"
"I'm not good enough to play for other audiences yet. It's not worth their trouble to listen either."
"…Don't tell me you're planning on giving up on the finals?"
"Well, I'll work hard to a certain extent, you know? It's not really a problem since I've already got the credits I need, though, so I definitely won't fail."
"M-Me too! My graduation has already been guaranteed too!"
"It seems like our hard work has paid off."
"Well then… Let's both reward ourselves a little by lazing around for a bit. Sounds good?"
When he learned about what I was looking for and the reason why I was looking for it, he seemed taken aback by my innocent view of things.
I told him about that night when Setsuna gave me a drunken phone call.
I told him how I did my best to play the guitar to calm her down, and how before I realized it, she'd peacefully fallen asleep.
I told him that since that day, Setsuna would always ask to listen to my shoddy lullabies, causing us both to stay up late into the night.
However, since then, in order for me to put her mind at rest, I've tried to increase my musical repertoire.
After I told him about the embarrassing things that happened the last few days, he let out a heartfelt sigh.
"…What the heck? Are you guys middle-schoolers or something? Did you start dating after she confessed her love to you under the big tree behind the school too?"
"Even so, it's a gigantic leap forward. …If you look back and compare it to what happened during the end of last year, at least."

"The lack of progress from you two has been really annoying, but seeing you two being stuck at a standstill makes me feel like I'm reading a shoujo manga. And I'm talking about the classic kind, the ones with characters being starry-eyed and stuff, you know?"
"What you two are doing here is way more embarrassing!"
"Hey, Haruki. How long do you plan on waiting?"
"As long as it takes… Until Setsuna can move forward once again."
"In that case, when does Setsuna-chan plan on facing you directly? Or perhaps… when does she plan on giving up on you?"
"Until Setsuna gives me a clear answer and closure, I'll keep waiting for her."
"And until then, whether Setsuna seeks me out, or whether Setsuna avoids me, I'll accept it. I'll listen to everything she has to say…"
"But… if that doesn't go according to plan, you'll never get an answer. You're planning on letting this uncertain relationship last forever?"
"If it comes down to that, I'll live with that. The point is, I don't want to pressure Setsuna anymore. I've already hurt her once before like that."
"In a deadlock like that… how long do you think you can last?"
"At least three years… Compared to the pain Setsuna has endured so far, that is the very least I can hold out for."
"That might work for you… But to Setsuna-chan, it'll be another three years on top of the original three, you know? You plan on making that girl wait for six years?"
"It might sound like what you're doing now is for her sake, but in reality…"
"I finally found it… my sheet music. Thank goodness I didn't throw it away…"
"Yeah, thank you. Now there are new songs for Setsuna to listen to."
My fingers stopped, and the silence set in.
It's been a week since these night concerts started. For the first time, I managed to play White Album without any mistakes…
The other side of the line remained silent, as Setsuna completely forgot to applaud or praise it.
When I planned on asking her, a quiet whisper came from the other side of the line, accompanied by a silent sobbing.
"Tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow… Even when exams start and after they end… From now on, you'll keep calling me, right?"
"Yeah… I'll keep calling you until you ask me to stop, Setsuna."
"But won't you have trouble with your phone bill?"
"I'm looking for a flat-rate package right now. Let's go sign up together when I find one, okay?"
"Isn't this hard on you…? Having so much of your time taken away, and enduring all these all-nighters…?"
"I've already covered my bases at my part-time jobs, and I've thought a lot about how I should spend my free time. …I plan to spend it with you, Setsuna."
"A girl who makes you call her every day and always acts so selfishly… Isn't that bothering you?"
"Of course not. Because it's the girl I like who's being selfish."
"I guess you could say it's because I've learned from my mistakes…"
…This really does feel like one of those old classic manga, just like Takeya said.
I know full well how embarrassing this entire situation currently is in real life.
But then again, the path that led us here was the exact opposite of what we'd consider favorable.

If the boyfriend character continued to completely betray the readers' expectations like this, he'd probably be cut from the script by now. In fact, it wouldn't even be surprising if the whole story was scrapped.
"Thank you… I… I'm so happy to hear that. I really mean it, I'm so happy!"
And yet the main heroine is…
A beautiful girl, and the school idol at that… When you think about it, she's actually the fitting image of a rival to the main heroine, an unattainable flower.
"It's fine. You can take your time and think it over."
"I'm sorry… My feelings were decided a long time ago. All that's left is simply to convey them to you, yet…"

And yet, she fell for a perfectly normal guy who was good at nothing but studying… All this time, she's been chained to this person that's so mediocre and fickle that one could only imagine him as an inconspicuous side character.
"I'm telling you, it's fine. I understand. I started this, in any case."
We just happen to be the main couple of a long-running manga where no one could possibly get a happy ending. Even the author has long lost any sort of vision of what to do with it.
And everyone knows perfectly well that if no one fixes this situation, the manga will definitely be abandoned by the readers and end up being canceled altogether.
But who could possibly set this on the right track…?
"Hey, is this really fine, Haruki-kun? Can you really handle all these terribly selfish requests of mine?"
"It's fine. It's exactly what I want."
The author, who was supposed to weave fate at his whim, ended up abandoning this story long ago, leaving the characters he created to play out its continuation.
"Even though I'm a terrible girl… who listens to your feelings without answering them, and is constantly burdening you without giving anything in return?"
"Then again, the way I see it, you're the one and only terrible girl in this entire world for me. That's why I'll accept everything, no matter what."
Not to mention, her somewhat delinquent-like rival has already stepped off the stage after the first act. We probably won't be seeing her reappear in this story.
"…! If you say things like that, my selfishness will know no end, you know?"
"Just let me have it then, Setsuna."
"I might end up wanting everything done my way and cause you an unbelievable amount of trouble."
"And whatever kind of unreasonable thing you say next, I'll be looking forward to it."
"If I stay chained to you like that, I'll probably always stand still, without ever being able to move anywhere…"

And thus the heroine, as a result of all the dramatic plot twists in the first act, and the writer's stagnation and loss of inspiration in the second, has completely lost all her will and courage to continue the story.
But so what? Nothing needs to be set back on track at this stage.
It's not like anyone would read a manga as tedious as this, anyway.
It's perfectly fine for this story to rely on the few characters that are left, and let the story keep unfolding ever so slightly, stagnant as it may be.
And even if no one finds it interesting, that's fine too. Even if everyone abandons it, and it becomes a slow, long-term manga series with a boring story.
Because if that happens, no one will get hurt anymore. We will be able to keep living our lives peacefully.
Even if it's like spending our lives in prison, or being caught in an endless limbo…
So long as the main heroine doesn't get hurt, the side character will be perfectly fine too.
That way, no fans, rivals, or even the writer can get between us. In a stagnant story, we can keep pretending to be shy characters forever.
Because the main heroine is scared of moving forward…
Because I, a side character, am the one truly scared of moving forward…
I'm not being modest or trying to hide my embarrassment. I really just think you don't need to apologize to me, Setsuna.
Because I'm just pretending to say something as generous as "I'll be waiting," when in truth, all I'm really doing is trying to escape from the risk of being rejected.
"Maybe I'll never see the heroine ever again…" That's the sort of hopeless situation that I'm trying to avoid.
"And then, yesterday, he played another very old song for me. It's by Ogata Eiji… do you remember?"
"What's the matter, Io? Why do you seem so taken aback?"
"…Of course I'm taken aback. Finals are about to start and you two are still fooling around like that?"
"Aw, come on… It's not what you think. We were just having a normal conversation over the phone."
"That wasn't the point of my statement, Setsuna. You're playing dumb on purpose, aren't you?"
"Is stalling like this okay, Setsuna? For either Haruki or you?"
"But I'm no longer running away. Things got a bit better because you got mad at me last time, Io."
"Sure, perhaps you're not running away anymore. But this time, you've also forced Haruki to stop moving."
"Well, rather than taking a step forward, isn't it more like you two haven't gotten any closer at all?"
"It's not like that… Time will solve everything."
"This again? Wishfully thinking about when something will happen can't possibly be your goal, right?"
"That's not… I mean, I've given it some thought, but…"
"Ah～ jeez! And just when I thought you two were making progress. I really didn't think it would be so miniscule, though."
"And Haruki's being his usual self too. I know he told us to just observe and not to interfere, but we just can't expect you two to resolve it yourselves."
"I'll give you an opportunity for you two to talk things out. Right, after exams all four of us should…"
"Lately, I've been happy just about every day, okay? This relaxed feeling between us is very comfortable, you know?"
"Because for Haruki, this is just tortu…"
"Haruki-kun said he'd wait for me! Until I've made up my mind, he will continue to…"
"That idiot… Why does he always force himself into a corner like that? Does he enjoy hurting himself that much?"
"He's been very nice to me. He gave me something I've longed for. …I'm really happy."
"If you want a man to show you affection, you have to take some desperate measures. If you're interested in him, go embrace him, girl."
"Or… if you don't want to do that, just turn him down flat. Why not just do that?"
"Because from a bystander's point of view, you two seem like a very shy couple. The way you two do things is just way too innocent."
"…Seems? Do we really seem that way to people around us?"
"As long as you can accept him, Setsuna, Haruki won't leave you this time, okay?"
"It'll all go back to how it was when you two first met, you know? Why can't you make a choice, even though you know the answer?"
"…Back to when we first met, huh."
"That's right. You'll finally be able to act like back then…"
"That's impossible. We can't go back there."
"I can't be the girl Haruki-kun met three years ago. I'm not the same girl he met back then."
"All gloomy～ and reluctant～ What she's trying to say is that she's running out of those pheromones of hers she uses to lure men in."
"Hello～ Setsuna! Long time no see, how are you doing?"
"…I was doing great until just now, but my mood has suddenly taken a turn for the worse. And I seem to recall telling you not to call me by my first name?"
"I see you haven't changed with that bitter expression of yours～ What's the matter, are you that ill-prepared for the finals?"
"Why are you taking a seat here? Can't you see I'm talking to a friend right now?"
"Your friend…? Oh, Mizusawa Io… I suppose the enemy of my enemy is my friend, huh."
"W-Wait! Why are you already declaring us enemies when we've only just met?"

"You were quite popular among the boys in the basketball club back in high school, but don't let that go to your head, okay? You don't seem to be the slightest bit noteworthy in university, after all."
"And why do you have to make remarks on my popularity when we've only just met?"
"Ah～ okay, okay. I won't do it anymore. I'm not interested in you at all, anyway. You're nothing if you don't join a club, Mizusawa Io."
"And don't be so cheeky as to call me by my full name either. You're a year below me, aren't you?"
"Ah～ okay, okay. Nice to meet you, Io."
"…! Y-You little… As expected of someone who can tick even Setsuna off, your personality is disgusting…"
"Let's get going, Io. I think I've lost my appetite."
"Don't you still have more than half of your food left? Didn't anyone ever get mad at you when you left food on your plate as a child?"
"No, my family was totally fine with it… Don't you think your family's quite old-fashioned?"
"Oh, or did I perhaps convince you to go on a diet? Are you planning on competing in next year's Miss Houjou?"
"Don't jump to such ridiculous conclusions. Why would I ever…"
"So you're also addicted to the fame, aren't you, Ogiso-san? Still can't let go of your former high school glory?"
"Ah, for crying out loud, Setsuna! Why don't you just go and do it, win Miss Houjou! You'll end up stomping all over this vain little missy's pride!"
"Whoa, hold on! I know I'm the one who started this, but that would be a problem. I can't have you overshadow my debut!"
"That's the whole point! What better way is there to deal with the epitome of vanity like you than hurting your pride?"
"I-In that case, I'll do everything in my power to inconvenience you! Whether it be downvoting you online, or even controlling the voting system itself…!"
"Oh, stop it, you two. There's no way I'm going to enter the contest. Even if I signed up, I probably wouldn't even make it through the first round."
"…Uugh～! The way you misjudge yourself is as irritating as ever."
"…Sorry, but I'm going to have to agree with her on this one."
"Mediocre effort won't cut it, you know? It takes lots of effort to keep my body in shape…"
"Oh? I guess you do work hard on something, at least."
"I've also gone through voice training. Since I want to be a singer, an actress, or a broadcaster in the future, I must be ready to be able to handle anything."
"It's amazing how you can work so hard even though your goal is so very shallow…"
"That's why when I see someone just wasting away their life, I tend to look down on them somewhat."
"This is especially true for women who are obsessed over good-for-nothing men and idly spend their days in indecisiveness. I can't stand the thought of them breathing the same air that I do."
"You really should just dump that man. You'll end up wasting your youth and losing your chance at finding new love, you know～?"
"How in the world did you even learn about our conversation?"
"You're awfully loud, Mizusawa-san. I could hear you all the way from the entrance."
"…Last Thursday, when I was talking here with Ogiso-san, that is."
"…Sorry, I take that back. I guess it was my fault for speaking too loudly, yeah."
"…Don't go along with her so easily, Io. She just said something terrible, remember?"
"Well, I… She just kinda hit a weak spot…"
"How dare you call him a good-for-nothing man!? You couldn't even hope to ever understand his true value!"
"Ah, that's what you meant, not the fact that she said you were indecisive."
"No, even if you could understand, a circle crusher like you would probably still go out of your way to bother others."
"Keep on blindly loving someone like that and you're only going to amplify the pain that comes after you end up getting betrayed, don't you think?"
"…! He never betrayed me! It was all because I forced myself onto him, that's why…"
"…Well, I suppose you can't get another opportunity to beat an opponent who's already died, either."
"What I mean is that you can't beat someone who's become no more than a memory."
"W-Wait… How do you know about that? No way, did Setsuna tell you?"
"That doesn't really matter, now, does it? Right, Ogiso-san?"
"I've said this already, haven't I? As if you'd have any idea? …Ugh, just stop prying already…"
"…Let's go somewhere else. It feels like this conversation is going to be anything but civil from this point on."
"Of course, that's exactly what I was hoping for. Let's find a place where other people can't hear us and continue. I'm going to enjoy utterly crushing you."
"We might get a little loud, so how about a karaoke box?"
"Sure. Let's head to the train station right now."
"W-Wait, you two… There's no need to really do something so immature, is there?"
"You know that you're coming along too, right, Setsuna? We're arguing about you, after all."
"When the going gets tough, you pretend like it's not your problem even though you're the one who started it? So you're that type of person, huh, Ogiso-san?"
"Well, how about this. We'll have our argument on our own, and if you don't want to listen, why don't you just sing?"
"Look, that's not the issue… Listen, I need to…"
"…I'll be taking a few turns to sing too, of course. The new songs from January should be up by now."
"Oh, don't you worry about that. I don't plan on skipping the standard rotation either."
"I'm sorry, Io. I'll call you later."
"We haven't settled this yet, you know? Are you running with your tail between your legs again?"
"All you did was provoke her! You just made Setsuna run away…"
"So, what now? Should we keep at this on our own?"
"Don't call me by my full name. It pisses me off."
"Listen to me when I'm… Huh, what did you just say?"
"Her singing, have you heard her sing? Have you gone to karaoke with her recently or anything like that?"
"Hmm～ nope. Setsuna hasn't been accepting our invitations for quite some time now."
"Could you be specific with 'for quite some time'? When was the last time you heard her sing?"
"Well, now that you mention it… Huh…?"
"Wait, um… Wait, wait a second… I don't… believe…?"
"Heheee… I figured as much. Makes perfect sense. So that's how it is, Ogiso Setsuna…"
"Don't call me by my full name."
"Sorry, but could you please be quiet for a moment?"
"Practice has already started, so could you play it for me once, Touma-san? I can't read sheet music…"
"We don't have much time left, Haruki-kun. There's only one day left! …Let's work hard together and complete our song, okay?"
Just as a memory of Setsuna's voice from the past tries to lure me into slumber, it's her voice from the present that snaps me out of it.
The clock's face shows 1 AM. Technically, it's already Saturday now.
"Are you okay? Want to hang up here today?"
"No, I'm okay. I just spaced out for a moment. Besides, we've already finished half of our exams, and tomorrow is a day off too."
"How are you doing on them so far? I probably messed up some of mine…"
"At the very least, I've managed to stay awake through every exam so far, so I should be fine. Truth be told, though, I already forgot everything I wrote…"
"Don't worry, I've already got enough credits. You don't need to worry about me."
"Yeah, same here. I can probably just barely pass over the cut-off line."
"That's fine then, isn't it? Since neither of us plans on enrolling in a graduate school."
As I talk to Setsuna about our exams, my mind is still half-occupied by thoughts of that daydream.
Why would I dream about something like that right now…?
"Well, since I'm going to fall asleep otherwise, how about I try to tackle a new song?"
No, there's no reason to lie to myself like that. I know exactly why I dreamed about that.
"I haven't gotten nearly enough practice for this song, so… I might end up butchering it, honestly."
It must be because of this particular song I've been practicing.
"That's fine. I'm not here to hear some grand performance. I just want to hear you playing the guitar, Haruki-kun."
"Ah, huh? Hold on… Did I just say something really rude to the performer?"
"Probably. Most people would say you did."
"I'm sorry. I really went too far there…"
"Don't worry about it… I know full well that I still lack experience."
As I was going through my sheet music, thinking about which song I should practice today, a page of handwritten sheet music fell out…
"There's just one thing I'd like to say. If you don't want to listen to it, I want you to tell me right away."
"I'll stop playing this one immediately and change to another song."
I'm not particularly happy with some parts I played here and there, but then again, I only had one day to practice…
"I'm sure it'll be fine. There's just no way I'll think that…"
The truth is, maybe I shouldn't be playing this song. Perhaps I should have burned this particular page.
Perhaps making her remember this… is something I shouldn't do.
Her reaction came just as I expected it, like on cue.
"No, no, it's not like that. It's just that, um… I spaced out this time."
Though she reacted exactly as I expected her to, she reacted in a sad way that was far from what I'd hoped for.
"I'm sorry… I guess I'm tired after all the exams, too. I'd just like to go to sleep for today…"
"Can I still call you tomorrow? I'll probably practice some other new songs."
"…U-Umm… yes, please. I'm looking forward to tomorrow as well."
"You'll call for sure, right? You can call any time."
As I thought, it's still too soon.
Noーto Setsuna, it might take an eternity until it isn't too soon for this song.
Nevertheless, that's not quite the reason why I stopped playing it willingly.
And even though I know it's not what I should be doing, I'm doing my best in desperately removing whatever Setsuna doesn't want to see from her sight.
"Good job… Our lives as third-year students are officially over."
"That's only true assuming we pass, right?"
Three minutes after our last final exam.
As I came out of the examination hall feeling rather bewildered by it all, I turned on my cell phone only for it to immediately start ringing loudly.
…I then heard Setsuna's voice, which was almost as unusually lively as my ringtone, as she cleared her final tribulation before the spring.
"Hey, do you have any plans for today? Do you have any work at your part-time jobs?"
"No, I don't think I have anything arranged yet…?"
"I was just talking to Io and she asked if we were going to celebrate this somehow. So, um… how about the four of us meet up for lunch?"
Setsuna's awkward proposal came close to what I'd been expecting, but not quite what I'd been hoping for.
"…! Yeah! This is great, it's been a while since we had everyone meet up together…"
I want to share my happiness with her, but I know it's still too early for us to meet alone.
That said, it's been three weeks since I last met with Setsuna, and I don't plan on letting this wonderful chance slip through my fingers.
"Ah, and also… I do intend to invite everyone when we meet, but there's something I want to ask you first, Haruki-kun…"
"Well, next Monday, I'll be throwing a bit of a party at my house…"
Ahh, come to think of it…
"L-Like I said… it's not until next Monday… Dang it, you saw right through me, huh?"
"Ahaha… Sorry about that. But I guess it was a little too obvious. …After all, I made sure to remember it."
Next Monday… February 14th. Setsuna's reverse Valentine.
"Mhm… thank you. Well, as I was saying, I'd like to throw a party with my family and friends. Um, so, Haruki-kun…"
"Of course. I'd love to pay you guys a visit."
"No, I'm the one who should be thanking you for inviting me. Thank you, Setsuna."
"No, I'm happy to hear you'll be coming. Thank you, Haruki-kun."
"…We're both acting quite pathetically today, aren't we?"
"Hehe, I guess. It seems I'm not the only one being pathetic today, but you are too, Haruki-kun."
Exams are over, her birthday draws near, and winter is coming to an end…
Listening to Setsuna's soothing voice, I couldn't help but excitedly think that in the past few days, we've made a bit of progress.
"Anyway, let's talk after we meet up, okay? Where should we meet? I'll head over to where you are now."
"Oh, yeah. The truth is, I still have something I need to do first…"
"Well, the thing is, Yanagihara-san asked for me. Do you remember when I was talking to you about her? That cheeky underclassman?"
The moment the name "Yanagihara-san" passed her lips, the warmth in Setsuna's voice immediately disappeared.
"What's her problem…? Even though I told her not to talk to me anymore, she just keeps doing it anyway…"
"It seems she's quite interested in you."
"Oh, spare me… She's probably setting up some weird scheme against me again. Ugh, it's so unnerving."
"Is that really what you're thinking? You're actually enjoying yourself, aren't you?"
"Eeeeeeh～!? How can you say that, Haruki-kun!?"
"After all, Setsuna, whenever you talk about that girl, you always sound like you're in high spirits."
It somehow feels as if her dark side that's usually unknown to most is showing, and she's revealing her true intentions one after the other.
"W-What do you mean? Has my personality become that horrible? J-Jeez, this is all her fault!"
Setsuna usually suggests that she gets really stressed whenever she quarrels with her, but the truth is, she's actually managing to release a lot of stress by doing so, isn't she?
…It's a stark contrast to how she speaks with me at least, where she has to be careful so as to not unintentionally say anything hurtful.
"Still, given everything you told me, Setsuna, I actually see her in a new light, you know?"
"Y-You do? But her words and her attitude are both just terrible, aren't they?"
"She's terribly vain and doesn't care how low she has to stoop to achieve her goals, sure, but she also puts in a lot of effort from behind the scenes, and she helped you out in a pinch, Setsuna."
"Remember the time when you were almost taken away in that car?"
"That was… maybe because she felt guilty of what she'd done. Maybe she thought she went too far that time?"
"No, the Yanagihara Tomo I know wouldn't get cold feet over a scheme like that."
"…You're being pretty mean to her yourself, Haruki-kun."
"Well, you know, I just felt that she just wanted to tease you lightly and had every intention of helping you from the very beginning, wouldn't you say?"
"That wasn't light at all! I was really scared back then…"
"Well, here's what I think… What if the truth is that she actually really likes you, Setsuna?"
"C-Come on, stop it… A mean girl like her would never…"
"Don't you feel as though she just wants you to notice her and she's provoking you because of that?"
Or perhaps she has some other goal in mind with the way she's provoking Setsuna, rather than wanting to go out of her way to hurt her?
"No, no, that's impossible. You're able to speak up for her because you just haven't talked to her yet, Haruki-kun…"
No, it's not hard to imagine at all that she really does hate Setsuna in certain aspects.
"And just the other day you said something about me taking a liking to her… I swear, I don't understand your standards for friends, Haruki-kun."
