"Honestly, I have my doubts about that sometimes, too. I wonder about things like why I'm still friends with Takeya after all this time."
"W-Well… Okay, if you really think so, Haruki-kun… maybe I'll try talking to her normally one more time."
With that, Setsuna finally gave me a mature reply on this matter.
"Anyway, let's leave it at that. I'll meet up with you when I'm done here, okay?"
"Can you wait at the cafe by Building 6? Takeya-kun and Io should be there, too."
Just then, a vague thought crossed my mind.
The truth is, Setsuna might need someone like Yanagihara Tomo in her life right now.
She's someone that Setsuna can truly be herself around. Because right now, she can't even show her true self to me…
It makes me think that perhaps someone like her, even as a bad influence, could turn out to be a good thing for Setsuna in her own unique way.
Just then… it crossed my mind.
"Here I am… at the broadcasting room."
"Come to think of it… Why did she call me out to somewhere so far away?"
"Yes～! I've kind of got my hands full here, so please see yourself in～!"
"That's right, it'll be the four of us. We'll rent a car to get there."
"Since it's almost spring break, let's just call it a celebration for Haruki and Setsuna getting back together. Leaving aside the fact it's been progressing at a snail's pace…"
"Hey, let's go together, shall we? When we split the rooms we'll act like we're a room short, then put you two in the same room. It's a perfect plan!"
Takeya and Io seemed more excited than usual when I met up with them at the cafe, just like Setsuna. Maybe it's because we've been freed from our long and excruciating exams.
"No, listen… I already asked you two to stop trying to force this. I'm not that much of a late bloomer that I have to rely on such tricks…"
"No, you're not even at that level at the moment. You're like a little amateur cherry boy who still hasn't even had a single girlfriend yet."
"Well, yeah. You don't have to force yourself to endure this alone anymore, Haruki. It's fine if you let us help this once, you know?"
"If you don't… who knows how many detours Setsuna will take this time? To be honest, I'm not even sure myself."
…Given the less than perfect situation I'm in, being the target of yet another scheme of theirs is nothing but a bother.
"Wait, if you're sticking me in a room together with Setsuna, are you saying you're willing to sleep in the same room as Takeya?"
"Ah～ don't worry about that at all. We'll just get three rooms!"
"…Do you really hate me that much?"
"That's about as unnatural a setup as it can get… There's no way Setsuna would overlook that, or anyone else, for that matter."
"Moving on, Tomo-chan. Didn't you say you had an important announcement to make?"
"That's right～! On the day that the DVD is announced to go on sale, guess what? There's going to be an event to celebrate its release～!"
"Come to think of it, Setsuna-chan sure is late… Hasn't it almost been an hour already?"
"Thank you～! It'll be taking place at Lemuria's Onjuku branch, starting at 2 PM. I hope to see you all there～!"
"I just tried phoning her, but apparently her phone's turned off. …Maybe she ran into some trouble?"
"Um, how can someone attend the event, though? Do we just buy the DVD from any regular store?"
"What kind of trouble? Our exams are over… and Setsuna-chan is not the type who would need to retake, right…?"
"Who knows, I didn't hear anything from her either…"
"Yes, you can get the tickets from there. For more information, please check on Lemuria's official website; the details should be posted there."
"Thank you, that wraps things up. Our guest today was Yanagihara Tomo-chan, who won the title of Miss Houjou University this year after her second consecutive year of participating!"
"She said Yanagihara Tomo called for her…"
"But the truth is… today, I've prepared an even bigger surprise for all our listeners!"
"No, this is probably just a recording, right? The person herself is probably meeting with Setsuna-chan right now."
"Ah, right… I guess that's it. I actually thought this was going live."
"As we mentioned at the beginning of the broadcast, this coming Monday, on February 14th, Houjou Station will be holding our annual Valentine's concert!"

"Hosted by Houjou FM, it's going to be the last major event to brighten up the end of this academic year! And as always, we've chosen five of the best groups or artists from our university to perform at a two-hour live show in Houjou University's north hall."
"For the past few weeks, we've invited our performers here to give them a chance to show everyone how passionate they are about performing. Today marks the last week we'll be doing that!"
Is this really a recording? Is it really just a coincidence…?
"Amazing, amazing! That's exactly right, Tomo-chan! You didn't miss a beat!"
"I went through training for this after all! Ah, jeez… Don't adlib like that! I'll get lost and won't know how to continue afterward…"
"Ahaha, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. All right, let's continue."
"So where did Setsuna-chan go to, in the end? Huh, I guess we're back to square one."
"What's the plan? Should we leave first? I'll send Setsuna a text."
"Right, so the guest who'll be joining us today is… a person who's here for the first time ever, but was instantly chosen to be one of the finalists…!"
"In fact, you're the one who brought us this fantastic surprise guest, right, Tomo-chan?"
"Yep, she and I are actually very close friends! Furthermore, our listeners should be quite familiar with her voice, you know?"
At that moment, I felt a chill run across the length of my spine, as well as a foreboding premonition that I could think of no logical explanation for.
After all, it would just be absurd… It's just impossible for something that preposterous to actually happen, and I was supposed to have come up with that composed conclusion.
"All right, let's have her take center stage here! Here we go～!"
"Aaaaaaah～! That's it, that's the voice! It really is the girl who sang Todokanai Koi! Woooow, I can't believe I've finally met heeer…"
"Also known as Houjou High School Light Music Club's singer… Let's see, um… 'SETSUNA'!"
"Welcome to the Houjou Station broadcast studio, SETSUNA-san!"
"Awh, jeez, I'm tearing up here… I've been harboring this unrequited admiration for you for two years now, you know? Oh gosh, what do I do?"
"All right now, SETSUNA? Please share a word with us on how you feel about next week's Valentine concert! Hehe… you'll do your best, right? Secchan～?"
We were all dumbstruck for a while.
While we were letting our guards down after the exams had finally ended, a trap was set that rendered us all speechless. A trap set by the trickster known as Yanagihara Tomo.
We couldn't protect Setsuna. …This threat was completely beyond anything we could have ever expected.
Setsuna didn't contact us at all. Nor did she return home.
"You'll catch a cold if you sleep in a place like this. There's a bed in our guest room you can use if you're tired."
"I'm sorry… I didn't mean to fall asleep. What time is it now?"
"It's 8 o'clock right now… When did you come back? You went outside once in the middle of the night, right?"
"Uh… I think before 6 AM? Your dad opened the door for me when he went to get the newspaper…"
"Mom told me to tell you breakfast is ready. I'll bring it over for you."
"Oh, that won't do… After all, I did rudely barge in uninvited."
"It'd be even ruder if you didn't eat after she already made food for you, don't you think?"
It was already past 10 PM when I arrived at the Ogiso household last night.

Having explained the situation about their daughter not returning past her curfew and giving no indication of her whereabouts before, then asking for their cooperation, her father had a sullen look on his face, while her mother instead felt grateful for my doing so.
"Ah, so any word from Setsuna yet…?"
"I swear, though, Kitahara-san… You really shouldn't be spoiling Nee-chan that much."
"Still… it's our fault that this whole situation happened."
"She probably just ran off to some friend's house. Even if we tried reaching her, she'd just pretend she's not there. It's just pointless to go out looking for her so desperately."
"The best case scenario is for my efforts to end up being pointless. I'm simply trying to increase the odds of that happening as best I can."
"…Nee-chan's really going to start taking you for granted. Kitahara-san, you'll be carrying that burden for the rest of your life, you know."
This is the outline that I've come up with:
Setsuna's participation in the Valentine's Concert coming up next Mondayーher first stage appearance in a very long whileーwas actually a prank set up by Takeya, Io, and me.

It had been quite a while since she last sang, and there was also the fact that we signed her up as our singer on our own accord for an event taking place on the exact same day as her birthday. She ended up angrily refusing to participate.
Following that, we spent a lot of time fruitlessly attempting to persuade her, though it only ruined her mood even more, and she ended up bailing out on us on her own in the end.
The scenario ends with me explaining my visit to the Ogiso household to search for clues of her whereabouts after being worried about being unable to contact her at all.
"No, I'm the one who should apologize… I ended up causing you so much trouble in the morning, and I even had you make breakfast for me."
"That girl is already an adult, so I really think there's no need for you to worry so much…"
"Even so, we need to prepare for the worst."
"You're a worrywart just like my dad, Kitahara-san. Though no one seems to worry about me at all!"
"That's because it's a lost cause worrying about you. You come and go as you please, so we couldn't find you if we tried."
"To begin with, Nee-chan's refusing to come home because she doesn't want to make an appearance at that concert, right? Meaning if we just revoke her entry, she'd come back for sure."
"Still, she's already signed up for an event like this after so long. If it means she can please everyone, her singing would be…"
"No, it's 'our' fault for doing this without consulting her first. If Setsuna doesn't want to do it, we won't force her to… It's just that we can't contact her to let her know that."
After that broadcast, we rushed to the broadcasting room, and all the staff present apologized to us to an embarrassing extent.
They promised to give up on the plan for the live performance, as well as apologize to Setsuna personally.
It's just that when we told them that participating in the event wasn't our own idea to begin with, everyone present seemed utterly disappointed.
It made me realize that they were truly looking forward to Setsuna singing that particular song…
In other words, it wasn't just us. These people were also unwittingly dancing to the tune of a certain trickster.
"What exactly are you trying to do here…?"
"Going so far just to hurt Setsuna and make her suffer… I'm asking you what the hell you're trying to do here!?"
"H-Hey, now, Io. Don't start this out as if you're looking to start a fight. Let's talk this through calmly and…"
"Hmmm～ Aren't you mixing up the means and the ends here?"
"Because honestly, my one true goal is to make Ogiso Setsuna cry."
"What I want is to make Ogiso Setsuna suffer. I want to completely and utterly humiliate her. That's what I'm saying."
"…Give me a damn break, you bitch!"
"…It appears that the other side doesn't want to settle things properly either."
"After all… the way she is now, isn't Ogiso Setsuna a complete and utter shadow of her former self?"
"All the way through high school, she was someone who I was never able to defeat, as much as I hate to admit it. That's why it pisses me off."
"Setsuna was never your opponent to begin with. Unlike you, she never once thought about winning or claiming fame. She was just a normal girl… who wished to live a normal life!"
"Besides, it's just one dumb song, so what's there to be afraid of? She sure didn't seem to have any problems shamelessly seducing the audience when she sang it three years ago!"
"…Did you know that she was trembling in fear during the rehearsal?"
"Do you have any idea how much that show made me suffer…? Even though the votes were so close to even until that point…"
"She's not who she used to be anymore. The way Setsuna is now, she's…"
"When was it that she stopped singing? Didn't I ask you the same question before?"
"…After we graduated from high school. I've never heard her sing since then."
"And I wonder what exactly caused that… I suppose the reason for that is worse than even what I'm trying to do to her, huh?"
"If she didn't want to do it, why didn't she just refuse? The broadcasting club totally chickened out, anyway. They'll most likely take all the blame too."
"It's probably hard enough for her to even refuse. Setsuna-chan must be blaming herself for not being able to sing, you know?"
"Allow me to repeat myself. My one and only goal is to make Ogiso Setsuna suffer."
"And to that end… you'd even go this far…"
"The thing is, I won't hesitate in resorting to whatever it takes to fulfill my goals. Kitahara-san and Iizuka-san… you two should be quite familiar with this fact, right?"
"…I've had enough of this. I don't want to see her face ever again."
"Well, that's about that. If you've got nothing else to say, I'll be excusing myself now. I still have to plan the celebration for next week～"
"Bye now… And do look forward to the Valentine's Concert, okay?"
"Hey, Yanagihara-san… tell me one last thing before you leave."
"Do you really… feel nothing but hate for Setsuna?"
"I suppose on one hand that must be true… But don't you at least like her a little bit, or at least gained some interest in her? Be honest."
"Isn't that why you're so irritated about Setsuna right now? …Because she's now far from what you expected her to be?"
"…As I thought. She's still being influenced by you, I see."
"You see… Ogiso-san has tried to compromise with me too. Going off with stuff like, 'I thought I managed to hate you just a little less' or 'And here I was just hoping I could talk to you'…"
"The way I saw her tears flowing out when she was saying such innocent things… you have no idea how good that felt."
"Yes, just like that… She always trusted your words so blindly, which is why she kept getting hurt over and over, isn't it?"
"That's… true. It's all my fault. That's why I want to make it up to her."
"…The both of you truly are boyfriend and girlfriend. There's no hope for either of you."
"Is this the Amano residence? I'm the executive secretary of Houjou High School's alumni association, Kitahara. Is Nao-san home?"
Last night, I left the Ogiso household and spent the entire night looking for Setsuna.
"…Amano-san? Long time no see, I'm Kitahara from Class E. Do you remember me?"
…But since Setsuna is hardly the type to engage in nightlife, my options as for where to search were quite limited.
"I'm calling you today because we're planning on having an alumni reunion. And I'm the one who's in charge of organizing this event."

In particular, I was interested in karaoke bars that worked until late at night. I went around ten different places in the Minami-Suetsugu and Onjuku neighborhoods and checked every single room in each one.
…Both the employees and the customers there gave me disconcerted looks, but it was hardly the time to be worried about that.
"Right, the date hasn't been decided yet. For now, we're just trying to make sure the invitations reach the right addresses."

With all of the small handful of other places to search I could think of proving to be dead ends, I dragged my feet and returned to the Ogiso household, and like a tyrant, proclaimed it to be my forward base of operations during the course of this campaign.
"Yeah, that's right. Everyone's being careful with their personal information lately. So it's kind of a pain to organize an event like this."
As of right now, my first priority is compiling a list of Setsuna's contacts from high school, middle school, and elementary school.
"All right, we'll contact you guys with more details at a later time. I think the secretary for Class A, Ogiso-san, is in charge of that."
Next up is information from her family.
Be it close friends, neighborhood acquaintances, or any relatives, I'm looking for any clue as to who Setsuna might depend on right now.
"You still remember her, right? Ogiso Setsuna-san. …Have you been in touch with her recently?"
This way, I can narrow down the possibilities. …Without letting it slip to the other side what's actually going on here, of course.
It's exactly because the Ogiso family shares such a close bond…
And exactly because the Ogiso family has cultivated favorable relationships with their neighbors and relatives that I can execute such a shameless plan.
It must be because she was raised in such a wholesome environment that Setsuna grew to become such a wholesome girl.
…So why is it that I keep causing that wonderful girl such terrible pain?
"Hello, is this the Ikebe residence? I'm the executive secretary of Houjou High School's alumni association…"
…No. Now is not the time to feel regret.
I know I can't take back the things I've ruined, but the least I can do now is make the best of what's ahead of me, right?
"For starters, I've gotten in touch with all the Public Policy Department third-year students who I thought might have a clue. …But none of them had any idea."
This operation is like searching for a needle in a haystack, and two other people have gone out of their way to join the search, as they always do.
Io took the same approach as me, using a phone to reach out to as many people as possible, as if she were an aggressive telemarketer.
She combed over the list of contacts Setsuna had made in university thoroughly, from A to Z.
"I'm planning on reaching out to people who took the same seminars as her next. And if that doesn't work, I'll try any club contacts she might have."
"There were two or three that kept trying to recruit her. Although I pretty much chased them off, so I doubt they'll know anything."
"There are countless clubs that want Setsuna as their poster girl. Especially in these past couple of years, since she's gone under the radar, it's been extra hard for me."
"Well, it was just a one-time thing for me anyway. I plan on leaving that job to her proper manager from now on, if you know what I'm saying?"
"That's only if our idol hires me."
"Well, how about you start off with a job interview? Later."
"I made my way around Arumi to check, but I couldn't find anyone even resembling Setsuna-chan there. Still… it's possible that I just overlooked her."
"I'm sorry. She most likely won't be there either…"
Takeya, on the other hand, decided to assist me by using whatever strength his two legs could muster.
Any place I could possibly imagine Setsuna might be, he went to check for me personally.
"I'll bet on it even if the odds are one in a hundred million. It's all for Setsuna-chan."
"Don't sweat it. But you'll pay me back with a favor for White Day. Threefold, at that."
"Of course, I'll repay you. …I'll do my best to convince Io."
"…Is that your idea of repaying me? It's more like taking revenge on me."
Hey, Setsuna… it's about time you came back.
Don't you know that everyone's doing their best to find you? Don't you know that everyone's trying their best to protect you?
So please, don't force yourself to endure this alone anymore. Please, let us support you.
Ahh, that's right… If I just keep this act up, I'm nothing but a coward.
Hey, Setsuna… it's about time you came back.
Don't you know I'm doing my best to find you? Don't you know I'm trying my best to protect you?
So please, don't force yourself to endure this alone anymore. Please, let me support you. Let me alone support you.
Please… you only need to ask.
"Yes, yes… thank you very much. Goodbye, then."

The number of places I've called must be in the hundreds by now since this morning. Admittedly, I didn't expect this strategy to bear any fruit, so upon having that prediction come true, I feel a strange sense of relief.
With this, I've contacted all her old classmates in the address book.
I've also already gotten in touch with all the friends and relatives Setsuna's mother told me about.
Among those was even the number of the hot springs hotel in northern Kanto that promised us they'd keep our trip there a secret from her family.
…Setsuna hadn't chosen those spots for her sorrowful escapade, of course.
"Oh? You're still at it, Kitahara-san? It's already evening."
"Yeah… I'm sorry. I've been here so long… I must have caused your family a lot of trouble."
"Nah, the one causing trouble is a certain family member of mine…"
As Takahiro-kun drags me back to reality, I take a glance outside. The sun has already descended so low that it's hidden behind the tall buildings in the distance.
According to the clock, it's almost 4 PM. Takeya should be back from his rounds soon.
"It's hard to believe Nee-chan is going to graduate next year. How can she still be so childish? …Hey, Kitahara-san, are you sure you want to settle for Nee-chan?"
"Well… if I had to choose, I'd say I won't have anyone other than Setsuna."
I tried to nonchalantly deal with his question, but my choice of words just made the whole exchange weird.
The fact that I've made such an embarrassing statement in front of a family member is supposed to be extremely awkward…
"Okay, I got it! Since Nee-chan has pulled the wool over your eyes completely, I'll help you look for her too, Kitahara-san!"
…Though the fact that it isn't is a testament to just how carefree the Ogiso family is. With the exception of Setsuna's father, that is.
"Oh, it's fine! There's no reason to worry about that at this point. I just need to be ready for whatever comes my way."
"I don't think you should be saying that unless you've been working on it daily…"
"I'm telling you, don't worry about it. I've barely made any progress this afternoon anyway."
"Ah, well, I'm worried about Nee-chan, you see. …Even though you might not be able to tell from my attitude."
"Besides, Takahiro-kun, why aren't you at school? Isn't it a normal weekday today?"
"I mean, it's not mandatory for students to go to school at this time, but you're still the class representative…"
"What's the matter? Did I say something weird?"
"It's National Foundation Day today. There aren't any classes on a day like this. You truly are absent-minded only when it really matters, Kitahara-san."
Realizing my careless oversight, before I could even curse myself or stamp the ground in frustration, I just stood frozen in place for a while.
A holiday… It's a day off both for universities and schools.
Normally, it would be impossible for someone to be alone in that place which holds so many memories for us…
But today, it might just really be empty.
I truly am absent-minded when it really matters.
"…I never called for you to come over, you know?"
Even though she's been here this whole time.
Even though this was the first place that came to my mind out of all the places Setsuna could possibly be.
"Even if you don't call for me, I simply can't see myself not rushing toward you. Though I suppose I've already let you down in that regard, and in more ways than one…"
"What do you mean, more ways than one? As a friend? As a boyfriend? Or maybe… as a guitarist?"
Setsuna is calmer than I expected her to be.
No, it's probably because she has spent the entire day agonizing here all by herself that her tears, troubles, and anguish are now long gone.
…At least, that's what I can infer from her expression.
"It's been three years since we last came here, huh?"
Setsuna is on the stageーthe very stage that we shared memories on.
"Umm… Hello, everyone. We're the Light Music Club!"
Sitting in front of the stage, she swings her legs back and forth while staring at the ceiling in remembrance of fond memories.
"We hereby welcome you to the Houjou High School Festival! Are you all enjoying yourselves?"
She closes her eyes with a nostalgic expression…
And she occasionally clenches her teeth, as if to try and resist the rush of something welling within her.
"Umm… We didn't plan to have a speech like this, so I'd just like to apologize in advance if it's a bit awkward."
She repeats the script from three years ago, word for word.
"I never thought I'd ever sing again… so would you forgive me if my voice doesn't sound very good?"
And she then honestly confesses her current state, dating three years since that memorable day.
"Why did it… have to turn out like this? Why does it always…"
She turns her gaze from the ceiling toward her feet, staring at her shaking legs for just a moment…
"Hey, what should I do? Haruki-kun, what am I supposed to do?"
Before finally… she lifts her head up to face me.
In response to all my other cruel questions, she chose to remain silent, but now…
"I hate singing. I don't ever want to sing again."
This last sentence, I imagine, is most likely a lie.
I slowly walk onto the stage, and slowly move toward the center.
Toward the very same spot where Setsuna once stood before.
The very same stage where that amateur performer confidently put on a show for the first time in her life and attracted the undivided attention of the audience, with a smile beaming across her face.
"I started to hate singing just so that I could keep on loving you."
The MC's words, carrying the weight of the ebb and flow of three years past, gouge at the emotions hidden in the deepest depths of my heart like knives.
"If I sing, I'm sure that the show during the school festival… all the time we spent together practicing… and the final 24 hours, all of those memories will come rushing back."
She stares into the distance as she dwells in nostalgia; she glares at an empty void with a pained glint in her eyes.
"But then… my memories won't be able to stop at those happy moments."
To me, her only audience, she conveys her message, one that's scorching hot yet freezing cold.
"What happened during the night after the festival. And my disgusting true self that I'd been hiding from you."
The words she'd never said, not because she was looking out for me, but because she wanted to hide her own weakness.
"What happened after the final exams, during the trip and then during the piano competition. All those days I spent with Kazusa and you, Haruki-kun… pretending to have fun."
But today of all days, she vented all of these things.
"And then, finally… the birthday party from three years ago."
The day… when I betrayed her.
"Even if I try to cover my ears or close my eyes… that memory still haunts me relentlessly…"
I'm sure Setsuna's eyes still see the snow from that day. Her ears still hear the echoes of my excuses from that day.
"What happened during the graduation ceremony… and at the airport, when we bid Kazusa farewell… it all emerges from my memories so vividly."
My utterly deplorable confession. My voice, calling out to Kazusa. And finally… the proof of our betrayal.
"If it continued on like that, I might start to dislike you… I may even come to hate you…"
That's not even supposed to be hypothetical.
She's simply stating the truth of the matterーthat it would be odd if she didn't come to hate me.
In an attempt to run away from it all, Setsuna has made a decision that's tantamount to her destroying her own identity.
"As soon as I managed to stop, I was able to forget about it pretty quickly. The melodies stopped popping up in my mind, and the lyrics stopped slipping out from my lips."
After all, all throughout that time, Setsuna lived with her songs.
"And no, I don't feel lonely or anything. Because… I don't even remember the time when I still sang."
Everyone around her burdened her with expectations that she never asked for, so when it all piled up, she'd sing her heart out alone in the karaoke box to vent everything.
She went to the rooftop to avoid people, but when she heard one of her favorite melodies from down below, she spontaneously started singing along.
"I did my best, you know? I tried so hard to hate singing just for you, you know?"
"But now you're telling me you want me to remember how to sing…? You want me to fall in love with singing once again?"
"Even though if I sing once again… I might end up hating you?"
She's forgotten how to sing, as well as how to smile…
And finally, she's forgotten how to connect with other people.
"I still love you very much. And… I want to keep on loving you."
"That's why… I can't do it. I just can't go back to singing again…"
"Yes… I heard everything from Haruki-kun. Yeah… There were just some… things I had to deal with."
"I stayed at a business hotel by myself last night. I'm sorry I didn't contact you."
"Yeah, yeah… Sorry, I won't be coming home tonight either."
"No, I'm fine… No need to worry about me."
"I'm at the safest place I could be right now. It's the only place in the world right now where I could possibly feel at ease."
"So please… Please leave me be for a little while longer."
"…I understand. I'll call you later today."
"Bye, then. And I'm sorry, Mom. Can you please tell dad that I'm sorry, too?"
"I'm fine. I won't hesitate any longer."
When I asked her if she wanted to come to my place, Setsuna nodded without any hesitation.
I told her to warm herself up with a shower, so she went into the bathroom without saying a word.
"I won't be coming home tonight either," is what she told her family.
I've already tucked away the picture frame, the DVD recording and especially that magazine from last time deep inside a drawer.
Meaning there's nothing holding memories from the past three years here now. I've removed everything that could possibly evoke any such memory for either of us.
That's why it should be fine. There shouldn't be any problem…
This time, this time… Setsuna and I…
No matter how hard I try to make myself think otherwise, it's obvious that this isn't fine.
I feel like this is just a bad rerun of what happened two months ago. We're just walking down the same path, about to make the same mistakes.
Perhaps Setsuna really won't reject me this time.
And we might be able to go further than what happened during that Christmas night… and manage to greet the morning together.
But it won't come about as a result of us believing in one another. It won't be a refreshing morning that dispels all anguish.
If we still carry the same heavy feelings that burdened us last time, there's no way our hearts could ever truly connect.
We've already experienced all of this for ourselves… But what do we hope to gain from repeating it all over again?
I've made up my mind, haven't I? About the fact that… I will be waiting for Setsuna.
And I'm not waiting for her to give up on me. I'm waiting for her to make up her mind.
"Hey… I guess you're done. There's bottled tea in the refrigerator over there. I'm sorry, but can I ask you to get it yourself?"
"I'm asking… you what you are doing…"
Even though the heater has already warmed up the room… Setsuna's voice and her body are still shaking.
"There are only two days left until the concert…"
A mix of bewilderment, panic, and hopelessness shone through Setsuna's piercing gaze as she stared at me. But she just stood in place, unable to approach me.
"Compared to back then, we're even more lacking in members, so we'll have to make do with an acoustic version. We have to make it work with only one guitarist and a singer."
"So please, stop playing that now! I'm begging you…"
Setsuna's voice, which seemed so fleeting up until a moment ago, had come back in full force. …And with it, so did her anger.
"Why? Why are you doing this…? Why do you insist on doing something so pointless!?"
"Of course it's pointless…! I won't sing, got it? I won't participate in that concert either!"
But her rage subsided almost immediately, and she stared into my eyes with a bewildered expression, as if to ask me why I'm doing this.
"Isn't there something more important we need to do right now…?"
Wrapped in nothing but a bath towel, Setsuna is kneeling down right in front of me.
Although she's covering her chest with her arms, all the curves of her body are laid bare for my eyes to see.
As she closes the distance so much that we can almost feel each other's breath, Setsuna slowly opens her lips and…
Carrying those decisive words, her warm breath reaches my face.
And it's not just her breath. Her lips, face, shoulders… Her entire body is unabashedly flushed after the bath, and the pleasant warmth is reaching me as well.
"Today… I'm sure I won't reject you, okay?"
That alluring voice, and those intoxicating words.
"Just for today, please believe in me… Please, Haruki-kun."
"I'm fine now. I won't hurt you anymore, Haruki-kun."
"Yeah, this is fine… I'm fine already."
As if dispelled by her touch, the sound of the guitar stopped as Setsuna cheerfully invaded my personal space.
The hands she used to cover her chest are now tenderly embracing my cheeks and are pulling me closer to her face ever so gently.
Naturally, our shadows merged into one…
But in response, I bind Setsuna with yet another spell.
"When you say something is fine, you're supposed to say it to reassure someone else, right? Why do you need to say those words to yourself?"
"If you truly want another person… the doubt of yourself being fine with it shouldn't even occur to you, right?"
As I turn my vague reaction into a definite statement, I reveal its true meaning.
"If it were me… I'd never be able to tell you that it's fine, Setsuna. Let alone tell it to myself."
And now, finally, Setsuna understands what my attitude means.
I can't believe Setsuna the way she is now.
I believe that she loves me, and I believe that she cares about me. But I won't believe in her own words trying to reassure herself that she's ready.
"That's… just a guy's logic! It takes so much more courage for a girl to do that compared to a guy!"
"If you really need to force yourself so hard to make up your mind, it's best to just leave it be for now."
Because even I've come to understand that Setsuna's simply trying to use me as an escape right now.
I finally understand the reason why Setsuna was able to see right through my attempts to escape back then.
The more you think about the other, the easier it becomes for you to see this.
"Why…? But why? Haruki-kun, don't you want to do it with me? Don't you love me…?"
And then, after casting another spell to put Setsuna at ease…
"You're the person who I love second best in the world."
I also chant a curse to make Setsuna feel anxious.
Setsuna's flushed face turns pale in an instant.
"That, that means… I, I'm still… to Kazusa…"
The one name that she tried so hard to seal away forever that she stopped singing. She mutters it, unaware.
I knew this would happen because of what I just said. In fact, that's what I was planning for.
"I, I… No matter how hard I tried, no matter how long I waited by your side, even now, compared to Kazusa, I'm still…"
"Because… the one I love the most in the world is the Setsuna who can happily sing in front of me."
For all my feelings to reach her, I knew it would have to make at least this much of an impact.
"The Setsuna who can sing and enjoy herself, despite my crappy guitar's accompaniment."
This is the most despicable form of wordplay.
"The narcissistic Setsuna that would ignore everyone around her, select five songs that she wanted to sing consecutively and wouldn't let go of the microphone at the karaoke box."
Takeya taught me this method of persuasion, telling me that in order to reach that "unreachable girl," I'd have to make an impact before telling her what I really want to say.
"The Setsuna who would still continue singing every day of the week, 24 hours a day, no matter how harsh the practice was."
With the way I am now, I'm showing her that I don't mind resorting to such an underhanded trick as long as it works.
"The Setsuna who, despite complaining a lot during rehearsals, still sang to her heart's content during the actual concert and accepted the audience's cheers with a beaming smile."
"I love her… more than anyone in the world."
But the chances of me actually pulling this off are still around 50-50, because my target is the one truly unreachable girl who stands at the top.
"And it's not just me who feels this way, Takeya and Io also do… and maybe even Yanagihara Tomo…"
But it's not only her body, but the bottom of her heart as well… I must make her understand this.
"That's how things stand, so… I'm sorry. I… need to prioritize practicing right now."
But it's still too early for that now. I have to keep waiting until the time is right.
"If you're sleepy, just use my bed. I might make some noise, but please bear with me."
"…How long are you going to keep doing this?"
"For starters, I need to play the whole thing once without a single mistake. …I've still got a long way to go, though."
"I can't take you there. Sorry, but you'll have to call a taxi."
One hour after the practice started.
Setsuna just sat on my bed with her arms around her knees and stared at me as I played the guitar with a blank expression on her face.
"This practice is totally useless. I absolutely won't sing, got it?"
"No matter if we'll be participating or not in the end, I have to be able to play it at least."
"I'm telling you, I won't sing. We won't be participating for sure."
Setsuna will never judge the way I do things.
And I will never judge Setsuna's assertions either. I just let what she said flow by as if nothing had happened.
This aimless exchange feels like it's been going on forever. We're all alone tonight, but neither of us has even been willing to touch the other as time passed on by.
After another hour, Setsuna opened her mouth once again.
"Have you perhaps… gotten the ridiculous idea that I actually do want to sing?"
"…I don't know. I still don't know to what extent you've come to hate singing at this point, Setsuna."
"I absolutely despise it. Both White Album and Sound of Destiny as well…"
"But you're still willing to listen when I'm playing, aren't you?"
"I like to hear you play the guitar, Haruki-kun."
Her words are very close to sophistry, but I know there's truth to them.
"But I simply can't listen to this song. Just listening to it makes my chest tighten up. I feel like I could burst into tears."
Setsuna only likes the things she likes. And only hates the things she hates.
No other rule apart from that exists in Setsuna's world. Though I suppose that's only natural.
"That's why there's no way I can sing this. Just this one, I absolutely can't…"
Because this is the song that embodies our memories. Because this is the song that brought about the beginning of the end.
Because this is a song made by Kazusa…
"It's all just a terrible prank set up by Yanagihara-san, right? We don't have any obligation to take part in it at all, you know?"
"Then… why are you of all people saying the same things she said? Why are you asking me to sing?"
"I just told you, didn't I? I like the Setsuna who can sing."
"Are you saying I have no value if I don't sing? Even though I'm nothing more than an amateur… who simply treats it as a hobby?"
"I can't help it, because that's who I like."
"Don't be so unreasonable… If you act like that… I might come to hate you, Haruki-kun."
"I told you before, right? If I remember how to sing, that might actually happen."
"Would you… really be okay with that? Would you be okay with me forgetting all about you…?"
"I'll probably be very sad. I'll be very shocked too. And I might not be able to get back up on my feet again."
"Even so, I still want you to sing, Setsuna…"
"Why…? Just how important is something like that to you?"
"I'm not saying it's important to me… rather, I think it's important to you, Setsuna."
"Hey, Setsuna… do you really like your current self?"
"You aren't able to sing because of me… and you can't even smile anymore for the same reason. Do you really like yourself this way?"
"Can you really be called Setsuna if you don't sing, Setsuna? Can you say that such a Setsuna is… truly happy?"
Oh, what did I just do…?
"I'm the one and only Ogiso Setsuna, I'm the real thing…"
I just said the exact same things Yanagihara Tomo said.
"Please, stop this already… Playing the guitar this late at night must be bothering your neighbors."
"My next door neighbor works at night. He's not home right now."
Before I started practicing, I paid my neighbor a visit. He told me he works at night and has Wednesdays off, so I promised that I'd try not to practice during daytime.
Though Setsuna's argument was sound to begin with, it actually had a flaw she had overlooked.
After all, this is around the time I'd always call Setsuna. I played my guitar every day around this time.
"There's not enough time anymore. We can't make it no matter how hard you work now."
"As little as 24 hours is plenty. I speak from experience."
During that school festival, I only got my sheet music the day before the actual concert.
Compared to then, now I'm only trying to play a song that I've already played before…
"I'll apologize to everyone involved tomorrow. You don't have to force yourself, okay? There's no need for you to feel responsible for this, Haruki-kun…"
"This was Yanagihara-san's fault, wasn't it? So there's no reason for either of us to feel responsible for this, Setsuna."
"Just think of this as me doing what I want to."
"No way… I'll feel bad for you, Haruki-kun. It'll all be a wasted effort."
"Effort is part of what makes me who I am. …That's why it won't be wasted or anything like that."
Setsuna has probably realized emotional appeals won't sway me, so she started trying to reason with me logically, but…
This is something Setsuna will never beat me at. There's no way I'd ever lose a pointless quibbling contest like this.
"Won't this cause problems? For the concert staff, I mean."
"Haven't we already established it's not your fault, Setsuna?"
"The DJ who was running the show was really happy when she heard I'd be coming… Even though it's a terrible song, she had it play again and again on the radio…"
"It pretty much went on air every day."
"If I said I wouldn't show up… would anyone else be disappointed?"
"Quite a few people, I think. The song is a lot more famous than you give it credit for, Setsuna."
The fact that this minor song is only broadcasted locally on the university campus has actually made its listeners develop a sort of familiarity with it.
That recording was from our last practice before the high school festival. Most likely, even when you include our actual concert, it's our best performance.
The seminar rooms, the cafeteria, the store… Whenever I heard this song playing in some other corner of the campus, I'd feel embarrassed, nostalgic… and at the same time, quite hurt.
"What do I do…? This is really unsettling…"
"There's no need to be worried, Setsuna. The one who's at fault here is Yanagihara…"
"I know that much. I know, but…"
"It's no big deal, right? Everyone will forget about it soon, right?"
"There are plenty of other groups who'll perform at the concert, so if just one group doesn't show up, it shouldn't make that much of an impact, right?"
"Because even if we do participate, it's just one song, right? It's less than ten minutes and won't make any difference. Someone will just take our place."
"I suppose it's just a small matter."
Setsuna didn't fail to notice my shoulders twitching a little.
"No, I… I just thought that was all such a middle-class thing to say."
"You're terrible… What does that even mean?"
She's being ridiculous. The things she's saying are ridiculous, and I'm sure she's realized it herself.
"What I mean is… putting me aside, you feel a sense of obligation toward all these people you don't even know."
And much like Setsuna herself is imagining it, I too feel the change in her demeanor, feeling slightly more cheerful.
"Of course I feel this way. What if someone went there just to see us…?"
Setsuna's resolve is gradually becoming weaker.
"And like I said, there will definitely be people like that."
The brashly unresponsive attitude she showed a couple of hours ago has subsided, and I can finally see her usual kind-hearted true personality showing.
"Jeez… Don't say things like that just to make me feel uneasy."
She's… probably calmed down a little.
"If you're worried so much about people you don't even know like that, you can't keep running away from things that make you uncomfortable forever."
"Really… Why did it turn out like this?"
I'm sure it's the upbringing she's had from a young age that's been instilled by her kind yet strict parents that's made her so averse to inconveniencing other people.
That must be why she keeps taking responsibility for others' faults. That's why she keeps mistaking her own suffering for that of others'.
"But if you ask me… I like the way you worry about things like that, Setsuna. And I like the way you act like a good-natured member of the middle class, Setsuna."
"…! Mmh, jeez… Being liked in such a way doesn't make me happy."
"It doesn't…? But I really do like that about you."
I think that Setsuna herself believes that her own disposition won't allow her to feel the happiness she wants.
After all, as a result of her kindness, Setsuna walked down a path of self-destruction because of me.
She'd given me a push on the back despite the fact that I'd betrayed her.
That's exactly why I want to cherish Setsuna's kind heart. It's why I want to cherish her small, yet strong sense of responsibility.
The sound of the newspaper delivery man's motorcycle blends into the sound of my guitar.
The other side of the curtains is slightly white. I would assume this is the coldest time of the day.
In the end, Setsuna kept on watching me until dawn.
She's simply putting her full attention on me without the slightest hint of sleepiness in her expression and her mannerisms.
"What… do you think I should do?"
And she continues to worry as she always has up until now.

She can't sing, she doesn't want to sing, and she hates singingーdespite having said all that, however, she's being considerate of both my feelings as well as those of many others, which is why she's unable to come to a conclusion.
"I think… that's something you should decide on your own, Setsuna."
"…What does that mean? Even though you've been pushing me forward all this time."
"I want us to participate. …Because if we do, I'll be able to hear you sing, Setsuna."
"But if you say we won't participate, then we won't. …This is something we both need to agree to do."
"It's fine if you need a little more time to think about it."
I really love Setsuna and the way she's inconveniencing herself and acting so indecisively right now.
"If you think this over seriously now and don't run away from it, but come to a conclusion after some serious thought, then I'll never bring this topic up again."
I know that it's painful and I know she must want to run away, but running away any more than we have would be unforgivable…
I find the fact that a problem of such a small scale can make her hesitate and stress her out so much somewhat endearing.
"If you truly don't want to participate, I'll be there to apologize along with you."
"Why would you…? It's not your fault, Haruki-kun."
"But it's not your fault either, Setsuna. So can't we take responsibility together?"
"I'll wait until the very last moment. Until you come to a conclusion after thinking over everything thoroughly, Setsuna."
That's right, that's why I'll wait…
I'll wait until the day when Setsuna can smile without a hint of sorrow weighing her down.
Until the day when she can forgive me once again, accepting everything without forgetting anything from the past.
Until the day I can meet that defenseless Setsuna, who'll freely hum along with my guitar without even realizing it, once again.
"Are you pretending to be lonely…? Why is that, I wonder…?"

A musical event whose performances are reserved exclusively for the students of Houjou University in accord with a project known as Houjou Broadcast, hosted by a group comprising the mini FM station's broadcasting and research club.
Along with the Summer Live that will take place on the first day of summer vacation, it's considered to be one of the two biggest events planned by said club.

In contrast to the Summer Live, which apparently puts more focus on the rock genre, this event in particular is more fitting for the season. A lot of solo and acoustic band performances are to be expected, and the songs are also mainly serene and ballad-like.

And given the fact that the mini FM station is the main host of the event again, the day's performances will not only be shown in the auditorium hall, but also broadcasted live for students within the university.
That's why there's always a sizable number of students remaining on campus on this particular day every year despite the fact that it's spring break.
"So… which way is the north hall?"
"Um… this way, I guess? That's how we head north, after all."
"It's quite far away, huh… Even though it's within the same campus."
"Come to think of it, I thought this was supposed to be a Valentine's Concert. Why is Ogiso the only guy here, then?"
"How should I know!? No one asked you to come. …I only invited one person anyway."
"I'm sorry, Ogiso-kun. For insisting on coming along…"
"Ah, wait up, everyone! Mihoko, come on, over here."
"…Are you okay, Yada? Aren't you a little pale?"
"If you don't feel well, do you want to look for a place to rest? There's still time until it starts, after all."
"Ah, no need, it's fine. It's not like that…"
"No, um… it's pretty clear that her steps look like they're being weighed down."
"Come on, Mihoko. You're the one who said you wanted to go and see it for yourself, right?"
"I'll stay with you until the end, okay? So let's watch the whole thing together."
"That has nothing to do with Ogiso's little brother. Don't pry into girls' matters so casually."
"Even though I'm the one who got everyone their tickets…"
"By riding on your sister's fame, mind you. Besides, don't you have entrance exams to take next week?"
"S-Still, I'm looking forward to it! I'll finally get to see Ogiso-kun's older sister."
"It's still the stuff of legend in our high school, Ogiso's older sister and Touma Kazusa together in a group! …I've always wanted to see her in the flesh."
"I've said this a million times already, but my sister is really no big deal, you know?"
"…Okay. I'm sorry for making you wait, everyone."
"Ogiso, what are you doing? Aren't you coming?"
"As I thought, there's only couples around us, huh? I guess it does hurt a little bit."
"It's Valentine's Day, after all. It doesn't really bother me, though."
"…Nothing to do with 'the younger brother,' huh…?"
I already expected Takahiro-kun would come, more or less, but I never would've imagined he'd bring those two along…

It's likely that she's the only one who… No, they're the only two spectators that have come to this event with me in mind. …I really don't want to imagine what expectations they have coming here, though.
Still, how do I say this… Now that I know they're going to be watching me, I know all the more that I really can't afford to screw this up.
"Hey, is it really just the two of us going? Two guys going to a Valentine's Concert is kinda…"
"That's just how it turned out, man. Satoko said she wouldn't come no matter what."
"Well, of course not. Not after you told her you'd be going just to gawk at another girl…"
"That other girl's just a performer. It's a concert, so what's wrong with listening to some songs, huh?"
"I'm sure anyone could see that you have ulterior motives… You're from this high school, aren't you?"
"Well, Ogiso-senpai is hella cute! I invited you because you said you never saw her in person yet, you know?"
"I only agreed to come in place of your girlfriend. Well, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't interested."
"Let's hurry up, then? I want to sit as close to the front as possible."
"I'll pass on the front row… The other couples might look at us with pity."
There are people here who have been drawn by the illusion spanning three years, too… and underclassmen from high school, no less.
Come to think of it, even three years ago, our upperclassmen from the university came in droves too. …And even though it was just a shabby little event hosted by our high school.
What's slightly strange is that not everyone seems to be heading to the concert venue.
The cafeteria, the cafe, and many other facilities are filled with students who are supposed to be enjoying their spring break.

I imagine they are taking up positions in places where they can listen to the live broadcast due to the limited hall capacity. No one appears to have any inclination to move until the concert opening.
This does seem to be a common occurrence every year, but even then, compared to last year, this year's turnout is really…
"What if someone went there just to see us…?"
There's nothing to worry about. …No, I think it's more important for us to be more conscious of that fact now instead.
As I thought, Setsuna's really amazing.
Despite having spent three whole years in obscurity, her brilliance remains unblemished even in the slightest…
…As I was lost in thought, I suddenly felt a moist sensation.
"It's been such a long time since we last saw each other, but you're as cold as ever, Haruki-kun～"
On my ear, of all places.
"What are you doing here? Wanna munch on some Pocky?"
I was about to say "That's my line," but she ended up stuffing a Pocky stick into my mouth.
"I can't undershtand whah you're shaying. …Want another one?"
And then, after taking the other half of the Pocky that I bit into and throwing it into her mouth, she takes another one from the box and stuffs it in my mouth again.
"…And here you didn't seem to even show up at all during exams."
Her usual way of taking things at her own pace once again blows away all of the surprise, anger, and concern I felt for her.
"Oh, I was pretty busy today, actually. Someone ended up taking over for me, though."
"Seriously, you could put it in a way that lets me understand a bit better…"
"In any case, today's your moment in the spotlight, isn't it, Haruki?"
"I know everything that has to do with you."
"Jeez～ you don't believe me, do you? You'd actually be really terrified about just how much I know about you."
I wouldn't say terrified, but I am a bit taken aback by the fact that she knows about it, and I can't help but put a bitter smile on.
Even though she almost never showed up in the lecture hall or the lab, she seems to pick up on this sort of intel so quickly…
"Even so, aren't you acting kind of strange? I've been watching you for a very long time now, you know, Haruki?"
"…You're still noticing things that are better left unseen, I see…"
"Don't tell me you're getting cold feet? Are you scared to perform in front of such a large audience?"
"It's true that I'm scared, but it's not exactly because I'm scared of messing up."
It's only been a month since I started practicing again.
I never hoped for success to begin with, so I don't have to worry about the worst case scenario either. In fact, it's probably what's going to happen anyway.
"The fact that my partner is still as famous as ever, I guess."
"Even though it's been three years, I'm still such a bad match for her when I think about it. I just kind of became aware of that, once again…"
"If that's the nuance you can infer from me explaining it like that, then maybe I've been able to take a step forward after all."
"It's been a hard, thorny road getting here. That's what I'd like to say, anyway."
All that money I poured into my phone bills. All those times I lent her a listening ear. All those times I shed the skin of my fingers.
All those times I tried to reassure her. And all those times I told her I love her…
"I see… So that's how it is, huh?"
"I know about the depth of your emotions, you know?"
"Hey. Could you give me a ticket? I couldn't get a hold of one myself."
"I could, but… I only have one left."
"…Fine, here. Now that you took it, you definitely have to come, okay?"
There's not much time until it starts anyway. I doubt I could find anyone else to give it to at this point.
…I'm not exactly sure why, but it feels like giving this ticket to her is the most appropriate thing to do.
"All right, now that I've fulfilled my goal, I'll head on to the auditorium hall first."
"You'll be invading my home stage once again, so you'd best steel yourself and put on the best performance possible, got it?"
"Even when I'm at my best, it's still nothing special. But I'll make sure to put in my best effort. Thanks."
"Go for it, Haruki. …And let me know whether your winter has ended, okay?"
After taking the ticket from my hand, Izumi walks out triumphantly and disappears from my field of vision.
In the end, once again, I'm left with nothing but a half-teasing encouragement from her.
I was unable to ask her about the vague riddles intertwined with the words she spoke.
Like, did that Pocky have anything in particular to do with today…?
And just what has she been doing since the beginning of the April semester?
"Huh? Oh, Yoshito! How long has it been, two years?"
"It's already been so long, huh… I'm always stuck in the Research Building, so I never really get the chance to pay you guys a visit."
"Oh yeah, you're specializing in science and technology, right?"
"Ah, I'm sorry, looks like my friend is here. I'll see you later, man… and you too, Mizusawa-san."
"Toyohama. He was in the same class as us during first year, remember?"
"Ah～ I think I kind of remember him, but I don't really recall… Speaking of which, Takeya, I'm surprised you actually managed to remember a guy's face."
"Well, this isn't exactly a large venue to begin with, and the tickets are as good as free. It's crowded every single year."
"It's cheap, and the atmosphere here is great. The chances of being spotted by another girl are really low too."
"…Sorry, but I need you to stay at least three meters away from me. It would really suck if someone got the wrong idea about us like that."
"Don't worry, none of my current girlfriends are from our campus. In order to avoid utter chaos, I've resorted to a novel sort of outsourcing!"
"Apologize to the proper meaning of outsourcing and all the girls who have ever put up with you."
"Well, obviously it'd be more packed than usual. …This is just another illustration of Setsuna-chan's influence."
"Hey, look over there, it's Ritsuko. Remember, from Class 3-B?"
"Hey, and isn't that Shimazu next to her, also from Class B? I guess they're going out, huh."
"Say what? It hasn't even been a month since we bro… ah, no, nothing."
"…As I thought, I should really sit farther away from you."
"Now that you mention it, uh… there are so many familiar faces here, it's almost like this is an alumni meeting from our high school."
"That school festival concert traumatized everyone involved, after all."
"Apologize to the proper meaning of traumatizing and everyone who was involved. Still, I guess it holds true in the case of those two…"
"More people are here than I thought there would be. Even though there's still 30 minutes left until it starts."
"It feels like there's a good mix of couples who came for the concert, our high school classmates, and new people who became Setsuna-chan's fans after hearing her song on the radio, I guess?"
"I wonder how many of them are here just to see Setsuna?"
"From the looks of it, I'd say about half of them. The legend of Ogiso Setsuna has not waned at all, it seems…"
"Though I guess the scale is much smaller compared to the high school era."
"That's obvious. She's been in something like a state of retirement for the past three years, after all."
"Is she going to be fine? Will Setsuna really be able to sing…?"
"We're still concerned about the same thing as we were three years ago. But as of right now, our first concern should be to secure some seats…"
"I never expected for it to be this crowded. What should we do? Give up on sitting and just watch standi…?"
"Over here! The front row! Here! I saved two seats for you two～!"
"Does that girl have nerves of steel…?"
Houjou University's north hall. The venue for today's concert.
It's somewhere far deeper into the sports grounds away from the main school building by about a highway's width, in a very isolated corner past even all the other club buildings.
There's a small and aged auditorium hall.

Even though it takes at least a fifteen-minute walk from the closest place on the campus to reach this location in the middle of nowhere, today, the line of guests stretches all the way to the outside.
There are couples, groups of friends, and people who have come alone…

Some people are killing time by chatting with their girlfriends while waiting for the concert to start. Some are huddling around the ashtrays outside, smoking. Others are just enjoying the atmosphere outside and not going in.
Winter is upon us, and it's quite chilly now at night. But the excitement in the air here seems to have made people forget just how cold it truly is.
In front of this auditorium hall…
Setsuna appears before me with an eager look in her eyes, her breath puffing up soft clouds of white. Even though she's wearing a coat, her body is still shivering from the immense cold.
"We haven't seen each other in what, four hours? What have you been up to up until now?"
"I went home to take a shower and took a short nap. By the time I was done changing, it was already time to head out. How about you, Haruki-kun?"
"Well, I… I ended up practicing even after you left. I was afraid I'd oversleep if I went to sleep."
"I prepared three alarm clocks, you know? But it was still my mom who got me out of bed in the end."
Up until this afternoon, we were practicing together. We were together for two whole days in a row.
We went to a karaoke box, and my apartment… With my guitar in hand, we checked out numerous places where we thought we wouldn't trouble others while practicing…
By no means could we say that we've perfected our performance, but as the time limit had arrived, we split up, and Setsuna had to return home for a change of clothes.
"Why are you waiting out here? You could've just gone ahead and went inside."
"I went backstage earlier and snuck a peek in there, but everyone seemed on edge and kept fidgeting… I felt like I was intruding somehow, so I decided to come out."
"Well… I guess everyone besides us is pretty serious about this."

For goodness' sake, Setsuna… What am I supposed to do about your indiscriminate behavior? Even Sugiura, who's three years younger than you, is acting more maturely than you are.
…Well, it's made her all the more adorable, of course. Setsuna's recent behavior, I mean.
"H-Hey, hey, Koharu! That was the guitarist, wasn't it?"
"H-He went to the second floor, didn't he? Together with Ogiso-senpai! T-Those two, could they be… don't tell me…!?"
"…Don't ask me things like that. How am I supposed to know!?"
"You don't have to glare at me like that…"
"Mm, mmm… chuu, nn, ha, ah, umm…"
In the end, Setsuna only remained annoyed for the first three seconds.
"Ha, ah, ah…nn, chuu… nnahh… ahh… Ha-Haruki-ku-n, nn, nn…"
Before the door even closed, she forcefully hugged me and pressed her lips against mine. Shutting her eyes as she let out her sweet breath after a few moments, she slowly surrendered herself to me.
"Nn, ha, haa… ah, ahh… nn…chuu…uu… ha, haa, haaa… uu, n… Ah～ it's been a week… I waited for so long."
Setsuna had been placed on a one-week curfew since last week…
"But… isn't it too obvious that we disappeared in the middle? I'm sure they're making some wild guesses about what we're doing right now."
"I don't mind them making wild guesses. Since we're doing something along the lines of their imagination anyway, it's not like there will actually be any misunderstanding, right?"
"…I have a feeling your dad wouldn't be so happy, though."
"He hasn't come out today. He's been cooped up inside his study all day."
"Does that mean… he doesn't want to see me…?"

Setsuna initially received a penalty due to the fact that she'd stayed out five days in a row and went to the concert without permission. As such, she was forbidden to stay out anymore during spring break.
"It's fine, Haruki-kun, don't worry about him! Just leave that lame old dad to be on his own!"

Putting myself in her father's shoes, this sort of conclusion for all the distress his daughter, who's already a university student, had put the family through was already quite concessive given the circumstances.
"No… the way I see it, he's actually being quite reserved…"
"What do you mean? Forbidding me from going out was just terrible!"
"Yeah, but that was because you went against his authority, Setsuna…"
"Are you saying it's just my fault? I mean, Haruki-kun… you did it, too…"

Nonetheless, Setsuna had arrived at my place early in the morning last weekend, had all three of her meals there, and would go into her "night mode" whenever I attempted to remonstrate her to return home.
"Well, of course I would. My own self-control isn't quite so virtuous, either."
As a result, Setsuna's father, who could no longer tolerate such behavior, placed Setsuna on a curfew that would be lifted under the condition that she showed genuine remorse for her actions.
"…With that in mind, I'll come over to your place tonight, okay?"
"I already know exactly when we'll get our chance. When it ends, and right after we've sent everyone home, we'll sneak out."
Setsuna… seems to have gotten stronger, but in a different sense than usual, perhaps.
At any rate, I need to talk to her father directly and slowly about all this, just once. I don't… think he has the wrong idea about us, but I still want to be sure I have his approval.
"The corner of your mouth is… wet…"
There must have been a trace left behind after our kiss.
And to deal with such a thing, all you'd need to do is dab it a little with a handkerchief, and that'd be the end of it, and yet…
What Setsuna chose to use was neither a handkerchief nor a tissue…
"Huh… it's wet again… That's strange, huh…?"
"Nnnn, nn, nnn～! Nn, nn… ha, haa, haa… umm…"
In response to Setsuna's impish, irresistible act of sticking her tongue out playfully, I press my lips against hers once more without warning.
She's strong behind her feeble looks, she's mean behind her amiability, and her reserved attitude defies her actual selfishness.
It's just that this changed demeanor of hers is quite like her high school self, something that elates me beyond description.
…I wonder if her dad would really be able to understand that?
"Well, since we've finished planning things here, it's about time we went downstairs."
While we'd spent only ten seconds discussing our escape plan, it took us more than ten minutes to settle… a certain something else.
Since we've been up for such a long time, it'd be pretty hard for them not to have guessed what we've been doing up here.
"Alright, let's go, Haruki-kun. I'm pretty proud of the roast beef I prepared for today…"
"Ah, before that… I have a present for you."
But I still need just one more minute…
"Th-Thank you… But shouldn't you give me the present in front of everyone else…?"
"I couldn't, not this… I have my reasons, but this just isn't something I can show to the others."
Setsuna froze on the spot when she noticed the small box I'd presented to her.
"Maybe I feel that I would really screw up by doing that. Or perhaps I thought it'd be over for me and I'd feel really hurt if you end up being even the slightest bit taken aback by it…"
No, more accurately, she probably froze on the spot at the sight of the sweat trickling down my forehead and at the way I'm babbling.
The moment Setsuna opened the wrapper… the nervous feeling I had when I bought this came up again.
Just like that time three years ago…
"Um… it might be a little old, and it's just something cheap, but it should look decent since I cleaned it."
The amount I spent on cleaning this is probably the same amount I spent on buying it…
"I don't want the others seeing me do this."
Because it's just something cheap. Because it's already so old.
And also… because it has a very deep meaning to it.
"Um… in case you don't like this, I've prepared something else as well."
"W-Would you like this better after all? I bought it from the same store, and it's more expensive than that one, and also…"
"I want this. I won't take anything else."
"Why is the one giving the present thanking me… The way you use Japanese is weird. You're so weird, Haruki-kun…"
Surely, this is… the most radiant smile I've ever seen.
This one time, I need not worry about the redness in her eyes, or the tears welling up in them…
We've finally returned to the day when she held that birthday party…
"Haruki-kun… can you put it on for me?"
As she said that, Setsuna… held out one of her hands in front of me.
After many intense moments throughout the span of three years, this ending is simply so calm it feels almost anticlimactic.
But this is itーthis is the ending we got…
And it's the best ending we could have hoped for.
"Ah, where did you go, Nee-chan? Everything's already prepared here."
"Sorry, sorry. Something got into my eyes…"
In response to the question about her reddened eyes, Setsuna responds with a well-crafted yet transparent excuse.
"Let's begin, then! Everyone, got your drinks ready～? …Hey Mom, I can have some wine today, right?"
"For the last time, I'm not Secchan…
"U-Um, Miss, it's a pleasure to meet you! I'm Ogiso-kun's classmate…"
"I'm Shimizu Sayuri! U-Um, I went to the concert. And I was deeply moved by it!"
"Thank you. Hey, are you two going to be enrolling in Houjou University next year?"
"Y-Yes, I'll specialize in a foreign language, and she'll specialize in education…"
"I see… It's a shame all our specializations are different. But if you see me on campus, feel free to call out to me anytime, okay? Ah, right, and how about I show you around the campus sometime?"
"Ehhh, are you serious!? We'll really take you up on that offer, you know?"
"Wh… Jeez, Sayuri… Let me introduce myself too."
The instant Setsuna became the center of the party again, the atmosphere livened up immediately.
She always puts on a show for others, constantly attracting the attention of those around her…
And yet there's no other like herーa girl who, despite the aforementioned traits, is unbalanced by the fact that her taste in men is as plain as her personality.
A girl that doesn't belong to anyone else, but to me and me alone…
"Hey now, hey now～ What's with that ring finger～"
"Making up for the three years you kept her waiting by completely overdoing it, are you? Just seeing you guys is enough to make me blush, you know."
"…Didn't I say I don't want to speak with you two again for today?"
The image of Setsuna's left hand didn't go unnoticed by the sharp eyes of a certain duo, who take their elbows and… jab me in my sides rather inconsiderately.
"Well then, let's get ready for the toast…"
"Eh, let me see, where? Whoa, it really is～!"
Just when we thought the birthday party was about to start in earnest, the sudden arrival of a long-anticipated guest inevitably interrupted our plans.
"Uwaaah… it's snowing hard… and it's so white."
As if to respond to our cheer, the snowflakes outside the window show off with a strong, intense dance.
Gazing at the window before her, Setsuna extends her left handーwith a slight glint of silverーbefore me.
Naturally, I stood at the empty spot next to Setsuna, tightly snuggling up to her.

According to the monthly weather forecast, after the current period of cold passes, a sharp rise in temperature is expected to follow. And then, the first merry signs of spring are also expected to arrive.
If that were to be true, this could perhaps be the last snow we see for this season…
Winter has come to an end.
The season belonging to the three of us has come to an end. The season of White Album has come to an end.
The season belonging to just the two of us.
"Is that so… I'm still waiting for my bus. If I start looking for another route now, I might be late…"
"It's snowing really hard here in Paris. I didn't think I'd make it by today."
"Same here. The plane landed three hours late… Jeez, and I was even hoping to go sightseeing with you."
"According to our original plan, we were supposed to meet up before sunset. I was supposed to pick you up at the airport, too…"
"We won't be able to spend as much time together, huh…"
"I'm sorry… I didn't think they'd give me extra work for tomorrow…"
"Ah, don't worry about that. You were here on a business trip in the first place, anyway. I'm just a little disappointed about today."
"Speaking of which… This company sure knows how to work its new employees to the bone…"
"That just means they have high hopes for you!"
"It's probably more like they don't even think of me as a newcomer…"
"Ahaha… I guess so. After all, factoring in the amount of time you've worked there as a part-timer, it's been nearly three years now, hasn't it?"
"Yeah, but still… that's supposed to be another thing entirely…"
"It's fine. This just happened because I'm being unreasonable, saying that I want to meet up with you…"
"But didn't we make it a promise? …That we would never be separated from each other for more than a week."
"Who would've thought that I'd be away on a week-long business trip, though…"
"Didn't I just say that? You shouldn't worry about it since it's for work. And besides…"
"Our promise will absolutely not be broken. Which is why I've come all the way here. …To chase after you, Haruki-kun."
"Just kidding! I've actually wanted to come here for the longest time now! To the Strasbourg Christmas Mass!"
"Gosh, when I heard you were heading to France for a business trip, Haruki-kun, I got so excited since I've always wanted to come here… That's why I owe a big thank you to your superior!"
"There's no need for that. He'll let it go to his head."
"That's why I was so worried when I noticed snow was building up at the airport, and the plane had to circle around because it couldn't land. But I'm glad we've made it in time…"
"Yeah… I'm glad we made it too. Whether it be for the Christmas Mass, or the one-week promise… and…"
"…? Ah, the bus is here. I'll see you later, then. I think it'll take another hour."
"Yeah, then I'll go ahead and check in at the hotel."
"Yeah, I'll call you again once I'm at the station."
"…Do you know how to get there?"
"I'm all good! …I made sure to bring along my French and German electronic dictionary."
("Take me to Hotel Cour du Corbeau, please.")
After graduating from university in March according to plan, I gladly took up a full-time job at Kaiousha.

While I'm at it, I was assigned to Kaiou Graph's all-too-familiar editing department, so I'm fully enjoying living the life of a new salaryman without getting to enjoy the freshness of a new workplace.
…Even so, due to the strong influence of my predecessor, I received the nickname "Kazaoka the Second" on my very first day thereーsomething I'm not sure if I should be happy about.

That's why, in order to accomplish the same amount and quality of work as that superhuman, I'm shouldering a responsibility that's far too heavy for a newcomer, and find myself busily running about every day.
…Perhaps it's better to say that I've been used as if I were a convenient tool.
("I have a reservation for two under my name, Kitahara…")
Today is the sixth day of my overseas business trip. It's been exactly one week since I've left Japan.

During this time, I went to three different countries and five different locations to gather material. In order to not bring shame to the name of Kazaoka the Second, I pushed myself to the limit and worked my hardest.
…Well, using the same methods as my predecessor, I accepted work from other departments as well in order to save on the trip fee, so that's my own fault.
Which brings us to today, December 24th.
After completing the morning interview in Paris, this business trip has come to an end. Starting tomorrow, for the next two days, I will be able to rest and enjoy my time with Setsuna in Strasbourg.
Tonight, we're going to the Cathedral to attend the Christmas Mass. Tomorrow and the day after, we'll tour around the city, then return to Japan in the afternoon of our second day.
…Well, that was our original schedule, anyway. Until this morning, when Hamada-san tossed additional work my way.
As a result, Setsuna and I will only get to spend some time together on the very last day.

But even so, I'll still get to meet up with Setsuna, who left Japan yesterday. We can still fulfill our promise of seeing each other at least once per week, and at this rate, we'll even be able to attend the Christmas Mass together.
We made it just in time for Christmas Eve. We made it just in time for the Mass. I've already set the stage for this memorable day.
Through my determination… I was able to catch up just in time.
Which is why right now, all I need to do is calmly complete this assignment.
…To replace the cheap trinket on the ring finger of Setsuna's left hand with the real deal.
I open the small box, revealing the Christmas present for Setsuna inside. …It's a once-in-a-lifetime present that holds a particularly deep meaning.
Between gathering materials, I went around different jewelry stores in Paris, and finally found something that was both affordable and matched the design I had in mind.
Though the express train arrived late following that, making me turn pale for a while, I made it just in time for the Mass… and this Christmas.
The only thing left to do is to hand it over to Setsuna.
Although doing something this personal at such a solemn ceremony is a bit shameful, I hope I can use the mood of this event to make it work. …After all, it's the first time I'm proposing to someone.
Setsuna will be here soon. And then, I will…
Right when I got all excited, I got a text that completely spoiled the mood…
My respected yet unreasonable superior at work ended up completely destroying my vacation this morning.
"Thanks for your hard work, this is Hamada."
Yes… I know I've been working hard.
"Sorry for doing this on such short notice, but here's an overview for tomorrow's coverage."
"The detailed information will be sent to you in an attached file via email. I just want to summarize the most important points."
I don't want to read it… I really don't want to read this now…
"Your job consists of an interview. Ensemble's chief editor insisted on this. I'm sorry, but you owe a lot to him too, right?"
Originally, I could've spent the entire day with Setsuna touring Strasbourg.
"Around this time of year, the subject for the interview goes on vacation to where you are, so your schedules happened to coincide."
I never thought I would get to work at such a romantic tourist spot, let alone on Christmas…
"The cameraman is a local; he'll meet up with you. Your only job is to do the interview, Kitahara."
That's right, I could just bring Setsuna along…? No. I can't, I'd be mixing my personal life with my professional life.
"You don't have to worry about any language barriers. You'll be working with someone who can speak Japanese fluently."
But the one who mixed my private life with my professional life to begin with was the one who gave me an unreasonable workload during my vacation…
"After all, the person you will be interviewing is…"
…That… wasn't Setsuna's voice. There's no way I wouldn't realize that.
It's just that, in this foreign country, there wouldn't be any person other than her who would call out my name…
I just simply don't want to believe it.
This is Strasbourg, a city located in the northeast of France. Taking a trip from Paris to here, even on an express train, would take approximately two hours.
And also… from Vienna to here, if you take the Orient Express…
But, but… even so, the chances of this happening are…
