"Ooohhh, Kitahara-san～! I love you～! You would be the man I wanted to hug the most if I had to take a questionnaire right now!"
Expectedly, the restaurant didn't seem to have many seats filled immediately after opening, but it was perplexing that the staff present seemed to be at their wits' end about the situation.
"It's just like I told you on the phone. We don't have close to enough staff to work in the hall…"
"I won't let you go～! I won't ever let you go!～ Come, let's die together～!"
I pushed away the floor manager who was clinging to me with teary eyes before taking a quick glance around the interior of the restaurant.
"That's what I told you over the phone! That's why we need your help～!"
"How did the roster become like this…? At least three people should be working here."

"I did make sure to arrange a shift of three, but I didn't expect two of the said three staff members to suddenly become unavailable. We could've managed somehow if at least one other person was present…"
That's about all Satou tried to tell me when he called me on the brink of tearsーrather, I'd say he was already crying by then.
To be even more specific, he apparently received a call about 30 minutes before opening hours.
On the other end of that call was Shimamoto-san, who was struggling to even say he was unable to get up because of a high fever of 39°C.
The floor staff was reduced to two people from the original three available, but no one seemed to be alarmed at that point in time.
That's because it was floor manager Nakagawa's shift on that day, along with who was considered the most reliable staff member and who was the least likely to be late or slack off from work…
"It just goes to voicemail even when I tried calling her… Seems like her phone is off."
Nobody could have imagined that she would be absent without contacting anybody.
"Well, it's gotta be because of that, right? Her mentor's not taking shifts anymore, so the spark in her heart must've died out…"
"That's why we called you over. We figured that if her boyfriend happened to come back to work, she'd pick up his scent and come back too…"
"This has nothing to do with me! I'm neither her mentor nor her boyfriend! And you guys should know that you're being really disrespectful to her!"
As much as I'm complaining, I'm fully aware that I have no choice but to help out…
As her trainer, I have to take responsibility for how she's absent from work without notifying the restaurant.
…Though I do intend to reprimand those who assigned me to be her trainer after work.
Really, what in the world's gotten into you, Sugiura…?
The two hours that followed were a living hell.
Apart from the difficulty of having to work with only two people available, I wasn't able to work efficiently given my lack of sleep from the exhaustion I had to deal with yesterday.
…No, I usually am capable of handling such a level of fatigue when I manage to concentrate.
It's just that I'm unable to forget about everything and devote myself to my work right now.
"Thank you for the wait. May I take your order?"
"This is the Minami-Suetsugu Goodies restaurant. Thank you for your patronage."
"Umm… I'd like an A set with the roasted rib steak."
"Would you like rice or bread with that order?"
"Sugiura-san! Are you at home? Are you alright?"
"Yeah, yeah… ah, I see. It must be hard on you."
"I'll have a Spaghetti Bolognese. I'll also have a mixed pizza."
"Ah, I'll have the drink set as well."
"How are you feeling right now? Yeah… Yeah… I see."
"…!? Eh, ah, certainly. I'll repeat your order, then."
"Yeah, well, I suppose it's best that you don't force yourself to come today."
"…Roasted rib steak with set A and rice, and minestrone soup…"
"Eh? Ah, let's see… It was really busy at one point, but now we are able to get by somehow."
"…Raspberry parfait, Caesar salad with a drink set…"
"No, no, only the drink set was correct, and there's no salad in the set in the first place."
"Yeah, apparently Shimamoto-san's in the same boat as you… influenza really is going around, isn't it."
"My deepest apologies, I'll call over another server immediately!"
"Nakagawa-san, please take the order from Table 8! I'm taking a three-minute break!"
What a disgrace… I would have been absolutely furious if I were the trainer right now.
But right now… I know that I'd be done for if I say that I just can't help it, but I really can't help it, can I…?
"Ahh～ Like I said, everything's fine now. The only one who is capable of replacing you is…"
"Sugiura! Where are you and what in the world have you been up to!?"
I've been worried about her this whole time and was incapable of concentrating on working because of it…
"Eh, eh… but why? I thought you didn't have a shift today…"
"Eh, umm, that's… well, that's not really important right now, is it?"
"Ahh～ umm… it seems like she just woke up."
"You overslept? You actually overslept!? Can you even be called Sugiura Koharu after such a mistake!?"
That's why I was unable to resist lecturing her upon the incredible relief when I heard her voice on the other end of the line.
"She might have overslept, but her fever has been around 38°C since last night."
"…Understood. This decoration of an acting manager will remain silent."
"I'm sorry… umm… I'm sorry for causing everyone so much trouble…"
"…There's nothing you could have done if you're sick. I'm sorry for shouting at you."
That's why I was completely unaware that her voice was trembling ever so slightly.
"E-Even so… if you weren't feeling well since yesterday, you should have contacted us earlier so we could've made arrangements."
"But, Senpai, you said you weren't coming anymore… so I felt as if you were trying to avoid me…"
"…I didn't mean me specifically, you could've called the restaurant. Or maybe Satou or Nakagawa-san."
"A-Anyway, if that's the case… just rest for today. Is your family at home?"
After hearing her reasoning, my head, which boiled up all of a sudden only moments ago, cooled down just as quickly in relief.
"Do you have any medicine? Did you eat properly? If there's something you need, I can deliver it to you on my way home…"
Perhaps the reason why I got so angry at her but cooled down in a matter of seconds was because I felt a sense of guilt.
"Senpai… will you be there for the whole day?"
"Yeah… I imagine Nakagawa-san would kill me if I tried to leave. Satou and me both."
"No, seriously, I'm begging for you not to leave, alright?"
"I felt as if you were trying to avoid me."
After all, the person in question has already noticed.
That's why the moment I decide not to press the issue further and think about visiting her to atone for what I've done…
"You don't have enough staff, right? I'll be there within 30 minutes."
The situation unfolds in an unexpected direction yet again.
"What are you saying!? Don't you have a bad cold!?"
"I've already recovered from the cold. I slept until noon, so my fever has subsided."
"It's not merely about yourself. What will you do if others get infected? Do you want to wipe out everyone else working this shift!?"
"Didn't I say that I've recovered already!? Besides, I'm confident I won't get anyone else sick! After all…"
"Ah!? Don't just hang up! Hey, Sugiura! Hey, wait a minute!"
Even though Sugiura only wanted to call to inform us that she was sick and wanted to take the day off…
If she is able to arrive within 30 minutes after recovering, doesn't it mean that in just three minutes she completely recovered from her illness?
That's just not normal at all.
"I'm really sorry! I was wrong to have been late and not to have contacted anyone as soon as I could."
She really came… in exactly 30 minutes, no less.
"You don't have to pay me today. …That goes without saying, actually. So just let me work now. Please."
"Um, you know, Sugiura-san, if we don't pay you for your work, it will cause a lot of legal problems…"
"Did you have to give her such a serious answer…?"
She changed her clothes within five minutes, although her skirt is a bit messy…
Even so, her posture, complexion, voice, and the way she talked showed that she might be fine, as she said.
…Still, she wasn't able to hide her pained expression.
"…That's not true. I'm fine, you know?"
"Like I can take your definition of 'fine' at face value, Sugiura."
That's why I could only rely on my intuition.
I casually stretch my hand out to touch Sugiura's forehead and check her temperature.
Despite her protest, she's finally keeping silent for a moment after making all that fuss up until now.
"And while I'm at it, you two should hurry back to your posts."
Based on what I see and feel, there isn't any evidence to refute her statement of being fine.
I was pretty sure that she was just acting tough… Was I just overthinking things?
Unconvinced, I continue to touch Sugiura's forehead, causing her to make a rather odd expression.
Though her reaction doesn't suggest that it's stemming from being sick at all…
"…Someone who has a girlfriend shouldn't do things like this. Isn't this sexual harassment?"
"…Then act like you're actually repulsed by it."
What does having a girlfriend matter when it comes to sexual harassment?
In the end, Sugiura went through my strict medical inspection and headed back to work in the dining hall as a result.
And then, a few hours later…
If I were to summarize it, Sugiura could only be described as someone suppressing her illness and forcing herself to work.
Because unlike how she usually was, she wasn't useful at all.
She was spacing out and making a lot of mistakes. It was her worst performance yet, even including her first day working here.
"Things didn't go as planned today, did they…?"
"…I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused."
"It's not that I'm blaming you. This is also my responsibility as your trainer, after all."
"I was under the impression that you would understand that not every responsibility is accepted reluctantly, Sugiura."
Sugiura seems to grow disheartened over even the slightest negative remark or action I've taken with her today.
Perhaps it's because of our unexciting conversation that our steps on the way back home feel rather heavy.
"The truth is, you haven't fully recovered, right? You're just suppressing your fever using medicine, aren't you?"
"I'm not doing… anything like that. After all…"
"…I really am okay. I have no doubt about it. Please believe me at least in that regard."
"You're making it even more difficult for me by asking me to believe you…"
Not only did she not answer my question, she ended up making me worry even more.
On our way back, I walked her home as she trotted behind me silently as usual.
…No, only half of it is what's usual.
My usual pace would be faster, and she would start lecturing me the very moment she found any openings she could exploit.
However, our pace is incredibly slow today.
"You know, Sugiura… I really think you should rest tomorrow."
"No, I didn't mean it that way."
"Well, I guess it's obvious. I made countless mistakes today, after all. I troubled the customers, everyone else, and you as well, Senpai."
"I wouldn't ask you to rest just because of some mistakes. Rather I'd tell you to make up for it by working twice as hard tomorrow."
"I'll work twice as hard tomorrow then…"
"Like I said, it's not that! Your mistakes, your negative thinking, I think it's all because you're tired, Sugiura."
"I wouldn't know even if you asked me. Ask your own body."
We left the restaurant at the usual time, but three trains had passed after the one we'd normally take by the time we got there.
It's usually a fifteen minute walk from the station, but at this rate it looks like it will take at least twice as long.
We had to go through a repetitive cycle where Sugiura would stop in her tracks before I knew it, and I'd had to turn around to check on her many times.
And yet, every time I asked if she was feeling ill, she just gave me the same answer…
"That's why you should get a good night's sleep tonight, and if possible, just stay at home and rest tomorrow too…"
"But the shift won't be operational if I'm not around… Isn't Shimamoto-san down with influenza as well?"
"I'll cover for you. Just like today."
"But Senpai, you'll be busy for a while. And the final exams are going to start soon…"
"The thing is even if I flunked everything, I'd still be able to advance to the next year. I'm also the hardworking type, just like you, Sugiura."
"Yeah. That's why you should just rest up and take care of yourself tomorrow. I'll let Satou know about this."
My exams were just an excuse for me to run away in the first place.
Still, how do I put this… I've told her about my exams in an attempt to avoid spending time with her like this, but divulging this just makes the endeavor feel meaningless…
With this, Sugiura won't come tomorrow.
That's why, even if I go to Goodies, our time together will…
Our time together, which I would unconsciously look forward to again, will…
"I know I caused a lot of trouble yesterday. I slept soundly last night, so I'm completely fine this time. I'll do my best to make up for yesterday's mistakes."
"I'll take my salary, so it won't be a problem, right?"
"How serious were you when you were preparing for your counter-arguments…?"
"Today, including myself, we will still only have three people for the dining hall. Please carefully think through whether to dismiss me or let me work."
"You two, why don't you say something!?"
In spite of my meticulous planning, it seems like we'll be spending time together again today after all.
"Why did you come? I said you should rest today…"
"I realized I'd feel better if I came to work."
"I think you of all people should understand why that's the case, Senpai. …Though I won't tell you the specific reason why."
"Then I won't be able to understand you, will I?"
"I guess 'Once on shore, one prays no more' is true for just about everyone, huh?"
In the end, it was just like she said…
Sugiura didn't seem to be in particularly high spirits, as usual, but she did show drastic improvement compared to her performance yesterday.
"I guess this just about covers most of Building 3. All that's left to see is the library in Building 4 on the other side."
"Ah, that's fine. Even if I do manage to get accepted, it's not like I'd actually go there at all within the four years I'd be here."
"It's enough for you to have taken me around all the areas related to the Literature Department. Thank you very much for today, Kitahara-san."
"Not at all… You can ask me to help you with stuff like this anytime."
The person who's walking beside me this evening is neither a seminar colleague I'm familiar with or an old friend; and it's certainly not his older sister who I happen to meet every now and then.
"Wow～ A tour like this certainly increases my motivation. I can't believe that I'll be studying here starting April."
"…Only if you pass the general entrance exam, that is."
"Don't worry～! The mock exams didn't feel so bad. Moreover, isn't this the university that even Nee-chan got into?"
"Your sister was excellent, you know? …She didn't get removed from the recommendation list, for one."
"I don't know what you've heard from Nee-chan, but I really am doing my best! Believe in me, Kitahara-san."
"Yeah, well, I do, but… anyway, good luck."
Apparently, Takahiro decided to visit the university he's taking entrance exams for out of the blue just yesterday.
His sister, however, who he had arbitrarily designated to be his guide for the day, had to attend a seminar in the evening.
Even so, the family didn't want to rain on Takahiro's parade, and so they came up with a solution after a meeting…
Said solution being to promptly nominate a certain someone who everyone in the family was familiar with; someone who they could count on as a reliable substitute.
"As I thought, Houjou is good. Decent city, decent outskirts, reasonably spacious, and reasonably new."
"That's not something a student who attends the high school right next door should say…"
It took me quite a lot of courage to press the answer button when I received Setsuna's call last night for the first time in a while.
Though the way Setsuna sounded so desperate, yet so unusually slow when I heard her voice from the receiver really perplexed me.
"Last week I toured some other universities. The city center ones had tall buildings, but their campuses felt very cramped. While the spacious ones were in the countryside with old school buildings."
"Well, in that sense, here it's in between…"
However, I could imagine Setsuna bowing apologetically many times on the other side of the call during our conversation, which warmed my heart.
It wasn't a big deal, but she relied on me…

Actually, and from what I know about her family, it's possible that they didn't have any other choice apart from me in the first place, though I'm happy to have been relied on by her family nonetheless.
…Though they never would have placed any faith in me if they were to ever find out about what I've done to their eldest daughter.
"More than anything, I'd say that the girls here are just next level. I guess this is the most appealing bonus of Houjou University that various upperclassmen have done their best to facilitate."
"Your sister is right near the top of even that level"… is what I instinctively want to reply with, but I stop myself, realizing the sort of excessive backlash I might get.
"And there's also quite a number of girls in the Literature Department! Is that why you changed departments, Kitahara-san? I imagine you must be fed up with Nee-chan by now."
"…I'm aiming to work in the publishing industry. That's all there is to it."
"Why'd you answer so seriously…? Of course I'm joking."
What was considered a mere joke to the Ogiso family ended up piercing through my chest painfully.
That's because I'm responsible for a lie that Setsuna's desperately held onto even though the Ogiso family was supposed to have no secrets between its members.
"Well, it's about time I went home, then."
"Oh? Already? Didn't Setsuna say that her seminar would end in another 30 minutes, though."
"It's fine, she's just my sister. We see each other everyday anyway."
If not for the fact that he's related to her, I imagine the guys here would beat him up for saying that…
"I have to stop by a classmate's house after this, anyway. I guess I shouldn't have taken the role of class rep in the first place."
"Yeah, I've had to deal with that plenty of times. What with taking the printouts to the absentees and all."
"She hasn't attended school even once since the end of winter break, so she's at risk of not being able to graduate. And to think that she's already acquired a recommendation to Houjou University…"
This all started out as a completely casual conversation.
However, upon hearing the phrases "she's not attended school even once" and "a recommendation to Houjou University," I felt rather uneasy somehow.
I feel as if I've heard those words before, and only just recently, at that.
"Even if you ask who it is… it's not like you'd know if I just gave you the name of one of my classmates, Kitahara-san."
"No, the thing is, back when I was a teacher in a prep school, there were quite a few students from the third-years of Houjou High. I was just wondering if it could be one of my former students…"
I know that what I just spewed out in the spur of the moment sounds rather deceitful.
It's just that it was the best way I could put it so I wouldn't specify a certain someone that I'm particularly worried about.
"Ah, so that's the case. Now that you mention it, our first-term class rep seems to know about you as well, Kitahara-san."
"T-Then, could it be that the one who hasn't come recently is that first-term class rep…?"
Something suddenly clicked somewhere in my mind.
I was reminded of how Sugiura Koharu's annoyingly meddlesome front had disappeared following the end of the winter break, and how she's been oddly dispirited ever since.
I still don't know whether she's like this because she's feeling unwell or if I'm simply imagining it, however…
If she really hasn't been able to go to school up until now, she really must be unwell in some way, as I thought…
"No, you're wrong. It's a girl called Yada Mihoko. Well… she was quite frail to begin with."
At that moment… I felt something click in my mind.
However, the source of the sound was just the slightest bit different from what I initially anticipated.
"I'm sorry. Seems like she's not feeling well today either."
"Would you like me to pass on a message?"
"Ah, no, thank you… I believe the homeroom teacher and the class rep did come visit yesterday, so…"
"Yeah, it was about her graduation, right…? We talked about that too, but… I'm not sure whether she can attend next week…"
"Say, Sugiura-san, will Mihoko really be unable to graduate? And to think that she's already acquired a recommendation for the university…"
"Ah, no, I don't think that will be the case… Mihoko has good grades and she's aiming for a private university, after all, so I imagine there'll be room to accommodate her."
"I hope so… The homeroom teacher said it might be quite difficult for her yesterday…"
"…Suwa-sensei always exaggerates things. I'm sure everything will be alright."
"Really? Thank you so much for looking out for Mihoko all the time. I'm really grateful to you, Sugiura-san."

"I hope you'll continue getting along with Mihoko from now on, okay? She chose to sign up for the Literature Department because she wanted to stay with you, you know? It was supposed to be a secret, though."
I feel sorry for calling out to Sugiura in her current state…
But she didn't notice me at all despite how I've been within her line of sight for a while.
"Oh…? So you really do get along with the entire family, huh?"
"I'm sorry… I just said something I shouldn't have."
Despite having immediately corrected herself, Sugiura's words were undeniably and uncharacteristically spiteful.
Perhaps she's confused about how to proceed with our conversation due to my completely unexpected appearance here.
"I heard about how Yada-san hasn't come to school ever since New Year's. As well as how her prospects for graduation are rather unclear despite how she's already been accepted to the university."
"So Ogiso also gave you Mihoko's address…?"
"No. I've walked her home two or three times back when I was still teaching her at her prep school. …I was answering a lot of her questions to the point where it was quite late in the evening."
I've particularly had to deal with instances where Yada-san would occasionally ask me questions that she should have been able to answer on her own given her level of comprehension.
Though now that I think about it, that was probably because she…
"This is the reason why you came late last week. The reason why you've been feeling so down… And the reason why you still came to work despite that."
"It was because you came here in the morning… and she didn't even answer the doorbell, which caused you to be late, right?"
This place also happens to be in the exact opposite direction from Goodies, with the station situated in between.
So Sugiura must've wanted to pay her a short visit before work, but in the end, Yada-san refused to come out of her room no matter how long she waited…
"Correct… was what I would've said, but only half of what you've said is true."
"She let me into her room last week. I was even able to talk to her."
"But I only ended up making things worse, because I was too stubborn."
I had spent the entire night coming up with a theory I thought was near perfect, but in the end, not even my first assumption was correct.
"…Let's go to work. If we don't hurry, we might not make it before opening time."
In the end, we arrived ten minutes late together, which made Satou and the others suspect us even more.
"Like I said, I didn't have any intentions like that. It was only so I could earn enough to pay for the graduation trip expenses. I'm telling you the truth, okay?"
"And it was pure coincidence that Kitahara-senpai was there. He just happened to be working there. That's how he ended up as my trainer."
"You see… Senpai was supposed to have the day off that day. The truth is, he wasn't supposed to show up at the restaurant for a while, and I thought that our ties would have faded away from there."
"But that day, Senpai suddenly showed up at the restaurant… and he was acting kind of strange."
"…And you know that I couldn't have just left him alone like that, right, Mihoko?"
"I remember a similar situation between us when we first became friends."
"Aa-ah! I remember that! I believe it was when our class had to split into groups and you…"
"…That's enough of that. I'd like to hear the rest of your explanation."
"…Right. Well, he ran away all of a sudden, so I panicked and chased after him while still in my uniform, all the way to the front of the station."
"At first, I couldn't believe my eyes that it was you there, Koharu-chan. But the face, the physique, and the hair all matched you."
"Ahaha… Who'd spend a winter night by the station dressed like that? It still makes me embarrassed whenever I remember it."
"But I knew it from the way you ran. You ran in the same way you did during PE and while you were in the tennis club, as if you were a leaping antelopeーso fast, and yet so elegant."
"And then you caught up to Sensei and sat next to him so boldly, which was very much like you, Koharu-chan…"
"L-Like I said, we were just talking for a little bit back then! Since you were watching, shouldn't you understand?"
"Yeah… After hanging up with me, you parted with Sensei and immediately disappeared into the station."
"I went straight home after that. So look, Mihoko, there's nothing for you to worry about, right?"
"…Then why did you lie? You said you were still at work and that you had to get back to work."
"…Sorry. Any answer to that would just be an excuse."
"Yeah, I… lied to you, Mihoko. I hurt you… I do admit that."
"So you do admit it… You admit that you lied to me."
"That's because I think what we're going to do from now on is more important. Still, it's not something a liar should say."
"What we're going to do from now on…?"
"I'll make it up to you. I'll do everything I can to make you forgive me. Because I'd definitely hate it if our friendship was ruined over this."
"We are going to graduate soon and attend the same university after that… We're really close friends, I'll be really sad if our friendship breaks here."
"What about you, Mihoko? Do you not feel the same way anymore?"
"I want… to believe you, Koharu-chan. I want us to go to school together again. I want us to attend the same university…"
"That's why I want to believe you, I really want to! It would make me so happy if we could swear to never lie to each other again…"
"Yeah, let's swear on it. That's why, Mihoko…"
"But… Koharu-chan, you're still hiding something, right!? About Sensei."
"You knew why Sensei was feeling down, right? The truth is, you have something to do with it, right, Koharu-chan?"

"From now on, I will not lie anymore."
While working today, I felt that only my hands were moving. I honestly can't remember what I've done.
Just for this moment… I've been waiting all day while killing time with the tedium of work until evening came, when I was able to talk with Sugiura alone.
"We had a big fight… I think this was the first time things got this bad between us."

"After I left Mihoko's house, my mind went blank, and it was too late to contact the restaurant. And then I even messed up my excuse."
…I'd even believe that it was the reason why she's been acting so strangely last week.
"I really screwed up… Things were not supposed to turn out this way."
She wasn't physically unwellーshe was emotionally hurt.
…How careless of me. Those were the very same symptoms I was suffering from not too long ago.
I've only been thinking of myself. Even though I'm older, and even though I'm a man…

"I have you to thank for that too, Sugiura. I was able to regain my footing because of you."

She possesses a strong will that I can't ever hope to match…

Even though Sugiura's harboring something so sorrowful…

That's why, if we want to overcome this together…

"So you can rely on me whenever you need to. If you want to talk, you can call me any time, whenever you feel like it."
It's simple… I can just do what Koharu did for me back during winter break.
"However, I won't intervene until you tell me to."
I just need to always stay by her side…

It's because I was afraid that things would come to this…
"I'll have you know that deep down I'm actually just like you, Koharu."

Koharu, who's always acted far too maturely for her age, and who hasn't shown any of her weaknesses to others, at least up until last year.
"That's why I want you to pat my head and tell me I've been a good girl… please."
I tightly clutch Koharu's head in a way that makes me look like I'm pinning her down, combing my fingers through her hair.

Even as I'm making a real mess out of her hair, she looks genuinely happy as she closes her eyes.
"Right now, I… may be in the weakest state ever since I was born."

"On the weekend after the final exam, there will be a little party at our house."

It'll be Valentine's Day… though the party's meant to celebrate Setsuna's birthday…

That's why I can't face Setsuna right now. It's because I've betrayed her yet again.
The bitter and warm sensation of my coffee slowly spreads across my mouth, and I focus all five senses on that sensation.
It reawakens the soft, warm and sweet memories I'd experienced just last night.
Along with the sensation of Koharu's breaths.
I wonder if she… is taking her classes properly.

"Sorry, Koharu. But I think it's only natural that Sayuri is angry."

"Yada-san was in terrible shape… It's all because of you, you know?"
"Well, what do you intend to do? How will you make it up to Yada for this?"
"This is already on a level where you can't just keep quiet because you know another person would get hurt, you know…?"

"Well, I know that, but… I didn't know that you're actually this bad."
The call that came a little before the date changed over is starting to stretch into the long call territory.

"I'm already feeling a lot better because of you, Koharu. You don't have to do anything more for me."

If we can't physically be together, at least we can spend our time together.

"And, in this author's case, his philosophy changed quite significantly between the early and late years of his career…"
"The point is, what he wanted to convey was that…"

"Even though our class is self studying, the class next door isn't! Don't bother them!"
"That may be true… though I'd say your safety net will only end up making things worse right now, you know."

"The last order has already finished a while ago. Go home already. It's also for the sake of the employees' physical and mental health."

"The last train has already left! Jeez!"

"Please stop trying to pointlessly get back at me…"

Our tongues get entangled as we exchange saliva…

"I get it. I get it, okay…"
"You don't have to sulk like that…"
"I'm just a bit annoyed that you're being way too rational, Senpai…"
"If I really were being all that rational… then I wouldn't be hugging you like this, now, would I?"
If I really were being all that rational… I wouldn't be violently sticking my tongue in like this.
I wouldn't be imposing myself upon her warm mouth and guiding her tongue to the back of my throat as if on instinct to indulge in her saliva like this.
"Even though I can't take hot food… even though I'm not good with hot things…"
As Koharu mumbles through teary eyes and labored breaths, I lick up all of the saliva stuck to her lips.
"But this feels so sweet that… no matter how hot it gets, I'll endure it. No, I think I might even come to like hot things."
"I thought… you didn't like sweet things?"
"…This kind of sweetness is just right for me… nhh, chu…"
Koharu accepts everythingーfrom the way I impose myself upon her to my gentle caresses.
"Nnhuu… haah… nhh, Senpai… Haruki-senpai… I love you…"
That's why we couldn't possibly stop our passionate kisses.
Because it's only in the moments when our lips touch that I can forget…
…How I've taken on the role of the traitor once again, just to hold her in my arms and kiss her like this.
"Hey, hey, did you hear those rumors about our vice-captain?"
"You mean to say the former vice-captain. I'm the current vice-captain."
"Oh, that thing, right? About how she stole her friend's crush… or something."
"So, Sugiura-san, huh…? It's kind of hard to believe. She was such an excessively serious upperclassman, after all."
"She was super strict, too～ I can't tell you how many times she's made me cry."
"That was because you always skipped practice."
"Well, if the rumors are true, she sure changed quickly."
"You figure she decided to go out looking for men because she had nothing to pass the time with after quitting the club?"
"Well, considering how she was, I guess it'd be hard for her to stop once she got herself a taste of a man."
"Come on, you two… at least show some respect to an upperclassman who was looking out for you for two years."
"Hey, we're still some of the better ones～ Remember the group that quit when the rules suddenly got much stricter?"
"Ah～ you mean Matsui's bunch? Now that you mention it, you're in the same class, right?"
"Yeah, her whole group seems overjoyed… She even spread the rumor to other schools who participated in the interleague match. The vice-captain was popular with the boys there too, after all."
"Well… it's still just a rumor, right?"
"Yeah, but her text went into so much detail. You got it, too, right?"
"They said even the first-years know about it, right? The boys, too."
"Isn't that going too far? Why did a private matter among a particular circle end up spreading so far?"
"Probably because she was harsh on people and she is a teacher's pet. Maybe there was some envy in it too."
"I really thought she was a good person though… Ah, but I'm not so sure about it now."
"…Let's get started with practice already. And don't spread that topic too much. It's just wrong to judge people based on mere rumors."
"Well, I think it's a bit too late for that… I'd imagine it's already spread through more than half of the school already."
"She's been getting it on with a university student, huh… aa-ah."
"Damn it! If only I were a university student…"
"Nah, you're just assuming things. It's not like she's fine with anyone as long as he's a university student."
"So you figure it's useless if I'm not dating a friend of Sugiura's?"
"Nah, I don't know about that either, but… are you into her?"
"Well, if I knew she was that kind of girl… I might've given it a shot. Not like I'd have anything to lose."
"Sure, she's got a pretty face, but don't you think she's kinda… lacking in some other parts?"
"Yeah, but even with a body like hers, she's doing it daily with a uni student…"
"You figure her boyfriend's into that kind of stuff?"
"Ahh～! You're just making it worse! You can't say stuff like that, man!"
"Damn, I got super turned on just imagining it!"
"Hey, she can hear you! She can hear you, man!"
"Didn't you say you don't have the time to be worried about others?"
"Aah, that's right, it's just as you said, I'm sorry, okay!? And that's why I'm doing my best even after school!"
"Finally, only two weeks until the entrance exam…"
"That's precisely why I can't stand seeing the class fighting… You could at least be considerate of your class rep who's about to take entrance exams here."
"They're not fighting, though. It's just a one-sided massacre."

"It must be pretty troublesome sticking out too much within the school. Sugiura did the orientation and opening speech this year, didn't she? …Though Suwa was the one who forced her to do it, or so the rumors say."
"Anyway, it surely is surprising. I always thought that out of every candidate for this year's Miss Houjou, Sugiura would be the only one unrelated to such rumors."
"She did refuse the entry to begin with."
"…Now that you mention it, your sister won for three consecutive years, right?"
"Whatever. More importantly, do you really believe this absurd rumor?"
"Who knows? But if you ask me, it would be far more interesting if it was real. Imagine if that Sugiura was actually a slut, it'd be something really unexpected in many ways."
"That's not a problem, now is it? Sugiura's quite fortunate, after all."
"We will be graduating in just a month, after all."
"Do you even understand… what that means?"
"I mean, most of our current relationships will fade away and new ones will form come the next month. She just has to make new friends in university."
"That also means that… all those memories that she has built up over the years would have gone to nothing in just a month."
"So, how are your tests going? Can you advance to the next grade?"
"You know it's only the second day. Only three subjects are over so far, so how should I know?"
"Only three subjects in two days? Exams in university sure have a relaxed schedule."
"…In exchange, the tests cover a wider range of content, and they're much harder. And unlike high school, there are no more reference books for each subject either."
"Ahaha, I know that, Senpai. That's why everyone runs around the campus like their lives depend on it right before exams. They must be looking for an available photocopier in a convenience store."
"I'll say this just in case… I'm always the one who provides the notes, okay?"
"Me too. Before the exams, it always seems like my number of friends increases… to the point of making me think that I'm really popular."
Koharu would call as a means for me to take a break in my studying for the exams. This sporadically started last week, and has now become a daily routine.
We refrain from long phone calls since the exams have already begun, but in exchange, she calls me more often.
More precisely, for 30 minutes every day. And always right before midnight.
That's why I'll stop studying five minutes before midnight, waiting for my phone to ring while brewing some coffee, taking my time to enjoy it.
"Ah, that's right, I forgot to say it. I'm sorry about Sunday."
"You haven't done anything wrong, so why are you apologizing? You've even given me a number of reasons to be happy."
"No, no, you're wrong! That's not what I meant, it's about Takeya and Io!"
How does her face look like on the other side of the phone, I wonder? Is she blushing in embarrassment or is she displeased…?
"Back then, they were quite rude to you, right? So I've been wondering if you were offended by that…"
"Normally they're not… well, they're usually like that, but they're not bad people."
"It's because of them that I am who I am right now."
Koharu had sought out those two for help in order to save me before she decided to take matters into her own hands.
Despite the fact that Koharu's positively biased in her assessment of me, she might truly have a good eye when it comes to people.
"…Now, I must add that 'it's because of Koharu.'"
"However, as a result, I'm always relying on you…"
"You always say things like that when I least expect it… That's why I said 'same goes for you.'"
"…Sorry, I don't get what you mean."
"Though, maybe, I can't be friends with them."
Just how much meaning is behind those few words, and what is she feeling while saying them…?
I could take a guess, but I probably won't know the truth.
"But Senpai… please continue being friends with them, okay? Don't force yourself to prioritize me, okay?"
"That's only… my selfishness talking right now."
Then why did you start sulking in front of the station after I prioritized those two last week…?
However, perhaps I'm even more contradictory than her, because I can't view her bluffing as anything other than adorable.
"In that case, Koharu, also promise me this."
"Continue being friends with Yada-san. Don't force yourself to prioritize me, okay?"
"I know it was my fault that both of you are fighting. And yet, I can't do anything…"
"I won't go to her right now. But one day, I want to apologize to Yada-san."
"…You don't have to worry. Mihoko is a good girl."
"It might take some time, but someday the three of us will reconcile. It'll be fine! I'm persistent, after all."
"So please comfort me until that day, Senpai."
"I promise. That's the only thing I can do… I'll make sure I'll do it."
Calls from Koharu meant to give me an excuse for a break while I was studying for exams… always end abruptly like this.
Unlike my long telephone conversations three years ago where words came out naturally, now every word and phrase is awkward, and spoken through clenched teeth.

The two of us, who are similar in both personality and the hardships we've wrought upon ourselvesーwe swore to lick each other's wounds and to be kind to each other, even if we had to be hard on ourselves.
Though we both know that it's only an empty promise.
Our vow is a potent yet counterproductive drug that causes us to drag outside parties into this and tear them apart the more we strive to protect it.
Even so, we can't go on without taking it.
Because I want to hear Koharu's cheerful voice, even for just a moment. …Because I want to hear her excited breathing.
"…With that in mind, there will be a meeting next week to iron out the details of the plan, and you should be contacted shortly after that."
"H-Hold on. Please hang on for a moment."
"This is actually quite a rare opportunity, you know? It's not often that someone outside the student council is chosen as valedictorian. It should be an honor."
"Same old Suwa. What a master comedian…!"
"Fu, fufu… ahahaha… I can't, I can't stop laughing… My stomach hurts!"
"I can't! No way, I… I couldn't possibly…"
"Because… I believe the former student council president, Hotta-san, would be more qualified…"
"This was already decided during the staff meeting. If you insist on refusing, then I need a good reason for that!"
"You're asking her for a reason… but you're the one who's not making any sense, aren't you?"
"It's gotta be that, right? Suwa's trying to forcibly go through with something again. Hotta's homeroom teacher Tomomatsu is only in his second year of working here."
"Take a hint, Suwa… Is he an idiot!?"
"He's picked a horrible time to show his favoritism…"
"Anyway, if you don't have a valid reason to refuse, I won't accept it. What is it? Tell me!"
"…If you don't have a proper reason, I won't accept it. Moreover, this was a unanimous decision. It's too late to overturn it now."
"What is it? You really don't have to be that humble. You should be proud of yourself. After all, you're going to be representing your class, no, in fact, all of the graduates this year."
"Wow… So that's supposed to be our representative, huh…? What part of her, exactly?"
"Does she want to be the center of attention that bad…? I totally don't get what this girl's playing at."
"It sure must be tough playing the honors student… Can't say I feel bad for her at all, though."
"I wonder what she'll talk about in her speech. Maybe the number of couples she's destroyed in the past three years?"
"Yeah, you think she would? I'd actually totally be down to hear all about that."
"Hey, quiet down! For crying out loud, I can't believe how loud you lot are so early in the morning. Keep in mind you're all supposed to be graduating soon!"
"And whose fault do you think that is? Ugh, just give her a break already, you asshole…!"
"Calm down, calm down, Takahiro. Nothing good's gonna come from arguing now."
"There, on the other side of the road. At the university's main gate. Isn't that girl wearing our school uniform…?"
"You mean her…? I believe that's a third-year student's… ahh!"
"I know, right? It really is her, right? Thank goodness I didn't mistake her for someone else."
"So the rumors about her getting involved with a guy from our university were true…"
"Man, you really saved me! It's really hard to find some organized notes for linguistics."
"…You should really stop resorting to borrowing notes from students in other departments."
The call I received around the time before the date changed last night had an unusually friendly request of "Bring your French notes with you tomorrow, Haruki!"
"It's your fault for suddenly deciding to change departments. Have you ever seriously considered just how badly my grades would be affected by your decision?"
"…You should seriously consider passing your exams with your own efforts first."
…I pressed the answer button without looking at the caller and froze for a few seconds, but that's another story.
"Well, then… what do you plan to do for the rest of the day?"
"I'll be studying from the moment I get home, obviously."
"…What an exemplary and boring answer. I see you still can't really be called a university student, as always."
"…This is coming from someone who just wasted quite a lot of my unnecessary time."
There was a long line at the photocopier we went to after the exam ended, and I let out a big sigh knowing that it wasn't worth waiting for my turn.
"…If you're saying your time is unnecessary, then what's wrong with me wasting it? What are you talking about?"
"Huh!? Hey, don't misinterpret my grammar on purpose! You're making it seem as if I've spoken in a rather confusing way here!"
"No, your statement actually was confusing. …Though I do plan to treat you to dinner as a token of my apology and gratitude."
"Then I'll correct myself and say that you've wasted my 'precious time.' …You can invite me out after my exams are over."
"Today should be fine given that we're free on Saturday, right? Want to drink a little?"
"Actually, my real hurdle starts next week. I still have nine subjects left after all, and three of them are on Monday."
"…You've already collected enough credits to graduate, right? You're just doing the rest out of pure interest."
"Whatever. In any case, I'll be studying from now until Monday morning. I don't think I'll be able to forgive myself in more ways than one otherwise."

…This is particularly related to a certain someone who frantically and desperately tried to remain cheerful, despite the fact that her tone immediately dropped the moment she realized I wasn't coming to work on the weekend…
…That's right. Perhaps I could study at Goodies this weekend? And then we could take a short, leisurely walk on our way home before getting on the train?
She'd lecture me with "the restaurant isn't a place for studying" and happily reprimand me if I'd made that suggestion, wouldn't she?
"A week left, huh… Can't it end any sooner?"
Now that I think about it, the reason why "Sugiura Koharu" didn't appear on my phone's display around the usual time she'd call last night is because I was busy with another call.
I wonder if it's because she got tired of waiting and fell asleep or if she's fed up with calling me every night…
Or perhaps something exciting happened at school, such that she didn't need to hear my voice anymore…
Well, whatever the reason, it's fine. So long as it's not the opposite of what I just thought, anything would be…
"That's right… will you be going to Setsuna-chan's party next week?"
"Are you suggesting you'd prefer to be alone with her?"
"What are you talking about…? The occasion was intended to be celebrated with her family to begin with."
"I just thought that you wanted to tell them something like, 'Please entrust your daughter to me!'"
I'm feeling slightly giddy over the fact that what I was thinking about a short moment ago really isn't matching the conversation I'm having with Takeya.

"Io and I will be making ourselves welcome as well. After all, this is Setsuna-chan's homemade cooking we're talking about here, right? …Though I guess you can say that this is a birthday party where the birthday girl herself will be making the cake."
"Make sure you come, okay, Haruki? You don't have any reason to refuse it, right? It's just an honest celebration held at home, after all."
I don't know who exactly came up with this idea… but I know that it probably wasn't Setsuna.
I don't know who planned such an event that would be so convenient for me to participate in and thus very difficult for me to refuse.
"I want to discuss plans about a vacation trip with you as well. Otherwise, you'd immediately immerse yourself in part-time jobs if I don't plan ahead."
"I can't wait for spring break. We won't have much time to have fun once we get into our fourth year, so let's make the most of the present and enjoy ourselves, shall we?"
After my exams are over… After my life as a third-year student comes to an end…
Where do I go, and who should I convey my feelings to?
…Who will I end up hurting, and what will I end up destroying in the process?
As I was momentarily lost in my own thoughts while looking downward, I'd walked past Takeya before I knew it.
Rather, what specifically happened was that Takeya suddenly stopped in his tracks, and he's now dumbfoundedly staring in the direction of the main gate while standing still…
"What is it, Takeya? What's the matter with…"
The moment I follow Takeya's gaze… the same expression forms on my face.
That's not all. The same happens on the face of the person who's within our line of sight…

She stares at us with the same look of bewilderment, and after that, she looks around her as if she'd just been robbed of her composure, and finally, her expression changes to one that suggests she's about to cry.
Even from afar, I can detect her anxiousness, sorrow and confusion. And I can feel the same expression creeping onto my face as well.
"Yo～! If it isn't Koharu-chan! Well, what's up? Did you come all the way here to meet me～?"
Having noticed her first, Takeya's demeanor changed just a moment before mine did.
Regardless of whether that's a good thing or a bad thing, he ended up covering up what would have been a fatal mistake on my part.
"Isn't it cold being out here in a place like this? What's wrong? I would have come to get you immediately if you'd just given me a call."
It's true. If she'd just given me a call, I would have immediately…
And to think there were many far more appropriate methods that she could have opted for rather than appearing here in such a conspicuous place and having Takeya notice her.
"Still, it's been quite some time since we last met here, right? I still remember how you had this intense look when you were glaring at us back when we first met."
"T-This isn't what it looks like. Um… this isn't what it looks like!"
As she tries her hardest to respond to Takeya's words, her gaze is desperately appealing to me.
Her eyes are probably trying to convey the same thing her words are. They're trying to tell me that 'It's not like that' and 'I never had the intention to do this.'
It's just that the meaning behind her words is completely different from what she's actually saying…
"Don't you have some business with us?"
"Like I said, I don't have any specific reason to be here. It's just, umm, I ended up coming here before I realized it…"
Takeya included me in his list of choices before I knew it, but regardless of how skillful his attempt at probing her is, Koharu's just incapable of reading it right now.
"No, you don't have to apologize. In fact, we're happy to have run into you, even if only by coincidence."
After all, the person who can't understand the reason for her actions the most happens to be herself…
That's what I can sense from her.
"That's right, if you're not busy right now, how about you go out with us, Koharu-chan? We were just about to get dinner. We were planning to celebrate our exams being halfway finished."
"…No, I'm fine. I'm sorry. I really don't have a particular reason to be here…"
"I haven't agreed to anything, and you shouldn't count your chickens when we're only half done with our exams."
…I usually wouldn't have been able to resist forcing my sermon onto him after a line like that.
"It's alright if you aren't busy, isn't it? If you're not comfortable being the only girl with two guys, I could call Io to come with us, you know."
"Like I said, I never agreed to anything…"
"…Is that so? That's a shame. We could've enjoyed ourselves to our hearts' content given that we have the day off tomorrow…"
"Aren't the two of you still in the middle of exams? Isn't this not the best time for the two of you to enjoy yourselves to your hearts' content?"
"…You don't have to rub salt into the wound. Haruki said the exact same thing just earlier."
"That's right. You're not supposed to be free right now…"
And Koharu lowers her gaze, now at a loss for words.
It's as if she's been gravely wounded by the very words she just said…
"Goodbye. Best of luck to you two."
"That so? See you, then. We'll come visit your restaurant after exams are over."
"Ah! I'm sorry, I totally forgot about that!"
This is bad… I have to make things seem coherent.
"Sorry! This was completely my mistake. The truth is, I actually made an arrangement with her."
Whether it's in response to Koharu's behavior, to the fact that she's here now, or to her current emotions.
"I-I'm not! I wasn't waiting for you, Senpai…!"
"I know that it's my fault that I'm so late, but you really don't have to look so mad…"
…My brain, which should have been exhausted by the exam in the morning, regains its composure almost immediately.
"I promised you last week at work… to give you a tour of the campus."
I accept my current circumstances and internally readjust my priorities, and with it, I come up with the most suitable scenario.
"I told her that I showed Takahiro-kun around campus last month and she said she wanted to visit as well, so we made an arrangement…"
I was the one who Koharu was waiting for.
But that's only because her senior from both her part-time job and the university she's going to attend happens to be the same person.
…He also happens to be the boyfriend of her classmate's older sister…
We promised to meet each other at the main gate after school ended on Friday and left work uneventfully afterward.
And today so happens to be Friday…
Koharu had arrived on time as promised, whereas I've been hanging around the school grounds with Takeya, having forgotten this rather trivial promise I've made with my junior.
Of course, we couldn't even contact one another given that we've never even exchanged phone numbers before.
And after waiting for me for more than an hour, she then saw the person who made that promise brazenly walking out without feeling even slightly nervous…
Koharu got really mad as a result, and acted as if she never made that promise with me to begin with.
"So that's how things are. I'm truly sorry!"
"I know I'm a little late, but why don't I show you around right now? …I'll even treat you to dinner, though we'd be eating in the cafeteria."
And Takeya's gaze… doesn't even have the slightest hint of suspicion.
Because the intense glint in his eyes suggests that he's gone past merely finding me suspicious and is now convinced that I'm lying.
"Let's go. …This is what's going on, Takeya, so I'm sorry."
But I can't afford to falter in that right now. I can only push forward and act as if what I'm saying is the truth.
"See you, Takeya. I'll call you later."
"Hey, Haruki… make sure you come to the party next week, okay?"
I couldn't bring myself to turn toward Takeya in response to his rather miserable tone when he said that, only lightly raising my hand in response.
I lightly push Koharu's back as we head back to where I just came from… into the university.
I'm turning my back on my friend. I can only concentrate on directly walking toward the darkness where I can't see what lies beyond.
I'm doing this because… I absolutely can't leave Koharu alone here right now.
I can only believe in that intuition.
"You can really be scary sometimes, Senpai…"
"Even though you're usually so honest to a fault, you hold nothing back when you lie."
"You know, there was that first time… back when we were looking for Ogiso-senpai together. You threatened the customers and the staff in the restaurant…"
That was the day when I accepted Koharu's dedication to meddle with my problems for the first time…
"You managed to spout out things one after the other without even thinking… and to a friend of all people. …Even though all of this was my fault."
It's times like this where I realize the painful truth… I'm an absolutely preposterous liar.
I talk about wanting to be honest with the people that are important to me while also being able to deceive them without batting an eye.
"No, I'm the one who's terrible. …I'm sorry."
"Even though I promised I would wait… I'm sorry!"
We're currently in an exam period, and it's evening at the moment…
"I said I would endure until your exams were over, Senpai… but I couldn't even keep that promise even though I made it myself…!"
But there's still quite a number of people walking in front of us, as usual.
"Before I knew it, I was already standing there… It really wasn't my intention at all."
"No, you don't understand, Senpai. It's because I'm lying to you right now."
"I waited at a spot like that and I could've been noticed by anyone. Iizuka-senpai, Mizusawa-senpai… even Ogiso-senpai might've noticed me."
"It's not like I didn't realize that. I was fully aware of it, but I came nonetheless. …I've done something so terrible."
"It is a lie… It's a cruel betrayal. And I've betrayed you of all people, Senpai…"
That's not a lie… it's just her inability to make a decision.
It's just that her desires overpowered her expectations of the consequences of her actions by the slightest margin.
I can't say I can completely understand what's in Koharu's heart, though.
"Where would you like to go right now?"
"I don't mind making the lie come true by showing you around the campus and having dinner in the cafeteria as we promised. …Even going to a family restaurant is fine by me."
"So don't cry. …At least, not while it's not just the two of us present."
"…Uu, uuu, I'm… sorry… I'm so sorry."
We're currently in an exam period, and it's evening at the moment…
"Come on, you can come closer if you want."
But there's still quite a number of people walking in front of us, as usual.
Why am I patting the head of a girl who's wearing our high school's uniform in full view of the surrounding crowd…?
And all while I'm hugging her shoulder, at that.
"…Would you like to stay here until you've calmed down a little?"
"N-No… I'm fine now. Staying here any longer will cause you trouble, Senpai."
Despite having said that, she hasn't lifted her head off my shoulder…
"Then, where do you want to go? I'll take you anywhere you want."
"Really? You're alright with taking me anywhere?"
"…It's close by. We should be able to walk there."
"I see… since you already have a place in mind, shall we go?"
"Umm… I'm sorry. I want to apologize to you first."
"Like I said, everything you've done up until now is…"
"It's not about that… I just lied to you, Senpai."
"No, it's not that… it's about where we're going…"
As Koharu said that, she slowly lifted her head that was resting on my shoulder.
And then, to prevent anyone else from hearing it, she inches her mouth to my ear so close that I could feel her breath.
"Whoa, it's so clean and neat, just as I thought it'd be!"
"Well, I do clean my room at least twice a week."
"Wow, I have to say this is quite the amount of produce you have here. I've heard that men who live alone have nothing but beer in their fridge."
"W-Whoa, you even properly clean your bathroom! And not just with water, you even use actual bathroom cleaners!"
"Well, I only do that about once a week, but… Koharu?"
"Ah, wow, wow! The night view's pretty here! Ah, it is cold here, though… and I can hear the noise of the air conditioner's outdoor unit…"
"…Calm down. And it's cold as you said, so close it, Koharu."
…Though she said it's cold outside, her forehead is drenched with sweat.
"Don't just stand there. Sit down for now."
Why did she have to end up being so nervous just like I expected her to be…? If this keeps up, I'm going to get nervous too.
She just realized that she hasn't performed the usual etiquette that she'd normally never forget to do, which made her blush in embarrassment.
…Things would have been alright if it ended at that, but she didn't notice the cushion I prepared in front of the table, and ended up sitting on my bedーa huge mistake.
Koharu flushed a bright red that reached her ears and lowered her gaze, making even me embarrassed this time.
We're acting like a middle-schooler couple…
I don't remember things transpiring this awkwardly during my first experience, though.
"I'm fine with… whatever you want to do, Senpai."
Wait, why am I even comparing what's happening right now to what happened during my first time…?
Am I hoping for the same thing that happened three years ago right now?
"…Shall we prepare dinner together? We haven't eaten anything, after all."
Even so, things are different from the circumstances back then.
There's still a future that we can share between us.
And there's still a possibility that today will connect to tomorrow and extend into a future further beyond…
"For the time being, I do have all the usual ingredients I need to make curry. Do you know how to work with knives, Koharu?"
"Ah, so you've never used them before, huh…? You seem like somebody who does though."
"No, I normally do use them, but I don't want to for today."
"Because if I'm focused on cooking, I can't look at you, Senpai."
"And I don't want that… because we don't have much time. I'm already wasting your precious time like this."
But Koharu has absolutely no intention of letting any unnecessary thoughts interfere with the short time we can spend together alone for the day.
"…We can talk while peeling the potatoes, can't we?"
"I can only concentrate on one thing. I'm sure I'll end up going silent if we do that."

"It's about time I left. I'll only ruin the mood if I stay around, anyway."
"Goodbye to you too… Ako. I might not come next week."
"I'm sorry, Koharu. We couldn't bring ourselves to believe you."
"I really do believe we need to apologize for that. But that doesn't mean…"
"That doesn't mean you get to act like you're the only victim in all of this, Koharu…"
"But I'm not. I really don't care anymore…"
"Yada-san declined the recommendation. She said she won't go to Houjou University."
"Sayuri and I heard about it last weekend. Sayuri cried back then, too…"
"Well, that figures. Imagine having to go to the same university with the person who tricked her for four more years, and in the same department to boot."
"Right… she'd have to witness the man she loves flirting with her… and that'd be a needle to the heart."
"It's possible that Yada-san's having the wrong impression of all this. And it's possible that you've been framed for what you've had to bear, Koharu."
"But I don't think the actual truth matters to her anymore…"
"W-Wait… If it was a misunderstanding, you'd just have to clear it up, right? It might take some time, but why don't you try honestly talking it out?"
"Even though Koharu's undoubtedly the one who refused to talk things through?"
"No sooner than after you fell out with her only once, you never tried to go to Yada-san's place to talk things through or even made any effort to make up with her again…"
"That's because you all were ganging up on her…"
"I never said that I didn't do anything wrong!"
"But… I absolutely can't say that Koharu didn't do anything wrong either!"
"Aarghh, jeez! Wait for me! Hey, Sugiura!"
"The class rep has a strange taste as well, huh. And he knows full well she already has another man."
"He defended her so much already, she should return the favor by doing it with him at least once."
"She must have done it with her boyfriend over and over anyway."
"Ahaha, no way, over and over, you say…? It sounds so depraved～!"
"Can you girls just quit it already!?"
"Haah, haah, haah… Y-You… run at the same speed as guys…"
"Calm down… You say that none of this has anything to do with you, but you immediately take the blame upon yourself."
"She hasn't decided to abandon higher education yet, has she?"
"But she won't go… She won't go to the same university I'm going to…!"
"She's just being emotional. She'll change her foolish way of thinking about all this after a while."
"After a while… and when, exactly!? Everything will be too late when April comes!"
"Like I said, it'll be fine… I'll try to go to Yada's place too, and I'll ask Suwa for help if I need to…"
"It's impossible… Mihoko won't listen. Because I… I… I did such a terrible thing to her…!"
"You're being too pessimistic, Sugiura. Don't treat everyone at school like your enemy."
"I mean, after all… after all…! I don't have any allies here anymore…"
"You do! At the very least, you have one!"
"But, well… whether you think this person is dependable or not highly depends on your personal opinion."
"To put it bluntly… I'll always be your ally, Sugiura, no matter what…"
"Well… because we both got unlucky and became class reps, and I also want to repay you for everything you've done for me."
"We might only have known each other for a year, but I still know deep down that you're a really good person, after all, Sugiura."
"That's why… stop blaming yourself like that. I will never believe something like you being a traitor."
"The roast beef seems to have been a success. It didn't dry out, and it came out well, even if I do say so myself."
"Anyway, the truth is… I made enough to feed about ten people."
"After all, roast beef will surely taste better if made using a bigger piece of meat. Though I still feel like I overdid it a little."
"So, well… won't you accept just a little bit?"
"When will your shift be over? If you won't object, would it be alright if I came over to your place at about midnight after the party?"
"If I can't, please send me a text. See you."
"Ogiso, you're… you're the last person I… want to hear that from!"
"You have reached the voicemail for the number…"
"Please leave a message after the beep."
"It's Kitahara… I'm waiting for you at the same place as last week."
It's been an hour since the time we were supposed to meet at the bustling station entrance.
Koharu had enthusiastically declared that she wouldn't have me wait this time just a few hours ago…
"Anyway, if you listen to this message, call me back. I'll be waiting. Bye."
But not only is she not here right now, I can't even get in contact with her.
"Thank you for calling. This is the Minami-Suetsugu Goodies restaurant."
"…Don't tell me you won't come tomorrow? I beg you, okay? I've already added you to our schedule for tomorrow."
"…That's certainly a possibility. I'll have to think about that."
"But right now, it's not about that. Satou, I have a favor to ask."
"No, no, no, no, please, let's talk about that, okay? So what is it? You got something urgent going on? Do you have anyone in mind who can sub in for you…?"
"You have all the part-timers' resumes in the manager's office, right?"
"Not only are you ignoring what I've said, you're also asking for something inappropriate…"
"Can you tell me Sugiura Koharu's home number? I have to contact her immediately."
"I'll take whatever comments, questions and criticism you have for me later. …Though I'll tell you in advance that me taking them doesn't mean I'll spill the beans."
"And there you've gone and denied me the very first thing I've wanted to ask you about…"
"Please. I'm running out of time. As the acting manager, you should know where the resumes are, right?"
"Do you happen to know about the Personal Information Protection Law?"
"…Why do I feel like I'm currently being the target of a very malicious scam?"
"I won't cause you any trouble. And I'm not trying to do anything wrong with this. So please, Satou…"
"But you know her cell phone number, right, Kitahara-san? You could always call her…"
"She forgot her cell phone, and I have it here with me. That's why I have to contact her at home."
"…How did something like that even happen?"
"Whatever comments, questions and criticism you have for me later…"
"…Well, alright. I'll make do with the little information you let slip."
"You can really be scary sometimes, Senpai…"
"Even though you're usually so honest to a fault, you hold nothing back when you lie."
As much as I'm racing against the clock, even I have to agree that I'm really not holding back.
I'm sure everyone will give us a particular look the next time we go to work after this incident.
…But this isn't the time for me to be worrying about that right now.
It's now two hours past the time we arranged to meet up. Even so, I still can't contact her, and she's still nowhere to be seen.
The sunlight disappears from the streets and the streetlights light up in its place; all the while, I simply remain in place as the merciless, cold air pierces me.
If this was an old drama play or movie, this would be the scene where the protagonist waits forever for his girlfriend who won't come…
Unfortunately, I'm not a man who is generous enough to simply wait obediently forever.
"Is this Sugiura-san's home? I am Kitahara, a member of the Houjou High School Student Affairs Office…"
On the contrary, if my life had taken a turn in the wrong direction, I would've been an ingenious yet morally corrupt stalker making a stir in society…
After that, the search for Koharu was extremely difficult.
As expected, she didn't return home, and even when I asked her parents if they had any idea where she could have gone, they could only tilt their heads in confusion.

However, her parents didn't seem all that worried and seemed convinced that their daughter would be alright, though I personally saw that as an unfortunate side effect of being a serious child who has earned their parents' trust.

…If I were to reveal the fact that I'm actually not related to the school at all and honestly told her parents about the relationship I have with their daughter, I dare not think of what dramatic reaction they might end up having…
From that point on, I decided it was futile to simply wait patiently, so I set out in search of her with my own two feet and with my cell phone in hand.
I started my search by following the route from Minegaya Station to her house. I even checked the park nearby just in case.

After that, I searched everywhere I could that wasn't closed yetーI returned to Minami-Suetsugu again, took a peek at Goodies, and looked for her at her high school's gate, my university's gate and within the campus.
…I even stopped to ask some of the girls from her school who were walking nearby, but when I mentioned Koharu's name, the strange reactions they gave me pierced my heart.
And after that, on a sudden impulse, I even stopped by Yada-san's house.
…Though I couldn't really bring myself to ring the doorbell.
In the end, I couldn't find Koharu after checking every possible place that came to mind, and I ran out of clues to follow.
She should've been here five hours ago where I waited for her, but not only has she not arrived, she didn't leave any clue on where she had gone.
I can't just relax and wait for the next day to come. I have to do something, anything…
But who am I kidding. In a mockery of the tragic resolve I've gathered…
I ended up finding Koharu just like that.
"Why didn't you contact me?", "Where have you been!?", or "Didn't you want to see me?"…
There's just no way I can say any of that right now.
Koharu was sitting on the small bench in front of Minami-Suetsugu Station.
I've searched through all my knowledge and memories, contacted and visited all the people and places I knew, and concluded that there were no other places I could speculate where she would be at…
Even so, the fact that I didn't think of this place shows just how utterly careless I am.
"I've been searching for you, you know?"
After all, this was the place where everything began for Koharu and me.
This was where our journey down the wrong path began…
"You'll catch a cold… Why are you dressed like that?"
Koharu was sitting all by herself with her gaze lowered, wearing her uniform without a coat on.
When I tried to put my coat over her, she only tightened the grip of her hands on her knees and shook her head.
"I'll walk you home. My apartment or your place, choose one."
The moment I touched her, I was struck by a sensation so frigid that it made me wonder if it really came from a living person.
And I could also feel the pain behind the cold she's been enduring from her subtle shivering.
"But, if you want to come to my apartment, then contact your home first. I was talking with your mother just now, and she sounded quite worried."
I'm sure that Koharu didn't exactly want to stay here. It's just… she had nowhere else to go.
Something happened that convinced her that… she couldn't go to my place.
"If you're just gonna be here and stay silent, then I'm gonna continue staying here like this, you know?"
After I forced my coat onto Koharu's shoulders, I put my arm around her shoulder as I sat next to her.
After hours of running around, I can feel the cold breeze pleasantly blowing against my body.
…Though I'm sure I can only feel this way for about one or two more minutes.
"But even if I end up getting a cold or pneumonia, or even falling unconscious as my condition becomes serious, and perhaps even die in the end, I still won't hold it against you, you know?"
After all, I know that my body will become cold within seconds. I can literally feel the chill running up my back as I continue to talk to her.
I wonder how long Koharu has continued to bear such a bitter and painful sensation.
"Because I'm doing this of my own accord…"
"Stop saying things like that! Please stop…!"
I'm sure the guilt that's spiraling within her right now is what's leading her to believe that this is her just punishment…
"I want to comfort you, Koharu. Is it okay if I do?"
I can no longer bring myself to blame her for being late and irresponsible.
"Because I'm a bitch. Because I'm someone who's not worthy of your kindness, Senpai."
"That's something that's up to me to decide, and there isn't any room for you to say anything about it, Koharu."
That's why I've returned to being the meddlesome Kitahara Haruki I was in the past.
"Hey, Koharu… no matter how you look at it, you're already at your limit, right?"
"Isn't it about time we talked about this? Won't you rely on me?"
I'm involving myself in her affairs even though she never asked for my help, and I'm doing my best to think of a solution that she doesn't want.
I'll expose the truth of the emotions that are inside her, look the enemy directly in the eye and make it so that I can protect her concretely.
After all, this is the only thing I can do…
"But why? Am I really that… well, I suppose I am rather unreliable…"
And yet… Koharu, who's clearly over her limit, is still unable to let go of the heavy burden that threatens to crush her.
"Because Senpai, if I rely on you now, I'll betray my friends once again. And this time, it won't be just one person…"
"Even so, I can't bear seeing you like this, Koharu."
"I just can't do that to someone I owe so much to…"
"That's right. I can't leave such an important person like you alone anymore, Koharu…"
"Even so… please leave me alone. Please don't concern yourself with me anymore."
"Come on, why are you being so stubborn…?"
"Because you belong to Ogiso-senpai, don't you, Senpai? You don't… belong to me at all, do you!?"
The moment Koharu's feelings burst out, I immediately realized my careless mistake.
"That's why I must not rely on you again. I must not ask anything from you again."
"No, I actually shouldn't have done any of that to begin with. To rely on you, to cling onto you, to kiss you, or to fall in love with you…"
And that's a mistake which I'm still unable to correct.
After all, while Koharu's words weren't entirely sincere, I can't deny that there's some truth to them.
That's why I've returned to being passive again.
"She's a beautiful and kind person, with such kind people around herーI should not have hurt them…"
But this isn't me giving up.
Even if I can't grasp Koharu's shaken heart, it just means that I will keep going after it, never letting it out of my sight.
I absolutely can't run away right now. …That's what the kind people around me have taught me.
Although her words reject me, Koharu does not pry off the arm wrapped around her shoulder.
Then finally, we started to talk, little by little.
We talked about how she ended up betraying her best friends and the consequences that came with them.
"You know, until yesterday, I seriously thought that I'd be fine as long as I have you, Senpai."
The gist of our conversation was much like what Takeya already told me, but she ended up tossing an unusually large bombshell at me in the end.
"But I was wrong. It was only an extremely sweet dream I had."
I'm sure Koharu would have endured if she was the only one who ended up suffering from all this.
"I'm not a strong person who can survive only by living by my own values."
But her actions ended up hurting other people… And there's also the fact that the person she believed to be her best friend ended up getting hurt the most…

"I can't stray from the moral values I've been brought up with since I was a child… I can't go through with something only I think is for the best, but instead, I have to choose what everyone else thinks is for the best."
There's no way her sense of justice that she always stood by would allow that.
"My way of thinking is actually quite ordinary. That's why I'm at fault right now for straying from that direction."
"We know that your relationship will ruin itself soon if we just leave you two alone."
"Senpai, it's for the best that you go back to being with Ogiso-senpai. It's for the best that Mihoko gets to go to university. It's for the best that everyone gets to be happy."
"Sooner or later… no, I imagine it won't be very long at all before she finds herself in internal strife and ends up being crushed by her own guilt."
"It's for the best that everyone other than me can become happy…
See? Everything would be resolved with that."
"I'd say a collapse is as good as imminent."
Just like Takeya said, Koharu's collapsed.
She's succumbed to her sense of justice, friendship, common sense, her maternal instinct, her love, and her desires.
She found herself being caught between layer upon layer of her heavy emotions, eventually becoming incapable of taking so much as a step forward.
And the only thing that's left for her is to slowly waste away. And it's not just her, either…
I won't say, "I didn't know about that" at this point.
"What are you going to do now, Koharu? How are you planning to solve this by yourself?"
I can more or less predict the answer. And I decided that I should just accept it…
"I will decline my recommendation. If we are not going to be together, then Mihoko…"
"What will you do after that? If you go to another university, I doubt it'll be as good as Houjou University. Provided you don't repeat a year."
"I'll work part-time. At Goodies, I mean. I'll work hard in the hopes I can become an official employee someday…"
"That is one way of doing things, but is it what you truly want? Think this through carefully."

"It's fine if you don't want to go to university. But then, can you tell me why you've been studying so hard while keeping up with your club activities? Why you've given it your all in an effort to get that recommendation?"
"Besides, if you decline the recommendation, the number of recommendations could be lowered next year. …Do you not care about giving your underclassmen a hard time?"
I won't watch over her anymore. I won't hold her gently or anything like that anymore.

"And there's still a lot of problems even then. You'll have to persuade your parents and your teachers, provide an appropriate reason to the university itself, and… how will you convince Yada-san to accept such a decision?"
I'll thoroughly exploit any openings I can find in her logic. I'll show her how harsh the skills I've refined in my seminars are.
