"Even if you think of paying the price alone, it will be meaningless if the other party doesn't accept it."
I imagine my own reasoning is full of holes as well, but I'll overcome that with the strength of my words. I won't give her any room to think.
"I think you can only call it 'action' if you can convince the other party, but I want to hear what you think about it, Koharu."
"In a case like this… I won't know until I try."
"If you don't take responsibility for trying and still fail to make anyone happy, then how's that so different from how you're currently running away?"
I keep mocking her objections which I can only see as excuses. I pierce her with a cold stare that I have trained through my interviews while job hunting.
"Takeya said you are my spitting image, but if you ask me, you've still got a long way to go. Well, I suppose that's not the fairest comparison given that you're younger than me…"
"Then… what exactly do you think I should do, Senpai!?"
"Do you think I'll ever be able to smile from the bottom of my heart again after what I've done to Mihoko?"
But still, she's done well to endure this far. Three years ago, I would've lost it by now.
"Do you honestly believe that I'll be able to go on living my life happily for the next four years knowing that a wounded Mihoko is so close by!?"
I had a feeling, Koharu… but you're a far cry from me.
"No, it'd still be fine so long as she's close by… but do you think I could enjoy my university life knowing that Mihoko's not there despite the fact that she should have been!?"
You will become… a far greater person. You will easily overtake me…
"I… I hate this side of myself! So… what should I do…!?"
Because, even now, she's much more talented and patient, and… compared to somebody like me, she's a much better person.
"Why is it that even you are bullying me, Senpai… Why, why…!"
I put all my strength into my arms and embraced Koharu.
Koharu doesn't reject me. She willingly buries her face into my chest and her overflowing tears soak my shirt.
"Uuaa… uaaa-aa… even you, S-Senpai… even you, Haruki-senpai…!"
"You… really care about Yada-san, don't you?"
"We've been together for three years… If I didn't care about her, if I didn't care about her so much, I wouldn't have been with such a selfish person for so long!"
I'm sure that… the history that they share is so important to her that the three months I've spent with her can't even compare to it.
…And I'm sure that it even rivals the three years I've been through myself.
"I get angry at her, and I even think about leaving her alone sometimes, but I still care about her! I just can't bring myself to hate her!"
It's precisely because Koharu's emotions contain such a negative side that I believe that they're genuine.
"She can be annoying at times, and there are moments when I just want her to leave me alone, but I care about her nonetheless."
I wonder if Yada-san ever said something like that?
"I got so carried away by my first love that I've forgotten something so obvious…"
…It might be imprudent to say this, but I'm honored.
She should have been a serious and unyielding girl, but her feelings for me sent her into such disarray.
"To only realize all this after I've lost everything… I'm such an idiot…!"
Before I knew it, Koharu's arms wrapped around me.
But somehow, the feelings behind this hug were slightly different from her usual feelings for me.
"Koharu… in that case, let's try our best. To make up with Yada-san."
"Senpai, you should become happy with Ogiso-senpai. You should be together with those who were always by your side."
She wants me to be happy with Setsuna, Takeya, and Io. As well as with Takahiro-kun and the Ogiso family.
She wants me to be happy with those irreplaceable people who were always kind to me, even though all I did was run away.
"If I rely on you again, Senpai, you won't be able to go back to the way things were before this time. I can't bear something like that any further…"
I love them very much too. Perhaps I can even say that I can't bear to lose any of them.
"It's my responsibility that you betrayed everyone, Koharu. That's the only thing I won't concede on."
"Moreover, I'm… sorry, but I don't think you can solve it by yourself."
Koharu's gradually losing things she simply can't bear to lose even as we speak.
"That's why I… can't let go of your hand now."
I can see my reflection through Koharu's wet eyes.
Normally, this would be the time where our lips would naturally inch closer together.
"Until you've taken responsibility for everything you need to, done whatever you could, and become satisfied with the fact that you've achieved the best result you could muster…"
We're on the verge of collapse right now.
It's just that my selfishness is causing me to attempt to delay that for the shortest moment.
"Until you return to the brave and straightforward girl you were before, I won't leave your side."
"In the past, I was often called that. People found me extremely annoying, far beyond someone like you, Koharu."
Because we only have each other, I can only gently put my hand on Koharu's head.
And Koharu can only reluctantly endure my hand patting her.
"Let's do it together, Koharu… For a future where everyone can become 'relatively happy,' okay?"
That's why the droplets that are pouring from Koharu's eyes right about now are merely my imagination… or so I believe.
"Ogiso… Thank goodness. I made it somehow."
"You're having politics and economics today, right? Time sure flies and now it's the real thing, huh?"
"I'm sorry I said such terrible things yesterday. I wasn't considerate about your situation at all despite the fact that you were having entrance exams today, Ogiso!"
"H-Hey, stop this! Everyone's looking at us!"
"…Did you go out of your way to wait for me just to tell me this?"
"There are things that I couldn't say over the phone, and I wanted to apologize to you face to face…"
"And I wanted to do it before your exam starts. I didn't want all the effort you've put in up until now to go to waste because of me."
"I-It's not like I was bothered all that much, you know. I didn't work all that hard compared to everyone else anyway, and I'm used to you getting mad at me, Sugiura."
"Still, I know that I've been right in our exchanges up until now, but you were the one who was right yesterday, Ogiso…"
"…So you're saying that I've always been wrong up until now."
"…No, it's alright. That's just like you, Sugiura."
"Yeah. I feel like I'm talking with the Sugiura I knew from last year. …You seem like you've gotten over your problem already."
"I have… a lot of things I have to tell you."
"Someday, I want to tell you all about it. I want you to know just what kind of a person I am. …On top of that, I really want to apologize."
"It seems like a lot has happened, Sugiura. …Though I don't have a clue as to what."
"But I hope that you can focus on your exam right now. I'm really sorry about what happened yesterday. And I wish you all the best today."
"Got it. …To be honest, talking with you like this cleared my mind. I feel like I can handle today's exam just fine."
"You don't have to keep repeating it. …Alright, it's about time I went to the classroom."
"It's obvious that I'll get accepted, right? We'll attend the same university by the start of spring. I'll look forward to it."
"…Sorry, Ogiso. We can't… attend university together."
"Umm, before our meeting today, there's something Sugiura-san wants to say. …Come on, Sugiura-san."
"It's sudden, but I'll take this opportunity to announce that today I will be resigning from my job here."
"It's been three months since I began working here."
"I slowly got used to the work bit by bit, I'm sorry that I have to quit after I've finally proven myself useful to everyone."
"I can't tell you the details because it's a personal matter, but for now, I plan to focus on my studies."
"I'm grateful for all the immense care each and every one of you has given me over the past three months. I will definitely use the experience and knowledge I've acquired here in my new environment."
"Lastly… Acting Manager, Floor Manager, and everyone. I am really sorry for suddenly imposing on everyone like this. Also… thank you for everything."
After that, Koharu bowed deeply, and everyone gave her a warm applause.
Even if no one ever saw this coming, Satou, Nakagawa-san, and the other core staff members still warmly bid her goodbye.
"Alright, that's it for now. Everyone, please get ready for opening hours～"
"Ah, Floor Manager… Thank you for taking care of me all this time…"
"Never mind that～ Come, come… Come over here for just a bit."
And that wasn't the end of it. Even after her speech, the girls gathered around Koharu to express how reluctant they were to say goodbye with happy and sad expressions alike.

I was suddenly called back to work here, and I had to put up with a lot that I couldn't handle despite how I was initially supposed to be only working in shifts as a trainer. Even so, perhaps I couldn't have asked for a better workplace in terms of the atmosphere…
"Okay then, I think today I will also go hom…"
"I'll hate you for a lifetime, Kitahara-san…"
It only took me ten seconds to take back my previous statement.
"What is it? Is she pregnant? Student marriage? Are you trying to create a scandal before you graduate?"
"No way. She said it herself, right? She wants to focus on her studies…"
"But she will graduate soon. She could at least continue until university starts in April… So in the meantime, Kitahara-san could train someone else…"
"I did say I'll take a break for a while, right? …Well, if I'm needed, I can come back after April…"
"I'll hate you even in my next life, Kitahara-san～"
"Stop it, okay? I did enough for this restaurant's sake, right? And she did too."
"It's a huge loss because you guys are so reliable～ Even if we started hiring urgently right now, I doubt we'd find someone who can pull their weight immediately."
"She considered that herself when she made her choice. Just send her off with a smile."
"Haah… Well, I'll do it for Sugiura-san. That's why I'm taking it out on you."
It seems she was really worried about this.
Given that this is the only place she can truly be herself among a large group of people as of now, it's really hard for her to let go of such a place.
She struggled with it all night, on the verge of tears the whole time, but she finally made her decision this morning.
"Well, anyway, I'll step in if things get hectic. I'll go home for now."
"Like I said, don't assume that I'll definitely come back. I will be a working man next year, alright?"
"Oh, you little! So you actually did do it, come on!"
"W-Wait! It hurts, it hurts, Floor Manager!"
…The girls' farewell ceremony sure is quite noisy.
"…I imagine they were quite reluctant to say goodbye to you."
Koharu had her ponytail half untied and smiled genuinely, but her red eyes implied how emotionally touching the farewell was.
"I also talked with everyone. With this, I have no more regrets…"
"You don't have to put it as if the world's about to end. …You'll be able to come back to the restaurant again when the opportunity arrives."
"…I'm prepared to move on. With an unwavering conviction."
As she said that, the bittersweet expression she had up until a moment ago disappeared, replaced instead with a stern look that did look as though it had the "unwavering conviction" she described.
…Her red eyes are still not back to normal, though.
"Alright, let's go to the bookstore first. Then go back to my apartment to make a plan. We'll decide on the objective today and act tomorrow."
"Our schedule will be fully packed from now on. We won't have time to rest. …If we go on with your plan, that is."
"Yes, please. …I'm sorry for involving you in this."
"Honestly, for me, I want you to reconsider that objective again…"
"…It'll be very demanding, you know? Rather, I think about 90% of it is impossible for this year."
"I will. I will regret it no matter what I choose."
"That's why I will take the choice with less regrets… The choice that will result in comparatively less people getting hurt."
"U-Umm… if you think you had enough of me, Senpai, you… don't have to force yourself… I'll be fine by… myself… uue…"
"Don't get hurt by your own assumptions! I didn't say anything like that!"
"B-But… but Senpai! You suddenly went silent… so I thought you've had enough of me… uee…!"
"You know I won't abandon you now, Koharu. …I will accompany you even to the depths of hell."
"…! Y-Yes… th-thank you… very much. I really am… sorry. Right now, I really need you, Senpai… uu…"
Koharu, who wept over her failure of attempting to resolve everything herself last night…
Has now fallen into quite the troublesome state after merely a day; she's gathered her courage and determination, but she's also dependent on someone.
"Anyway, the die has been cast. Be it half a month, a month, a year, or…"
"Perhaps I'll have to bear with it forever…"
"…Let's get moving. With your unwavering conviction, that is."
But her current change is no cause for concern to me.
After all, Koharu's current situation is considerably better than what it was before.
I remember how she handled things so straightforwardly and single-mindedly back when we first met…
And I can see that signs of the bright, charming and straight-laced girl who's difficult to handle are returning.
"By the way, what was with the commotion before? It did seem as though Nakagawa-san and the others were doting on you quite a bit."
"Do you always get teased by them?"
"Y-Yeah… well… if I had to say, rather than me…"
"Well, just a little is fine, right? Hurting Senpai's reputation just a little."
"Like I said! About you and Kitahara-san!"
"Since you two came here together and are resigning together…"
"No, Senpai becoming my trainer was totally a coincidence."
"Then what about you two resigning together?"
"Kitahara-san's always been so rigid and serious, so I imagine everyone would be really interested to know how a younger girl managed to make him fall for her!"
"So, how was it? Now is the perfect time to talk about it, you know～"
"How's it going between you two? How far did you go? Did you kiss?"
"…I don't know whether you can use this as reference, but…"
"We only made love in the restaurant once."
"…What was that? What did you just say, Sugiura?"
"I'm sorry for troubling you. I don't know how I should apologize to you, Sensei…"
"That's not what I want to hear! I don't understand what you were trying to say at all!"
"Please withdraw my recommendation to Houjou University."
"Tell me your reason! There's only one week left until graduation, why are you saying this now!?"
"I'll be trying out for the second wave of admissions at Seisen University. They're offering a program that I'd like to get into no matter what."
"Like I'd accept a reason like that! What did your parents say about this!?"
"I've already persuaded… no, they've already accepted it."
"I can't trust that! Bring them here. I'll talk to your parents directly!"
"There's no need for that. …It's a done deal in black and white. My parents have approved of my selfish decision."
"…Sensei, I know I'm troubling not just you, but also the school by declining the recommendation, I really am sorry."
"This isn't just about troubling us… this will also affect the number of future recommendations…"
"I know. That's why I came here, to ask for a favor. …I would like to apologize to the university."
"…You mean you want me to apologize to them?"
"I'll be apologizing personally. But, if possible, Sensei, I would like you to accompany me."
"Sensei, I understand that it'll trouble you even further. However, by having you there, I believe it would reduce the damage to the high school to the bare minimum."
"I understand that it's improper to say this as a student of Houjou High School. …But I want to go to Seisen University! Please!"
"…So you heard all of it, huh?"
"If you two happen to see Mihoko… and you wouldn't mind, please tell her this."
"It's fine to go to Houjou University. …There will be no one to hurt you."
"I should be on my way. I have to begin my final push. …Though I only have a month left."
"Well, bye then, you two. …Get along with Mihoko from now on too, okay?"
"You're changing your ideal university right now and declining your recommendation… And you're going to Seisen with only one month left… It's just impossible!"
"S-She's right. Seisen is on the same level as Houjou, if not even harder…"
"…Thank you, Sayuri. For worrying about me."
"I'm not worried about you or anything! I'm just saying that you're being an idiot!"
"Even so… I've already made up my mind. If I'm going to get accepted somewhere, I want it to be where I want to go, rather than where I'm able to go."
"You won't make it. You'll end up wasting a year. …You'll end up hating us."
"I won't. I'll take responsibility for the things I've done. …If not, our relationship wouldn't be like this right now."
"Goodbye, Ako, Sayuri. This will probably be the last time we meet, since I won't be going to the graduation ceremony. Bye, you two."
"Still, Koharu, once you've decided on something so defiantly, you really do follow through with it."
"Declining the recommendation, negotiating with Suwa-sensei, and even visiting the university to apologize."
"But everything else after declining the recommendation was your idea, Haruki-senpai, wasn't it?"
"Indeed I was the one behind the idea, but to think you'd do so without hesitation…"
"Because I believe in you, Senpai. …Your life experience, your way of thinking, and your tendency of not holding back."
Even now, I'm actually really opposed to all this.
The method that Koharu had decided on to allow Yada-san to attend Houjou University is one that puts her own future in great jeopardy.
"It's just a slight misunderstanding between the two of you. There should be a better way to solve this."
"Perhaps you could first enroll at Houjou and attempt to persuade her over time, to the point where she would return to university someday? I imagine she can be pardoned for a temporary absence…"
"It might look really bad right now, but if you look closely, you'll see that it's actually just a case of a high school girl having a broken heart."
"I'm sure when you look back in a few years, you'll wonder why you took it so seriously back then, and it'll just become an embarrassing memory that you'll smile about whenever you think back on it."
I continue to ignore the fact that it's my responsibility to get to the bottom of this and insist on pressing Koharu to change her mind.
"In that case, let me know what other methods are available for us to make up with one another, right here and now."
"We don't have room for time to do the work for us anymore. I simply can't hurt Mihoko more than I already have."
"Please don't consider this a simple case of a broken heart… I wouldn't want someone to belittle the love I have. …Even if said someone happens to be the person I love himself."
"I'm serious right now. Who cares about what happens in a few years. And anyway, I'm sure I'll still be serious then…"
"Once you've made up your mind, you're not going to listen no matter what I say…"
"That's why I couldn't forgive you, Senpai. That's why we clashed. That's why I came to love you."
Incidentally, once she strengthened her resolve, she wouldn't even hide her feelings…
"It's hard to get into Seisen's literature program, you know?"
"Senpai, they had an exchange with your seminar, right?"
"I have some acquaintances there, but honestly, I think theirs is more prestigious than ours."
"There are many graduates who get jobs in mass media and publishing, right?"
"Well, their department is well-known for that, after all."
"Senpai, you're aspiring to work at a publisher, right?"
"Then that's sufficient. It's worth a try."
Should I think deeper about this or just let it slide…?
"I'll definitely pass. I won't cause trouble to anyone."
"Not to Mihoko, Sayuri, Ako, my classmates, my teachers, my school, you yourself, Senpai, or my mother and father."
"Nor to Iizuka-senpai, Mizusawa-senpai, or Ogiso, and lastly… not to Ogiso-senpai."
Koharu's strong determination slightly deviates from her reason to go to Seisen University.
Did she not realize this, or did she choose to overlook it for now…?
"By the way, how did I do on Question 3?"
The fact that I've been reminiscing about things up until now causes me to forget for just a moment that I'm now Koharu's personal tutor, and she's currently studying for exams.
It all began the day before yesterday. Even with over ten hours from dawn till dusk, it was an exam preparation plan that started way too late.
Someone who has experienced the reality of university entrance exams even a little would either roll on the floor laughing or snicker at our hopelessly late efforts with cynicism.
To be honest, even I'd laugh at how she still tries to get into Seisen University with so little time left…
"See! I haven't been messing around even after I got my recommendation. I've maintained the level of studying of an average exam taker."
There goes my reason to laugh at her.
She really has done a good job at maintaining her study ethic. Among Seisen's past exam questions, this is one of the more difficult ones…
"Don't take entrance exams lightly. Come on, let's continue with Question 4."
That's rightーwe shouldn't be taking this lightly…
"Anyway, Koharu, since you've decided to take the general entrance exam, I won't leave your side until the date of the exam."
For her to be able to smile at the very end… For me to be able to see Koharu's true smile…
I don't have much time to put in a serious effort at this point.
"That's why for these three weeks… I want you to prepare yourself and follow what I'm telling you to do, Koharu. I want you to… believe in me."
I felt a slight, yet penetrating sting at that remark.

"Yeah, I've discussed it with the teachers last week… Although she doesn't have the required attendance, her grades in the second term met the required criteria, so they decided to give her an exception."
"Thank you. This is all thanks to you, Sugiura. Thank you for the notes you always gave her when she wasn't at school."
"With this, I can at least catch a breath for now. …Though there are still many issues that haven't been solved yet."
"So, what's going on today? What do you want to tell me that I have to keep a secret from Mihoko…?"
"Do you want me to refill the water?"
…It'd be a problem if Yada-san's mother turned around right now.
Since I've met her twice already.
"Um, about that problem that couldn't be solved…? I want to tell you the reason why Mihoko refused to go to school."
"…! You know the reason? That's a relief. That girl never said a word about it. She still has a slight fever, so I refrained from prying into what's going on with her…"
"So what is it? I wonder if it was because she couldn't get along with her classmates…?"
"Back when she was in middle school, she often told me she didn't want to go to school… But she stopped saying that upon entering high school, which made me very relieved…"
Now that I think about it, Koharu once told me about this before…
Although she had been in Houjou ever since kindergarten, she still couldn't blend in with the class.
"It was all because you were there to pick her up every morning, Sugiura-san, and got along well with her. I'm very grateful for that."
"I-I'm sorry! However, this time I am the cause of the problem!"
"I ended up hurting Mihoko. That's why Mihoko's isolating herself more desperately than she has up until now…"
"As you said, I was very close to Mihoko."
"I'm not trying to be conceited, but I believe that she trusted me the most."
"Because I betrayed her, I think that's why… she refuses to open her heart to anyone else now."
"The only thing I can say is… perhaps what's going on is just simply silly and trivial to adults who have been through life for tens of years…"
"But this is a problem that has utmost importance for us who have only lived out life until our teenage years."
"Don't be, I'm glad you told me…"
"Also, I know I'm about to make another forward request, but… I have something I need to ask of you, auntie."
"Do you mean… by coming to our house?"
"No, if we were to talk directly right now, I think it'd just become more complicated. That's why… I want you to give this to her."

"I've written all my current feelings down here. I've tried my best not to be emotional, to be calm, and I thought it through carefully… But I wrote it with honesty, with nothing to hideーfor better or worse."
"…I just need to give this to Mihoko, right? I understand."
"Are you sure you're not going to give it a second thought? Because Mihoko truly doesn't forgive me."
"Yes, I'll make sure to hand this over."
"Her friend here is trying her best to communicate. If Mihoko still refuses to respond, it's obviously her fault."
"…But the reason she became like this could be because we've spoiled her too much."
"That's not… true. Mihoko is a really good girl. I was at fault."
"…Anyway, I'll take responsibility to pass this letter to Mihoko. And I'll make sure Mihoko reads this."
"No, I'm the one who should thank you. And once again… please keep being friends with Mihoko, okay?"
While Yada-san's mother left and I sat on the seat right before me in place of her, Koharu heaved a massive sigh with her entire body.
Well, I suppose the act of being honest to the mother of a friend whom you've got into a fight with does require quite a bit of courage.
"She will. Her mother gave you her word. She'll do whatever it takes to make her read it."
"But if she still won't forgive me…"
"Isn't that the very reason why we're getting her mother on our side?"
"Now you can just pass letters to her whenever you want. As many times as it takes."
"We're entering a war of attrition now. There can be no more mistakes."
This is the last strategy I taught Koharu.
"You really have considered many things. You handled things like an adult."

I personally thought that this was the easiest and the most proper way to go about this, but the way I was so calculating and accounted for various risks seems to show just how cowardly I am to Koharu, given that she's always tackled problems head-on.
…If I used this calculating attitude on a certain other girl, I wonder if our lives would have been much easier…
"About the strategy to make an ally of her mother… You said it will definitely work out, right?"
"That's… because she's the one who cares for and loves Yada-san the most."
"It might sound rude to you, Koharu, but she cares for Yada-san even more than you do."
"…You don't even know much about her; I'm surprised that you believe in her so strongly."
"…I didn't believe it in the past."
"Because I only knew one kind of mother, I didn't believe it at all."
"But the more people I got to know well enough, the more chances I got to meet different kinds of mothers."
Moreover, during high school, I had to visit almost all of my classmates' homes, and because of this, I got to know their mothers.
Takeya's mother is rather celebrity-like, while Io's mother is the exact oppositeーsomeone who's had a completely modest upbringing.
Also… there are mothers who talk just about everything with their daughters, someone with nothing to hide.
And there are mothers who are estranged from their daughters due to a mix of misunderstandings and incompatible personalities, but still adore them for who they are in the end.
"…Based on the statistics, I came to think that I can believe it."
The more I know about mothers, the more I feel like taking a gamble at some point to see how things go.
"From your conversation with her, I'm even more confident that she's a good mother."
"At the very least, she's more reasonable than Mihoko and me?"
"If either one of you two were this flexible, none of this would've happened."
At that time, if only I was like that too…
What am I saying. I need to stop thinking about that. It's too late to regret it and we already decided to move on.
"Say, Senpai. Regarding what we were talking about before…"
Koharu cast her gaze downward and looked rather hesitant, which was rather unusual for her, but I responded by tilting my head in puzzlement in a way that suggested I thought nothing of her reaction.
I actually heard what she said, but since she said that it's not something she should ask, I should pretend that I didn't hear that.
"Hey, Senpai. Since it's almost noon, should we get lunch here?"
"Yeah, that's a good idea. After that, we'll go back to my place and resume studying."
In any case, with this, I've finished planting the seeds. All that's left is to wait until they sprout.
Of course, I'll have to do my best to water them, fertilize them, and pray that they'll all grow to be big and strong during this period…
However, with this, we've done everything we could.
…With the exception of one single thing.
"Should we call it a day? Since we've already reached our goal."
Today marks the fifth day of our one-to-one winter lessons.
She's been here for twelve hours from dawn till dusk. Then, after going home, she'll need six more hours to finish the homework I gave.
The round trip from her house to here is one hour. Three meals and a shower takes about two hours.
And that leaves three hours for sleep… sometimes even less than that, in order to complete the daily assignments…
This was bound to happen eventually.
Really, she just doesn't know her limits.
"Hey, wake up. The last train will leave soon, you know?"
She completely fell asleep on the desk, and no matter how much I shake her shoulder, there's no sign of her waking up.
"Koharu, Koharu… Jeez, you'll catch a cold."
Despite the fact that I'm sighing, the truth is I'm just messing around with her a little…
It's obvious that my hands couldn't muster the strength they needed to truly wake her from her sleep.
While I'm listening to her peaceful breathing, I look at her sleeping face, which looks even cuter than usual.
Before I knew it, I began to curl her hair around my fingers despite the fact that I was meant to shake her shoulders.
Koharu, who stretched her hand out to me as I fell down in an attempt to pull me up, only to be dragged down under with me in the process.
Koharu, who attempted to save me after I'd been stained, only to end up being stained herself.
Koharu, who ended up being corrupted by my own hands.
And yet… even though her heart and soul should be heavily wounded by all that…
How are you able to remain this pure… How are you still able to show me such a beautiful sleeping face…
…I want to hug her, though I really hope my body manages to suppress such a temptation.
Ever since the day we decided to move forward, Koharu no longer cried with such intensity as she did before.
Is it because she believes in what she's doing now, or is it because she believes in me…
She's really strong. She's really amazing. I'm envious and jealous.
And… she's just so dear to me.
To let this earnest girl get the happiness she deserves.
"It's about time to wake up. …You promised you wouldn't stay overnight for the time being, right?"
If I'm able to look back at this dazzling girl straight in the eye without feeling hurt and without wanting to run away, then…
"There's still quite a bit of snow left over from yesterday. I slipped twice on my way coming here."
"Wow, it's dark. Aa-ah, jeez, you don't look so good."
The harsh, dazzling sunlight hurts my eyes as I detect the shrill sound of a curtain being drawn.
Despite the fact that the sky is covered with thick clouds to the point where the sun can't be seen, the brightness piercing through the window is comparable to that of a cloudless, clear sky.
…Well, that's because the snow from last night piled up.
"…Senpai? Your eyes seem red somehow, you know?"
Koharu, who already treated my place as hers, was casually cleaning up while looking at my face.
"What happened? You don't look as if you've shaved either… This is quite unbecoming of you, you know that, Senpai?"
"Don't force yourself, okay? If you collapse right now, I'll end up the same, you know?"
Koharu kneels right in front of me and brings her face close to mine with upturned eyes, as if she seems more concerned about my condition than cleaning up.
My heart throbs as her pleasant scent tickles my nose.
…In the same vein, I'm sure that the scent I'm letting out has reached Koharu as well.
"You don't seem… to have a fever. How are you feeling?"
But she doesn't seem to care about it and puts her white hand on my forehead, coming even closer.
"I said I'm alright, didn't I? More importantly, why aren't you…"
As I struggle to compose myself, I brush away her hand and glare at Koharu ever so slightly.
"Why aren't you attending… the graduation ceremony?"
Koharu stopped her lively movements for just a moment.
It's March 1st. It's Houjou High School's graduation ceremony.
It's a memorable day that occurs only once across one's school life, much like the entrance ceremony.
"Shouldn't this be the culmination of your three years in school? It's only today… Just a single day."
"It's one day out of the less than two weeks we have until the entrance exam, right? It's a big deal."
I do indeed know someone who skipped out on their graduation ceremony.
But I simply can't compare Koharu to her. After all, I'd be comparing her to someone who's skipped nearly half of her classes like a delinquent back then.
"Regardless if I go or not, I'll still be able to graduate. It won't make a difference."
Today was supposed to be the grandest and final big moment for the serious and excellent Koharu, who did not rest even a little up until the very end, and yet…
"Alright, let's leave that aside and start studying. I don't have much time left, after all."
"Okay, it's about time, let's go to the gymnasium～"
"If at least Yada-san showed up… then Koharu's actions would've…"
"…Don't say her name. She doesn't have anything to do with us anymore, right?"
"She has nothing to do with us anymore…"
"Come on, you two are the last ones. Get going already."
"I get it, okay? Come on, Ako."
"Fuu… okay, I'm fine now! Koharu, show me everything you've done."
Koharu ended up pushing me into the bathroom in the morning not only because I didn't sleep, but also because she was worried about the scent of alcohol.
I washed myself, shaved, soaked in the bathtub, and let myself feel forlorn for just a moment, all in a desperate attempt to return to my usual self…
I've gotten livelier after getting out of the bath, and I see Koharu staring blankly at the scenery outside.
At the streets, painted a pure white by the unmelted snow.
She finally noticed me, but it wasn't because of my voice, but rather my reflection on the window.
"…I'm sorry, I've yet to solve even a single question."
My bath was longer than usual, but there aren't any traces of ink on Koharu's notebook.
The first question seems to be extremely basicーa question of such low difficulty that she usually would be able to solve it in under three minutes.
"It won't make a difference," she said…
"I-I'll do it right now! Give me ten minutes, please!"
"I-I'm sorry. I'll give my all now! So, umm… please don't speak like you have abandoned me…"
"Then, let me rephrase it. …Please accept your graduation certificate."
"I hereby bestow the graduation certificate to Shimizu Sayuri from Class 3-A, with the same honors."
"I hereby bestow the graduation certificate to Sugiura Koharu from Class 3-A, with the same honors."
"Oh, 'With the same honors' is correct in your case, right, Koharu? Your register number isn't first on the list, after all."
"See, it's written properly here. 'The aforementioned student is hereby certified to have completed all school courses.'"
"…Why are you looking at me like you think I'm ridiculous and that you're fed up with it?"
"Because I do think you're ridiculous and I am fed up with it."
I suppose a real graduate won't accept a fake graduation certificate written in pencil on a sheet of paper that was torn from a notebook.
"I just thought I could attempt to simulate the atmosphere."
"It's not like I won't get the certificate, you know? It will be delivered to my home."
Koharu, who had criticized me for what I just did, forcibly snatches away the note I was about to crumple into a ball and toss into the trash can.
"It's a waste of paper, so I'll take it back. Senpai, do you have a tube?"
"Just fold it. It's a thin piece of paper anyway."
"I can't. I'll hang this on my wall as a decoration and laugh at it every time I wake up in the morning."
"Aa-ah, what a waste of a notebook sheet. Really, you can be so childish sometimes, Senpai. …I'll treasure this forever."
With the way she's treating that piece of paper, "It'd be a waste of paper" is probably the last thing on her mind…
"That will be all the students from Class 3-A."
"I see… so you were nominated to give the graduation speech."
"I refused, though. It was rigged from the very beginning anyway. Suwa-sensei forcibly decided that I would be the one to do it."
"Suwa, huh… I wonder if he was also the one who pushed me to be selected for the role back in my day?"
"Wow… so you too stood out in Suwa-sensei's eyes, Haruki-senpai? It seems we have a lot in common, even in terms of our unpleasant experiences."
"Isn't that why Takeya calls you Mini-Haruki?"
"I still don't agree with that. It's not like I'm imitating you, Senpai. I was just born three years later."
In the end, our break became surprisingly lively with other topics of conversation.
As Koharu listened to my memories of high school, I asked of her own memories for the past three years in return, though neither of us ever touched on what happened half a year before graduation.
"So, what were you planning to say in your speech?"
"Like I said, I've turned it down…"
"Knowing you, Koharu, you've desperately prepared the speech already, right? So you wouldn't embarrass yourself if you got chosen without warning."
"…Senpai, are you suggesting you placed a listening device inside my room?"
"Be it studies or school events, I know exactly what you're thinking. …You're actually a little proud that you got chosen, right?"
"…If I'd never met you, Senpai, I would be standing proudly on the stage with my head held high right now."
"Aah～ I'm joking, I'm joking! Don't feel sad, Senpai."
We have so many things in common, and we sometimes end up pointing at each other and laughing, while sometimes we bury our heads in our arms…
As if we were alumni who spent three years together in the same school, we got stupidly excited about this over sweets and tea.
"Then… how about you reveal the speech you thought of right here and now?"
"So you wrote something embarrassing? You're making me want to hear it even more."
"My friends say that you and I have the same personality."
"Jeez… Still, there's no meaning to it. It's not fit for its purpose at all."
"…Before I realized it, it became a message toward a certain person."
"And I didn't even know whether I would be delivering a message or sending one…"
"That's why I put it in an envelope and dropped it off this morning. …At the Yada household, that is."
"Just like what you said, Senpai… I can speak with Mihoko any time."
"Even if we graduate, even if we go to different universities, things will never come to an end between us. …So long as I don't give up, that is."
"Next, we would like to invite the representative of the graduating students, Hotta Tomoaki from Class 3-F, to give his speech."
"As the representative for all graduating students, I am truly honored and grateful to be able to speak during this great graduation ceremony today."

"Looking back on our school lives, I can still vividly remember the time we've spent since the entrance ceremony and how it's passed by so quickly, to the point where we're finally able to welcome this very day."
"Looking back three years ago… it was a bright spring day back then with the cherry blossoms in full bloom and a warm breeze passing by… You were absent from the entrance ceremony, right?"
"After drawing lots, our seating arrangement was decided, and the seat beside me ended up being empty for a week."
"So I always thought about who it might be, being bored when the lessons were only filled with self-introductions, never approaching the actual subject matter."
"A week later, we met for the first time… that was three years ago. I still remember all the memories I have with you."

"Spending a night studying together at your house before the exams. In that three-story house, having extravagant meals, and even an extra-large bathーI was so taken aback by the culture shock, I couldn't sleep at all."

"There was the three-legged race we participated in at the sports festival. During the race, we fumbled our pace and got hurt as a result, so we ended up chatting in the infirmary up until the closing ceremony."
"From field trips to school festivals and even normal, day-to-day occurrences… I can immediately recall all of those scenes in my mind."
"In our second year, when we were placed in different classes, we cried as if the world was ending."
"And in our third year, when we were placed in the same class again, we cried as if we were long-lost sisters."
"Something we can't forget is that, since we're both stubborn, we argued a lot."
"Every time we argued, we immediately made up, as if the argument never existed."
"…The only time we couldn't make up was our… last big argument."
"All I need to do is close my eyes and think about it to feel nostalgic, delighted, pained and hurt about it all."
"But it must be you who suffered the most, right?"
"It must have been so painful that you've come to hate me."
"But you know… I, whom you hate so much, still love you very much even now."
"You might think that I'm not in a position to say any of this, given that I did something really horrible to you and hurt you very deeply. But this is the one thing I won't back down on."
"I've been running away and ignoring everything for the past few days, but…"

"I just can't stand the thought of me being part of your worst memories from now on and having you hating me forever, Mihoko, and I can't bear the thought of you overcoming it and forgetting about me either."
"That's why I'll disappear from your life for the time being."
"Until your life returns to normal, and you go to university, enjoying every day of your life, relieved from the bad memories you hold now…"
"Until someday, when you think you can forgive me even a littleーuntil that day comes, I will work hard somewhere else."
"And then, when our paths cross again, we'll have a big fight again, and make up with each other."
"Certainly, someday… I believe that joyful day will come. So in the meantime, I will work hard while you are not with me, Mihoko."
"Because our lives still go on, I will never give up, and I promise to treasure all of my trusted relationships all the more."
"I actually wanted to cry with everyone. I wanted to hold Mihoko as I cry while singing Aogeba Toutoshi…"
"After that, we would go to a karaoke place and sing our hearts out, so much that we would forget why we all cried so much just before that."
She's doing her best to remain strong even when she's unleashing her emotions about her friends from the bottom of her heart…
"I wanted to go on the graduation trip too. With Mihoko, Sayuri and Ako… I wanted to tour around Spain, Italy, and France!"
And the moment her speech ended, tears began to overflow ceaselessly even as her expression remained unchanged.
"And then Touma Kazusa's concert would be ongoing coincidentally. We wouldn't have minded our manners and made a big fuss, and in doing so, we'd end up being a nuisance to everybody…"
That's why I hugged her from behind without any restraint.

"The university entrance ceremony would be waiting for us immediately after we return. We'd say something like, 'Oh, this is no different from our time in high school, huh?' and stick together as always…"
My arms wrap around her tightly as if to assert the fact that she belongs to me.
"And then, and then… I'd walk around the hallways, and run into this familiar-looking fourth-year upperclassman who's so stubborn…"
I bury my face in her silky hair and wipe her tears with my thumb…
"And we would walk about the campus together as we exchanged teasing remarks with one another…!"
I vow to protect her from anything that would make her suffer.
It doesn't matter if that's my responsibility or not… because from now on, I…
"You can't do this out of sympathy, you know…? Do you want to be misunderstood by a girl again… Senpai?"
She always pushes herself past her limits and tries to get a hold of herself, but the truth is, she's always doubtful and hesitant…
The only conclusion that one can draw from her is that she's a girl who only appears to be strong.
"Hang on, Sayuri… why are you being so confrontational all of a sudden?"
"In the end, neither Yada nor Sugiura attended. This is all the result of what you two did, you know?"
"Don't forget this. Don't think back fondly on this, you hear me? …And don't shove the blame on everyone else, okay?"
"We get it, so shut it already. You're going to fail the entrance exams and be our underclassman."
"The results will be announced next week! Don't make assumptions like that!"
"Isn't it obvious? Since you got dumped the day before the exam…"
"W-Wait… You didn't have to say that of all things out loud, Sayuri… That's the topic that's most sensitive to Ogiso-kun, isn't it?"
"Y-Y-You…! Even after all the horrible things you did, how dare you!"
"There's no way it'll become a memory. It's not over after all."
"There's still a month before university starts, right? Then it's not overーwe're just getting started."
"Don't you get it? We're going to keep trying to persuade Mihoko without giving up from here on out."
"It's not like we can do anything about it. It's all our fault that a certain irritating busybody ended up not coming, after all…"
"That's why we must do it ourselves… That's what the two of us have decided."
"The graduation trip won't be happening anyway, so we're free during spring break."
"It'll be hard for the four of us to get back together for a while… But if Koharu wants the three of us to be together…"
"We will do our best to make up with Mihoko and gradually isolate Koharu from us."
"Jeez, Sayuri… Why do you always have to be so bitter…?"
"No… that's not it. Not at all."
"I see… haha, I see… that's good… yeah, that's great! Let me in too!"

"I think you should go to prep school so that you perform better during the second wave of admissions. That's right, how about you join Seisen's Literature Department? Isn't the girl you like going there as well?"
"Your work never pays off, Class Rep. You are quite popular with the underclassmen, though."
"W-W-Wha…What are you saying!? I'm popular with my classmates too! Look! Someone took my second button!"
"Oooh～ we still have that custom, huh～ this school is surprisingly old-fashioned～"
"Besides, it's not only one person who wanted it, you know? The spares I prepared almost ran out. See, this is the last one…"
"U-Umm… can you give it… to me?"
We're finally at the middle of March, where the signs of winter have all but faded away as the sunlight gradually shines stronger and the air gradually warms up.
"…Well, we knew this day would come."
Today is the day of the examination for the second wave of admissions to Seisen University.

It's been three weeks since Koharu decided to take this exam… and after spending an impossibly short amount of time preparing for it, we now find ourselves standing right in front of Seisen University's main gate.
Compared to the first admission term, I bet there's barely even a tenth of the number of examinees heading in the same direction we are and with the same attitude as us.
But with the number of accepted applicants being only a tenth of that, it wouldn't be weird at all to say that the path to entry is super-duper tight. …Though I wish I could've worded that better.
"Well, in any case, just do your best. The only thing I can do is just pray for you, though."
"What are you talking about? The fact that I can stand here today full of confidence is all thanks to you, Senpai."
I'm confident that I've done everything I could.

But in the end, I can only speak for what we managed within the limited time we had. If someone were to ask me if I'd be able to achieve a result that would overcome these conditions, I'd argue that it was a ridiculous endeavor to begin with.
"Do you have your exam admission card? Did you properly pack all of your stationery? I suppose you should also turn off your phone now…"
"There's no point in saying all that when it comes to me, Senpai."
In any case, there's really nothing for me to worry about since she's just not someone who would make such careless mistakes, much like myself.
…However, the fact that there's nothing to worry about is the very thing fanning my uneasiness, as I find myself stuck in a loop of contradictory thoughts.
"Alright, then, I should be heading in soon."
Leaving my worries aside, with light but powerful steps, Koharu marched through the main gate of Seisen University.
She really does seem much more confident and relaxed compared to my own trembling voice calling out to her.
As soon as Koharu reached the gate, she turned around to face me once again in a precise, clockwise fashion.
"Thank you… for everything you've done for me up until now!"
Her voice rings across the vicinity as she bows her head deeply to me.
"I, I… absolutely won't forget it! I won't forget everything you've given me, Senpai!"
How do I put this… that show of gratitude sounded far too exaggerated, and far too powerful for someone who's simply going to take an exam.
"…You're exaggerating. Remember that there's still a lot we'll have to do our best in. This isn't the time to feel relieved."
That's why I can't obediently accept such humble words. I can only concentrate on what I'm facing right now.
"I'll pick you up later. Call me when the exam is over."
For some reason, the sight of Koharu looking at me with such seriousness in her eyes caused me discomfort, so I quickly turned around and hurried off.
All while I attempt to drive out the thought of why despite her relaxedness, she still carried an air of tragic resolve about her.
"Ah, Mom? It's me. …Yeah, I just finished."
"The result… yeah, I did what I could. I have no regrets."
"…I really am sorry for everything, I've asked for so many unreasonable things. I'll pay you back the exam fees. Don't worry, I have money left over from work."
"I can't do that… I need to set things right. Even if I fail, I don't have any intention to rely on my family."
"…Ah～ let's drop this topic for now. Let's discuss it in detail after I get home."
"Yeah, I'm coming home right now. …There's nowhere I need to be anyway."
"Eh? Really? I can ask for anything? Then, umm…"
"That's a relief… So you do know who I am."
"W-Well, I have seen you once before, after all."
"Ah, you mean on the video of my performance during the school festival? Now, that's embarrassing… What a shame that such an awful performance still remains to this day."
"You don't have to feel all that nervous. …Well, I guess it's natural to be on alert when a stranger approaches you."
"N-No, you're not a stranger… I know about you, Ogiso-senpai! …I actually know a lot about you."
"But this is the first time we've properly met, right? Nice to meet you. I'm Ogiso Takahiro's older sister, Setsuna. Thank you for looking after my younger brother all this time."
"I'm really sorry for acting so brazenly…"
"N-Not at all… but how do you know about me?"
"Takahiro said you're having your entrance exam today. So I thought I'd finally have a chance to talk to you."
"I-I don't really understand what you mean."
"I'm sorry, perhaps it'd be better if we did this at a later date? Still, I just couldn't wait."
"Ogiso-senpai… Umm… How much do you know about me…?"
"Just how much do you know about what I've done…"
"Takahiro consulted me about you. He told me about a girl in his class who seemed to be incredibly sad."
"I just couldn't think of you as a stranger after that. And so I wanted to talk to you at least once, no matter what."
"Can I tell you about something that happened in my past? It's a very old story, from a time when I was still in middle school and hadn't enrolled in high school yet."
"I… received a confession during my third year of middle school."
"…I have nothing to say about that."
"In the end, we failed to make up even when graduation arrived… I chose Houjou High through the process of elimination. …Because it was the only place everyone else was not going to."
"So, I entered Houjou and I changed the way I've been interacting with people up until then. After that I didn't get too close with my friends and always maintained a small distance."

"If I got closer with them, I might have ended up getting completely ostracized because of some little thing. …That's why I thought it'd be best to avoid getting close to them from the very beginning."
"…You don't have to look so frustrated about it."
"But wasn't it all a misunderstanding…? Doesn't that make it nothing but a petty resentment directed toward you?"
"It's the same for you, though, isn't it, Sugiura-san? For people who you could call friends as if it were only yesterday to gossip about you…"
"My circumstances are different! It's not a misunderstanding. I really am a traitor, so I'm only receiving my proper punishment."
"…My friends only did what was right. My situation is different from yours, Ogiso-senpai."
"It wasn't your fault, Ogiso-senpai… That's why I'm frustrated. The way I am now, I can understand the pain you felt back then."
"Fufu… you really are the person I was told you were."

"Although it's the first time we've met, and although I'm only telling you about an old story of mine, you're treating it as if it's your own matter… Rather, you left your own matters aside and really tried to defend me."
"But I couldn't achieve anything. In the end, I'm useless. So there wasn't any meaning in it…"
"You never try to justify yourself. And you never go out of your way to blame others."
"I said that just because it really was my responsibility. It was my fault for not taking action."
"…Alright, then let's move on to something that happened recently."
"Last week… there was a middle school reunion."
"Yeah, I did. There's still a girl who I'm close with up until now, and she said she'd be attending."
"I dressed rather plainly and went out early. I got a little lost, but I ended up arriving there safely. …I discovered that it was a rather large and stylish Italian restaurant."
"But when I tried to go in, my legs were suddenly frozen in place…"
"I wandered around the entrance, walked aimlessly around the area, and looked at the people who went in from a distance."
"Yeah. I didn't know what to do alone. In the end, I gave up after about 30 minutes and headed back to the station."
"Then, someone suddenly tapped my shoulder from behind."
"Ah, was it the only person you were still close with?"
"Unfortunately… it was the leader of the group of friends I used to be in. The girl who had a crush on the boy who confessed to me."
"She saw me from the windows in the restaurant and chased after me."
"Was it because she still harbored ill will toward you, Ogiso-senpai…"
"…From there on, we enjoyed a lively, nostalgia-filled reunion together. It was almost anticlimactic."
"The close group of five all assembled. Everyone mostly remembered what happened in the past, then they started to talk to me one after another."
"…So did they say anything? Did they talk about the falling out they had with you, Ogiso-senpai?"
"Ah, they just went something along the lines of, 'Oh, something like that did happen, huh?'"
"I guess it's aptly put that between the bully and their victim, the bully forgets their actions almost immediately while the victim has to remember everything."
"…And of course, that's exactly what happened. Other than the friend I mentioned, everyone has forgotten all about it."
"At first, I was like, 'What the heck?' I've been holding on to it for more than six years. …I even changed my way of life because of it, so what is wrong with them?"
"Why not? Aren't you frustrated about this?"
"I was, but above all, I was having so much fun, was so happy, and so filled with nostalgia… In the end, I still really cared about everyone."
"We went to karaoke after that… with only the five of us, ignoring all the guys who tried to invite us."
"I sang five songs in a row and everyone just booed at me without consideration… But in reality, I was the one who was inconsiderate."
"But everyone knew that I love karaoke, so they clapped for me and cheered me on with maracas, reminiscing about the past without even paying attention to the songs…"
"…Look, here's a photo we took there. I exchanged phone numbers with everyone. And we plan to go on a trip next summer."
"…You look like you had fun, Ogiso-senpai."
"I really had a lot of fun. It feels as if I've wiped the slate clean in more ways than one. …I can even say that my life's changed again."
"It's been six years since then. It's been a really long time. …I've tried my best to make up with them within that period, but I wasn't strong enough for that."
"…I was pretty certain that someone like you would truly be glad for me."
"Ah… I'm sorry. I just acted as if it happened to me…"
"Don't be. I told it to you so that you could think of it as if you were in my shoes."
"I wanted to give you hope. …Because I know about your pain very well."
"What am I saying? Maybe I'm just being pushy about this… I can't guarantee that you'll overcome your predicament smoothly just because I did."
"Not at all… It gave me a lot of courage."
"Really, you're truly… a kind person, just like I've heard."
"Ah, what was that? You're saying you've heard things about me? Goodness me, what exactly have you learned, if I may?"
"God, what have I been doing all this time? Thinking about how selfish I've been is just making me feel even more miserable…"
"I have to give him back… No, he was never supposed to be mine to begin with, but I have to swear that I just won't do something like that again…"
"Don't give up, okay? Be sure to make up with your friends."
"O-Okay… Ah, this isn't the time to talk about that…"
"Well, you did push yourself so far… If it's something you've had to make an enemy of everyone to obtain, it's fine for you to believe that it's something worth fighting for."
"Also, please don't blame yourself like that. Really, you're just as Haruki-kun described you to be. You two are strikingly similar even when it comes to things like this."
"That's why you seemed like someone that I would become fond of. Do your best, Koharu-san… Can I call you that?"
"I heard from Takahiro. Sugiura-san is having her entrance exam today, right?"
"I hear that competition is stiff for that university because they only accept a limited number of applicants? I imagine that it's going to be quite tough, but I hope she'll manage to pass."
"Also, I actually need to ask you for a favor…"
"Could you let me have her for just an hour after her exams are over?"
"Of course, this is only my selfish request. I know how unreasonable it is for me who should not have any connection to you to ask this."
"Even so, I want to talk to her at least once. I want to hear her worries. I want to get to know her."
"I promise I won't cause you any trouble, Haruki-kun. This will be the last time."
I received this text soon after I sent Koharu off.
I immediately replied with the location where Koharu was taking her exam, her schedule, and the place I'd be meeting her. I gave Setsuna the right to wait for Koharu.
I'm sure Koharu will be surprised. She might end up hating me for handing over this spot.
And after she knows the truth… she might lament and blame herself. She might take it all upon herself again.
The truth about how Setsuna and I, on the last day of February, on that snowy day…
On the night before Koharu's graduation ceremony… we had already exchanged our goodbyes.
According to the forecast, it was just a matter of time; the harsh cold outside speaks for itself.
That's why I felt it was all destined to happen. For it to be snowing again.
Every time I betray Setsuna, the sky brings about falling snow in a merciful attempt to cover up my despicable sin.
…The descent of white, dancing crystals is something that's kind to me alone; and to Setsuna, whose name contains the character for snow itself, it's cruel.
"When Takahiro told us about her, Takeya-kun hung his head, and Io looked like she was about to cry."
"I thought those two were heavily sympathizing with what happened to her, much like I was…"
"They knew… They knew that the university student who ended up separating her from her friends was me."
I said it, I finally said it.
I'm in love with this girl named Sugiura Koharu.
Even when I'd been texting Setsuna, even when I'd exchanged presents with her…
That girl had always been by my side.
"Everything happened because of me. She… Koharu involved herself to protect me."
"Of course I feel responsible… if I'd only gotten a hold of myself… if only I never hurt her friend…"
"If she really hopes for a future where she never met you in the first place, then perhaps you should feel responsible for that, Haruki-kun."
"Did she regret it? Did she ever lament about the fact that she met you, Haruki-kun?"
It's the opposite. She's directly and clearly told me that she never would have wanted that.
"…As I thought. That's why there's no need for you to feel responsible, Haruki-kun. The only thing you have to do is protect the girl you love best."
"Ah… do you know what I'm getting at here? I'm actually being sarcastic."
This isn't just mere sarcasmーit's a merciless interrogation that's cornering the both of us.
"But it's pretty ridiculous of me to be saying such things, right? Considering what I did to you during Christmas…"
"It's not your fault, Setsuna! That's why you don't have to feel responsible!"
"…In other words, Haruki-kun, the girl you love best right now is the girl you truly consider as being the most important to you, regardless of your conscience, sense of responsibility or guilt…"
And it doesn't seem like Setsuna has any intention of tuning down her merciless investigation any time soon.
"So, you should know what to do from now on without asking me, right? You just don't have the time to worry about me anymore with the way things are…"
Her words sting me as if she's embracing me with swords thrust through her body.
"But you're terrible too, you know, Haruki-kun? …Toward her, that is."
"Why did you just watch over her? If you had tried to be a busybody from the start like usual, she might not have gone through all these painful things."
It's because I was afraid that things would only become more complicated if I were to get involved.
It's because I had a lot on my plate as well, so I decided not to go out of my way to interfere with matters concerning her school.
It's because Koharu told me that she was alright…
"You don't have to feel responsible. The only thing you need to do is desperately protect the girl you love. You only have to save her…"
She could only look away from her own situation.
After all, Setsuna's been running away from her own situation as well. She's condemning me exactly because she knows how it feels to do that.
"Haruki-kun, you know about what happened to me in the past, right? So you know how I feel about this, right?"
Back when she was in middle school…
A single unwanted confession caused cracks to form in her strong bonds and eventually caused them to collapse.
"At that time, if you were there, Haruki-kun, I would've absolutely been clinging to you. …And I wouldn't have ever let go of your hand."

Setsuna's been through what Koharu's experienced up until now, so she just couldn't accept that Koharu wasn't rewarded for what she had to endure. She simply couldn't stand the fact that Koharu had lost everything.
"Then, you know what I wish for now, right? …Please save my middle school self."
…And that's even after she's placed what she's lost on the scale.
"As of now… who do you want to protect the most?"
"That… That would be… the person who's trying to remain strong and move forward as best she can, despite having collapsed once because of me…"
"It's my junior, the girl called Sugiura Koharu."
"I won't let her collapse anymore. I won't see her look upset again. …I'll do something about this."
At this moment… droplets fell on the table.
"Sorry for saying all these terrible things, okay? …I won't deny that it had a bit of jealousy mixed in it."
Yet those droplets didn't belong to the person who was being hurt by those words, but instead to the person who said them.
"Protect her, okay? Save my past self, okay?"
"You should save those who you can save, alright? After all, my wounds… are no longer within your ability to heal."
"That's right… My wounds are ones that you alone can't heal for me anymore…"
"Only two weeks have passed since then… but I'm already talking about it like it's a distant memory."
"The last day of February… a snowy night…?"
"…Senpai? Your eyes seem red somehow, you know?"

"The two of us talked about this and decided that we wouldn't tell you about this until your exams were over, Koharu-san. …We didn't want your preparation for your exams to be affected because you suddenly felt responsible for this."
"The truth is, I think it was a bad idea for us to meet. …I knew that it'd end up being a painful memory."
"I didn't mean for this to happen! Once my exams were over, once the tutoring was over…"
"This is what Haruki-kun chose. He said he loved you best."
"No, it's not like that! It's because I just couldn't let Senpai go no matter what! I just couldn't give him back to you…!"
"That's why you should stay by his side. I can no longer do that."
"Actually, I'm really sorry. I was fully expecting you to attempt to take responsibility for this."
"Even so, I really wanted to meet you. I really wanted to meet you and talk to you."
"The first reason is because something delightful happened to me. …So I wanted to share it with the person who's likely to be the happiest about it."
"Yeah, about how I made up with my friends. …The truth is, it's the most recent event in my life that I haven't even told my family about, you know?"
"The second reason is because I wanted to cheer you up. Putting aside your relationship with Haruki-kun… you are someone that Takahiro respects."

"My brother really chose his words carefully, you know. He said he just couldn't believe that you'd do all those absurd things and expressed his frustration that he wasn't capable enough to help you."
"…But I did do all those things. I even betrayed Ogiso despite the fact that he stood up for me so much."
"He doesn't see it that way, so please don't worry. …After all, I don't see it that way either."
"We're siblings, and we're quite alike. We're both easygoing, careless… and these traits are exactly why we're so taken by the same kinds of people."
"I'm just kidding. The truth is, my third reason for this is… simply because I was curious about you."
"I wondered what kind of person you are. Someone who's considered to be nearly identical to Haruki-kun with how meddlesome and serious she is… and a very wonderful girl, at that."
"That's all from me. …Sorry I've kept you here for so long."
"You'll meet up with Haruki-kun after this, right?"
"He said he'll be waiting in front of Onjuku Station. I think it's about 30 minutes from here?"
"For me to go where Senpai is…"
"Umm… she will arrive there at around 7 o'clock. I'll take responsibility in sending her there."
"Okay, sent. With this, everything will be my fault if you don't go there, right?"
"Thank you, Koharu-san. But it's time for you to go. …To where Haruki-kun is, of course."
"As I thought, I should talk to him once more. Because… this is… just cruel."
"That was close. I almost ended up letting loose in the middle of that…"
"I've done what was expected of me, right?"
"As an older sister… and as an ex-girlfriend…"
"I've held this in for two weeks, after all… so it's alright now, right?"
Even while I was sobbing heavily and couldn't say a word, Setsuna only stared at me kindly.
Her compassionate eyes have given her forgiveness even toward someone as patheticーand as cruelーas I am.
"I've received your payment. Thank you very much."
That's why I could only tuck my tail between my legs and run away.
What I mean to say about Setsuna, who simply couldn't bring herself to blame me…
is that I know that the last sight I had of her will forever be etched in my mind.
The moment I went outside, I reflexively let out a white sigh as I noticed that the snow and the cold were stronger than I expected.
Although I could see the snow from the window next to my seat, it was unexpectedly heavy when I was directly exposed to it, covering my entire surroundings in a pure white.
As I took a step forward, a peculiar high-pitched sound came from my shoes, which could only be heard on days such as these.
Before I realized it, the street was dyed white with snow, which little by little got crushed under the weight of my feet.
But with the way the snow is falling now, I'm sure that the dents I've left with my footsteps will fill up almost immediately.
In other words, and as I thought, there's no longer anything I can do here anymore…
I didn't notice because my gaze has been lowered this whole time.
I'm currently standing right next to the table we sat at near the window earlier.
Setsuna's waving at me with a smile.
And it's that gestureーthat precise gesture of hersーas well as the kindness she's showing me in her desperate attempt to save me…
That I'll never be able to erase from the deepest depths of my memories.
The big clock in front of the station points exactly at the number seven.
The girl I've been waiting for is now standing right in front of me.
But my beloved junior's standing completely still in front of me, saying no more than "Senpai" as if she had forgotten how to say anything else.
"…Anyway, good job. Come on, let's go home. I've prepared dinner."
"I will hit you right now, Senpai."
"That's why I want you to hit me as well."
Obviously, I completely understand why Koharu's saying all this right now.
"Aren't we just terrible…? Aren't we just the worst…?"
…Setsuna truly and completely forgave the two of us.
"To have done something like this to such a wonderful person, to such a kind person… I'm really the worst… I'm such a hopeless bitch."
"Even so… you're still the most important girl in the world to me."
"What were you thinking…? Really, just what were you thinking, Senpai…!?"
"I was thinking about you, Koharu… I was desperately thinking about how I could be your strength."
"You'll regret this. You'll definitely regret this, you know that!?"
"I'll regret my decision no matter who I choose… be it Setsuna or you, Koharu."
"That's why I made a decision that would leave me with only slightly less regrets… I've chosen none other than the girl I love more than anyone else right now."
Koharu didn't hit me. Instead, I felt a powerful thud on my chest.
I hugged the head that hit my chest tightly and pulled her shivering body filled with mixed emotions closer to mine with great force.
"I can only save those that I can save. Setsuna isn't a girl that I can save anymore."
"Well, I only said this to hide my embarrassment… It's just that, I want to be the strength for the girl I love. That's all."
Now that I think about it… I've finally said that phrase.
"After all, you've never even said that you love me."
I've finally said the words that Koharu spontaneously blamed me for never saying back then…
I've finally and unconsciously said these words as if it was completely natural, to the point where she might've not even noticed…
"I will treasure you… I absolutely will treasure you, Senpai…"
That's exactly what I was going to say… That's without a doubt something I must say…
"I love you, I really love you… I won't let you go."
But the way a man thinks about these things… wouldn't work on someone as straightforward as Koharu…
Compared to the strength Koharu's pouring into her arms that she wrapped around my back, my own embrace around her seems to be lacking.
That's why I hugged Koharu so tightly that she couldn't breathe, determined not to come up short.
"…That's right, Koharu. Please take care of me from now on."
"Yes… leave it to me… Just leave it to me!"
But I'm sure that I'll never be able to win against this girl, no matter how much time passes.
"You're 30 minutes late! What were you thinking!?"
I've been sprinting in the middle of this cold until I was drenched in sweat, but she refused to acknowledge my effort simply because it did not bring about the outcome she wanted.
"You know what day today is, right? So why are you late? I thought this was a serious matter for both of us…"
"I was called for medical checkups. It was supposed to have ended over an hour ago, but the personnel ended up making quite the amount of mistakes…"
"And now you're making up excuses to escape, how sly of you…"
"You can call me sly or whatever you want, but there's only one thing that I'm supposed to do. I don't have interest in anything else."
"Oooh… So what are you trying to do? Why don't you spit it out right now?"
