"Did you say our princess is back!?"
"…We thought she had returned, but the instant she got back, she suddenly shut herself in that room. See for yourself."
"Oh, ohhh… I see. So how's progress? How much did she manage to get done?"
"I'd ask that you'd confirm that for yourself, President."
"Don't joke about stuff like that… The princess will murder anyone who interrupts her while she's writing…"
"Then why are you getting me to do something like that?"
"Wouldn't it be more of a problem if the commander sacrifices himself instead of the soldier?"
"…Ahh, hmmm, well whatever. Let us just rejoice in the simple fact that there's progress right now, shall we!"
"Will we even make it in time? We've only got two months left before the first performance."
"I think we'll… probably be fine? Besides, it looks like she'll be able to create a very strong character this time around… to the point I feel pity for her partner."
"It's a wonder you continue to put your trust in her even though she pushes you around all the time, Prez."
"There's nothing I can do but trust her… She doesn't joke around when it comes to the stage."
"On the other hand, you can say that everything else is a joke to her."
"The princess is out of anyone's hands when she switches into that mode…"
"You two went around the stands together, did you not?"
"Aren't you loved a bit too much, Haruki-kun?"
"Jeez, you're making me quite envious. And you're supposed to belong to me, you naughty boy～"
"The bathtub and sink are sparkling clean. There's not even one speck of dust."
"Hey, Haruki, you got any uncensored porn? Let's throw a screening party!"
"It seems neither of you have changed even though it's a new year."
The day I resumed communication with the outside world, the usual duo came knocking on my door.
They complained and scolded me for my irresponsible treatment of them, all the while carrying heavy grocery bags full of beer and food supplies in their hands.
"You even used disinfectant… Did you have to be so thorough with your cleaning?"
"I just finished cleaning up the place from top to bottom, that's why."
So not only did I have to clean and do the laundry for the whole day today, I had to start cooking again.
…And as might be expected, my whole body is crying out in pain after having been idle for the past few days.
"You were cleaning up? Today? Why didn't you get that done before the year changed? You don't miss out on things like that every year, though, do you, Haruki?"
"This guy went on a ski trip with his classmates during the New Year holiday. And he only received the invitation last-minute, I've heard."
Takeya's nonchalant follow-up hurts my heart.
I won't lie anymore… It's because I made that decision that I invited these two over.

Nevertheless, I've attempted to eliminate all traces of a certain person from this place while going along with the flow and making excuses. In the end, I'm in a state where I've yet to come to a proper resolution.
"Oh! Here's a suspicious DVD! Still, you only got one R-rated disc, huh…"
"That's… umm… A while ago, I had the chance to go back to the school on work-related business… and at that time…"
Despite our current situation, the fact that Takeya found that peculiar item causes me to act in an increasingly awkward manner.
Having said that, Takeya continues to hold the disc in his hand.
Is he hesitating to watch it with those present with him, or is he puzzled over why I'd accept such a thing?
"…There, the food is ready. Clear the table for me."
"O-Oh… right! That sure took long. Well then, I'll be helping myself to some beer!"
In the end, after playing around with the disc for a bit and repeating other meaningless drivel, he quietly puts it back on the shelf.
The way he's acting suggests that… my close friend, who finally visited me after so long, has yet to return to his usual self.
"I told you, stop calling for me like tha… huh?"
"What's wrong～? Did you find a woman's bra in there?"
"Are there actually any bras meant for men?"
Of course I wouldn't fall for that. Why did you think I went through all the effort of doing a thorough cleanup?
…Though I do feel a little uncomfortable about the fact that he seems to have figured me out.
I guess I still don't have a good grasp of my distance with these guys.
"…It's nothing. Hand me a can of beer too, Takeya."
"Yeah, here. Well then, is everybody ready～? Let's begin with… Happy New Year!"
"Happy New Year. Let's treat each other well this year too, Haruki."

"Thank you very much for the kindness you have shown me last year. I would very much appreciate your continued guidance and support this year, therefore, allow me to offer you my most sincere greetings for the new year…"
"…Hold on, what's with that long-ass greeting? Stop imitating Haruki."
"You know what, you guys should just go home."
As we remain in a wafting atmosphere that's slightly different from usual but also retains a little of its usual feel…
The cold beer sliding down my throat tastes slightly more bitter than usual.
"You guys didn't have to wolf all your food down like that…"
The pot was perfectly emptied by the time we finished the rice porridge.
"Can't help it… I've only been able to eat rice cake soup for several days straight, you know? I've had it with the osechi."
Should I have thrown some rice cakes into the pot as well?
"We still have lots of leftover black soybeans. I don't feel like eating at home for some time."
If you bring them to me, I'll happily eat them all…
"Ahhh～ I don't feel like moving for a while～ Haruki, I'm staying over tonight."
"You don't have to tell me that. …Should I make some tea?"
"Say, Haruki. What happened between you and Setsuna?"
"Could you have picked a better time to ask that!?"
Unlike Takeya, who was surprised by Io's sudden attempt to cut to the chase, somehow, I was already prepared for this.
"It seems that you two haven't got in touch with each other since Christmas, much less met one another. Anyone would think that something must have happened."
After all, Io had been stealing glances at me while we were eating and drinking like she had something to say.
"Still, you didn't have to bring up the topic right after we just finished eating…"
"It's exactly because we're on a full stomach that I'm bringing it up now. It's easier to have a nice, calm conversation when we're all in a happy mood and can't think straight."
"Just how strained were you imagining the conversation to be…"
"Hey, Haruki. Is it really no longer possible between you and Setsuna?"
Even Io, who looked like she wanted to settle the matter quickly, didn't say anything in the two hours since she arrived.
Each and every one of us knew what our gathering at my place was supposed to entail from the very beginning. But all of us also hesitated on delving into the subject.
The two of them were fearful about the fact that their actions had the opposite effect and ended up hurting the friends that were closest to them.
While a certain someone evidently has a reason far crueler than the two could ever possibly imagine.
"…You can at least tell us, right?"
That I've already divulged this to someone else.
That I ended up seeking support from that certain someone.
"In the end, I wasn't able to forget. Even so, I said I had already forgotten."
"I lied. Setsuna saw through my lie."
Takeya sighs in disappointment and then says nothing more.
As for Io, she remained silent ever since I started talking and left all replies, refutes, and scoldings to Takeya.
It would appear that the 24th of December I'd shared with Setsuna was just that much worse than the two had imagined.
The fact that I'm still hung up on Kazusa. And that Setsuna still can't get over how I feel about Kazusa.
"Sorry about that… You guys went out of your way to create this chance for me, but I messed it up."
I've always thought that I needed to be condemned by Setsuna.
I believed it was a path we needed to take in order to return to being the school idol adored by all and the class representative shunned by all.
…But at that moment, I had no idea that everything was about to come crashing down and fall apart.
"It's not a problem you can solve with a mere apology."
It's something that only Setsuna would know…
"Then solve it! Phone her however many times you need and apologize! Even if you have to get down on your knees, ask for her forgiveness!"
"If I do that, it will only cause Setsuna further pain…"
That's why Setsuna still adamantly refuses to admit that I did anything wrong up until now. She's done this not only for my sake, but for her own, as well.
I've always thought that there's no need for her to force herself any longer.
"Even if that's the case, just make it up to her someday! For the amount of pain you're putting her through now, pay her back several times over!"
If you think about what this guy does usually, those are flimsy words that carry absolutely no weight.
But the emotion overflowing from his expression and voice shows that he's far more serious than when he himself is the person involved.
"Is there really no hope anymore for the two of you?"
"I don't know… I just don't know."
I don't know how to return things to the way they were before Christmas, much less to how things were three years ago.
"It's all a matter of your feelings. If you think it's no longer possible, then it will turn out that way, you understand?"
Besides, even if Setsuna allowed that, I don't know if it's even alright for me to go back to her with the way I am now.
"…Ran away from Setsuna and lived with another woman?"
"That travel set in the bathroom… I believe it was also there when we were here last time."
"More than half of the toothpaste is gone from what I just saw. It was brand new before."
"You… What are you doing, acting like a woman…?"
If that is the "second toothbrush" used to show off our lover status, then I'm certain that I took care of it during the day.
Her handkerchief, cosmetics, and even condoms, which are shoved under my bed right now, all serve as evidence of that.
As for that travel set… Ah, that's right. I thought it was Io's or Takeya's. After all, it was already there way before winter break started…
That woman did stay over once in the past, but there's no way she was prepared for a sleepover that time since it was an unexpected situation…
Or could it be… that it wasn't an unexpected situation to her back then…?
"I'll ask you one more time, Haruki."
But then, so what? Is there a need for me to shrink back like this?
"Did you end up bringing another woman back to your place because things didn't work out with Setsuna?"
I should have been frank with them from the start. I shouldn't have kept it a secret.
It'd just be a little earlier than planned. They'd realize what I'm trying to tell them.
"Io. You don't have to bring this up now. Besides, it's not like that's a big deal…"
"Stop applying your lack of common sense to Haruki! He's different from you."

Would I have been able to bring myself to divulge such a disheartening truth to these long-standing friends of mine, had I known that I would be able to settle things with Setsuna simply by coming clean to them?
"Did you end up receiving comfort from another woman?"
So this is… In other words…
My punishment from God for being a selfish coward? Is that what this is, basically…?
"Were you in each other's arms when Setsuna was crying alone?"
"You idiot! Why didn't you feign ignorance!?"
My two friends got angry at me for two completely opposite reasons.
"Doing the exact same thing you did three years ago! Just how many times do you have to go wrong before you're satisfied!?"
"You think a sorry is enough!? Don't you understand? Your cheating is not a simple matter of being unfaithful!"
Io's words were pretty much what I expected, but even so, it still brought me pain.
I am once again reminded of my lack of resolve.
"Getting into a casual relationship, messing around and acting on a whim… You don't do those kinds of things, Haruki! So then why…!?"
It wasn't a casual relationship. I can't embrace someone if I'm just messing around. I don't fall in love with someone on a whim.
"You won't be able to go back anymore, you understand? You won't be able to forgive yourself even if Setsuna forgives you, and that will hurt her even more."
However, those words from my mouth dissipate in the air, and it also made me realize my own stupidity.
That's why I'm no good… Io's been saying that all the time.
"You learned nothing from your past mistakes. Just what are you doing…? Seriously, what were you thinking…?"
Io's eyes brim with tears of frustration.
She's seriously reprimanding me with all her heart, but even so, she shows no signs of forsaking me.
Apart from the other person present, namely Takeya, she's someone I consider a friend, one whose tendency to meddle with others' business seems to be almost limitless, much like mine.
"Take care of… Setsuna. Even if you decide to never see me again, stay a good friend to her."
Exactly why I can entrust to her someone who is important to me.
"How could you give up on Setsuna like that…!? How could you give up on her…!?"
For what reason did you think I kept a reasonable distance from Setsuna for three years?
It's because of this yearning for Setsuna inside of me… This disgusting, opportunistic feeling of mine.
"Isn't it obvious? I'm going to call that woman who was here."
"No. It has nothing to do with her. That's the one thing I absolutely won't allow."
What she was about to do might feel like shameless meddling to others, but to me, it was within expectations.
After all, it's a method that I've used countless times before when mediating for Takeya.
"There's no point in trying to act cool now. It's all because you betrayed Setsuna that the situation became this complicated."
"I know the fault's all on me, but even so, I can't involve her in this."
But right now, I clearly reject Io's meddling in my business.
"…Do you treasure that woman that much?"
In a flash, Io slapped me on my left cheek this time.
Because there is another feeling sprouting inside me.
A desiring feeling. A feeling that cherishes that particular person.
It's a new emotion, one that's the worst of the worst of the worst…
Takeya, who had just been letting Io vent out her anger, reaches out his hands as if to hug the girl who is now sobbing.
"I think it's best for Haruki and Setsuna-chan to put some distance between themselves for a while."
"Shut up, let go of me…! Waah…"
Even so, Io doesn't seem satisfied and brushes Takeya's hands aside in a fit of frustration.
"Don't put all the blame on Haruki. It's our fault too for trying to bring them back together forcefully, remember?"
"But Haruki ran away! He's just running away from reality! That's not like him at all!"
"Haruki's also feeling pretty hurt right now. We could at least be a little considerate of that."
But Takeya doesn't give up today.
He grabs Io's shoulders, forces her to face him, and carefully chooses his words.
"I can't forgive him. It's too unfair to Setsuna. There's no way I can forgive him…"
Even while Io pushes away Takeya's hands, she looks up at him with eyes seeking understanding.
It was an expression that Io would never show to the person in front of her now if she were her usual self.
Even I, who is on the receiving end of her verbal attacks, find that unexpected crying face of hers alluring.
That's why, when faced with a frail Io unlike her usual self, Takeya pulls her in close…
But his words and behavior afterward weren't what I expected or hoped for.
"Setsuna-chan was the one who rejected him, wasn't she? Why is Haruki taking all the blame?"
"W-What are you… Takeya, what are you saying…?"
"Just how many years will it take to erase his sins? How many years should he be held liable for a crime of love?"
They're at a distance close enough to kiss, but the words weaved by his mouth are of denial, irony, and depravity.
"What's wrong with running to another woman after being rejected by the one you love and ending up having your heart be unable to take it?"
"Wha… Just what the hell are you saying…!?"
"Stop it Takeya! It's all my fault!"
I realized why those sorts of words keep coming out of Takeya's mouth.
"Who says you have to wait obediently until the person turns around to look at you again? Is there any guarantee that it will even happen in the first place?"
"Why… Why are you saying those things, Takeya!?"
"You'll probably never understand. If it's you who's always playing hard to get and bossing guys around."
"Wasn't that a big chance for you? I think it'd have gone well for you if you kissed her right then."
"Right in front of you…? If I do that, I'll be the butt of your jokes for life."
"Just how many years do you plan on continuing with this unrequited love of yours? You should've just sided with her and gotten angry at me."
"Couldn't help it, now, could I? If what you did should be considered a crime, I'm already long overdue for a death sentence."
"That's why you're always turned down by your dream girl. You paper tiger."
"If she's going to keep supporting Setsuna-chan, then I can take your side without reservation."
We had a cool albeit pathetic exchange as we sat back to back, not caring if even a single girl was watching us.
…All the while trying to hide our embarrassment.
As always, the wind blowing in through the window is so cold that it's prickling my skin.
Having somehow been the first to arrive in the lab after a while since the end of winter break, the piercing cold from outside is unfettered despite the fact that I'm indoors.
Yes, I was the first one here. There wasn't anyone else present.
…Not even a sleeping bag for me to accidentally almost step on.
Well, I guess that's only natural.
She never was the kind of diligent person who would arrive on campus right after winter break, especially before first class.
It's been a week since Chiaki left my apartment.
I hadn't given her a call even once, and there weren't any calls from her end either.
I had been desperately trying to return to my old self.

Waking up at 6:30, eating breakfast, resuming my part-time jobs, coming in contact with people other than Chiaki… I was working on returning to society, to return to being the Kitahara Haruki anyone would recognize.
That's exactly why I couldn't be pampered by Chiaki during that process. I stopped my hand from reaching for my cell phone many times now.
As for Chiaki… Well, she's just fickle.
Even so, now that university has resumed, there's no use in trying to avoid each other anymore.
Since that's the case, I decided last night to take the initiative and go meet her so we can talk about things.
How does she feel about me right now?
Did she only comfort me as a friend, in a way beyond how a friend would? Or have her feelings begun to run deeper than that…?
However, regardless of what it is that she feels about me, I need to decide what to do about my own feelings.
After that, we'll confront each other with our answers and then try to decide on the future path we should be taking…

But this is Chiaki we're talking about, so she'll probably just laugh and say: "What, Haruki? You've gotten all serious about this just because we've slept together a lot?" as if she doesn't really care about it all.
I want to thank her. After one week, I want to see her listless face again.
I'll come back and check again in the evening. She'll most likely be here sleeping leisurely then.
"Did Setsuna come by here? I've been looking for her for a while…"
"Setsuna? Did she come to campus today? I haven't seen her."
"Ah, I met her. We were attending Administrations Studies together just a while ago."
"Administration Studies, huh. So, what happened after the seminar?"
"Well… right after the lecture ended, someone who looked like an acquaintance of hers called out to her, and they left together."
"She looked like a Houjou student, though I've never seen her before… I'm thinking maybe someone from the Public Policy Department?"
"Hmm… Well anyway, at least we know she came to university. Thanks, I'm a bit relieved hearing that."
"I was surprised! I didn't expect you to come all the way to my seminar room."
"Sorry about that. But I just had to meet you today no matter what, Setsuna."
"You had to meet me today…? But why?"
"I wonder why～! Ah! Well, see, we still haven't exchanged New Year's greetings yet～!"
"…Happy New Year. I hope we have a good year, Shouko-san."
"Right, right, I should be wishing you the same thing. Ah, I'll be treating you today, alright? Order whatever you like!"
"Then, should I go for the parfait again?"
"A parfait, huh? You got it. Excuse me～!"
"Umm, a mango pudding parfait and… what will you have, Setsuna?"
"Then we'll have two of those, please～"
"Brrrr, it sure is cold today as well～ As expected, nothing beats a parfait for a day like this."
"We really do have similar tastes, Setsuna. I could even say that we can't really be considered different people at all!"
"…What's wrong? Is there something on my face?"
"Hmm… how should I put it? This is probably the wrong way to put it, but…"
"I'm just thinking how you have become really cute in the short time we haven't seen each other, Shouko-san."
"Turn your back to me for a second. Come on, take a deep breath."
"…This should do it? I suppose I should apologize? I didn't think you'd react so drastically."
"I-I mean, you know… what was that all about?"
"Ah, I didn't say that to spite you. Shouko-san, I always thought you were pretty since the first time I met you."
"But up until now, you've always seemed like an adult. Although you do have a somewhat defiant side to you…"
"…And you think I'm acting more like a child today?"
"Yup, frank, bright, and cute. You look really happy somehow."
"I'm not kidding. Think about it, have you made a blunder like that before?"
"Did anything good happen? …Perhaps during winter break, you had a chance encounter with an amazing individual?"
"You've been telling me those kinds of things so directly up until now. But it's cute how all of a sudden you stammer like that, you know?"
"Like I said… There's no way anyone should've noticed…"
"…I'm just playing with you. Hehe, sorry. Looks like I really troubled you."
"You're right. It's probably just my imagination."
"I'm probably viewing everyone but myself as being happy right now."
"Perhaps it's because I don't want to face my own circumstances that I'm being more alert about even the slightest differences in others' mannerisms."
"I suppose that's quite inconsiderate of me, now, isn't it?"
"So you weren't happy during your winter break, Setsuna…"
"There's no point in saying that, though. Everything's my fault, after all. I just got what I deserved."
"What? Is there something on my face? Or is this payback for earlier?"
"…If it's alright with you, you want to try talking about it?"
"You'll feel better if you talk to someone about it, you know? …Even if it has to be with an utterly despicable wretch."
"For this matter alone, I've decided that I won't rely on others anymore."
"After all, it was my fault that everything came to pass."
"I knew things would turn out this way, but I still took that horrible attitude."
"I ended up being too stubborn about trivial matters and caused the two of us to become broken people right now."
"It's the guy who's at fault in that situation. You didn't do anything wrong, Setsuna."
"No, you're wrong. I'm the one at fault."
"It's the guy's fault for letting the girl think that way. …A guy I know would definitely say something like that, you know?"
"He'd say that and wouldn't accept that the fault lies anywhere else. …As far as the guy I know goes, anyway."
"That person always puts the blame on himself no matter what happens. As he complains and cries in pain."
"And you know, I respect him for that from the bottom of my heart. That's why I want to be someone like him."
"But, but… if he's such a noble person, then you wouldn't be suffering like this right now, no? You'd instead be blissfully acting lovey-dovey with him, now, wouldn't you?"
"…Things are just not going smoothly between us. I guess we're really incompatible."
"How can you say that with a smile? Maybe it wasn't that big of a shock to you after all?"
"Maybe because I cried for ten days straight? …Maybe I just got tired of being sad all the time."
"I guess I'm a bit pathetic, don't you think? It's probably inevitable that things don't turn out well between me and a guy."
"Why are you so obsessed with that one guy?"
"He's serious, dependable, enjoys nagging, is nice to everyone, a bit of a narcissist, and someone who always tries his hardest despite being troubled over something."
"…But then what's so great about a guy that hurts himself so easily because of those qualities?"
"…So you properly remembered what my ideal man was like."
"Well, he does fit that description perfectly."
"That sort of stubborn and inflexible busybody, don't you find them really cute?"
"Shouko-san, do you hate that kind of guy?"
"That feeling of vulnerability totally hits my weak spot."
"Aa-ah, I ended up telling you. I suppose my resolve was weak."

"There's someone from the Literature Department in the club I'm in. According to her, that girl is in the same seminar as Haruki and they're always together. It feels like that girl is following Haruki around."
"That idiot… Why did he leave evidence like that lying around so carelessly?"
"Maybe because he originally didn't intend to date her?"
"Why is that? Is she not that cute?"
"…Isn't it because Haruki is different from you?"
"…Anyway, moving on. Since Haruki had that clash with Setsuna, a crevice suddenly opened inside his heart…"
"And in that moment, that girl appeared before him with perfect timing? Something like, "I'm the present～ ♪" while dressed in a Santa suit."
"…Why is it that your head is always filled with such rotten ideas?"
"But still, it does seem like you hit the nail on the head. You're as good as Haruki…"
"Yeah, I do think I overstepped my boundaries this time around. That's why I think it's about time I pull away from this matter."
"Doesn't matter whether it's you or Mini-Haruki, everyone's starting to become more like him…"
"Well, since that's the case… Takeya, from now on, it's your turn as his best friend."
"We know her name is Izumi Chiaki and that she's in the same seminar as Haruki, but she doesn't appear to be coming to university lately, so it's really difficult to meet her."
"This is a mission only you can do. Only someone like you who's chasing skirts all year long…"
"…Ah, ahh… Io, before you ask that of me, isn't there something you need to say to me?"
"When we were in Haruki's room for the New Year's party. Didn't you do something to me then?"
"…This is all for Setsuna's sake, you know?"
"Even if it's for Setsuna-chan, doesn't the thought of trying to cheer me up ever cross your mind?"
"You're so petty. Just what is it that you want? Are you telling me to get down on my knees and apologize?"
"H-How about b-becoming mine for one day?"
"It's not funny anymore if you stammer like that."
"Why am I messing up where it really matters…!?"
"No way. I'm not up for sex without love."
"No, sex with me is always full of love, you know? Want to give it a try?"
"There's a difference between constantly being full of love and everlasting love."
"Everlasting love…? What kind of fantasy is that?"
"You won't do it no matter what?"
"Well, if we at least know what she looks like…"
"You'll help search for her if so?"
"What? Do you have her photo or something?"
"I don't have anything like that. Though the image data is probably still stored somewhere in your head's hard disk."
"…Have we met with her before though, I wonder…?"
"Probably. It's likely you even met her more than once."
"When? Where? I have confidence in my ability to search for data when it comes to cute girls."
"Last month, in front of Haruki's apartment."
"We passed by that girl at the entrance when we were about to head inside the apartment, remember? …You said you might've met her before."
"I didn't realize it then… but that girl was probably planning on staying the night over at Haruki's that day. But because we barged in by force…"
"…So she had no choice but to go home?"
"I did say that there was a travel set inside the bathroom, right?"
"Right!? It must be her, Takeya! Just who in the world is she?"
"Wait, hold on… I can only remember that I've seen her somewhere before."
"When and where did you try to flirt with her? Try to remember! This is really important!"
"B-But you know, Io, can you count the slices of bread you've eaten in your life…?"
"…Sorry, I'll try to remember. Give me some more time."
"After eating the parfait, it feels like the chill is coming out from inside my body～"
"I see you're still unable to resist acting that way."
"No, you gave me courage. Not just you, but Io and Takeya-kun too. I'm blessed to be surrounded by good friends."
"Come on, don't be deceived before the act even begins."
"I think… I'll try to hang on a little longer."
"Then you should have accepted him from the start. If you had forgiven him for everything, including his attachment and lies…"
"I told you before, didn't I? I'm quite selfish."
"That's why I've also come to hate lies. Even if it's a lie from someone I really love."
"Well then, I'm going this way. Thanks a lot for today, Shouko-san."
"Umm… umm… don't worry! I'm sure that come spring, everything will return to the way they were."
"Ah, um… I don't have any proof, it's just a hunch."
"So, um… so… what was I going to say?"
"So in three months huh… For someone like me who waited for three years already, it'll be like the blink of an eye."
"What a complex character… Am I really able to recreate someone like her?"
"But if I don't perfect this, I won't be able to complete my work."
In the lab on the first evening after the winter break, the sound of the incoming text that I've been waiting for finally comes.
However, inside the incoming text folder that I hurriedly opened is a text from an unexpected sender…
The name that has been buried deep inside my text inbox until just two weeks ago is once again displayed on the screen.
"Well, I guess ten days have already passed since the new year. Sorry for the late New Year's greeting."
"…Though I wonder if I should be apologizing for attempting to check up on you so casually like this."
"If you see this text and find it ridiculous, then please just block my number. I'm well aware of how much I've wronged you, at least."
"But I somehow always end up thinking about you, so after hesitating a lot about it, I decided to text you. …How have you been?"

From the odd fact that she had free time, the fact that she's being more polite than usual, along with the formality of her text's title, I could tell that she was feeling the same sense of distance that I am.
After we parted the way we did, it must've taken an extreme amount of courage for her to contact me of her own accord.
Though I suppose Setsuna understands that as well.
…She knows that after we parted the way we did, neither of us would have had the strength to initiate contact of our own accord.
It's because I fear the feeling I got during our parting, so it felt like I couldn't move forward.
"Thank you for your text. I'm not angry with you at all, and there's no reason for me to be. I guess I can only be mad about not being able to contact you myself."
Waiting for others to make the move first is too cowardly. Despite that otherwise understandable saying, I'm a terrible man who couldn't have done any better.
"I've been going to university since yesterday. There's a lecture of which the paper submission date is fast approaching, after all."
"As for how I'm faring… while I can't say that I've completely gotten over it, I've been living my day-to-day life properly."
"I've been going to my part-time jobs, studying for tests, and just living the ordinary university student life. It's not like I can advance in my life and studies if I don't continue on."
"Enough about me, though, how are things with you, Setsuna?"
"You've only been worrying about me in your text and didn't write anything about yourself. It's actually making me quite worried about you."
"I'm glad that you've contacted me, but you should also write a few lines on what's happening in your life, you know?"
In the end, I forcibly leave my usual words of sermon before my thumb reaches for the send button…
Even as I wrote that text, the door to the lab showed no sign of opening.
There wasn't anyone to come in lazily as if it's only natural to show up late at night and say "Huh～ Haruki? What are you doing?".
Making sure the windows are locked and turning off the lights… I close the door to the lab.
"I'm living a pretty normal life right now."
"I wake up in the morning, eat breakfast, go to university, chat with friends, and study. Days without a change."
"…For a while, I cried until all my tears dried up, but now that's no longer the case."
"Humans are pretty amazing that way, don't you think?"
As I read Setsuna's second text, my legs suddenly break out into a run down the darkened hallway.
The only one that's amazing is you, Setsuna. Just how mentally strong are you?
Do you know just how horrible a thing I did to you only so I can be my current self?
Do you know just how much I betrayed not only you, but also everyone who's worried about me?
I exit the school building as if running away.
There's no one around on the moonlit campus. Only the freezing air to rapidly chill down my burning body.
After stopping for a moment and gathering my breath, I leave the area as if running away.
Besides, I won't be able to meet with that person anymore today.
Not after I've seen this text. Not after I've sent a reply.
If that person were to see me now, she would once again read my expression and would probably try to comfort me excessively.
I can't deny that I've been wishing for that up until a short while ago.
But with the way I am now, there's no way I can accept that warm form of healing.
"It's already been two weeks since the end of winter break, you know? You haven't shown yourself at the seminars even once."
"In fact, you haven't shown up to any of the lectures. There's no point in trying to deceive me. I've checked all of the lecture halls."
"And that's not all, you do realize that final exams begin in two weeks, right? Do you even plan to advance to the next year?"
"If you end up having to repeat the year, you'll probably be kicked out of the seminars too. Are you okay with that?"
Are you even okay with… not being with me?
"Anyway, get back to me as soon as possible. If you're in a situation where you can't even make a call or send a text, please let me know about that too."
"Come on, Senpai! Just how long do you need to get changed? The morning meeting is already over!"
"…Did you just open the door without hesitation knowing full well the possibility that I might be in the middle of changing?"

"No, what I'm trying to say is…"

"Come on, there are only ten minutes left until we open, you know? We're short on hands out in the hall today. Please be ready to help out."
"…Well then, let's work hard today as well, Senpai."
I believe that Satou said she would only come to help if things get too hectic…

But the fact that she has earned the right to speak even over the acting manager within just one month of working here… Isn't she setting a new record for this restaurant, surpassing even my three-month record?
"Welcome. Table for two? Will you be smoking today?"
"A Japanese cheese Hamburg steak set, a clubhouse sandwich, and a melon parfait after the meal."
After dealing with the first wave of customers after opening hours, we weren't as busy.
Do they really lack manpower in the hall? They have three people even without me…
"Will this be all for your order? …Please wait and your order will arrive shortly."
In only one short month, she's already acting like one of the core employees. She's totally being treated like the successive floor manager.
She's originally supposed to be here as a short-term part-timer to earn money for her graduation trip, but will the restaurant really be able to let her go that easily…?
Just as I was lost in thought, the very person I was thinking about comes into view, already right in front of my very eyes before I even realized it.
She's rather short… The difference in our height is quite big.
Though the last time I pointed that out, she stomped on my foot with her heel and tried to pass herself off as being five centimeters taller.

In the three days that we've met within that one week, I've been asked the same question over and over again, such that I can't really boorishly ask her "What do you mean?" anymore.
"Just how long are you going to keep on dragging this out? Agh, jeez, it's really frustrating."
But to the meddling… single-minded Sugiura, I have yet to give an answer that she would be satisfied with.
"How can you say that…? After we went through all that trouble to set things up for you, and you just wasted it…"
"We? Set up? What are you talking about?"
"…Even though you must have heard it all from Iizuka-senpai already."
I've only heard the gist of it from Takeya… so you were the one plotting things behind the scenes.
"Hey, we got customers. Go and greet them with a smile."
"Jeez～ you're always pushing work on me when you're in a bad situation. Just you wait, I'll be sure to drag the details out of you next time.
…Welcome～! How many seats will you require?"
Despite the fact that I've managed to send her away smoothly, I still feel very bad about being unable to repay her for her involvement in all this.
However, before I could come to the conclusion that Sugiura's expecting from me, there's another issue that I absolutely must take care of.
It's been two weeks since winter break. Until now, Chiaki still hasn't shown up at the seminars even once.
I simply waited in the lab for the first week.
I wanted to know the first thing she'd say to me after seeing my face.
But I totally couldn't figure out the first thing I'd say to her if I went and sought her out.
And that's why I didn't search for her myself.
My patience reached its limit after only a week.
I began trying to contact her by phone and text, thinking that even if I were to go meet her now, I could mask it all behind a scolding along with abusive words.
Still, she showed no response, and another week passed…
Those ten days together, just what did they mean to you?
Are you honestly just a "friend" who's fickle?
"The number you're calling is switched off or out of our service area."
Are you a woman who would give her everything to help comfort an idiot of a friend in need and not think about the consequences? Are you a woman who is irresponsible and lacks self-awareness?
Is the guy an idiot for falling too deep in your "love"?

"Hey! Kitahara! If you have time to be dejected over your girlfriend ignoring your calls, then hurry up and go retrieve the manuscripts!"

Please let me see you. Please tell me what's in your heart.

…As I lost myself in thought, Mari-san was already staring at me with her long, sharp gaze before I realized it.
"You do seem as if you're not forcing yourself… but it feels as if you're currently in dire straits."
The time is the usual 2:00 AM, after the last train has already left.
The journey toward the taxi stand in front of the station from the editing department felt so cold that it seemed to freeze the surrounding hustle and bustle.
"Speaking of which, I apologize for what happened during New Year's. You went out of your way to call me from abroad, but I was out at the time."
"No, that's fine… It's just me worrying too much."

"Could it be, you didn't come to work during winter break because…"

"…If only I didn't go on that business trip."

I'm afraid of being alone, yet I couldn't communicate with others. Were it not for the fact that she accepted me, I would've been crushed by my anxiety.

"…Ah, excuse me. I think I got a little depressed again."
"…Are you having fun making me go back and forth?"

I couldn't contact Chiaki today either.
I don't know what the future has in store for me, whether it be one where I manage to meet her again or one where a new me unhindered by her absence is born…
Perhaps I'm at the point where I have to think about such possibilities.
Then… when the time comes, where would I place Setsuna in my heart?
"You have two new messages. First message, January 22nd, 11:37 AM."
"Ah～ are you from the KY Development company? About the house located in Yurine-gaoka Sanchome, the one listed on the magazine. Could you please give me more detailed information about it?"
As for Setsuna, she'll send me two to three texts a day, and the texts she sends don't feel like we're very distant, but they don't suggest that we're very close either.
The content of her texts is also unchanged, never talking about how estranged or intimate we are and using polite language inconsistently.
That's why it can relay the message of how unstable Setsuna is feeling right now.
"…That's about it. Please give me a call back."
…I must resolve this as soon as I can.
If I let this drag out again, the same thing will happen again as three years ago.
To expect anyone, much less myself, to forgive me after binding such a wonderful girl to me for so many years is…
To expect to be forgiven is…
Enough, I'm too tired to be thinking about this.
Since I'm not planning on going out tomorrow, I might as well just sleep without taking a shower.
Wrapping myself with the blanket that once had Chiaki's scent…
"Haruki? Hey, it's me. You said you have work today, so I left a message here."
"Please, do as I say immediately. …Please give me a call afterward, no matter what time it is."
Before my consciousness fades away, at that final moment, I can hear the voice of my best friend.
"Listen, okay? You have the DVD for the high school festival at your place, right? The one that has the entire day's stage performances?"
"Go watch that right now. Ah, not the one about us. …Start from the beginning, the very first segment."

"I was careless… Last month, when I saw her walking down from your apartment, I should've already realized…"
"If I realized it back then, things wouldn't have turned out like this. I might've even been able to protect you."

"We could have spared Setsuna from even more pain than what she's dealing with right now…"
I'm the one who's caused Setsuna all her pain. No one else is involved in it.
"Just do as I say. The stage on that day, watch carefully, listen carefully… and realize it yourself."
What exactly do you want me to realize?
On that last day, when the three of us could truly be together…
"Senou… no, you need to be careful around Izumi Chiaki."
"She's not as simple a person as you might've thought."
"…Well, it might be too late already."
I'm sorry Takeya, I don't want to do anything for anyone right now.
I couldn't open my eyes again once I shut them. After working multiple part-time jobs at once after so long, it leaves my mind and body feeling very exhausted.
I'm sorry, Takeya. I'll do what you asked me to do after I wake up tomorrow.
So please… spare me for today.
What does she have to do with the high school festival three years ago?
"The first performance, The Demon of Mt. Uzuki, is a drama presented by the Theater Club. Original story by Sawakura Misaki. Directed by Fukushima Kouji. Scripted by and starring Senou Chiaki."
"This is the Theater Club's introductory comment."
"This work is a combination of a northern local folktale, the rebirth of someone from a different world, and a modern science fiction love story."
"Please enjoy this grand tale told across four chapters featuring four beautiful sisters as the main characters of each individual chapter."

"Well then, we will now welcome the Theater Club to the stage."
Three years ago, the first performance on stage during the Houjou High School Festival was the stage play by our well-renowned Theater Club, which regularly participated in national competitions.
When the stage play started, we were in the music room we used as a waiting room changing our clothes, and I was astonished by Setsuna and Kazusa's beautiful figures.
That's why this recording will be my first time watching the performances that were staged that morning.
"Good morning. Today's weather is quite nice."
The stage is decorated in a way that resembles a Japanese-style room of an old-fashioned household.
There was a long-haired lady sitting next to the futon, speaking to someone who appeared to be asleep there.
But there wasn't an actor under the blanket, the girl kept talking to herself as the story progressed.
"Are you having a bad dream? What kind of dream was it? Would you mind telling me about it?"
Ahh… Well, I finally understand it. This is a one-man show.
Her acting and lines alone convince the audience that the boy in front of her is her younger cousin, whom she had spoiled as if he were her younger brother ever since they were kids.
This is something that even an amateur at stage play like myself can easily understand and enjoy watching.
"Hey, Azusa. Koichi-san seems like he's not getting enough sleep. So please let him sleep a little longer…"
And then, as the number of character appearances increase, it doesn't change the fact that the story is still easy to understand.
The boyish second daughter with a sharp tongue, the third daughter who's very quiet and doesn't show any emotion, and the fourth daughter who is kind-hearted and loved by everyone else.
Even though the sisters never appeared on stage, her acting made it very easy to imagine those characters as if they were there.
I'm sure the spectacle that everyone in the audience is imagining is four sisters and the cousin sitting around the dining table.
Compared to the average Theater Club member, this person's acting is clearly on a completely different level.
The performance is so amazing that I can understand why our high school Theater Club is of a national-worthy class from the first three minutes alone.
Telling me to watch this now, what exactly is Takeya trying to tell me?
Could it be that a certain member that appears later in the play has something to do with what he wanted to show me?
After that, the first part of the story began with a protagonist named Chizuru, and her performance captured the heart of its intended audience even through the video camera.
The uncle's death, the police who are desperate to find the truth.
The events that happened in their town, an indiscriminate murder. As well as those who got involved in it.

The girl prepares to finally confess the warm feelings she has toward the young man who was her cousin…
And with it, she unleashes the power of the demonic bloodline slumbering within her, awakening her murderous impulses and having her bloodlust laid bare to the one she loves.
…I'm starting to get goosebumps. And this is supposed to be a stage play from three years ago.
The curtain fell for the first act.
The play has already won the cheers of the entire audience in merely fifteen minutes; and this is supposed to be a one-man-show.
It's only natural; even I, who doesn't have any interest in stage play overall, got so excited that I started sweating.
Quite frankly, I'd say this performance is so exceptionally perfect that what the three of us did on the same day and on the same stage is embarrassing in comparison.
I still haven't solved the mystery yet.
What Takeya tried to tell me wasn't in that fifteen minutes of content.
The main character changed for the second act, and a brazen girl in words and mannerisms wearing a shortcut sailor uniform appeared on the stage.
"Hmm, aren't you fancy? I used my precious time before going to school to make this meal for you."
In other words, she's the second daughter among the four sisters, who had played a supporting role in the first act.

It's a case about how the main heroine's underclassman disappears mysteriously.
This is a suspense story describing how the younger cousin had a quarrel with someone, and through his dreams, arrived at the culprit's whereabouts.
This is by no means inferior to the first act, and I'm sure the audience from three years ago were sweating from excitement, just like I am now.
Is it because I've been paying too much attention to the screen?

The mature eldest daughter and the serious second daughter. Their tone, their talking speed, as well as their movements are completely different.
But if you pay closer attention, you can still see that the quality of her voice, her body's build, and her height are the same.
There's the question of whether there could be more than one actress of such skill in a mere high school club.
Naturally, it's because of her acting, but this time, it's also because I can feel a chill run through me.
After that, the curtain fell on the second act.
The cheers were even louder than the previous time.
Amidst that resounding applause, the voices of those who came to the same conclusion as I did may have been mixed in as well.
And my doubt continues to grow deeper…
At this rate, that suspicion is no longer just a suspicion.

"I took quite a detailed look at it once before entering university. I should be able to manage if I just copy the stuff I had from back then."
This story is created based on folktales originating from the northern area.

"I'm happy as long as I can be with you, onii-chan. To tell you the truth, I don't even mind if I have to stay at home all the time."

"I really like sparklers. I want this feeling to remain forever…"

In the first segment of that DVD, during the credits section of that amazing play that took place three years ago.

As expected, I still don't know what he's trying to say. What exactly am I supposed to do…?
That mysterious door suddenly slammed open from the inside.
"I'm not doing this, I won't do this anymore! Just look for some substitute on your own!"
It was a young man who forced the door of the hall open, his angry words equally forceful.
"Wait, wait, wait a moment. Please calm down for a bit, okay?"
"How can I be calm about this! She didn't have to go that far with saying all that, now, did she!? Is that how you're supposed to treat your colleagues?"
"Like I said, calm down… Didn't you know full well about how the princess never compromises on anything?"
"You're to blame for this too, President! That woman's become so brazen because of you…"
"…That couldn't be helped. The princess is the reason why the Watos Troupe exists."
"If only you could pull yourself together a bit more…"
"What can I accomplish on my own? …While I'm at it, who else apart from her has the ability to accomplish anything?"
"…You may go home for today. I'll contact you again tonight."
That mess I just witnessed ended slightly more than ten seconds after it started.
"…Goodness me. Did you guys see that embarrassing scene? …Are you guys trying to join the team?"
"Ah, no, we're just here to observe a little… What was that, though?"
"Nothing much, just some quarrel between club members. Well, that just means everyone's serious about it. …Don't worry about it, it's very common."
But I didn't pay much attention to the man who just left, nor did I listen to Takeya's conversation.
"If you're here to observe… you're here to see her, huh? Senouchi Akira, I mean."
"Oh? You're not? I was pretty sure you were here to see our best actress."
"Well, whatever, we welcome everyone here. We're just practicing reading the script for today, it's probably not that interesting. Want to come in and have a look?"
"Ah, it's okay… we're fine here. Don't worry about it."
It's just that, through the shadow of that opened door, I focused all five of my senses, trying to perceive what's inside the hall.
"Alright, let's continue then. …Who's going to take Yoshida's place? Want me to do it?"
"No need. That level of acting might as well not exist."

I could easily recognize that the voice that came out from the hall belonged to her from how sharp it was in terms of vocal quality and what she was saying, even without having to concentrate to do so.
"Please don't be so harsh when he's still trying to memorize his lines…"
"No, that person doesn't understand 'him' at all. He didn't use any emotion. …I might as well solo this play as well."
Instead of the voice that's always been by my side, it feels more like the voice from the DVD that recorded the play from three years ago.
"'He' is actually an inherently sensitive person. But you could never tell that from his usual behavior. He'll only let it slip when he takes a moment to catch his breath."
The person who stood on the center of the stage, her presence alone is enough to apply pressure to every other member…
It's the person who's always sleepy, always looking at me with a listless smile, and also the person who gently accepted me…
"So it's these complicated personality traits again… Can't we make it a bit simpler?"
"If we do that, then it won't be 'him' anymore. This entire script would then be meaningless."
"That person won't do. That's not like 'him' at all. The real 'him' is much cuter than that!"
"Ah～ that 'him' the princess is talking about can be dealt with later. So let's just think about what to do for now."
"Like I said, let's just practice my part."
"Guess we can't help it. We'll discuss the issue of the protagonist with everyone tomorrow. Alright～ let's continue."
I couldn't understand it at all. No matter how hard I think about it, I can't come to a conclusion.
"Well then, let's start from the beginning of page fourteen."
The inescapable maze of thoughts forming in my head are gradually driving my heart further into a corner.
I can hear a singing voice that threatens to crush my heart from the auditorium.
The girl who's singing a cappella.
She finally hears the noise, turns around, and starts asking questions of the person standing there.
"I see, so you are the ones playing… White Album."
"It might be an old song… but I really like it. …Don't you think so as well?"
"Nice to meet you, Guitar-san. I am…"
That's not the first time we met each other. She already knew me back then.
That's why she didn't call me Guitar-san, she called me Mr. Executive Committee Member's helper back then.
This is without a doubt an old, irreplaceable scar of mine.
…I told her about this when I was sleeping with her, it's the meeting between Setsuna and me.
"Well, I'll return the key. You can go home first."
"Make sure you return it, okay? Don't be like last year and practice on your own until morning again, okay?"
"It'll be fine. The script is not finished yet. I'll sleep properly back in the club room."
"Don't say it like that… We'll run out of male members at this rate."
"Isn't that because you're terrible at picking people, President? Why don't you find someone more useful?"
"…I'll work on that. In any case, please give him another chance."
"That's so annoying… Well, we'll talk about that tomorrow. Good work."
The moment she noticed me at such an unexpected hour and such an unexpected place, Chiaki was momentarily at a loss for words, standing there with a plain expression.
Izumi Chiaki appeared before me again, this time looking like someone I've never seen before.
At an unexpected hour and unexpected place, hearing my voice, Chiaki's body trembled for a moment.
Among the expressions that I've seen from her up until now, just exactly how much do they amount to in the total percentage of expressions she can make?
Blood slightly returned to Chiaki's face that looked pale just a moment ago.
The expressionless face Chiaki had started to show both happy and sad emotions at the same time.
That was the moment where the stage actress that I was unfamiliar with became the Izumi Chiaki that I know.
Chiaki closed the few meters of distance between us and flew straight to my chest in an instant.
The softness of her body and the smell of her sweat, both of which I'm all too familiar with, stimulates me almost immediately.
"Even though I decided for us not to see each other for a while… I thought that it would be best for both of us."
Breaths spout out with her earnest, coquettish voice.
It was extremely easy for me to immediately think how this is undoubtedly Chiaki, despite the fact that she's different from what I'm used to.
…If it wasn't for what I've seen in the last hour, this should still be "the usual Chiaki."
"See, what I had in mind was that you'd be able to return to your normal self with a little more time, Haruki, and after that we'd pick up from where we left off."
"Are you just showing me pity? Or are you simply toying with me?"
"Why did you go out of your way to find me? Why did you chase after me?"
That's what I planned to say to her, but she completely sealed everything I wanted to say.
"I-I… If you're like this, I won't be able to stop myself any longer… That's not how I'm supposed to be."
The way she's seeing right through me is very painful.
If you just hit me with words like this… If you just let out how you feel, saying you couldn't hold your feelings in any longer like this…
Don't tell me that what I just saw was simply an illusion, that it was actually you putting on a one-man-show again…
Just like that, the faint ray of hope instantly disappeared the moment Chiaki lightly clicked her tongue.
"Well, it's Izumi now, right? You should show up to some of your class reunions. We do happen to be close by, after all."
I could feel no warmth from the words of the person whose breaths are permeating across my chest.
"Didn't we see each other one time last year? In front of Haruki's apartment, I mean."
"I thought you didn't notice it～ I thought you forgot my appearance a long time ago."
"Unfortunately, I can never forget the appearance of a beauty for the rest of my life."
"…Well, much obliged. That's quite the pointless ability you have there, though."
Chiaki's face is still buried in my chest.
From such a spectacle, a bystander would assume that she's a spoiled girlfriend who's throwing a tantrum on the brink of tears after a long-awaited reunion with her lover.
"This person… Senou Chiaki is… an alien that's beyond the comprehension of humans like us."
I'm suddenly incapable of understanding the woman in my arms whom I'm supposed to understand very well whatsoever, as if I've immediately accepted Takeya's words.
"Don't ever believe anything she says, Haruki! It's all just an act from beginning to end! …And she's a genius at that."
"You've been running your mouth off for a while now, but I want you to correct something."
"I'm Senouchi Akira here. Not Senou Chiaki or Izumi Chiaki. Got it?"
Chiaki invited me into the auditorium. It's a dark place with a single light to brighten things up.
A single spotlight focused on the stage.
The footsteps on the wooden stage resound across the space where no one else is present other than us.
Then she stopped and stood there, at the one spot the spotlight focused on, at the center of the stage.
"Seems like you've finally seen it. My true self… I've prayed many times that you would never discover this."
"…Yuutsuru. It won first place in a competition when I was still in middle school."
The one staring down at me is no longer the Izumi Chiaki I know.
"Nice to meet you, Kitahara Haruki-kun. I'm Senouchi Akira from the Watos Troupe. …Or you could say, the actress who played Izumi Chiaki, I guess?"
The crane that was saved that day took the form of a human girl.
"It's cold, isn't it? There's no air conditioner, so it's boiling hot during summer and freezing cold during winter."
Chiaki said that while her breath was visible in the cold.
"The venue is rather small, so it can't really fit that many people, and it means that regular performances have guests lining up to the exterior."
Although this place isn't that big, the cold air in here still pierces through my skin.
"Even so, I still like this place a lot. Because this is my home turf."
In the freezing air, Chiaki's smiling.
"Speaking of which, my home turf during high school was the stage in the gym."
Without a doubt, she knows how I feel right now, and she's still showing the usual smile she always had with me.
"Along with you, Haruki, and Ogiso-san, and Touma-san… it's the same place where you guys share your memory."
"You were very cute, you know that, Haruki? When you played the guitar back then."
This woman… she knew everything about us.
"I was prepared to just disappear and fade away for good. If that happened, it'd be good for both you and me… Ogiso-san would also achieve happiness."
The things I said. The things I didn't say… The things I… couldn't say.
"But Iizuka-kun did something unnecessary… Well, Mizusawa-san was probably the one behind it, actually."
"Maybe I should correct the 'nice to meet you' bit… Long time no see, Kitahara-kun. Do you remember me? Senou Chiaki from Class G. …Well, you probably don't, right?"
It's like she was nonchalantly greeting me at an alumni reunion…
Izumi Chiaki… Senou Chiaki… Senouchi Akira… she's wearing a sweet smile devoid of any malicious intent on her face.
Chiaki's attempting to encourage me under the persona of Izumi Chiaki as I collapse to my knees on the stage.
"I can't question the fact that I'm at fault for deceiving you, but you also have yourself to blame for not realizing it as well, you know?"
In this situation so treacherous it's sending chills up my spine, Chiaki's words, demeanor and breaths envelop me in warmth as usual.
"After all, Haruki, you and I pretty much never had any sort of connection back in high school."
Is it because of her great acting that I felt so taken by her I couldn't help myself? Or is it because of another reason…

"You commute by train, Haruki, while I commute by bike. You take work at school seriously, while I skip classes all the time. You do your best at studying, while I do my best at after-school activities."
Even so, we've been in the same school for three years. We definitely should have run into each other somewhere.

"The class representative who always scored in the top ten, and the underperforming student who always scored in the bottom ten. The president of the Go-Home club and substitute member of the Light Music Club, and the one-man army of a president of the Theater Club."
My only impression of her was that Senou-san's grades are almost as bad as Touma's.
"Be it our hobbies or grades, they're all completely different… That's why there was no way we would have met each other."
Is it because I was too dull to realize it, or is it because Chiaki is too good at hiding it…
"If that's the case, why do you have to hide it…?"
She doesn't think she's done anything wrong. She's not apologizing either.
She's not even averting her gaze from me.
"It's because Haruki, you… changed over to the Literature Department. You came back to my side…"
"And so the plan that I concocted three years ago, yet one I never got to accomplish, started progressing."
"So you changed your department? What? So would that make you a first-year here?"
"I see… Hey, if that's the case, we've gotta throw a welcome party! Don't worry about it. We're fellow classmates starting today, right?"
"…So come on, go on and buy us some beer, would you, new guy?"
During the first class of my specialized course's lecture, she sat next to me…
Back then, Chiaki already knew about me.
And she knew me so well that she treated me with the familiarity she would have with a character she included in the plot of a drama she wrote herself.
That's why Chiaki's been treating me as a character in her play since then.
"Haruki… Ever since three years ago, I've been a huge fan of yours, of the unit consisting of Ogiso Setsuna, Touma Kazusa, and you…"
"Compared to your stage play… our performance was…"
It was amateurish and extremely rushed…
The karaoke master, the genius pianist, and the amateur guitarist who was only good at studying, our personalities didn't match at all either.
"But the result was amazing. It was much more popular than our plays."
"That's what everyone said… it's all because they had Ogiso Setsuna as the singer…"
"But after it was over, some people started saying that Touma Kazusa's performance was really amazing."
I think that's true as well.
That stage could be taken by just having Setsuna and Kazusa's performance, that alone was more than enough to mesmerize the entire audience.
My presence had no impact at all…
"But it's not only that. There was also a certain something in that performance."
But Chiaki denied something that even I, who was part of that stage, thought was the truth.
"When I heard the song you guys created, I felt a certain sadness in it, as if there was something that I couldn't forget or simply let go…"
"It's natural that you'd feel sad because our performance came directly after yours ended, right..?"
"That's not it. I'm very confident in controlling my emotions. …Haruki, didn't you already experience it?"
While we were talking, while we were kissing, while we were holding each other, while we were living together…
She would always freely control her emotions and act in ways that tended to my own emotions with perfection.
I was completely unaware of that.
"That's why I focused everything I had on observing every detail on the stage. From finger movements, to eye expression, as well as your 'performance.'"
"It was quite interesting when I realized it…"
"Well, the three of you just ignored the audience and were just flirting with each other up there."
"Ogiso-san and Touma-san were both trying their very best to get your attention. Both of them were competing with each other to perform for your sake."
"The love-triangle relationship you guys were having could easily be seen during that performance, you know?"
"That's a lie… That… How could that…"
"Can you really say that it's a lie? From that day until the day of graduation, what happened between the three of you, I wonder?"
"After three years, I finally figured out the truth. That atmosphere was created by you, Haruki."
Why did I say it…? Why did I tell someone so easily…?

"Despite the fact that your performance was rather awkward, it was as fascinating as it was because the three of you came together… As well as the fact that you've managed to make both of them feel attracted to you."
I've already sworn not to think about what happened on that day ever again.
"And so, my interest toward you spiked. You three became very interesting 'material' to me."
"The title was already set… Obviously, it'd be Todokanai Koi."
"Sung by Ogiso Setsuna… Yet it's a song that's written based on Haruki's feelings toward Touma Kazusa."
"You may not notice it, Haruki, but you're quite cruel sometimes, you know. What kind of emotions do you think Ogiso-san felt when she sang this song?"
To what extent…? Just how much…?
Just how deeply did the actress Senouchi Akira infiltrate my heart under the name of Izumi Chiaki?
"It isn't exactly flashy with some big event happening, a completely simple psychological tale. I imagine the guests won't exactly give the most favorable reception…"
She used her own body in exchange for the setting of this story, to find more details in order to make this story more complete.
"But I want to reenact it again no matter what. I'm a crazy fan of that day, you know?"
"Is that why… you got close to me? For something so silly… you slept with me?"
"It's not 'silly' at all to me… In my opinion, it's the exact opposite."
"Just like how you think sleeping with a woman is not 'silly,' Haruki."
In other words, in Chiaki's eyes, sleeping with me was just something silly…
She can let out the fact that I didn't think it was silly at all with a composed expression on her face.
"The way I am now, I can reenact the role of both Ogiso Setsuna and Touma Kazusa. …It's all thanks to you, Haruki."
"You told me the true story behind you three. You taught me how to act like the two heroines. …And you've even taught me what it means to be a 'woman.'"
"You're the best director there is. Going through all that for you was definitely not a waste."
"After all… winning you over was definitely not easy, you know?"
"In terms of being a 'cute girl,' I couldn't beat Ogiso Setsuna. In terms of being a 'cool woman,' I couldn't beat Touma Kazusa."
"And when I started to wonder what it was that I needed to do, my answer was to become that 'Chiaki-chan.'"
"If you were running from the woman that was Ogiso Setsuna, Haruki, you probably needed 'a woman who doesn't behave like a woman' in order to feel safe."
"I couldn't show it normally, but I had to become feminine and accept you when you needed it. …It was quite a difficult role to play… How did I do?"
I can't say anything. I can only let out a dry laugh.
No, I couldn't even laugh properly; even this laughing sound was something I forced out of my throat so that the person right next to me could barely hear it.
"The secret to not letting others know that I'm acting… is to add a very small amount of my actual feelings into it."
She's someone from my seminars who's at times more than a friend, but not quite a girlfriend. Other times, she's a mysterious close friend who does things mindlessly.
Other times, she takes the role of a lover who'll gently accept everything about me.
"Much like you, Haruki, my parents were divorced and I was taken in by my mother's side… It was nice for the two of us to have something in common, as negative as it is."
Just like the time she researched the northern folktales, she approached men because she was studying themーshe's an actress to the core.
"Since there's an undeniable truth there, Haruki, you would never be able to see through that lie."
I did think about the possibility of being tricked.
But given the way she worried about me, I'm sure she did take my feelings into consideration.
But who could have ever imagined that… all this was merely an act? To think that I'm nothing more than a subject for her research…
"My acting… was perfect, was it not? You were really into it all, weren't you, Haruki?"
There was a loud noise. And I've done something unthinkable.
I slammed Chiaki, who had been kneeling in front of me and examining my expression, onto the floor of the stage with all my strength.
I'm on top of Chiaki, sealing her movement and her mouth.
This is not something a man should be doing. But my body and my heart acted beyond my control.
"Are you planning on violating me here out of revenge? …I'm a little sweaty, though, so you might have to bear with it for now, okay?"
Even though her head and back were slammed onto the floor… Chiaki's expression remained calm, she easily accepted the fact that she's being pinned down.
Even though I've pinned her down in my anger, Chiaki remains unafraid, and instead looks me right in the eye with her usual, faint smile on her face.
"But I'd like to ask a favor…"
She may look like Izumi Chiaki, but this person is definitely not Izumi Chiaki.
"I saw this in an older film… there's a line that reads 'please don't hit my face because I'm an actress.'"
While on stage, she'll be unperturbed no matter what accident occurs.
"That film didn't exactly leave a deep impression on me, but somehow I sympathized with what that actress said."
Whether it be feeling pain, having trouble breathing, or having a concussion… she blocks off everything from reality and just focuses on her acting.
"So… what I'm trying to say is…"
"I know there's not much I can do if I end up not being able to give birth, but at least make sure not to hurt my face, okay?"
This demon of an actor… Senouchi Akira.
"Ah, ah, ah… uu, uaa… Chiaki, uaa…"
"Aa-ah, that's why I said it's better for you not to know."
But for someone like me who's not an actor nor part of the Troupe, all of this might just be "something silly."
My tears fell onto Chiaki's face.
"Your crying face… no matter how many times I see it, it's just adorable. I want to use my body to soothe you from the bottom of my heart."
Even though I know that those are my tears, I don't want to admit it.
"Why…? Why… would you do this to me…?"
"Yeah, I really love you, Haruki. So please don't cry anymore… No, please allow me to see you cry a little longer."
"Ahh… I'm loving this. Your accursed words made my feelings toward you even clearer."
"Don't… mess with me! Just how long do you intend to keep toying with me…!?"
"No, I'm serious. I really do love you, Haruki. There's no one else who loves you as much as I do in this world, you know?"
"Your tears are delicious… Mm, nn… chuu, ahhhn…"
Right now, the one person I've been clinging onto after abandoning everything is embracing me and planting a rain of kisses on my face.
But this is all merely an act…
An utterly enthusiastic performance from a monster of an actress who's more serious than anyone else when she's on stage but forgets everything and anything the moment she leaves it.
It's useless… I won't be able to sleep at this rate.
No matter how hard I try to close my eyes, and no matter how much I try to not think about anything, I can't do anything about how wide awake I am.
The bedside clock shows that it's 8 o'clock. It's 8 o'clock two days after that day, though.
30 consecutive hours of sleep have washed away all of my tiredness from head to toe.
I shift my gaze to the side, fed up with the view of the well-lit ceiling above me.
Even though I'm aware that a certain person who makes silly noises and lazily tosses and turns on the bed as she's half-asleep isn't here anymore.
And even though I'm aware that the moment I confirm the truth of her absence, my heart will become as cold and heavy as lead.
I'm even afraid of checking whether or not I'm crying. This is all I've been doing throughout the winter this year.
I first tried to get out of this state through effort.
I tried to focus my heart and soul on a single task in order to gain the strength I had when I was still my old, healthy self.
Then, I tried to snap out of it without effort.
I simply soaked myself in the fragrant hot water as I melted from its warmth, allowing my cold heart to slowly melt along with it.
And as for the third time…
I can't see what lies at the end of my efforts. The moment I stop trying, I freeze up in the blink of an eye.
It's just… I cannot erase all that I've done to Setsuna.
I've divulged the history I share with Setsuna to another woman. I'm afraid it's inevitable that she'll know about it soon.
Be it from my friends' mouths or my own. …Or perhaps a certain rumor from the theater.
The way I am now, the more I struggle, the more I continue to betray Setsuna, and even if I run away, I'll only end up inevitably hurting her.
That's why I've returned to the state I was in the day before yesterday, back when I was unable to bring myself to read Setsuna's text before I fell asleep.
"Even if you put it that way… the screenplay is done and practice has already started."
"No matter how you think of it, you're using a real person as a model. Don't you think that's a violation of privacy?"
"I've read the script and made the necessary considerations. It doesn't seem to include anything besides the trio's relationship."
"Even so… anyone from high school would be able to tell what this is referencing."
"By all means, if you insist, then please take legal action against this. …Although in that case, the person himself must lodge the complaint personally."
"…You think he can do that the way he is right now? The one that's made him fall into such a state is none other than your club member, you know?"
"…If apologizing will solve the problem, then I'll gladly get on my knees. That's why I'd like you to leave the princess… Senouchi alone."
"You… Why are you defending that woman so much?"

"I was deeply fascinated when I watched The Demon of Mt. Uzuki being performed in high school back when I was in my fourth year. I must admit I was really delighted when I heard she was enrolling at this university."
"Huh? You were in your fourth year at that time…"
"Oh, me? I'm in my seventh year now. I'm going to be expelled if I don't graduate this year."
"…Final exams are coming next week, Senpai."
"I found her during orientation and spent half a year persuading her to join."
"Does Senou mean that much to you?"
"She refused the unofficial offer of an up-and-coming company after an audition. It was a close call."
"I've heard about that too… it's a great company. Why did she reject it?"
"The princess is unsuited for a place that's too famous. …Perhaps it's better to say that she'd immediately have a conflict with the higher ups if she went there. This is the best for her."
"You and Senou… no, are you and Izumi going out?"
"Can you detect even the slightest hint of femininity in that monster?"
"Sure, I genuinely adore her merit as an actress, but I wouldn't want to get close to her as a person."

"She doesn't give a damn about what people say and doesn't budge on her own statements, and she has the last word on everything from the programs to the cast and schedule. She's a demon on stage, but she's a red panda outside of it."
"…Just like back in the old days."
"People are seeing my role as president as more of a name rather than respecting the managerial position that comes with it."
"…Let's go for a drink sometime, Mr. President."
"Thank you for your patience. Here's the Napolitan pasta, mixed pizza, and egg sandwich…"
"Ah, put it all over here. Oh, and hurry up with the banana parfait."
"Yay, the food's here～! Well, time to eat!"
"Mm… nn, am… pardon me for eating, Mizusawa-san."
"…Someone's got a big appetite for this time of the day."
"I've been like that ever since I started practicing. No matter how much I supply myself with energy, I use it all up in the end."
"True enough, in the couple of times I've seen you on stage back in high school, you were really energetic."
"I remember losing ten kilos when I was acting once. I had to eat a lot for three days to fill myself back up."
"…That might be even worse than doing sports. Even I haven't lost that much weight when I had matches."
"I've also watched a lot of matches from the basketball club. The stage is closed off during official matches, so I couldn't get any practice."
"If you want to talk to me about something, do it soon. At this rate, I'm going to finish eating in ten minutes, you know?"
"No need for apologies. At any rate, I presume you're here to start a fight, right?"
"Well, I'll cut to the chase with no reservations now, Izumi Chiaki-san."
"That's a bit formal, isn't it? We've already known each other for six years. …Though we've hardly spoken to each other during that period, I guess."
"This is about Haruki, isn't it? How very thoughtful of you, Mizusawa Io-san."
"Exactly. What exactly do you even think of Haruki…?"
"I love him. I really love him. Why would I have slept with him otherwise?"
"What's wrong? Did you want me to say 'As if I'd like a guy like him,' or something like that?"
"'I only used Haruki for the sake of my own drama.' Did you want me to laugh out loud while saying that?"
"Mm… Ah, excuse me～ I'd like to add on a vegetable omelette, please～"
"That's right. It was the princess who spread Todokanai Koi throughout the university."
"She spread it amongst the broadcasting circle. She hoped that when her play finally became a reality, the whole university would be familiar with that song by then."
"I see… I've always wondered where the sound source got leaked…"
"I heard she got approval from those concerned."
"…Ah, I got the license to use that song, you know! I've already confirmed this with the high school, and they told me that there was no problem using it in Houjou University…"
"The one who gave permission for that was me. …The other three had long since relinquished their rights to it."
"In any case, the princess is wagering everything on the next public performance. After all, she's been carefully planning this for three years now."
"I didn't expect her to be this serious…"
