"But that's still really amazing. After all, that means that your colleagues approve of you, right? That's as good as a job offer!"
"I wouldn't say I've gotten that far yet… though I suppose I do feel that I've made a good start."
However, that's all the more reason why neither of us will be satisfied with the conversation ending with "See you then."
"If I recall correctly, your superior's brilliant. You mentioned that she was the most successful woman among the younger people working there, right?"
"Well, in any case, as long as I'm working under her, I need to make sure not to let her down."
That's why… I engage in momentary idle chatter, riding on our promise that we'd only be talking until I get home.
"…Do you get it now? That basically means they've offered to hire you, right?"
This is a really nonsensical conversation.
We've talked about advancing to the next grade, our exams, about my part-time jobs, and our theses. …And now we're talking about how I'm looking to get officially employed.
"Hehe… I see you're as confident as always at times like these."
"I'm still maintaining my good grades and have ample experience with part-time jobs and social experience, and I've also been attending seminars about business communication."
Setsuna seems just as excited as I was when Mari-san told me about the prospects of my future earlier.
"Don't you think you're counting your chickens before they hatch?"

"What's wrong with getting full of myself? At least, there shouldn't be any issues if you're using it to motivate yourself. …Specifically, in a way that's different from keeping yourself physically driven."
Naturally, my footsteps have slowed, and it's fifteen minutes since I started my usual five-minute walk back to my apartment.
Moreover, I've even gone out of my way to go around a nearby park because I just didn't want our conversation to end so soon.
"Is that so… I already knew it, but you really are amazing, Haruki-kun. I haven't even thought about what I should do after I graduate yet."
"It's not necessarily a good thing to try and decide as soon as possible. I think it's fine if you use the time you have to think about it carefully, Setsuna."
I imagine Setsuna's already realized this. She's realized that I'm breaking my promise and intentionally prolonging our conversation… without sparing any time I have at my disposal.
Even so, she pretends to be completely unaware and does whatever she can to continue this meaningless conversation with me, such that we've been talking for almost 30 minutes.
"I'll lose when I run out of time."
"I'm sure you'll be fine, Setsuna. You'll definitely find your own path after thinking about it properly. …I guarantee it."
Nevertheless, as much as time can flow without ceasing, there are limits as to how many detours I can opt for.
"Congratulations… well, it might be a little early for that. Anyway, do your best, Haruki-kun."
"Sorry for keeping you up this late."
"We made a promise when we first started to talk. We said we'd kill time together until you got home, Haruki-kun."
The other person who I have to talk to no matter what has appeared before me, her expression as fickle as ever.
"Someone seems quite brazen today. And here I thought you'd get flustered the moment I found you out."
"Not really, there's nothing to hide at this point. I can even tell her that you're here, Chiaki."
"Oh… so you two completely made up with each other."
"Aren't you the one who wanted to say something to me?"
"Even though you ignored all the texts I sent you…"
"What do you mean, 'not really'? That's not an answer."
While I'm at it, she also appears to be sulking.
I touch her cheek gently to discover that it's cold… so cold that she couldn't possibly have been waiting here for just a few minutes.
"You must be freezing. Hurry up and come in, then. I'll run a hot bath immediately."
"Oh… so you're not going to tell me to hurry on home."
"Someone seems to be unusually steamed up today."
Chiaki is maintaining the persona of an abandoned cat that she portrayed during our previous meeting.
…Though she's not leaping into my embrace immediately, unlike the last time.
"Come on, let's go. I'm getting cold."
"What if you catch a cold? Don't you have a play soon?"
"That's really not something you should be worrying about right now, Haruki."
"…What in the world is up with you today?"
"How will you take responsibility if I end up with a miscarriage…"
"Get up already! We really should get going."
"What are you trying to do, going out of your way to come over to my place and then refusing to budge after that?"
She really is a fickle person…
"A, E, I, O, U, and sometimes Y～!"
As I thought, she really was feeling so cold that she obediently disappeared into the bathroom the moment I finished running a bath for her.

…She even went as far as to ask me to take her clothes off, and the moment she finally settles into the bath, she goes back to not acting her age again. Well, I suppose it's only typical of Chiaki to be acting like this.
Even so, Chiaki… is definitely acting more selfish than ever today.
She was pouting strangely at first, and she almost seemed like she was ready to pick a fight with me. Perhaps her preparation for her upcoming public performance is taking a toll on her…?
Could it be that she's playing a role that she hasn't shown me before today?
"You didn't even say itadakimasu. You ungrateful girl."
"You should eat more lightly at this hour. Deal with it."
"…You did add quite a bit of oil though."
"Don't eat it if you don't like it."
"Then… does it really taste that bad?"
"It's… not that either. It's just that I haven't eaten in a while. It's fine, I'm fine now."
Chiaki finally slowed the pace of her eating, such that I can hear the faint crunching sound of her chewing her cabbage.
How hungry was she for her to actually eat like that…?
"That's because the play is the day after tomorrow."
"That's all the more reason you should be taking care of your nutrition… also, have you been sleeping properly?"
"Yeah～ I get it, I get it! Sleep here for today. I'll wake you up so you can make it in time for your practice."
"Practice is actually still going on right now, even through the night."
"I imagine everyone is panicking right now. I might even get replaced as the lead actress."
As she said that, her expression didn't change.
The scripter and leading actress of Watos didn't seem like she thought about the worst possible outcome.
"If things are really serious for you right now, why did you even go out of your way to come here?"
"Didn't you say the script completion was delayed? Isn't that exactly why everyone's pulling an all-nighter and trying to make up for lost time?"
"Well, it's always the same during times like this…"
"Then the main character shouldn't be slacking off either… Watos wouldn't exist without you, right? Don't you have a tremendous role to play for the troupe?"
"Well, without me, they're as good as third-rate."
"So someone who's first-rate like yourself has the right to be selfish even after you've caused so much trouble for everyone?"
"For you to worry about things like that, Haruki… You do know what the play is about, right?"
"That has nothing to do with this. It's just that I'm getting impatient watching someone who's not taking responsibility for something she has the ability to do."
"…You're such a difficult person, you know that?"
To think Chiaki of all people thinks I'm difficult to deal with… Well, even I think there is some truth to that…
"I'll go back soon. It should be fine if it's just two hours."
"…Haven't you already wasted those two hours on waiting for me to get back?"
"It's really no big deal. It's just that I… got a little something…"
"A little something? What do you mean?"
"I had a reason in mind, but I brushed it off because it was too cliche. Give me a moment, I'll think this through again!"
She changes her expressions one after another, from being troubled, inspired, surprised, bewildered, irritated to being disgruntled, as if she's practicing her acting skills…
In the end, she said some ambiguous things that have nothing to do with the situation at all.
"What do you mean, 'let's go with this'…?"
After that, she repeats her cycle of unusually jittery behavior again, feeling irritated, bashful, disgusted, in denial, and then inspired yet again…
In the end, she took out an envelope from her bag.
"I haven't given these to you, right? How many do you want? I can probably give you around five or so…"
"…You want me to come watch it?"
She wants me to bear witness to the story in which I betrayed someone important to me and caused everyone to suffer?
She wants me to relive the miserable tale engraved in my memory of how I got involved with Setsuna and Kazusa three years ago?
"A normal troupe would allocate tickets across their members. I'd say about 20 per person. But things are different where I'm from. It was hard to get a hold of these for myself."
"I thought it'd be irresponsible that I didn't come to your place before I went on the big stage."
As I thought, nothing about her has changed…
"The script came out very nicely. At the very least, I think everything related to your character is perfect, Haruki."
She knows full well how others feel, but she's not interested in acting appropriately based on that knowledge.
Even though she excels at moving and mesmerizing audiences with masterfully crafted stories and performances on stage…
"From here on, all that's left is the show. I already memorized all the dialogue while I was writing the script, so there's no problem on my part."
She understands sorrow. And she can understand what it means for others to suffer. But she refuses to think anything beyond "And what of it?" in response.
I'm sure she's not like that merely to others, but herself as well.
"All that's left is to see how well the rest of the group will perform… Well, the audience is there to see me mostly anyway, so that shouldn't be a problem."
She's incapable of connecting with anyone on a deeper level. After all, the role she's playing tends to change in an instant.

She goes from a friend to a lover that's comfortable to be with. But she can become a total stranger the very next moment. An enemy at her leisure. And when you've finally wisened up to it, you'll realize she's a con artist and you're her victim.
"I see, well, that's great. Congratulations on finishing it."
"Please look forward to it. I'm sure you won't be bored by it."
"…Then you won't have to lie to me anymore. The limited period we set until spring will finally come to an end."
"Everything will come to an end after the performance is over… right?"
"Umm… umm… don't worry! I'm sure that come spring, everything will return to the way they were."
"I figured I'd drag it out until the spring."
"You said something like that at some point earlier, didn't you? Is there something special about spring?"
"Well, it was part of the schedule, after all."
"I see… I see… so it's already about time this got brought into the conversation…"
"This was always meant to be, no…?"
"That woman will abandon everything once her performance is over."
…Takeya's warned me about that many times already.
Even though I always hold on to the slightest hope in my heart that things would be different every time he tells me that…
"…Do you really want things to end as soon as possible?"
"Aren't you the one who wants to put an end to all this, Chiaki?"
"I guess～ You can finally make up with Ogiso-san now."
"So everything's going to go according to Ogiso-san's calculations in the end, huh… Nn～ she's quite the tough woman."
"I'm certain she has a side like that～ She's definitely like that in my interpretation of her."
She wants to put an end to this, yet she's still toying with me…?
"No matter what happens, you will return to her side… So that's why she forgave me so easily. …That's a bit irritating."
Then I can't fall into her pace. I have to act jaded in front of her.
"I've played many different roles up until now. From other people's characters, original characters, to modeled characters. I can grasp the feelings of all of them."
I have to do this in order to finally rid myself of my miserable feelings. It's all so I can finally sever what remains of my affection for her…
"But… I've never had to play a heroine such as Ogiso Setsuna, who's more or less impossible to empathize with."
I can only resent Izumi Chiaki, and pity Senouchi Akira.
"This is my loss… In the end, I still couldn't become Ogiso Setsuna. I can understand her, but I couldn't be like her."
Naturally. You are neither capable of empathizing with her nor understanding her.
"Well, I intend to play her to perfection nonetheless. It's not as easy as any other character that I've played before, but still, I think I can handle it."
This alien simply caught me and performed a human experiment on me.
If that's the case… is it not the rule of Earth for the captive to have their memories of the past few days erased?
It's impossible for an alien and a human to understand one another. Isn't that how it's been depicted in many old TV shows?
"I… really can't go and see your performance after all."
"I think it'll be flimsy. I'll probably find it utterly ridiculous after watching it."
That's why… what I just said could've started a space-war.
"Your imitation is too shallow… You don't understand anything about Setsuna. You were never capable of empathizing with her, much less understanding her."
"Because even the man who's been seemingly so familiar with her for three years still couldn't understand her～"
"If you play Setsuna like that… She'll probably laugh at you when she sees you, you know?"
"…If that's the case, why don't you let me know how you see it, Haruki?"
"Setsuna would never mock others. …That's why I said the Setsuna that you want to play isn't Setsuna at all."
Even so, I won't lose to an alien like Chiaki, especially about things related to Setsuna, who's an earthling just like myself.
I don't know what it is that I'm saying right now, but I won't deny Setsuna even if it means I have to let go of reason.

She also has a perfectly common hobby: karaoke.
Nevertheless, she spends her days in discontent. Placed on such a high pedestal in school, she's had to change her pastimes and personality so as to not reveal her hobby to anyone.
And thus, her hobby became karaokeーrather, her hobby became "enjoying karaoke by herself."
"Um, the starting chord for this song is…"
"Huh, you know about it even though you never played it before?"
"Ah, that's at my regular spot, Hyper Jam… Kazuki-kun, do you go to X3600? Or P-Kara?"
There were minor adjustments to the story's setting, but the opening act unfolded in a way that was almost identical to its original counterpart.
However, the script's tone is also a lot more comedic in comparison, and the heroine was portrayed as being rather silly.

The amateur singer who's good at singing but only has her cuteness going for her, and the stubborn guitarist who's knowledgeable but very mediocre. They didn't seem to be on the same wavelength during practice.
As she continues to spend more and more time with Kazuki, Yukine's facade of a beauty placed on a high pedestal also gradually peels away.
But at some point, she also comes to enjoy the fact that Kazuki can see through it and appreciate her true self.
The group has now assembled a guitarist and a singer. Even so, they don't think that they have enough members yet.
If they want to participate in the competition, they still require a bassist and a drummer, at the very least.
There's only three weeks left until the competition… That's why Kazuki is desperate for experienced candidates to fill the role of bassist and drummer.
…At least, that's how things should've gone.
"…So, what business do you have coming all the way here, Nishimura?"
"Well, you're good with the piano, right…"
"If you're this good, then you can definitely make it within three weeks. Yes! I found our keyboardist!"
"Weren't you looking for a bassist and a drummer?"
"Fuyuki, I'm begging you! Please join our band!"
"It doesn't matter what instrument you'll be playing! What really matters in a band is that all its members work well together, right?"
"…And what makes you think we work well together?"
"Because you're the only one who can go along with my guitar playing!"
"Only someone as skilled as you can cover for my lousy performance on the guitar!"
"…I suppose I should commend you for the fact that you're able to rationally gauge your own ability, but that's all the more reason for you to consider the position you're in right now."
"Even so, I still want you to join, Fuyuki. In fact, I won't accept anyone other than you!"
"Knock it off with the boorish flattery. You're actually giving me chills."
"But it was you, wasn't it? You're the one who's been accompanying me with your piano all this time whenever I was feeling down."
"…I don't know what you're talking about."
With an infamous streak that's a stark contrast to Yukine's popularity despite their rivaling looks, she boasts a dominant presence in the school. Though an unsettling one, at that.
She's an untouchable, a piano prodigy immune to any interference from the teachers due to her mother's influence as a famous pianist.
But as for her true self…
She's the mysterious pianist who always accompanies the protagonist's terrible guitar playing from the neighboring classroom.
She's the one who sits right next to the protagonist in class, and she's actually quite compassionate despite her unapproachable exterior.
Though her compassion only ever seems to be for Kazuki alone.
"You know, if you can't even play this part without any mistakes, your demo tape will probably get a fail on the preliminary round."
"Ah, well, we already passed that, so that won't be an issue… It's just that I wasn't the guitarist at the time."

"…Why did I of all people get involved with you, anyway? It's pretty obvious that this band is going to be nothing more than the laughingstock of the contest. And to think I've never finished below second place in any of my own competitions."
"…Well, that's all in the past. Come on, keep playing."
"Why are you so hell-bent on signing on with a major record label or whatever? For all the effort you're putting in, you're barely improving at all."
"…Was that a question, or did you just mock me?"
"I guess… Maybe I just want to leave my mark on the world?
"W-Wait a second! Why did you hit me when I gave you a serious answer!?"
"What sort of far-fetched nonsense are you saying with such a serious look on your face!? Sheesh, I got goosebumps! That was disgusting!"
"I-Is it really all that weird? I mean, every man should set a goal like that for himself at least once in his life, don't you think?"
"I think you'd be better off saying you just want to be popular with the girls, don't you think?"
"All of my old friends said the same thing… My goal had them rolling on the floor laughing. I was the worst at playing out of all of us, after all."
"Why would you want to leave a mark in the first place? …Are you really that happy to be alive right now?"
"…Scratch that. Never mind. Just forget it."
"Anyway, well, that's an admirable goal you've got. Go for it. It's just too dazzling of a goal for me to ever understand, though."
"I see, you don't get it, huh… Yukine seemed to understand it, though."
"She even said that she'd support me forever. She even said that she'd be my number one fan."
"You're quite the realist, then. But it's such a waste of your talent. If you would just dare to dream a little bigger…
Fans of this theater troupe probably already know about what's going on. And they're enjoying themselves despite being fully aware of that fact.
They knew that all of the main heroines in the play are portrayed by Senouchi Akira.

The fact that the story's set up in a way that neither of the heroines have any interaction with one anotherーand the fact that she's acting out both of their roles by herselfーfully demonstrates her peerless skill as an actress.

Up until a while ago, the famous actress was playing the first heroine who was bright and charming in character, but now she's portraying the second heroine who's gloomy and hostile, and she's really making the two roles feel distinct.

I'd note, however, that she's also planned for this second character to behave just a little more violently than her real counterpart, just so her emotions are easier to understand in a stage setting…
"Kazusa wasn't that unreasonable of a girl, was she?"
"You think so? That's pretty much how she always acted, though. And she was pretty scary at that."
Twisted as she was, the genius pianist possessed skill and knowledge that far surpassed that of the mediocre guitarist, and she continued to bully the latter under the pretense of special training.
And yet he desperately clung to said special training, as if he'd been waiting for those very days to come, and worked on improving his skills.
With the two spending more and more time alone together, their hearts grew ever closer. That's the sort of overly natural development the story had.
The only unnatural thing about it, then, was the fact that it wasn't the only natural development to occur.
Act One has ended. There's a ten minute break.
"Alright～! Things are going smoothly. We've completely hooked the audience!"
"Thanks for your hard work. Here, have a drink to stay hydrated."
"No problems. I told you right from the beginning."
"…Haah. How did I do? Do you think I need to act a little less high-spirited?"
"No, this feels just right for the first half. Your character's change between the first half and the climax sticks out more that way."
"What do you think, Senouchi-san? Were there any problems?"
"…Did I do something wrong? I can still correct whatever I need to right now, so please tell me."
"H-Hey, you two… We should have the review meeting after the…"
"This was pretty good for the opening act. You're not too fast nor too slow. It was easy for me to act with. Please continue like this."
"And from Senouchi no less… that's quite amazing."
"Hey… then why are you in such a foul mood?"
"Don't scare me like that… I almost froze on the spot."
"Anyway, I'm satisfied with our performance so far. …That being said, don't talk to me right now."
"P-Princess? What is that supposed to mean?"
"So the two of you have come together like some couple, eh…? So that's how it's going to be… You're trying to mess around with me…!"
"Fine, I see how it is… I'll let you see how great I really am, so you'd better enjoy it to the very end…!"
"No, not at all. I'm actually feeling quite warm."

The chairs have been taken out so that the hall could accommodate more viewers, but the number of spectators is completely beyond the venue's capacity anyway. The hall is just about packed to the brim.
Setsuna and I are among the crowd, and we're leaning against the wall at the back of the hall. We can feel the heat of the passionate performance even though the heating should be off.
The fact that a mere university drama club is able to incite such excitement among the crowd really speaks volumes about the troupe's talent.
…Or rather, it really speaks volumes about a certain someone's talent.
It's only natural… The opening act was little more than a generic romantic comedy, but it's really grabbed the crowd's attention and gotten a lot of laughs out of them.
"…Do you want to keep watching this?"
If we weren't already aware of how things will unfold from here… and if things unfolding in such a way didn't only serve to hurt us…
Perhaps we would've genuinely enjoyed this just a little more.
The story progresses with the complex intersection of the relationship between Yukine and Kazuki, as well the relationship Kazuki shares with Haruna.
Yukine pouted like a child upon discovering that Kazuki and Haruna have been spending quite a lot of time alone together.
Kazuki was confused about the matter, given that it was the first time that he had seen a girl feeling jealous.
And the way he could only act flustered caused Yukine to feel even more irritated.

Haruna intervened and mediated things between the two, having felt exasperated by the ridiculous conflict between them, though she somehow also harbors feelings of uneasiness about the matter herself.
…At least, that's all I can say about this scene.
For some reason, I'm feeling incredibly embarrassed about how innocent the two actors are on stage.
And while I'm tilting my head downward, I cast a momentary, sideways glance…
And I notice that the person right next to me also has a bright red face, and her head is lowered at the same angle as mine.
"I said no! I'm not finished with that yet… No, I didn't plan on showing this to anyone in the first place!"
"Let's see～ Todokanai Koi? W-Wow… Hey, are these lyrics by any chance!?"
"…If you don't know anything, then don't look at other people's notes, okay?"
"'Even if these feelings can never be conveyed, there will be a day where it can be reflected upon your heart'… Amazing… this is amazing, Kazuki-kun… You have an unexpected talent～"
"It's embarrassing, so please don't read it out loud…"
"This is… the song we'll perform for the competition, right? Which means I'll be the one singing it… Amazing!"
"Eh, ah, no… that's impossible. Everyone quit before the sheet music was written."
"The composition is missing… I've never done it before."
"I did hope that I would be able to fully complete it someday. Though given the way things are now, I doubt that'll happen any time soon."
"It's been a while now… It's quite heavy, Kazuki-kun."
The title of this story finally appeared in the middle of Act Two.
"Don't leave your notebook on the desk. I was so embarrassed reading it that I was thinking about tearing it up and throwing it away."
"I told you not to read my notebook without…"
"You never thought about the composition for a second, now, did you? It's so obvious that you're an amateur."
"And because of that, you made the person who had to set the music to the lyrics go through extra trouble. On top of having to give both of you special attention."
"But wait, does that mean… you actually finished it? Our song, I mean."
"I did this for Yukine. Because she really seems to want to sing this song. …Your request meant nothing to me at all."
"…I just hope we can make it in time."
And so the three made a song.
A song that had its lyrics written by Kazuki, its melody composed by Haruna, and it was a song that would be sung by Yukine.
And the events of that day forged the bonds the three shared together into one, setting the gears of fate in motion.
And then, the day of the competition arrived.
But while the gears of fate binding the three of them together had only just started to turn, their pace spun out of control far too quickly.
"It'd be weirder for me not to feel nervous…"
"It's fine. We're not the ones favored to win this anyway. Our competitors are all rock bands, whereas we're the only ones who couldn't read the mood and decided to go with pop."
"And we decided to go with the lame pop, too…"

"Our singer only has experience in karaoke, our guitarist only has the passion without the skill to back it up, while the only person who's decent among us is our keyboardist who specializes in classical music."
"…Could it be that our band is the most embarrassing one?"
"Other bands also have a female singer, but it seems that no one else is wearing a frilly white outfit like the one you're wearing, Yukine."
"Oh dear… I'm even more nervous now. Jeez! You didn't have to put more pressure on me."
"Jeez～ this is all your fault, Kazuki-kun. You were the one who forced us to participate in this competition, after all…"
"What if I end up messing up at the very beginning… Or what if I end up being so nervous that I won't be able to sing…?"
"What do I do? What do I do? What do I do…?"
"I'll give you something for good luck. So can you close your eyes for just a moment?"
"N-Not at all… I mean, it's not that I don't want to at all! I'd be stupid if I said I didn't want to, so you'll have to do what you want to do before I can say no…!"
"It's a pick. One meant for a guitar."
"It came with the first second-hand guitar I bought. It's been my lucky charm ever since."
"Before concerts or tests… somehow, I would always manage to calm down when I held onto this."
"Well, I guess it's nothing more than an attempt to temporarily comfort you. …Will you accept it, though?"
"Ah, you have this smug look on your face that says 'I just said something cool,' but I'll have you know you're off by a long shot! I'm going to give you a dose of reality!"
"Were you really part of a band, Kazuki-kun? This isn't how musicians think!"
"…Yukine, could it be that you're heavily biased toward people who play rock music?"
"B-Because… if you put it that way, it's only normal for me to think of it in 'that' way… You could at least read the mood, you know…"
"N-No, that can't be… Well, I'm doing this because it's you, Yukine…"
"～! You could at least not treat me like some kind of backdrop!"
"Well, I'll close my eyes again and you can give it another shot. You have 30 seconds!"
"I know you're closing your eyes, but… why are you straightening your back as well?"
"Oh, and also, I'll take this pick as a lucky charm as well. …I'm very happy, I'll be sure to cherish it."
"Can you please stay like that for a little longer…?"
"Excuse me, you guys are the last band, right? It's almost time, so please make your way toward the wings of the stage!"
"Huh? It's just you two? Where's the other member?"
"Ah, y-y-yeah, it looks like she stepped out for a minute to take a break～"
"Is that right…? Well, when everyone's here, please come over as quickly as possible."
"We're pressed for time, so please hurry!"
"Ahaha… hahaha… that was some… incredible timing, huh?"
"Uh, aren't you supposed to laugh along in a situation like this?"
"But it helped you relax a bit, right?"
"Yeah, all that did was make me feel relaxed a little…"
"There's no need to rush things. It's not like our relationship will end along with the competition, right?"
"Even if you don't see a reason, I do see a very big reason…"
"Never mind～! Well, I'll go ahead and start looking for Haruna!"
"Keep it spread out, just like that."
"That was close… But I got so close… Oh, which one is it!?"
"Haruna enters the stage from the left, so please make your way there through the crossover once you've finished changing."
"…Are you alright? Aren't you out of breath?"
"What are you saying? We're still only halfway… …!?"
"…I'm sorry. I just tripped on the costume I took off."
"But back there, with Yukine… That was just some suspension bridge effect stuff going on… right?"
"Put it on me, quickly. Yoshida will be in trouble if I take too long."
"It's finally time for that scene, huh…?"
"When they got caught up in a complicated love triangle."
"Anyway, I need to take a deep breath… Damn it, now I'm the one freaking out instead of Yukine."
"…Uh-oh, I don't have my charm with me. I should have asked her to give it back…"
"Flirting like a pro and then breaking down into a panic? You've got your hands full, huh?"
"Well, you missed a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. I kind of get why you'd be so flustered."
"You don't have to play dumb anymore. I saw the whole thing."
"Are you two middle schoolers or something? That was so embarrassing I couldn't even bear to watch, you know?"
"So did you watch us or did you not…?"
"Then you shouldn't have exposed yourselves. To top it off, I was right next to you and you didn't even notice me."
"B-Besides, where have you been!? We were supposed to be on standby in the waiting room half an hour before the show, remember?"
"I didn't go anywhere. I was in the changing room the entire time."
"Oh, don't mess with me. Not after you made me wear something as embarrassing as this."
"…Why? It suits you perfectly, doesn't it?"
"…I don't want to hear that from you."
"Oh, knock it off with all your questions! Yukine will hate you if you're that stubborn with her, you know."
"Yeah, I hate you. I absolutely despise the kind of man who's so stubborn, yet so easily swayed. …It gives me the creeps."
"…Let's go, then. Let's just get this over with and disband our band already."
"Obviously. Didn't I promise that I'll only stay until the competition is over? I don't see any reason to spend any more time with you two, and I'm not interested in doing so either."
"In fact, I'm surprised I actually stuck with you two for so long. …Why didn't I give up on this sooner?"
"How many times do I have to say this? I'm doing this for Yukine. I don't want to receive any gratitude from you at all."
"Even so… I don't care how much you hate me, but at least accept my gratitude."
"I can't accept that! I won't back down from this no matter what! I was so happy working on this with you!"
"Ever since you were just the mysterious pianist who accompanied me when I wasn't even good enough to play with my friends…"
"…It was such a hassle to accompany you. You either misplayed or you were out of tempo, and your taste in songs is terrible, too."
"I'm sorry… and thank you very much for everything you've done until now."
"…It's not over yet. There's still one more thing, and it's the most troublesome thing of all. The actual performance."
"Yeah… this will be the last thing."
"…For good luck. Let's see you not miss any notes until the end, yeah?"
I feel warmth enveloping my right hand that's leaning against the cold wall.
As I glance to the side, I see that Setsuna is still staring straight ahead and didn't take her eyes off the stage while her left hand was entwined with mine.
…Even though the thorns pricking her heart still haven't been plucked out, she's still intently listening to our song.
The story is starting to diverge from what really happened.
That particular scene before the beginning of the competition…
The real thing happened on the night of the High School Festival, while the story portrays the event as occurring right before the competition.
The characters in this scene are supposed to be Setsuna and I, but in this scene, the two who kissed were Haruna and Kazuki instead.
Perhaps there's a specific reason as to why the person with the protagonist in that particular scene is different in this story?
The scriptwriter has a precise understanding of the events from that time. Even so, she had arranged for the events of her story to unfold differently.
We're the only ones who know that this drama isn't just a mere story, and to us, we're witnessing a strange, parallel world.
Perhaps she's set up all of this as her way of making a practical joke directed at the two of us specifically…?
Setsuna's eyes widened momentarily at that very moment, and she let out the faintest hint of a self-deprecating smile, biting her lip.
And at that moment… I, too, bit my lip and immediately cast my gaze downward, not knowing how I should react.
After all, even though what we're witnessing is merely an act, to us, it's…
"Hey… those two just mixed something up, didn't they?"
"What are they gonna do…? This was supposed to be the climax, but the whole hall just fell silent."
"Is this gonna mess up the whole thing…? It'd be such a waste. I thought it was going pretty well, too!"
"…Shut up, already. I can't hear the song."
The commotion around us directed toward the actors on stage isn't about their acting, but rather their musical performance.
They are no longer the audience here to watch the stage play. They became the audience of the competition in the play… That's how deeply the performance has drawn in its audience.
While listening to the three performing on stage, they've completely fallen for the illusion that they're watching the competition liveーand so have we.
"Yukine" is the one singing on stage.
She's slightly more theatrical compared to Setsuna, but they both sing with that same bright and clear tone.
…And Yukine is singing after just being betrayed by the two people whom she believed she could trust the most.
Through her hand gripping mine, I can sense Setsuna's warmth… though I can also sense the pain she's feeling.
Which is why I wrap Setsuna's hand in my other hand as well, trying my best to ease her anguish right now.
I can't think about whether I have the right or responsibility to do this right now. …And I don't want to think about it.
"Alright, change the set now. There's still the final act, let's continue to work hard!"
"Thanks for your hard work, Senouchi-san. Come, rest a little."
"H-Hang on! What's the matter, Senouchi-san!? Someone! I'm sorry, but please, hurry over and help!"
"…She's regained consciousness for the time being. It doesn't seem like she can stand up yet, though."
"Well, can she continue with the show?"
"Yoshida! What are you saying at a time like this…?"
"Yes, I'm saying it exactly at a time like this. We're at the most important part of the show. We're finally moving onto the final act, you know?"
"I know the president prepared a substitute, but we absolutely cannot switch out Senouchi-san today. It just wouldn't be fair to the audience, or to me either."
"Even if you say that… she hit her head when she collapsed."
"If she can't go on, we'll just cancel what's left of today's public performance. At the very least, I'm not going to continue acting without her."
"She said she wants to continue… Still, given her condition…"
"…Why did she suddenly collapse, though? She's never had any problems acting on stage regardless of how much sleep she got or even if she hadn't eaten anything."
"That's probably… because Senouchi-san is still a woman, after all…"
"D-Don't tell me… was it morning sickness or a miscarriage…?"
"Why are you bringing up stuff like that all of a sudden? That's sexual harassment, President!"
"B-But it can't be… does that mean…"
"And it seems to be quite severe, at that. She's turned really anemic as a result."
"…This is the worst that could've happened."
"And I'll have substitutes standing in for you starting tomorrow, one for Yukine, and another for Haruna. It was probably a bad idea to have a single person doing both of these roles to begin with."
"…What are you saying, President? Haven't I successfully played multiple characters at once up until now?"
"You were too into it this time. And it ended up backfiring."
"Besides, even if your body can do it, there's still the question of whether your heart can return to being Yukine…"
"You were really serious about using your little trump card earlier, weren't you? …As a woman, rather than an actress."
"It's unfortunate, but… if you know it for a fact now, you'll get another chance to make one."
"Like I'll ever get another chance! I've clearly been rejected."
"But still, you were in that sort of relationship with him once. Perhaps if you cling onto him and cry your heart out, Princess…"
"I couldn't possibly… do something so cliche."
"Well, that's how it's going to be. I'll be personally explaining the situation to all the viewers. After all, it is part of my responsibility as president."
"No, you can't. You're currently very anemic and you're completely heartbroken. I don't see any reason why you should continue."
"And I'd believe you if you were still the same person as you were before you fell for a man."
"I did not fall for him! I just couldn't keep a hold on him, that's all!"
"In any case, regardless of whether or not we're going to continue, you're going to be stepping down, Princess. Not only for today, but starting tomorrow as well."
From here on, I'm sure they will abandon the original, which stopped half way, and start a new branch for the story.
The story will continue with the scriptwriter's interpretation from here on out, separate from the original story of the trio's relationship.
…She'll lay her fangs bare as she'll unveil her true intentions to us.
"…Do you really want to watch it until the end?"
She definitely won't show any mercy to me. Yukine will definitely push the story toward a dark ending.
And it'll definitely hurt Setsuna deeply, who's completely unrelated to this on the surface.
"It'll only be painful from here on, right? Let's go, I'll walk you home."
After all, there's no way she'd hold back when it came to a performance.
To her, it's only right that she harms the hearts of the few for the sake of moving the hearts of the majority…
In any case, there's no doubt that the two of us will end up having our hearts gouged out, at least.
"If it'll end up hurting you, Setsuna, then I'll leave without a question. That's my top priority right now."
It will cause a deep wound for sure, it might even become fatal at this rate.
"…I want to watch it until the end. I want to accept her message."
Even so, Setsuna looks forward with a fixed gaze again.
"Hey, Haruki-kun… You also need to do so, you know?"
That's why I chose to wait for the final act that has yet to begin.
To confirm her true intention, to see the truth in her acting.
She already damaged me, and toyed with me, and took everything I possibly had. Yet she appears in front of me yet again.
To that person, I shouldn't be of use any longer…
The story went through a sudden time skip.
In other words, three years after the previous scenes… The time we're living in right now.
But the story seems even more like a parallel world compared to before.
"Yukine, will you come to the school festival this year?"
"No… I still have work to do…"
"And also… there's this other university festival as well. My office just keeps filling up my schedule."
"Eh? Me? Hmm… well. I was thinking about spending it with you, so I didn't have anything planned…"
"I'm sorry, Kazuki-kun… Well, maybe next time…"
"Ah, yeah. Good night. …Sorry to make you go through all this trouble. You even had to call me…"
"Fufu. Don't worry about that. …Okay then, see you."
"I thought you'd be getting together with Yukine, but I guess that's not quite decided yet～"
"'Sorry to make you go through all this trouble. You even had to call me,' huh～ That's what you're apologizing for? Pretty shameless, don't you think?"
"You brought another woman to your apartment, yet you're taking a love call from your girlfriend. Aren't you a lucky guy?"
"Aren't we friends? Even if you're in my apartment, I'm sure Yukine wouldn't worry about it."
"Besides, we're not done talking yet. What's going on with you?"
"You refusing to go study abroad is what I mean. You finally would have gotten to live with your mother, wouldn't you?"
"Why did you do that…? Didn't you say there's no more room for improvement for you if you stay in Japan?"
"That's true, I'd have to move to Europe if I wanted to improve any further. But what if I didn't want to do that?"
"But wasn't that your dream? To become a world-class pianist, just like your mother…?"
"…You're the last person I want to hear that from."
"Well, what happened to that dream of yours? The whole major label debut thing? Or are you all satisfied with your life now that you've got such a lovely girlfriend, huh?"
"Will she really be alright? Senouchi-san has already gone way past her limit, right?"
"I don't need you telling me that… Just take a look at these scratch marks."
"But even you should be able to stop her now, President."
"…I'm not one that's known for resorting to brute force."
"That just means you've never tried to stop her seriously!"
"Well, you see… At this point, no matter where we stop her, it's a wrap. Not to mention it'll be up to you guys starting tomorrow."
"Even though you've been so biased toward her all this time? Are you going to abandon her now that she's not following your will?"
"Me? I would never. The princess is the one who'll be abandoning us. She could cut her ties with a meager acting troupe like ours in a heartbeat."
"So there is a play that you can only perform in because you've fallen for a man, huh…"
"Show me, then… Show me your last and most amazing performance."
"Don't forget that… promise of ours, okay?"
The story jumped back to narrate the blank three-year period.
The concert three years ago… The band failed because they didn't qualify.
However, the song caught the eye of the president of a certain professional entertainment company, and a year later, the company hosted a stunning debut.
…Featuring the singer, Hatsushiba Yukine. And her alone.
Kazuki had given up on the guitar and enrolled in university. He's been living a completely normal university life.
She was an up-and-coming singer, and he was a mere university student…
Even so, Yukine's passionate confession meant that the people closest to them recognized the two as an official couple before and after her debut.
And then there was the other remaining member of the three. Fuyuki Haruna, the genius pianist who had a bright future ahead of her, sealed away her potential by her own volition.
The first year passed by quite peacefully.
Yukine, whose feelings haven't changed since the moment she met Kazuki.
Kazuki, who sealed away his true feelings, but uses his true feelings to honestly answer Yukine's feelings for him.
And ever since that competition, Haruna miraculously stayed with them as "just a friend," and continued to watch over Yukine and Kazuki.
During the second year, things started to change. Yet they still didn't foresee the incoming storm.
Since Yukine was a popular star, she had to hide her feelings for Kazuki inside her heart, so the time they spent together drastically decreased.

Kazuki was just a university student with a famous girlfriend. He feels insecure toward Yukine, who had accomplished his dream in his place, and jealousy and doubt festered within him as the days went by.
As the friend who watched over them, Haruna tried to help Kazuki vent out his problems. But she couldn't suppress the poison that was spreading throughout his entire body.
Ever since that day three years ago, Haruna's been saying "I never had any feelings for you," and now, she finally revealed her true feelings.
She refused the opportunity to study abroad in Vienna, which was also her mother's base of activity. She chose… to remain in Japan and stayed with Kazuki.
She offered herself as Yukine's substitute and continues to do so.
And that was where their inevitable mistake began.
…Haruna and Kazuki may not have thought of it as a mistake, but it was indeed the gravest mistake of all.
Everything continues to go downhill from here.
"Why are you saying things like that…?"
Kazuki saw it all from the shadows.
He saw the very moment the two best friendsーone, his lover and the other, also his loverーfinally broke apart over him.
I'm sure that this is a very difficult scene to enact.
After all, Yukine and Haruna can't possibly appear simultaneously on the same stage. But their conflict and subsequent collapse are essential to the story.
It's only natural to find the story weird as a result.
However, even such an unreasonable performance was mere child's play in the face of the lead actress' frightening prowess.
And so the sounds of destruction resonated through the hall.
Setsuna's palm is covered in sweat.
But I imagine it might be the sweat from my hand that's holding hers.
No matter how much it hurts us or how cruelly this part was depicted, we're certainly absorbed in her performance.
For the three of us, that scene never actually occurred, yet she's acting it out right now…
"Kazusa… was definitely not that strong either."
Setsuna, who's too gentle and could never stand on the stage. Kazusa, who's too cowardly and would keep running away from the stage.
As for me… I'm the only one who's the same on stage.
As an observer, who can only watch things happen.
Anyone would imagine the ending to this story to be a disheartening and sorrowful one.
They must be under the impression that Yukine's been completely left out.

The trope of the victimized long-distance lover, whereby she is abandoned by the protagonist for a friend who's closer. How it came to be was not only a matter of distance, but also of varying standpoints.
Haruna, who abandoned her piano, stayed by Kazuki's side; Yukine, who did not cast aside her singing, only had her singing with her.
And that's why Yukine is singing…
She's singing the song that reminded her of the first time the three of them came together. She's singing the song that reminded her of how the three of them split up.
…I'm sure anyone would interpret it that way.
"…How can you keep up in your condition?"
"Probably because I'm being led by 'Kazuki.' …He's doing a great job."
"Everyone's growing. It's just that you weren't watching, Princess."
"Also, it's the longest scene, not to mention almost the entire dialogue is yours."
"…That is, if you can last until the end. No, you collapsing would be one way to shine too."
"You don't have to provoke me… I don't have any strength to fight back right now."
"You think things have come to an end here…? I haven't conveyed anything to those two yet."
But by this point, the main actress, who also happens to be the scriptwriter, is displaying a tumultuous tenacity that no one could have ever expected or imagined.
Yukine didn't make any decisions and simply allowed things to unfold. Haruna embraced her strong feelings of love and pursued them.
The heroine who got everything except for her lover, and the heroine who threw away everything in order to obtain her lover. They confronted each other for the last time.
"My feelings for you, the chance in my hand right now, and even my dreams."
"The feeling of falling in love as a woman. The joy and pride of being a singer."
"I'll obtain them all. I'll work myself to the bone to obtain them."
This is an incredible display of balance.
She's completed the earnest, admirable, yet young and energetic Hatsushiba Yukineーand without any feelings of unease, superiority or repulsion.
"If I keep chasing my love with everything I have, I'll grasp it one day."
"If I do that, you might be hurt because of it, Kazuki-kun."
Her love has definitely gone too far and is one that she's forced upon him, but it's also boundless, strong, and kind…
"But I… don't regret this. Because from the moment I grasped it, I realized that this is my dream."
"I realized that this is an irreplaceable path that you laid out for me, Kazuki-kun."
That's why Kazuki and Haruna are suffering even more.
"That's why I won't give up on anything."
Everyone can come to this realization as we arrive at the endーthis is a story created for the sake of Hatsushiba Yukine.
"Abandoning something in order to obtain something else is something I don't like doing."
A girl who's simply too greedy, too genuine… and just far too strong.
"And as far as the amount and intensity of love I can feel goes… the sky's the limit."
"Even if my love for singing were to grow stronger, my feelings for you won't grow any weaker because of it, Kazuki-kun…"
I have no words other than the fact that the author is simply out of her mind if she actually believes she's modeled this heroine after Setsuna.
"All the time we can't spend together just makes me love you more. And all the short moments that we do get to spend together make me love you even more than that."
"That's why, as far as my love goes, I won't lose to her."
No, this character simply isn't using facets derived from only Setsuna anymore.
"I don't care if I win it all or if I lose it all. Regardless of what happens, I'll keep chasing after all of it."
Hatsushiba Yukine is both Ogiso Setsuna and Touma Kazusa…
"I won't ask you to believe me. I don't think it would be wrong for you to choose either me or Haruna, Kazuki-kun."
And Izumi Chiaki herself as well.
"But my love won't lose to Haruna's. And if Haruna feels the same way, we'll just have to let you make the choice, Kazuki-kun."
She's really such an idiot… a genius of an idiot.
"I really, really love you, Kazuki-kun! I promise you that, if nothing else, these feelings of mine are true…"
The story took numerous turns from here on as well.
Yukine and Haruna were locked in a mutual battle of love and hate until the very end.
As for the ending… Well, it would be pretty tactless of me to elaborate any further, so I'll leave it at that.
All I'll say is that it got unanimous applause from the audience.
And even though the intermissions between the acts took so long, everyone in the audience forgot just how late it's gotten.
Ah, and there's one more thing…
"During the end… well, the moment the performance ended, you collapsed again."
"I… see. What's the time right now?"
"Let's see… It's 1 AM. Well, we're almost done packing up."
"Everyone's gone home already. That being said, Tanaka-san, the president and I are taking turns staying here."
"Ah, don't worry about it. I know the last train's gone by now, but I was planning on staying over at a friend's place anyway."
"In any case, thanks for your hard work today. I've learned a lot."
"Did someone wait for me? After the performance ended, I mean, um…"
"Are you talking about fans? You did receive a lot of flowers and presents."
"No, I'm not talking about that… It's more, well… He's someone I wouldn't really call a fan, and he looks a little gloomy…"
"Who knows? I didn't hear anything like that, at least."
"But I'm glad I was able to be in a play with you, Senouchi-san, I really am. I'm quite satisfied with my performance today, even if I do say so myself…"
"You did really great, Yoshida… I'm the one who caused you guys trouble."
"I was late with the script and even fainted on stage, and because of that, I won't be able to go on stage starting tomorrow… I didn't do anything right this time, and I'm sorry."
"Not at all… I was following your lead the entire time. The reason why our performance was as great as it was today is because of…"
"It's alright, you don't have to console me like that…"
"…You'll affect everyone's morale if you're going to behave so weakly. I really hope you'll be able to return to your usual, confident self tomorrow."
"And then… during our next public performance together, we'll…"
"You can't go outside dressed like that! Right now, it's…"
"I just want to go out for a moment… just a moment… I just want to confirm something."
"…The fact that I've already lost everything."
"Thank you, Yoshida-kun… You don't have to stick around here anymore."
"I'm really looking forward to it… Performing with you again, I mean."
"And, if you'd like to, maybe… we could do something when we're off-stage as well…"
"No, not really… I was just reminded again about the fact that I'm a genius."
"There's not a man on stage that can resist falling for me. …Didn't I tell you that before I showed you the script? You even glared at me as I was saying it."
"…But I'm sorry. I've already fallen for a man off stage."
"I… need to go get my coat."
"…But what if I can't catch up because I went back for it?"
"It's already 1 AM… Who am I chasing after?"
"Just maybe… the last train still hasn't departed yet."
"If I had, I could have gotten back to Haruki. I could have made him take care of me for the rest of my life…"
"But now, I… I'm going to be abandoned without getting a say in it, huh?"
"I've lost absolutely everything… and all because of Haruki."
"My first time, my second time, my third time… the tenth time, the twentieth time…"
"My position, my fame, and all my future performances… Even the very place where I was supposed to belong! Everything… I've lost everything!"
"It's all your fault that things turned out like this! And now even you're going to be taken away from me on top of that!?"
"What the hell… You're just going to ignore what I had planned all along…? Don't make a fool out of me…!"
"I must say… even when you cry, you really are so theatrical."
The loud sound that resounded across the dark, cold entrance of the station under the snowing and lightless night…
…Immediately got swallowed by the darkness at the very moment I called out to its source in an astounded tone.
…This is quite the crude display, though I'm judging this by Chiaki's own prideful acting standards.
"You're making me out to be quite terrible…"
"Even though I let you do everything you wanted… you refuse to take responsibility as a man."
"Now you're just being spiteful. You're the one who betrayed me first, weren't you?"
"…And what's wrong with me being spiteful?"
"Don't take that defiant attitude with me."
Even though we're currently bickering with one another, I'm still grateful to God for allowing me to bear witness to this precious moment.
Because I've finally gotten to see it.
Senouchi Akira was weeping. Senou Chiaki was wailing. Izumi Chiaki was crying her heart out.
I wonder if any man other than me has ever had the opportunity to witness her in such a state?
…Outside of the instances where she was acting, of course.
"I didn't think you'd run out while still wearing your costume… You'll freeze to death at this rate."
The moment I remove my coat, I am immediately blasted by the freezing wind and snow.
But my compassion drives me to offer my coat to this pathetic woman who's kneeling on the floor and begging for forgiveness with tears rolling down her face.
"…What's with that patronizing attitude of yours? I don't want it!"
"…Just shut up and put it on."
She really is an expert at reading others' hearts. She even saw through me as I tried to rub my moment of superiority in her face.
"Don't touch, don't touch me…! Stop patting my head and stop treating me like I'm some cat…!"
"Well, you're the one who started acting like a cat in the first place…"
As I slowly caress Chiaki's chilled cheeks and move down to the nape of her neck with my palms, I take in the sensation of her skin that I haven't gotten to feel in a long while.
I'd gotten so used to it when I'd held her in my arms for days on end, but right now, the sensation feels almost nostalgic.
"I'll make sure to wake you up for tomorrow's public performance as well. You know how punctual I am, right?"
After savoring the feel of her neck and cheeks, I run my hand through her hair and dishevel it.
"Can you stand up? I'll call a taxi…"
"I'm getting really tired of that line."
"But you abandoned me and went back to Ogiso Setsuna."
"And that line really hurts, so stop it."
"Well, at least you're just feeling hurt. I'll have you know that I'm feeling nauseous, helpless and cold at the same time…"
"That's why we should hurry home, take a warm bath, and go to bed."
"Don't turn into a broken record, now."
"Why are you showing up in front of me now? You were making fun of me with her during the performance."
"Because, believe it or not… I abandoned Setsuna to come back and get you."
"You really managed to finish the whole thing…"
"Is it really that surprising? A girl can eat this much too, you know."
"Well, if it weren't this cold out, that is…"
An empty parfait glass is in front of me.
While I'd completely lost interest in my coffee the moment it turned tepid, Setsuna thoroughly enjoyed her order of ice cream.
"I've been ordering this a lot whenever I come here with a friend of mine recently. It might have turned into a bit of a bad habit."
I can't properly discern anything from the expression Setsuna made when she muttered that.
"Cloudy with a chance of snowfall in the evening. That's what the weather forecast said, anyway."
"So it won't get much warmer, huh."
"It's usually like this throughout all of February, right?"
"Does that mean it'll get warmer tomorrow all of a sudden?"
"If the cold air followed a strict schedule, I suppose."
"If it were me, the cold would've already been gone since yesterday. …It'd already be warmer by today."
As silly as this might be, we're not bored by it.
We're not feeling bored even though we're only talking about the weather. If anything, we're happy to be able to have such a boring conversation.
It's already been three hours since I met up with Setsuna this afternoon. Time has passed miraculously smoothly between us.
Although my body feels cold, I'm slowly regaining the warmth in my heart.
If I can act like nothing happened, and just go back to our usual days…
"Do you have anything planned after this?"
I hide both of my hands under the table.
What am I doing? Why am I looking at my watch while I'm spending time with Setsuna?
I'm not supposed to have any plans for later. There's no reason for me to be worrying about the time today.
"Thank you for asking me out today. It was nice to see you after so long, Haruki-kun."
"Well, I… really wanted to see you too."
"We really do think alike, don't we?"
However, Setsuna continues talking to me in her usual manner, not noticing my frivolous movements.
She hasn't spoken a word about what happened that night. I'm not sure if she's forgotten or if she's just being considerate of me…
If I were to take it a step further and invite her to dinner after this, would Setsuna be bothered by my invitation?
Or would she instead smile as easily as she is now, then ask me, "Why do you need to ask me about something like that at this point?" while nodding, as if it were the most natural thing in the world?
I need to make up my mind. Both of us are fully aware of that.
That's why we're able to spend time together like this right now, peacefully and uneventfully.
I'm sure that if I were to run away without another word, Setsuna would be ready to accept that it would mean absolutely nothing at all.
…And she must believe that I'm not the kind of person who'd allow himself to make use of such a convenient lapse in memory to run away.
That's why… I just can't betray the faith that Setsuna has in me.
"Let's… make this the last time the two of us meet alone."
Which is why I have no choice… but to betray Setsuna.
As if the cold from outside had seeped into the cafe, time froze still between us.
"It's not that I think that she can't go on without me… and it's not that I think you'll be just fine without me either, Setsuna."
However, I force my numb lips open to speak.
"I imagine she will keep toying with me. She might even betray me again. And I'm probably in for more painful experiences with her…"
My words come out like icy blades, leaving wounds all over my mouth…
"But… I still think it's more pleasant than betraying you, Setsuna."
"And it's not as painful as… being with you, Setsuna…"
And they proceed to tear Setsuna into shreds.
"After all, all I'd ever have to do is get back on my own two feet again."
Our surroundings fall into absolute silence the moment I stop talking.
Setsuna's staring at me without a word, and I can't tell what thoughts lie behind her expression at all.
…And I'm sure she's desperately trying to keep it that way.
Nevertheless, she seems to have no intention of interrupting me or objecting to what I just said.
"I don't want to hurt you anymore, Setsuna. Because I know I'll only keep inflicting wounds upon myself that will never heal if this goes on."
And so I callously continue to hurt Setsuna and recite words meant to tear the two of us apart.
"I know how incredibly selfish this is. But I won't change what I've decided on."
Because this is… the last time I'll have to do it.
"And the reason why I was able to make such a foolish decision… of course, wasn't just you, Setsuna…"
"That's right. It's because I love her."
It's precisely because this will be the last time I have to do it that I'm inflicting Setsuna with the gravest wound possible.
"She tricked me and hurt me as well. She's a horrible woman… But none of the moments I spent with her were this painful. I wanted them to last forever."
And in doing so, my entire body is stained in red.
Though I no longer know if the blood that's been spilled is Setsuna's or mine.
At last, Setsuna opens her mouth.
Though the words that followed were not intended to curse me or express regret at what I just said.
On the tip of her tongue, there's a knot she made from the stem of the cherry that came with her parfait.
And I'm sure that I'll never be able to understand the meaning behind that gesture, no matter how much time passes.
"Do you want to go watch Chiaki-san's play? We can still make it in time before the show starts, right?"
"Let's go and confirm them, then… Her true feelings."
Chiaki is hugging her own shoulders.
She's tightly clinging onto the coat that I've given her.
"I can't hug you while you're on the ground."
"Ahaha… you got tricked. Haruki, you got tricked again～"
Just like that, Chiaki starts ridiculing me, as she usually does.
But her hands, stuck to the ground, are still shaking.
She desperately straightens her elbows while getting up on one knee and gritting her teeth, causing her to spill even more tears.
As her hands finally break away from the ground, she places them on her knees to support herself and force her exhausted body to stand up…
Only to fall back to her knees again after running out of strength.
Unable to keep watching her like this, I attempt to lift her up with my arms, but Chiaki rejects me with a loud voice that strains her body to its limits.
"What do you think…? This is the first time in my life I've completely lost control of my body like this."
"Didn't you say that… I have to stand up on my own, Haruki? That if I manage to stand up… you'll forgive everything."
"Even so, I'll bear it and stand up on my own… So, please… please…"
"There's no way I'd forgive you that easily."
Chiaki stood up using her own strength.
But the next moment, she ran out of strength and collapsed into my arms.
"I'm the one who should be crying here…"
Chiaki finally stood up because she believed that she would be rewarded by me, and so I respond by embracing her with all of my strength.
…I know she's being vague with me here, but I find myself accepting her immature behavior right now.
I'm an idiot. I'm an even bigger idiot than she is.
But I just can't help it. After all, she kept our promise. She showed me a Chiaki that I can believe in.
…Well, more precisely, I should be saying that she's shown me a "Yukine" that I can believe in.
"Didn't you say that you wouldn't get turned on by me anymore? Why are you so hot and hard now?"
"Don't even think about touching me there at a time like this."
"My body's all worn out, but my heart's still wild with passion, you know?"
"Wait, so were you… really going at it during that kiss scene earlier…?"
"I'm going to drive you wild with jealousy, Haruki. I won't tell you anything until you ki… Mmph!"
Although the date has changed and it's supposed to be March now, cold, delicate, and powdery snow has continued to descend upon us from the sky above with a flutter.
And yet, even though it's so cold…
"Nn, nnn… hwa, aah… Nn… nnn… nnnn…!"
Chiaki's lips feel so hot they could burn me.
"It almost seems like… the snow always falls whenever we find ourselves at a crossroads, doesn't it?"
"I can't be as cool as she is. I could never become that strong, either."
"Though on the other hand, that woman can be such a slob sometimes."
"I couldn't do it. In the end, I couldn't become that woman you could address in that particular way, Haruki-kun."
"I am cold, but that's none of your business, Haruki-kun."
"That's why you mustn't embrace me or lend me your coat even if it seems like I'm cold right now, understood?"
"I can't tell you how much it'd bother me if you insisted on being kind to me even though you won't be by my side from now on, Haruki-kun."
"That wasn't cute at all, now, was it? I bet it made you think I was being brazenly selfish, huh?"
"I'd say that it's my biggest flaw of all. …But I'll be living with this personality of mine for the rest of my life, you know?"
"This terrible personality of mine… Vindictive, mad with jealousy, and unable to forget the person I've loved all this time. But just as unable to bring myself to forgive him, either…"
"That's why I shouldn't keep pushing myself past my limits anymore. That's what I've decided."
"Perhaps I'll be able to express this feeling again when I meet someone new someday. Or perhaps I'll keep harboring this feeling within me forever."
"But now… I feel like I have to let you find your own happiness as you finally move on from Kazusa and me."
"That is my final act of selfishness toward you. My final act of pride."
"The last train of the day on Line 2 will be departing shortly."
"I… hate her, you know? And I despise you as well, you know?"
"That's why… I'm not giving this back to you."
"Just like how Yukine never returned Kazuki's pick, I'll cherish it for the rest of my life."
"How long are you going to stay asleep!? You're supposed to be overseeing the presentation for today's seminar, aren't you!?"
"Then hurry and get up! Go shower, eat breakfast, and head to university!"
"N-No, don't do that… If you keep sucking it like that, it'll leave a kiss mark."
"Nn, ah, no… Not there… a little lower… ahh… nnn."
"Haaah, haah, haah… eh? It's over already?"
"…Shouldn't you feel a little concerned about the perverted behavior you just exhibited?"
If I just let her be, she would probably do something horribly wrong with the vacuum cleaner… with an aroused expression as well…
"N-No, why did you stop halfway… My switch was turned on this early in the morning too."
"Hurry up, put on your clothes, take a shower, and then have breakfast."
"Wait, what kind of order of events is that?"
"When the sun comes up, you change back into a normal human being, huh? You vampire～ Even though you were sucking on various parts of this maiden's body last night."
"Vampires are only interested in the blood of a female virgin."
"You're the one who turned me into your servant～"
"That's enough dirty talk for now. Speaking of which, your attendance this year has been pretty bad…"
"It doesn't matter if I can't graduate. The path I'm taking doesn't require a university degree."
We've been living together for half a year now…
I'm still incapable of bringing about a change in her personality, as embarrassing as it is to admit it.

Her seminar attendance and research paper submissions only barely afford her a pass, too. All she does at home is sleep, and she leaves all the house chores to me. She's like a stray cat that's lost its wildness that would immediately huddle onto my chest and knees.
"I'll make sure you'll enjoy your life when I get famous someday, okay, Haruki?"
"I'm not bored to the point where I'll believe in dreams like that."
She barely worked for Watos recently as well. Instead, she went to apply to other major troupes.
"After you become famous, you'll just dump the man who raised you. Then it'll turn into some scandal in a magazine."
"What are you saying～ I can't live freely unless I'm being raised by you, you know that, don't you, Haruki?"
"Be more independent. You really feel a lot more like a parasite lately."
"That's why I said you only have to endure it for another three years. After that, Haruki, you may rely on me."
"I don't believe in dreams like that. I already have a job and I'm independent, I can live on my own no matter what happens…"
"Ah～ about that, try and work hard enough to feed the both of us for now."
"Why don't you stop chasing after that dream and find a path that's more realistic…"
"I made it to the final round of that last audition, you know? They're taking two people out of a hundred."
Her ability is what's worrying me. She easily manages to blow away my arguments based on common sense every single time.
I move my lips over stubbornly, but even so, Chiaki happily accepts it.
And then, she buries her face into my chest.
…She presses both of her hands onto my own.
This kind of "promise" is something that I can never get away with.
"That'll have to depend on how you perform."
We've agreed on a limit of only doing it once per day. But if we both agree to it, then the limit can be ignored.
"Me? Didn't I say it clearly last night? When you used both of your hands to rub my chest."
"It's just like what I said, it's from the bottom of my heart, you know? Gosh～ that was so embarrassing～"
"You think I could remember what you said while I was entranced by the sensation in my hands? What did you say? Say it again!"
"Well then… do you want to repeat what we were doing～?"
But in the end, ever since "that day," I would always find myself completely succumbing to Chiaki's coup de grace.
After all, I can never actually win against her when she resorts to tactics like these…
"I'll make you happy. Someday, I'll make you say 'It's great being able to be with you,' okay?"
Moreover, she's only saying those words without actually acting on them…
"That's why you don't have to work too hard. You don't have to suffer on your own. You don't have to struggle on your own either."
Because the cat that I decided to never abandon again confesses her feelings all of a sudden.
"It might take some time, but I'll be here for you, Haruki. …Until your wounds heal, that is."
She used to be a beast that was hungry for the taste of that wound, and she managed to reopen it numerous times…
"…It's fine, even if it doesn't heal."
I pet Chiaki's head and let out a gentle smile as she looks at me with upturned eyes after she licked the wound on my chestーin my heart.
"I've already decided to live on with this wound for the rest of my life."
"Then… I'll hold onto the knife that gave you that wound forever, Haruki."
But this cat is slowly turning into a human.
"For the sake of the three people who I admired. For the sake of never forgetting about the three people that fell apart. …And for the sake of never using this knife again."
"…You're chuckling over another good line you just thought of again, aren't you?"
"Should I show my face at Watos after all this time～? It seems like I got an interesting plot."
"I'll fix it someday. I'll definitely fix your twisted personality."
"…! Hurry up, take your shower! I still have to clean the house, do the laundry, and cook… Agh, there's just so much to do!"
And in the end, we reenact our usual morning.
In other words, we're reenacting a spectacle that's typical of both our days and our nights.
No matter how mad I get at her and no matter how much I lecture her, Chiaki would laugh it off, give me some vague reply, and that would be the end of it.
And that's not all. She's simply incapable of ceasing to mess around like a clown all the time.
When I'm feeling down, when I'm feeling troubled, or when I'm feeling distressed…
She always saves me with her innocent, irresponsible smile.
That's exactly why I fall into unease whenever I remember the time I was trembling as I had my knees in my arms.
As a result, our relationship might return to the days when I received fake treatment from Chiaki.
But even so, I can't leave this trickster's side anymore.
That's why I will scold, lecture, and hold onto Chiaki…
I must "act" like I can't leave her alone and see to it that this sloppy girl continues to rely on me.
In order for her to remain by my side.
"The truth is, I recovered a long time ago, my feelings toward you aren't twisted at all."
"But even so, I'll keep my act up. I never plan on changing myself, I'll keep making you sigh."
"So I can continue to remain by your side."
"I'll keep playing the role of the pierrot until you forget about the pain of that wound."
"Please keep lecturing me and let us stay together forever."
As always, the wind blowing in through the window is so cold that it's prickling my skin.
Having somehow been the first to arrive in the lab after a while since the end of winter break, the piercing cold from outside is unfettered despite the fact that I'm indoors.
Yes, I was the first one here. There wasn't anyone else present.
…Not even a sleeping bag for me to accidentally almost step on.
Well, I guess that's only natural.
She never was the kind of diligent person who would arrive on campus right after winter break, especially before first class.
It's been a week since Chiaki left my apartment.
I hadn't given her a call even once, and there weren't any calls from her end either.
I had been desperately trying to return to my old self.

Waking up at 6:30, eating breakfast, resuming my part-time jobs, coming in contact with people other than Chiaki… I was working on returning to society, to return to being the Kitahara Haruki anyone would recognize.
That's exactly why I couldn't be pampered by Chiaki during that process. I stopped my hand from reaching for my cell phone many times now.
As for Chiaki… Well, she's just fickle.
Even so, now that university has resumed, there's no use in trying to avoid each other anymore.
Since that's the case, I decided last night to take the initiative and go meet her so we can talk about things.
I'll come back and check again in the evening. She'll most likely be here sleeping leisurely then.
"Well, I guess ten days have already passed since the new year. Sorry for the late New Year's greeting."
"…Though I wonder if I should be apologizing for attempting to check up on you so casually like this."
"If you see this text and find it ridiculous, then please just block my number. I'm well aware of how much I've wronged you, at least."
"But I somehow always end up thinking about you, so after hesitating a lot about it, I decided to text you. …How have you been?"
"Did you come to university today? Have you been able to return to a proper early-morning lifestyle? …Though I guess I can't imagine you oversleeping, Haruki-kun."
"Or perhaps you've been unaffected by it all? Have you let it all go completely and started a new life? I'd feel relieved if that were true, but at the same time, I'd feel a bit down as well."
"Well, I'll end it here. Final exams are coming soon. Let's both work hard, okay?"
"Thank you for your text. I'm not angry with you at all, and there's no reason for me to be. I guess I can only be mad about not being able to contact you myself."
"I've been going to university since yesterday. There's a lecture of which the paper submission date is fast approaching, after all."
"As for how I'm faring… while I can't say that I've completely gotten over it, I've been living my day-to-day life properly."
"I've been going to my part-time jobs, studying for tests, and just living the ordinary university student life. It's not like I can advance in my life and studies if I don't continue on."
"Enough about me, though, how are things with you, Setsuna?"
"You've only been worrying about me in your text and didn't write anything about yourself. It's actually making me quite worried about you."
"I'm glad that you've contacted me, but you should also write a few lines on what's happening in your life, you know?"
"I'm living a pretty normal life right now."
"I wake up in the morning, eat breakfast, go to university, chat with friends, and study. Days without a change."
"…For a while, I cried until all my tears dried up, but now that's no longer the case."
"Humans are pretty amazing that way, don't you think?"
Chiaki never showed up at the lab that day.
"We're finally going to be fourth-years, huh…"
Now that the long period of final exams is over, the students immediately spring into high spirits in welcoming of the still chilly mid-February.
All of Houjou University's courses for this year will be finished by the end of the week. And the entrance exams for the new students will start next week.
"Hey, Haruki. Do you wanna go skiing during the holidays? Snowboarding would be nice too."
"Why are you suddenly bringing this up? Did you already plan this with the nurses you were hanging out with earlier?"
"Ah, yes, the nurses… their irregular and hectic schedules cause them to build up a lot of stress, making their carnal desires insatiable!"
"You sound as if you're speaking from experience…"
"…Yeah, well, putting such magnificent experiences aside, would you be up for an invitation like that?"
"And I figured you'd say that, so I'm obviously not inviting you to participate in something like that. I just thought the four of us could rent a car and go together."
"You're just playing dumb on purpose now, right? I mean Io, you, me, and…"
"You didn't word that very well. Of course I'd be doing it on purpose if I were playing dumb."
Even though I tried so hard to evade the subject… this guy just can't take the hint.
