"I told you to drop that! I only planned this meeting because you promised not to talk about that…"
"Aah, sorry, Haruki. We obviously don't believe that."
"But, but, but… I saw her! She was in the apartment right next to Kitahara-san's…"
It may be due to the difference in time spent with me, or merely their disposition toward Yanagihara-san's personality…
What's ironic is… the more they come to my defense, the more Takeya and Io stray further from the truth.
And Yanagihara-san, who's acting the most hostile toward me right now, is the only one who knows the ridiculously horrible truth.
"It's just that… I don't think Tomo is completely making things up either."
"We thought that if things have gone this far, perhaps Touma might have something to do with it."
"Take for example, that ever since Touma-san came back to Japan, you've been having a lot of complicated feelings, or something like that…"
"Maybe you went to see one of her concerts without telling Setsuna-chan. Does that ring a bell?"
"Why won't you believe me…? You were taking everything I told you seriously until yesterday!"
It's not just that they trust me.
"Why do you lose your spines the moment Kitahara-san is around? Aren't you worried about Setsuna?"
"Well, of course we're worried. We're worried, but until Haruki…"
"Let's listen to what Haruki has to say. If he manages to explain everything, then you'd be satisfied too, right, Tomo?"
Takeya and Io "want to" believe me. They're waiting for me to dispel their worries.
They want me to laugh at the idea that I'd break up with Setsuna. They want me to reaffirm that there's nothing between Kazusa and me anymore.
That our friendship would never break apart…
Let's say I were to improvise an answer…
Scratch my head with a half regretful look on my face, and say "Sorry, we got into a little fight."
They would undoubtedly believe me over her.
They'd look at each other and laugh as they say "not again…" and then promise to help us make up.
"There's something we can do to help, right? Don't hold it all in, for Setsuna-chan's sake too."
And then everything would be resolved…
Because this friendship is almost rigged to continue existing.
So even now, we can still go back to those old peaceful days with just the four of us… perhaps even the five of us.
I could turn back the clock, and it'd be as if nothing happened…
Of course I can't go back.
When I was finished telling them everything I told Setsuna, silence enveloped our table.
Because as I went from one matter to another, I was vindicating Yanagihara Tomo little by little.
I told the truth in its terrible entirety. Neither Takeya nor Io tried reinterpreting it to make me look better, even though I'm sure they could.
The bustle of the bar painfully reverberates in my ear. After all, this is the only table this quiet.
Yanagihara Tomo glares at me, and looks at Takeya and Io from the side.
And Io, rather than looking at any one person, stares down at the table as her shoulders shake slightly.
And in unison, her voice was also subtly shaking.
"Tell me you're lying, Haruki… Laugh at me and say it was all a bad joke!"
"No! That's not what I want to hear."
My trying to be considerate, in a way almost identical to how Io usually is, was the last thing she wanted to hear.
"I mean… we always knew… that Touma Kazusa was in love with you five years ago, and just as deeply as Setsuna was."
The moment the truth slipped from my mouth, Io stopped doubting her thoughts.
"But it is too late for you to accept those feelings now! She's awful for suggesting it… but you're even more awful for accepting her, Haruki!"
She finally understood that I'm not lying… That the true lie had been everything I had told her up until today.
"How many years have you and Setsuna been together…? How many times do you have to betray her…? How many times do you have to hurt her until you're satisfied…?"
That realization was visible when she raised her head.
"How many years have you been separated from Touma Kazusa…? So why does it have to be her? How much do you have to obsess over her until you're finished?"
She grits her teeth, pulls away her face, and her eyes start watering as if on the verge of crying. But in her misery, she can't even bring herself to cry.
"She's the woman who ruined your relationship with Setsuna and ran away immediately after. She already abandoned you once, Haruki!"
Both anger and sadness, disappointment and confusion. All these emotions blended together…
"I don't get it… I don't get what's going on inside your head at all, Haruki!"
"Don't say 'I'm sorry'! What you're supposed to do right now isn't to apologize! Why can't you understand that!?"
But at the same time, it was an expression she was showing me because we were friends.
Io hadn't given up yet. She was desperately trying to get me back on her side.
That Setsuna needs me, and that the best possible resolution is for me to be with Setsuna. This would be for Setsuna's sake, but also mine.
"What are you going to do about Setsuna…? Are you going to just abandon her after ruining her like that?"
But Yanagihara-san was on Setsuna's side more than anyone else.
"The two of you were engaged until now. Why would you go out of your way to make her feel like she's in heaven just to put her through hell? What did she do to deserve that…?"
"Do you hate her that much? Going out of your way to make sure she suffers in the worst way possible… Do you think she killed your parents or something?"
That's why she's brazenly throwing all the questions at me that neither Takeya nor Io have ever dared to ask me.
The most important question they just had to make sure of, and the question that I want to answer the least…
"All this time, Setsuna has chosen a lifestyle that would go in line with yours, Kitahara-san. She limited her own opportunities for your sake!"
What Yanagihara Tomo wanted out of Setsuna was different from me.
"Her education… her job… even her singing…"
She understood Setsuna's songs better than anyone else, was a bigger fan than anyone else, and was her biggest promoter.
She desired the artist SETSUNA more than the actual Ogiso Setsuna.
"She made it a condition… that she could still be with you, that she could still have the time to see you…!"
But Setsuna graduated, found herself a job, and her appearances on stage grew fewer and fewer.
Because I wasn't on the stage with her. Because I wouldn't go to see her concerts. Because it would take time away from being with me.
Her own strength and potential, and the reality that stood in its way. And then all the other reasons…
But no one would believe me if I told them I had nothing to do with them or her decision.
"Because, she intended to be with you forever. She intended to spend her entire life with you!"
Despite that, she thought about Setsuna's feelings and respected the path she chose.
All while looking at me in contempt, yet she still looked at the two of us when we were together with a bitter smile.
"So why Touma Kazusa after all this time? Why can't you be happy with Setsuna…?"
But just now, she was hit with the horrifying reality that Setsuna's sacrifice was completely pointless…
"Was she that good in bed? Did she find all your weak spots?"
But I cannot do anything to quell it. I have no choice but to accept it all.
"Losing your sense just because some woman you used to know spread her legs for you… Did it feel that good?"
"Don't… say that! Blame me all you want, but leave Kazusa out of it…"
"Did she perhaps know some amazing techniques? I bet she played you the same way she plays that piano of hers… just like her mother used to."
"Stop it, stop it…! I haven't slept with Kazusa! She's not that kind of woman!"
…But I couldn't accept her going after Kazusa.
"She's been through a lot too! She's been lost, and suffering… so please don't talk like that about her!"
The only things I want to protect are Kazusa's feelings, and her honor.
Because I promised to protect her. The only one facing judgement was to be me.
But the retort, and my judgement came from a direction I didn't expect…
"You haven't even slept with her. You haven't even done anything. It's not like you're burdened with something you can't take back…"
"You're just going to abandon Setsuna simply because you love her…?"
I insisted… insisted on the last bastion that is protecting Kazusa.
"Then, what does Setsuna mean to you? Are you saying that even after joining with her in both body and mind, your bond with her is still no match for what you have with Touma-san?"
But that attempt only had the opposite effect on her.
Io is… completely and utterly disgusted with me.
"What does Setsuna mean to you? Do you think that any of those things you said gives you an excuse? How much are you looking down on Setsuna, Haruki?"
"Eh, no, that's not… I didn't… w-wait…"
All the color drains from her face, her feelings evaporate, and the anger she directed at me earlier is nowhere to be seen.
"You've ruined everything for those around you, and now you're saying it's all platonic between you two…?"
"What a poor excuse for love. I feel like vomiting."
I was prepared to lose my friends today.
I thought that it was only natural for them to hate me, to look at me with nothing but contempt.
Yet the words Io threw at me hurt far more than I ever imagined.
"Fine then… The two of you can go ahead and live in your little fantasy world and play house together."
"Y-You… have it wrong… Listen to me, Io."
I never imagined I'd be met with disgust about that one thing… and to have my reasoning be so utterly rejected.
"It doesn't matter how much you two hurt everyone around you. After all, your bond is so strong you can't see beyond each other, so it's fine."
"Kazusa has… been through a lot. Even with how famous she is, she's still all by herself… so I'm… I'm the only one she has."
All the things I desperately planned to hold in until everything came to an end…
"So it's alright since Setsuna hasn't been through a lot? It's okay for you to abandon her because she's not all by herself?"
All of the harsh constraints that I put on myself in order to not hurt Setsuna more than I already have…
"That's exactly what you're saying, Haruki… If you disappear, Setsuna won't be all alone. You won't feel sorry for her so it's okay to abandon her. That's what you're saying…"
All of that didn't just become utterly meaninglessーit ended up degrading Setsuna even more…
Yet again, I wasn't prepared for this whatsoever.
I kept telling myself that I was going to make enemies of everyone, that I was going to lose all my friends, yet…
It hurts that my feelings aren't being conveyed. It hurts that my love for her isn't reaching them.
"But you know, Haruki… this is what Setsuna looks like after being abandoned by you…"
This is the desperate pain Setsuna was bottling up back then.
This is my retribution for switching partners overnight.
Something I must accept, Io's very last…
However, the moment I thought my heart was going to break in two, a calm yet overpowering voice interrupts me.
"If you have no intention of convincing Haruki, then go home. If all you're going to do is to talk down to him, then leave and never see him again."
After being told to shut up by the women, Takeya had been keeping to himself.
"Give up already. Actually, it seems you've already given up. Then you're of no use here."
Takeya, who had been wordlessly gazing at me from the side, suddenly takes control of the whole conversation.
"I haven't given up. I'll convince Haruki… I'll make him reconsider his feelings about Setsuna, no matter what."
Of all things, he willingly stands against the women's sense of justice.
"There's no need for people like you two around if you're only going to drive Haruki against the wall. So get out of here already."
He's going against the person who was closer to him than anyone else, the person who he watched over Setsuna and me with.
"What is… this? Takeya… are you defending Haruki? Are you telling me I'm wrong?"
"I don't give a damn about that. All I know is that you're currently in the way of me talking to Haruki."
"…! Hey! Whose side are you on… mine or Haruki's!?"
No matter how I look at it, Takeya has no reason at all to defend me.
And no matter how I look at it, the ones who are saying the right things here are Io and Yanagihara.
And yet, I know the name Takeya's going to say.
Yet I couldn't stop it from boiling over…
"Take this, it'll sober you up a bit."
After that, the two women left. …With harsh, condemning looks in their eyes that were focused on Takeya more than me.
But once our table became quiet, neither of us were in the mood for conversation. Before long, the two of us had left the bar too.
Takeya walked along the city streets in silence, and I followed behind him without saying a word.
Under the cold night sky, we finally find a place to sit and share our canned coffees.
The warmth from the coffee permeates throughout my entire body, although I didn't need it to sober up since I had barely drunk anything.
"I was the one who caused it."
Ever since he chased out the girls, or perhaps ever since we met up, Takeya had been very relaxed.
Among the four of us, he was careful not to stir anything up; instead, he stuck to the backseat role and threw in a laugh or two when he could.
"Make sure to make up with Io later, okay? I won't be able to smooth things out between you two any longer."
"You're worried about us at this stage? Have you forgotten about the mess you're in?"
Well, as expected, not even he could hide his frustration this far in.
"Aa-ah, why do I have to pick up the pieces after that mess?"
"Irrespective of whether you're right or wrong, I out of all people should know… that you never budge once you've made up your mind."
"Seriously, why do things have to be like this…?"
No, perhaps it was his plan to lose his cool halfway through from the start, to settle the score alone with me.
So he can take on all the responsibility by himself when he fails to convince me.
It's almost as though he's ready to take on the responsibility for all my actions…
The winter cold pierces through me much harsher than usual, perhaps because I didn't drink all that much.
The canned coffee I had in my hand had turned cold before I knew it, and was no longer suitable to warm my hands.
I'm not sure if I'm feeling cold because of the loneliness that's welling up within me, or if it's because of another reason.
"Could you listen to what I have to say?"
The only thing I wanted to do was to convey something to the only person standing in front of me.
I wanted to tell him a single truth, with just a few excuses put in.
"Houjou University Hospital… That's pretty under wraps. The mass media doesn't know a thing, huh?"
"It seems a lot of politicians and artists are being taken care of there. They're probably used to that kind of care."
When Takeya heard about Touma Youko's illness and the place she was staying at, he was at a loss for words.
It's only natural for him to react that way, I suppose. In fact, he's taking this much better than expected.
Perhaps it's because Youko-san is nothing but a stranger to him, or perhaps because he figured something out from my behavior.
"I'd prefer if you didn't say a word of this to anyone, of course. It could make a lot of noise here in Japan."
"Why not? It's one of your reasons for leaving, isn't it?"
"That's just an excuse. And it doesn't change the fact that I'm making the wrong choice."
"Yeah, you're right. You made the wrong choice… you should have talked about this honestly to Setsuna-chan."
The wrong choice Takeya was referring to was a bit different from what I was thinking of.
"Had you spoken to her about it honestly, Setsuna-chan could have carried the burden with you."
But we both know that the central point of the issue is different between us.
"Had you done that… then perhaps, you would have been able to find a better solution…"
And then I start to understand. Takeya is drifting away from the point on purpose.
"Is there… no such choice? Is it not still possible for the three of you to talk it out together?"
For us to share our wisdom together, carry each other's burdens, and perhaps find a better solution to all this.
"Sharing the pain amongst the three of us," something I'd usually suggest.
"I've already decided to live with Kazusa from now on. And I swore to not involve Setsuna in it."
"There might be greater happiness if you do involve her! I'm certain Setsuna-chan herself would agree!"
"…If we shared the burden among the three of us, then… I might be unable to pick Kazusa anymore."
I could only make that kind of choice once I was determined to give up on Kazusa.
"I really loved Kazusa all along. I wanted to make her mine alone."
But if Kazusa's burden is shared among the three of us and the three of us become happy because of that…
"I thought I was over her two years ago, but I was wrong. Even after all this time, nothing has changed. I only piled up lie over lie for these two years until I started believing them myself."
Then Kazusa will stop trying to make me hers. She'll disappear by herself before I know it.
"That's why I can't rely on Setsuna… It's all just because of my ego."
It will be a future without Kazusa by my side.
Three will find happiness, two will find happiness in each other… while two will be left without the happiness they want.
"You're despicable, you know that? …And Touma is just as bad."
"Kazusa has nothing to do with it. It's all my…"
"No matter how much you try to defend her, and no matter what her circumstances may be, nothing changes the fact that she has done something terrible."
"She's trying to make a man her own… even if it means breaking up a relationship between two people who truly love each other, and are even engaged."
"Out of all the women I've met, I have never encountered such a terrible woman. I wouldn't get within ten feet of her."
I had nothing to counter him with.
Because emotions are filling my mind rather than reason.
"Don't say bad things about Kazusa… not my Kazusa."
Nothing but those laughable responses came to mind.
"I misjudged you. I always thought you were a man of good judgement… At the very least, I thought you had better judgement than me."
Takeya sees that I have nothing to respond with, so he breathes a sigh as if he's had enough.
Just a few moments before, he had shut down Io and Yanagihara-san and proclaimed himself as my ally…
"I don't even want to talk to you right now. That's how much of a poor opinion I have of you."
But in time, even Takeya leaves my side…
"But I'm still your friend. I may not have any desire to be, but even then, I'm still your friend…"
"So this is my last request… I'm begging you, Haruki… go back to your usual self!"
"If you only say the word, if you say you're going back to Setsuna-chan, then I'll make sure everything goes back to normal!"
"I'll convince Io, Tomo, and everyone else too! I'll make sure every single thing you said today is forgotten, so please… please…"
"I'm begging you… I'm begging you… take it all back! All you have to do is to say it was a bad joke and apologize."
…Really was a true friend of mine…
The only one I had… and I'll probably never be able to see him again…
He was another person I considered most important to me, in a different way than both Setsuna and Kazusa.
…He was someone that was truly precious to me.
"I knew I was wrong from the very beginning. Even so, it's not like I wanted to set things right from the beginning either."
"Why, why though…? I can't believe it… Why, Haruki…!?"
Damn it, I'm such an idiot. …I only realize how precious our friendship is when I'm about to lose it.
"I've… always been like this. I'm stupid down to my very core."
All of this is really so stupid. Everything I've done up until now could only be described that way…
"I try to do the right thing, but I get it wrong. And even when I know what the right thing is, I still do the wrong thing."
New discoveries, happiness, frustration, pain, and nostalgia that I once shared with him are brought to my mind.
"But… this is just too big of a mistake… Not even I could mess up that badly. How could you… abandon such a good girl like Setsuna-chan…?"
In this hopeless situation, the expression he desperately tried to keep to prevent himself from crying slackened for just a moment.
"Take it back… if not, then this time, I'll truly have no choice but to disdain you…"
"I won't be able to defend you… I won't want to defend you. I'll be forced to admit that you're an awful person…"
"Don't defend me anymore. You'll end up losing your friends too, you know?"
"It's not true… It can't be true!"
Because I don't have the right to cry. I don't have the right to be sad.
All this is due to my own actions. There is not a single thing that couldn't have been prevented.
I willingly chose this avoidable fate out of my own desire alone.
"You can go already. Nothing will change from talking any further."
I'm really, really… grateful to you, Takeya.
Thanks to you, I found a tiny bit of salvation…
"If you're not going, then I'll go ahead. Bye, then."
"I'll never forgive you… I won't forgive you for the rest of my life, Haruki…"
Even so, up until a few moments ago, there was true friendship between us…
I can go on believing that.
It seems like the trains are still operating.
In this station that never sleeps even in the middle of a snowy night, the ticket gates continue to spew forth countless people.

Perhaps I felt relieved by seeing the big crowd of people in front of the station, or perhaps I felt overwhelmed by all the things that had happened up until now, and before I knew it, I was looking up at the sky.
The bright lights of the city make most of the stars invisible, with only the bright moon watching over the city.
It felt like I was dreaming. Of course, it was not a good dream.
He was the first friend I ever made after I enrolled in high school. He was always at the center of all my relationship problems.
I thought that our friendship would stick around whether I wanted it or not.
Those two have been stuck together for longer than Takeya and me. Yet they're never honest with each other, so I'd get irritated at how nothing ever progressed between them.
I thought to myself that one day I would be able to do something for them, the same way they helped me out.
Yet all the strings that brought us three together have been cut loose.
All because of my own mistakes, and my mistakes alone.
Even so, with the way things have turned out, I don't even have the time to lament over it.
I can't even cry over Yanagihara-san hating me, Io being fed up with me, and losing my best friend… Takeya.
Tell me God, was what I did truly so awful…?
I thought the bicycle passing by me stopped to make way for me, yet its rider spoke with a voice I recognized.
"What's the matter? Do you have business at our place?"
"What about you, Takahiro-kun? Are you going out this late?"
Yet I wouldn't call the meeting miraculous, just a small coincidence.
…After all, I'm only 200 meters away from the Ogiso household.
"About that, I received two tickets for a late screening. It's the film I promised to watch with a friend, and apparently the director is even meeting with the audience too."
"Yeah, mom got them for me. She knows a guy who owns stock in the theater."
And the reason for Takahiro-kun being out at this time is neither a coincidence nor a miracle.
"Nee-chan isn't home right now, you know? Yanagihara-san came about an hour ago and left with her."
So they even lured away Setsuna…
"That's strange. Did you two promise to meet today?"
"No… not really. I'm not going to your place today. I have some business to take care of somewhere else around here."
Is he trying to be considerate… or did his mother tell him to?
"Ah, by the way… since you're here, I might as well ask."
It was a very predictable question.
"Because she's been weird lately. As soon as she comes back from work, she just locks herself in her room. She always eats out and never shows her face around the living room anymore."
And the way Takahiro described Setsuna's current condition was also something that I'd anticipated.
"Just two days ago, when I saw her in the corridor, she immediately went back to her room, almost as if she was running away from me."
As is the fact that Takahiro-kun has noticed by now that something is wrong with her.
"And when I got angry and knocked on her door, I heard her turning the lock on it."
"…I see, you do know something about it. You wouldn't be going so quiet otherwise."
"…I'm no match for you, am I?"
Truly, I am no match for the Ogiso family, and their love for each other.
Everyone's always concerned for each other, and even the slightest change in behavior catches their attention. And they don't hesitate to try helping each other.
Something that never existed in the Kitahara family, and something that was completely one-sided in the Touma family. That kind of heartwarming love.
"What are you doing, Kitahara-san? The two of you just got engaged."
I was supposed to become a part of this family before long.
That shining jewel on Setsuna's finger was supposed to light up my way to a brighter future.
"Make up soon, okay? I can't bear how things are at home anymore."
But I'm sorry. I'm really sorry.
"You don't have to apologize, you know. Let your actions speak for themselves…"
"Ah… sorry. I have to go now!"
But there is absolutely nothing I can do, other than apologize…
Takahiro is out, and Setsuna is away.
The only people waiting for me at the Ogiso household are those two.
In other words, this is something they don't want their children to see… and a conversation they don't want them to hear.
"Why have you been so quiet since we came here?"
"You come and force me out of my home, and then all you do is drink tea."
"I didn't have anything else to do."
"That can't be true. Every time you have time on your hands, you either go to the beauty salon or go training."
"…On some weekends I prefer doing nothing."
"It's me, isn't it? You're worried about me because of last week?"
"…I have no idea what you're talking about."
"Sorry about back then… I behaved really inappropriately."
"There's no reason to apologize. After all, I'm on your side, and I'm your friend…"
"Thank you… but I'm fine now. I've decided to keep doing my best."
"It might be a bit unreasonable for me to ask this, considering what I did, but I want you to forget all about last week."
"You just said you had no idea what I was talking about, right? So it shouldn't be difficult for you."
"I wasn't crying back then. In fact, I had absolutely no reason to cry in the first place."
"True, we ran into some obstacles, but we've had plenty of those before… and we've always overcome them."
"So I'll continue doing my best! I'll give it everything I have! That's the way our relationship has been from the start… so it'll be fine this time too!"
"…Setsuna, stop it! Don't force yourself to act strong…"
"I'm not forcing myself. After all, the person who taught me that everyone will be rewarded if they keep their hearts strong is none other than…"
"Don't push yourself so much… It's okay to cry… You have every right to be hurt right now, Setsuna."
"It's okay to show your weak side sometimes. To us, and even to him."
"You're wrong… I can't rely on anyone else. This is a problem with my feelings. If only I can manage to keep a strong heart, everything will be solved…"
"What you should be doing right now is clinging to Kitahara-san!"
"Stop worrying about appearances. Don't try to act like you're okay! Don't blame yourself! Don't keep everything to yourself!"
"Like I said, you've got it wrong…"
"Let your feelings come out! Tell him not to go, tell him to not leave you behind! Tell that to him, and let everyone know!"
"If you do that, I'm sure he'll come back to you. As long as he realizes how much he's hurting you, he'll… After all, he's always had a strong sense of responsibility."
"We'll help you too… I promise we'll sway Kitahara-san's feelings…"
"…You don't have to do anything unnecessary."
"This is a matter between the three of us. It has nothing to do with you."
"Nothing to do with us, how could…"
"…Sorry, perhaps that came out a bit strong. But you really don't have to do anything."
"I don't particularly mind, but isn't that a bit unfair to Mizusawa-san and Iizuka-san? How many times do you think they've helped you out?"
"I know, and I love them… but I'll have to insist, this one time."
"Because everyone will start blaming Haruki-kun. They'll say he's in the wrong or something stupid like that."
"…Do you mean that what he said to you was so cruel that we couldn't possibly understand?"
"…! It's because you say things like that that I don't want to talk about it…"
"So that's why you don't want us to intervene. It's because you know the fault is all on Kitahara-san's side…"
"We merely hit a snag. If only we can talk it out, he'll understand."
"So please, don't say a word to Haruki-kun. I'll talk to him myself, and I'll take as much time as I need…"
"I know more about him than anyone. Please, leave us be for now."
"I'll come up with something. So please, don't back him into a corner."
"I apologize for calling you here on your day off."
By the time I entered the living room, the mood was already painfully heavy.
Maybe it is because of the weight I carry with me here, or perhaps it's caused by Setsuna's parents at the thought of speaking to me.
It probably is because of both.
"Under normal circumstances, we wouldn't have to speak to you about this directly… Especially at a time when Setsuna is not around, which I'm aware is not commendable."
"However, we have been very concerned about Setsuna, and we don't consider you to be an outsider to our family, Kitahara-kun… Though if you disagree with that assumption, you may correct me."
"I don't disagree. I'm glad that you think so."
Hearing that was supposed to be something happy.
I've visited the Ogiso family more times than I can count, and Setsuna's mother and Takahiro-kun have long since considered me as part of the family.
Yet today is the first time I'm hearing her father suggest such a thing.
"Let's get into the matter at hand."
And now, I cannot even feel the slightest happiness over being accepted as someone close to the family.
"Let me first confirm, Kitahara-kun, do you have any idea on why we called you here today?"
Setsuna's father and I face one another, while her mother looks at us from the side, clearly restless, and shuffling between looking at us and looking away.
Almost like a completely different person from the woman who would gossip to me about Setsuna's complaints and fondness toward me, only to get glared at by Setsuna for it.
Tension, uncertainty, worry and fear mix together in her eyes. Those eyes tell me she is praying.
"At the beginning of this month… the last time you were here, you talked to us about your future together with Setsuna, with many implications."
"D-Darling, that… was just something Takahiro and I decided was the case on our own. And it was something we thought would only happen quite far in the future…"
And most likely… I'm looking back at them with the same look on my face as hers.
"If that's the case he can set the record straight now. That he never made such a promise, that he never spoke to Setsuna about their future together."
I put my hands on my lap and close them tightly. There's enough sweat in my clenched fists to spill out between my fingers.
I can tell exactly how this is going to play out.
"A short while before that, I gave Setsuna… your daughter, a ring. We also spoke of our future."
A chain of events that I never desired, but one that I can't avoid.
"And would I be correct to assume that your intention was… to marry her?"
The two of them may have thought that those words were a slip of the tongue.
"And what exactly does that mean? Are we correct to assume your intentions are still the same as back then?"
However, it was planned from the start. A means to guide the conversation in the right direction.
"Would we be correct to assume that you desire to spend the future with Setsuna… our daughter?"
It's a direction that I do not want to head in, yet one I cannot avoid.
No matter how many times I think of getting away from it, I always end up back here again. So I want to at least avoid prolonging the pain.
Not just for myself, but for Setsuna's parents too…
"I'm sorry… circumstances have changed since then."
"I cannot marry Setsuna… your daughter. Please allow me to take back my proposal."
Please, let this be over with already. I acknowledge all my wrongdoings, so hurry up and give me my judgement.
I'll accept any punishment. So please, quickly… acknowledge my error…
"They should be talking about it right about now… him and your parents."
"The reason I took you here today is because your mom… asked me to. She told me that they wanted to talk to Kitahara-san without you."
"Because they probably knew. They knew that you'd definitely protect Kitahara-san if you were around."
"That wasn't my question! Why do mom and dad… Tomo, did you tell them!?"
"Your mom was the one who let us know… they noticed that something was wrong with the way you were acting since quite some time ago."
"That's why I met up with Kitahara-san yesterday to get the truth… with the help of Iizuka-san and Mizusawa-san."
"Everyone knows already! All the horrible things Kitahara-san said to you… all the horrible things he did…"
"This isn't something you can sort out on your own anymore, Setsuna. You'll just end up forgiving him. You won't be able to make him regret what he's done."
"Regret…? There is no reason for that. All I have to do is to find a way for the three of us to be together… If only I can find a better solution…"
"That won't make Kitahara-san come back to you! He's going to Europe with Touma Kazusa!"
"…! Stop it! Stop it, stop it, stop it!"
"Why is everyone so set on backing Haruki-kun into a corner? Why are you all so quick to jump to conclusions!?"
"That's because… what he's saying right now is utterly absurd! What he's done to you is beyond cruel!"
"It's not over yet… It's not at all over between us yet! So why are people trying to end it when it's none of their business!?"
"Stop it, stop it already… Stop acting against Haruki-kun… Stop getting mad over your own misunderstandings… Stop deciding that it's all over…!"
"…I'm going home! This should cover the bill."
"I was, I was just… worried about you and…!"
"Don't call me from now on, because I won't answer!"
"Ah… uh, uah… I do feel… bad about it but…"
"But, but… You don't have to… say it like that…!"
Setsuna's dad is looking at me with a stern look.
And her mom can't stop crying.
They're both deeply affected by my selfish words, coming from their daughter's "ex-boyfriend."
Which means… that they don't see me as "just her boyfriend."
A reminder that they saw me as someone special to the family.
"I'm in love… with a different woman."
Which is why my words also have a weight heavier than the words of an ex-boyfriend, a weight heavy enough to crush their hearts.

I can imagine the emotions that are violently boiling within them right now; they must be furious and grief-stricken at how I ended up ruining their daughter, who they raised with utmost love and care…
…And I imagine they're also carrying an immeasurably deep hatred toward me.
"Surely, that has to be a lie, right? That can't be what you told Setsuna…"
Even so, they still try to assume the best of me.
"There is another reason for this, right? She can be really inconsiderate sometimes, maybe it's that…?"
"That's not it… at all, not even a little bit."
"Did you have a disagreement over who to invite to the wedding? Or you couldn't agree on whether you should continue with your current job after the marriage…?"
"If it has anything to do with what we have said, then you don't have to worry about it! The most important thing is what you two want together… so, please?"
"That's not it. It really… is just a change of heart on my side alone. Setsuna has not done anything wrong."
And the pain I feel as I watch it all collapse without leaving a trace.
"I thought you to be a man who just wouldn't ever say something like that of all things."
Without time to tend to my wounds, the next sharp needle pierces my chest.
"Due to circumstances, we might not have had the best impression on one another. I admit I avoided you, and you may have wanted to keep me at arm's length."
"But the reason I acted that way was because Setsuna trusted and loved you completely… and I felt like it was out of my hands."
He's controlling his emotions and speaks calmly…
However, his calmness does not suggest a lack of emotion from my betrayal at all.
"I thought of telling her, 'He might just be tricking you' or 'See what happened last time?'…"
"But those weren't words I could tell my daughter… because I thought that you loved Setsuna from the bottom of your heart. I thought you were a man I could trust…!"
I raise my voice without realizing it.
I have almost no memories left of being scolded by my father. Yet I can feel that the might in this man's voice has that same sternness.
I had even dreamed about the day I could call him my father, where he would give me a light scolding over a pint of beer.
Yet, the words he speaks to me now are neither kind nor are they affectionately trying to lecture me.
It was a powerful and stern voice that was defending a man's "family" from an "enemy."
Seeing that his words made me shrink, he lets out a sorrowful sigh.
I couldn't even come up with an excuse, much less contradict him.
In the end, I could never tell him "I'm not wrong."
"Well then… what are you going to do now?"
"I'll speak to Setsuna one more time. I won't ask her to understand, but I hope I can at least convince her to forget me."
"However, you're in this city. You live and work here… You could still pass each other by on the train or on the streets."
"Do you not think it is unfair to ask that of her? To forget about you despite you being so close to her…?"
"…Please don't worry. I don't think we'll ever see each other again."
"How do you intend on convincing us of that?"
"I'll be leaving this city soon. From April, I'll be living abroad."
"Abroad… is it a part of a job transfer?"
"U-Um! Maybe that's the reason you're breaking up with Setsuna…? You don't want to keep her waiting by herself when you're out and…"
Setsuna's mother is desperately trying to find a proper explanation that puts me in a positive light, up until the very end.
And as a result, the sins I have committed only become more vivid in my mind…
"I'm going to… Vienna. I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused you."
She's realized who my partner is.
She's realized that it's "the friend Setsuna once brought home from school five years ago."
"…Is everything settled now? Or is there anything else?"
I'm trying to run away right now.
The way I tried to avoid any further questions was an utterly despicable attempt to end the conversation.
"If there is nothing else to talk about, I'll be…"
Even so, I have no other choice right now.
I didn't have the strength to bring up her name here.
I stand up and bow to the two parents who are still stiff as two rocks, and open the living room door…
Right in front of the door… I bump into someone in the corridor.
And Setsuna's mother, who realized who that someone was, opened her tear-filled red eyes in horror.
In other words, I wasn't the only one who didn't expect this.
His head was hanging in the darkness, so his face was hidden. Yet both of his hands were clenched in anger, and his whole body looked petrified.
That alone was enough for me to tell how long he had been listening for. And his feelings came through to me almost painfully…
And those clenched fists flew into the air.
"What the hell was that all about!? What the hell are you even saying!? Have you gone completely insane!?"
I feel a heavy impact on the back of my head, and a pain that spreads from my cheeks to my mouth.
A warm metallic taste spreads to the depths of my nose and my throat.
"Nee-chan, Nee-chan… What are you going to do about Nee-chan!?"
"Weren't you together ever since high school!? Weren't you engaged!? Weren't you supposed to become my brother-in-law!?"
"Give them back! Give back those five years you stole from her… those five years you completely ruined, Kitahara!"
"S-Sto… Stop it, Takahiro! Please stop it already… Uu-uhn… Dear, please!"
"He just left. Less than five minutes ago."
"It's too late. I won't allow you to go outside right now."
"You must be joking! After all the terrible things you guys did to Haruki-kun! Ganging up on him and causing him so much pain!"
"I hate you… I hate you all, I loathe you!"
"Everyone tries to go after Haruki-kun, everyone tries to push him away from me. I hate you all!"
My burning hot cheeks are grazed by the cold wind, and the pain I was numb to finally makes itself known.
The blood from the cut in my mouth mixes with the blood from my nose, and a horrible taste envelops my tongue.
…Yet I was oblivious to the pain from all these wounds up until a short while ago.
"Stop it, Takahiro! Did you not hear me when I told you to stop!?"
"I won't allow you to act violently toward someone else. He's… someone who has nothing to do with our family."
"Kitahara-kun… I'm sorry for my son's horrible behavior. Please forgive us."
"If you have to go to the hospital because of this, I'll take responsibility for all the expenses needed. I'm truly sorry."
"And, please do me this favor. I'm aware that it's rude considering I was the one who called you here, but…"
Her father's words, her mother's crying.
Those actions that reinforce the fact that they love their family. The realization of that hurts…
Because it felt like my heart was going to be torn in two.
And for a second time, my physical pain is chased away by sheer emotional pain.
"There is a short-cut around here, one only the residents here know about. A narrow back alley."
Even though she was completely out of breath, Setsuna continued to explain.
Yet her explanation wasn't the reason she chased me, only the reason she caught up with me.
"This will feel a bit cold, but try to bear it."
Setsuna took out a handkerchief and wettened it by a nearby water fountain. Just like she said, even my burning cheeks felt like they were going to freeze over.
Yet I couldn't feel sorry for myself, because I felt at the same time the coldness in Setsuna's hands as she gripped the handkerchief.
"I'm sorry, Takahiro really did something stupid…"
"There's no reason for you to apologize, Setsuna, and Takahiro-kun isn't in the wrong either."
"No, he is in the wrong… hurting you like this. Even though they know you're the most important person to me… They're all so cruel."
The cruel one here is me. Yet even now, Setsuna is still defending me.
Her true feelings, her escape from reality, and her numerous misunderstandings blended together, and her feelings for me have become even stronger than before.
Almost like me, she's making enemies of everyone around her.
"This might sting a bit, try to bear it one more time, okay?"
"Hey, don't move. You're not a little kid, so you can bear it."
Setsuna didn't allow me to speak about what happened.
When she appeared in front of me, she was holding a first aid box in both hands. A big box with every possible necessity.
The fact that I came over, that I spoke to her parents, and that I got myself injured.
Overwhelmed with so many truths that disturbed her heart, Setsuna threw all her thoughts away and instead chose to come running with this heavy box.
Her rash behavior, her adorableness… and the lovable way she's harboring these assumptions as she heals the wounds on my cheeks.
And with them, I can feel a bit of pain, coldness, and a never-ending warmth.
"Okay… that should do it. Good job."
After finally applying some gauze around my mouth and sticking it in place with tape, Setsuna puts the materials back into the first aid box.
All with a composed expression. All while we're in an atmosphere that's no different to how things used to be.
It's almost as if nothing had happened. Almost as if the two of us were back to our old selves.
"Is it a little hard for you to speak? Could you try saying something?"
"…I didn't ask you to talk about that. A single word would have been enough. I just wanted to make sure the tape wouldn't peel off."
Yet all that was a front that could be broken apart with a single word.
"Don't reach out to those in the wrong. You've hurt yourself enough…"
"I'm the one who gets to decide that. It's not something you get a say in, Haruki-kun…"
The first time I realized that Setsuna would never admit any fault in me was back then.
"The three of us can be together…"
"I just wanted the three of us to stay together forever. I didn't want to be left out by those I cared about."
"No, I want the three of us to be together. So nothing's actually over between us…"
"Let's go, Haruki-kun. The three of us aren't finished yet."
Right now, we're sharing the memories about the same place, and the same time.
But that is not a coincidence.
Because the situation back then and right now are far too similar to each other.
"That's right… because that's precisely what I've always wanted since the beginning."
"Let's go back to when it was just Kazusa, you and me. Let's go back to that day… before the school festival."
Five years have passed… yet Setsuna is still the same.
"Kazusa went away because of me, so I thought I could never see it come to fruition."
She decides that everything is her own fault, and comes up with these contrived reasons to show why I'm faultless.
"That's why I thought I could replace it with a different kind of happiness with just the two of us. I believed we could live together…"
Always putting herself in the worst position.
"No, that's not it! I'm not sad that it's not possible, I don't feel regret."
"Because all we have to do is… wrap ourselves in a happiness that's even greater than what we had five years ago."
"So please, Haruki-kun. Let me join you two… don't leave me out of your company…!"
Because I love Setsuna too much to keep the balance even between the three of us.
"No one would accept that kind of relationship."
"No one has to accept us. As long as the three of us are happy, I don't need anything else…"
Even so, if I were to force myself to accept the three of us being together, I won't be able to return to just the two of us ever again.
…And that goes for both Kazusa and Setsuna.
"You can't… Out of all people, you shouldn't be saying that, Setsuna."

I'd only end up making the two people I care about more than anyone else in the world completely miserable, chaining them to myself in a limbo where I'm closely tied to the both of them, yet also indecisive at the same time.
"I'll say it, let me say it… After all, I love both you and Kazusa, and this is finally our chance for us three to get back together."
"I'm… going to Vienna, so we can't be together anymore."
So I'll have to make the choice, the future without Setsuna.
…Even if it means I have to use different means… I cannot involve Setsuna in a future without light at the end of the tunnel.
Setsuna slowly puts her fingers on my shoulder.
If she embraced me, or kissed me, I wouldn't have the strength to push her away.
She doesn't get any closer than that; even now, she's trying her best to not cause me more trouble.
"Then, I'm going with. I'm going to Vienna with you!"
She's giving me up to Kazusa.
"From now on, I'll be with you, Haruki-kun… and Kazusa too. It's okay, I promise I won't be a burden to you."
Without questioning how unreasonable Kazusa and I are being, she brings back all the guilt she was supposed to have thrown away two years ago.
If everything is her responsibility, then everything will be solved if she merely changes herself.
Those are the nightmarish delusions she is trying to convince herself of.
"Because you have a family, you have Io, and Yanagihara. You have so many others you have bonds with."
Even as I'm making a choice that will bring happiness to no one, she's denying it with a choice with an even more miserable outcome.
"Family, friends, my job… As long as I have you two, I don't need any of it…"
"Of course you do! There's just no way you'd be able to endure such a thing!"
If she makes such a depraved decision, she'll inevitably get hurt.
After all, Setsuna just isn't the kind of person who can live without interacting with others around her.
She's the kind of person who asks for help and helps others. The kind who supports others in their time of need, and lets others help her with her own weaknesses.
…Setsuna is, or rather, most people are like that…
Setsuna is the kind of person who can firmly plant her roots in this world… just like a normal person does.
That's why if she becomes uprooted from the earth… she'll be separated from the world and wither away.
"It's not just about you, it's about Kazusa too…"
"I'll fix all my shortcomings. I'll do my best without pushing it too hard. I'll have a proper talk with Kazusa. So please, please… please…!"
"You can't… because even if you try your hardest, Kazusa can't."
"Unh… ah… I won't steal you anymore… I won't take you away from Kazusa anymore…!"
Kazusa still loves you too. She has always loved you.
But… this is different. The "three of us" that you're thinking of is not the same as the one Kazusa is thinking of.
What you want is a "three of us" that exists in a broader world.
A group surrounded by warmth, and kindness… and sometimes sternness from loved ones. A vast, and proper way of life.
But that's not what Kazusa sees…
No matter how much she tried to broaden her horizons throughout these five years, it never worked out. The only places where she belonged was with Youko-san and within her memories.
The piano introduced Kazusa to a broader world, but it couldn't provide her with that world. …It's because she rejected it.
If Setsuna is a tree that plants roots, then Kazusa is a tumbleweed. It's just not possible for her to extend her roots and live firmly.
She must find water to sustain herself little by little as she goes, separated both from the ground and the world.
"It's only me. The only one she needs is me."
It's not a matter of whether I love her or not.
As someone who has lived in contact with the broad horizons of the world up until now, and as someone who can live without that world, I alone can be the water she needs. …That's all there is to it.
"Setsuna… you should just forget about me."
But there is no way Setsuna would understand even if I did tell her.
So all I can tell her are these words of farewell.
"I'm going with Kazusa… I'm going together with Kazusa."
There is no longer anyone but us two. I'll start living in a world for Kazusa alone.
If it means protecting Kazusa, I might be the only one coming into contact with the world.
But I won't bring that world with me back to Kazusa.
No one can enter the world for Kazusa and me.
"What are you doing here? What time do you think it is?"
I don't remember if it was me or Setsuna who left first.
I don't even remember which road I used to return here.
Yet, before I knew it, I was in front of my apartment.
And late in the night, well after midnight, someone was waiting for me in the freezing entranceway.
It was Kazusa who was waiting for me outside the door, breathing warm air into her world-famous hands…
"I was waiting in the apartment, but you wouldn't come home. And when I called you, you weren't answering."
"So I went outside for a bit to see if I could pick you up at the station, but then I was worried I might have missed you on the way, so I rushed back."
"When I saw you still weren't back, I decided to sulk in bed but I couldn't fall asleep, so I went back to waiting."
"Then… that cycle repeated itself about five times."
"If you have that much free time on your hands, then just go to sleep. Your concert is only a week away."
What an idiot… How counterproductive can she be?
"Yeah, but we were taking turns. What happened to your face, Haruki…?"
"Oh, right! You want a drink of this? I bought it in the convenience store just earlier."
"I don't know what you're talking about…"
"Tell me, what happened? You're injured, and you're carrying a bottle of wine."
"I considered drinking it on the way home, but…"
"I remembered I hadn't fed you yet."
"…What time do you think it is?"
But that part of her dragged me out a little from the pit of despair.
"You went out and got yourself hurt again without telling me, didn't you? And not just your face, but your heart too."
"…I don't know what you're talking about."
…She shouldn't do this. Providing relief to the person who deserves nothing but condemnation.
"Don't go and make things harder for yourself without telling me. You don't belong to yourself anymore."
"You mean to say that 'my body' doesn't belong to 'only' myself anymore. Don't neglect the important parts."
"It's the same thing. You're mine now."
I'm sure Setsuna's breaking into tears right now. And I've caused the smiles of the Ogiso family to disappear.
Everything is my fault, yet I'm the one being comforted.
"Like always, you make things harder for everyone. Not just for other people, because you don't even hold back against yourself. That makes you the biggest bully there is."
"If you think I'm hurt, shouldn't you console me with a bit more kindness?"
But because you keep clinging on to me, I can't help finding solace in you.
"Well… the one where you hug me softly without saying a word."
I can't help trying to obtain what I'm not allowed to desire.
"…If you let me, I won't go easy on you."
I'll end up showing cracks in my resolve.
"I'll hug you with all my heart. I'll kiss you with such fervor that I won't be able to stop until we've gone all the way, you know."
"I'll make you forget about everything, you know?"
"…That's what guys are supposed to say."
"Until you give me the go-ahead… I'll sit obediently and wag my tail for you. I'll keep waiting while anxiously thinking about when you'll come for me."
I think I heard her purr for a second.
Perhaps she was sensitive to that crack in my resolve, so that at the first sight of it, a switch went off inside of her.
Her lust for me, her desire to save me.
Those two intense desires that exist within Kazusa.
"…Just kidding. Like you'd have the guts to do that."
"You have no guts, but you're strong. You don't have the slightest need for my kindness."
"Well, I'll be waiting. If you ever feel like you want me, just say the word. I'll never reject you again."
But as I thought, she's showing such restraint for my sake. Her way of showing that she prioritizes my feelings over anything else.
No matter what Kazusa does, it's always about me, me, me…
There may no longer be a person by the name of Touma Kazusa who doesn't live under my shadow.
"Anyway, come in. Not like it's my apartment or anything, though."
For some reason, she tried to make sure.
The moment we entered the apartment, I hugged her from behind so tightly she couldn't move, yet she was the one who asked if it's okay.
"Will you be able to hold back? Will you be able to forgive yourself?"
To most people, her question wouldn't make any sense.
Because it looks like I'm about to take her by force, yet her only worry is for me.
That innocence once again permeates my brain, and little by little, the pain in my heart goes numb.
"…If you're going to hug me, I'd prefer if you'd take off your boots first. We won't be able to make it to the bed like this."
I'm not allowed to feel this kind of solace, yet…
Kazusa's body is so soft and warm. It smells so good.
"So… let me go, for ten seconds only."
I could push her down with all my force and lean my body over her. I could experience the sensation of her body.
I could take off her jacket almost as if tearing it off, and I could force my hands through the opening to grope her soft, round breasts.
I could put my other hand down her skirt and feel around her thighs, her butt, and her most important place. I could put my finger inside every cavity she has and press it in.
"I'm… finally of some use to you."
But even then, Kazusa would continue to withdraw her strength, and close her eyes with a warm sigh. She'd still try to accept me with her entire being.
"I can save you… even if for a little bit."
Even knowing how short lived the moment will be…
Kazusa would still see serving as nothing more than a painkiller to me as something happy.
"…Well, in a sense I knew this would happen."
I apologized, not for taking her by force, but for not doing so.
"I know it would bring me relief to make love to you. I know I would feel overwhelmed with happiness, but…"
I swore that I wouldn't lust after Kazusa while we were still in Japan. That we wouldn't cultivate our love until everything here is settled.
No matter how pointless it is in the end. Even if it brings absolutely no one any happiness…
If I break this vow, I can't be certain I won't break further, more important vows in the future. I'll continue living as dishonestly as I always have.
"Haruki… you really are stupid. You're obstinate, beyond stubborn, and you always argue about every little thing… You're completely beyond saving."
"I'm sorry, Kazusa… Every time I lose my way, call me out on it."
"It's fine. I'm used to your blue-balling at this point. And besides…"
"It's because you're like this that there's a purpose in me hugging you like this."
Despite everything wrong with me, Kazusa accepts me unconditionally.
We don't seek to improve each other, to correct each other's faults.
Without changing, without improving, we affirm and accept each other.
"Then at least cry in my arms. Let me be of some use."
There is no future. We don't need it.
As long as this moment can last forever, everything will be fine.
"Let's be… happy together, the two of us."
Then we will be able to live in happiness forever.
All while trampling on everyone else important to us…
No, it's precisely because we've had to trample on them that we alone have to find our happiness.
The amount of suffering we've caused to so many people would have been for nothing otherwise.
"Leave it to me, Haruki. This time… I'll be the one protecting you."
For a while, I listened in drowsiness to Kazusa's whispers.
At that moment, I couldn't tell if I was crying or not.
"I heard from Miyoko-san. She said you were hospitalized again."
"Only a precaution. I'm making sure I improve my health enough to be present for your concert."
"Thanks, I guess… Hey, has that flowerpot been washed?"
"I'm checking on my sick mother. What else does it look like I'm doing?"
"Seeing you come with a bouquet of flowers is so out of place it's actually scary. Did Nori-kun tell you something? Perhaps he told you that I had only a month to live or something?"
"Are you that weirded out by seeing me not come empty-handed? How little faith could you possibly have in your daughter?"
"Anyway, I'll go get the flowers planted. I'll be right back."
"Tell one of the nurses to do that for you. I won't have you cutting yourself on the flower thorns."
"That you bought back that old ruin."
"…Actually, I never managed to get anyone to buy it, so all I did was get it back from the real estate agency…"
"Yes, it wasn't cheap. And considering the state it's in, I'll have to spend a fortune on renovation too, since someone decided to break the windows."
"Ooh, I wonder what horrible person could have done such a thing. A burglar, maybe?"
"Didn't you come to give me hell for that?"
"It's not like I have the right to complain about how you spend your own money. It's not like you've made a fortune on me either."
"That's not what I was trying to say. Are you doing this on purpose?"
"Once the renovations are done, I'm going back there. I'm not going back to Vienna anymore."
"I had actually planned to live there with you."
"That's amazing. If that actually happened, it would be the greatest thing you've achieved in eight years."
"So you did come here to give me a piece of your mind, huh?"
"…Sorry, that came out by instinct. I didn't come here to say that. In fact, I came to say the opposite."
"…I see. You're going back to Vienna."
"…I understand your reasoning and your feelings. And I know that I should be there for you, as family, but…"
"I can't be in Japan anymore because… I did something unspeakable here."
"You're going to take him with you, aren't you?"
"It's okay, I don't want you to congratulate me so miserably. I'm fully aware of just what I did."
"Yet your entire body is radiating happiness. You're practically floating. The complete opposite of what he was like."
"Yesterday, he escorted me to the hospital. Miyo-chan was gone on a different errand."
"That explains it… So you already know everything. About my decision."
"Not even your mother was capable of stealing a man like that in her glory days."
"It's all my fault. It's all because I'm so weak…"
"I'm always relying on you because I'm weak, yet I know you're no longer in any condition to help me, which makes me even more helpless…"
"So in the end, I made the worst possible decision."
"…The worst possible decision for everyone except for you, that is. And of course, he is no exception."
"Kazusa, you'll make him… and everyone around him unhappy. All because of this childish, romanticized love you have."
"I'll accept anything that comes my way."
"…Then don't look so happy. If the others were to see you like this, they'd lose their minds."
"I was kidding. I was just a bit annoyed by my daughter, who loves a boy ten times more than her own mother."
"…Well, it's fine. You'll make it up for me by giving it your all on the next concert."
"Only three days now. How are you feeling?"
"I feel great. I could go on stage right now and play."
"It'll be my last concert in Japan… and I won't leave behind any regrets."
"I suppose it'll be the last time I can hear you play in person too…"
"…I feel a bit tired. Could you give me some time to rest?"
"Okay. I have to go back to the studio anyway. I'll be back."
"Alright then… I'm looking forward to your concert."
"Even though we might be separated, even though I'm the daughter who abandoned you and ran away…"
"…Would you still love Touma Kazusa even if she wasn't a pianist anymore?"
"Then why did you bring that up all of a sudden?"
"Just a theoretical question, and a completely pointless one… See you."
"…And the tour documents are in this folder. I've set it up so you can find the instructions in these documents."
"Here is a list containing the contact information for those working on the project. I'll leave you their business cards too…"
"They said you were done with your special cover."
"Yes, and it's all proof-read too. All that's left is to wait for it to be published."
"So that means, once you're done teaching me all this, you're not coming back…"
"…I'll still be an employee here until March. We can take our time and make sure you're fit to take over for me this coming month."
"Don't treat me like an idiot. I've been working here two years longer than you. I can learn all of this stuff by next week."
Ten days after my sudden resignation.
As a desperate measure by my unhappy superiors, all my work is being temporarily transferred to Matsuoka-san.
"The hard part will be once you're gone. You know my workload will be doubled because of this? And our editing department doesn't have any plans for recruitment yet."
Once this measure was decided on, thinking that no one else would accept such an assignment, Matsuoka-san looked a bit deep in thought and eventually stepped forward.
"After all, no one could have imagined last year that we'd have someone hop off from Kaiou Graph. The recruitment period ended long ago."
Of course, he didn't forget to glare at me the moment he accepted it.
"Hamada-san is doing his best to come to a solution with HR, but for now, we'll have to live with increasing the workload."
"I'm really sorry for causing such a mess…"
"I have no idea what kind of family situation you're dealing with… But to me, I can see this as nothing else but you just pushing your job on someone else and hightailing it."
"I heard you said no to a farewell party."
"Because this isn't a respectable resignation… and I doubt anyone would come."
Ever since it was made known I was resigning, the air around the editing department has taken a nosedive.
"How could you possibly know that? Isn't it because you're always building walls between yourself and others, that no one can come up to you and talk?"
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. Suzuki-san has stopped chatting, and Kizaki-san has been exclusively focused on work.
"God, you irritate the hell out of me. You were always like this, but ever since you decided to quit, you've worsened tenfold!"
And practically the only person who will talk to me… Or rather, the only person who has no choice but to talk to me for work related reasons, is Matsuoka-san, and he's been in a sour mood every time.
He continuously points out all the problems with me that I'm only too well aware of, and unable to respond to.

Couple the disappearance of chatter from the editing department with the passing of the deadline for the Air Pocket, and you would find the office so quiet that you could wonder whether this is a publishing office at all.
"Don't you feel the slightest desire to make this up to me? You've robbed me of all my days off from next month on."
"If… there is anything I can do."
This is another thing my decision brought along. Another fragment of the world I destroyed.
If I could even slightly make up for this, I'll…
"Good… once your quota is done for today, we're going for a drink."
"You're paying for my drink, of course. After pushing all your work on me, that's only natural."
I was prepared to face any form of abuse…
"In exchange, I'll pay for your drink. I am the guest of honor at your farewell party, after all."
"Isn't that… just called splitting the bill?"
"Shut up and don't worry about the details. Are you coming or not? And don't talk back to me, rookie."
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. Suzuki-san has stopped chatting, and Kizaki-san has been exclusively focused on work.
"You'll regret thanking me, you know. I'll be throwing abuse at you every second of the way."
He glares at me with a stern expression, and hits me lightly on the shoulder.
"So I'm sorry, but I'll be back late today. I'll come home once I'm done drinking, so about dinner…"
"Ah, I got it. I'll eat something outside."
"Be careful about what you eat, okay? Make sure to get plenty of vegetables, and avoid alcohol and sweet foods. Your concert is tomorrow."
"You sound more like my mother than my mother. That's why people get so jealous of you."
"Anyway, I got it. Go with your friends; it's your farewell party, isn't it? …Let yourself loose every now and then."
"Okay… I'll do that. I'm sorry for not being with you on the day before your concert."
"I'm fine. More importantly, you should go and have fun."
"Ah, by the way… when can I enter the venue tomorrow?"
"I'll begin by afternoon. We may end up passing each other."
"Can I wake you up before going to work tomorrow? I just want to spend some time talking to you."
"Okay, got it. I'll go to sleep early then."
"Um, uhm… for asking you to come at this hour."
"Ah… if that's your concern, I'm always free."
"But you still live at home with your parents…"
"Don't worry. I've been away from home ever since last week. I'm living in a business hotel."
"…They're annoying, my family. I don't want to see them."
"Now of all times, I'm starting to understand what you meant all those years ago, Kazusa. I really wish they'd leave me alone."
"But you're way more important right now! Your additional concert is tomorrow, right?"
"Your concert last month was a massive success. Don't you feel pressure from having to live up to it?"
"…I think I'll be fine this time. My practice is completely done, so all that is left is a good night's sleep and I'll be ready."
"I see… How wonderful. Yeah, I'm really glad! Do your absolute best! Aaah, I won't be able to come see you. I'm so sorry!"
"I couldn't tell who you were at first, and your hairstyle is completely different. But as expected, you look good in everything."
"O-Oh, this is just for show. People kept recognizing me, so…"
"Wow, you really hit it big, huh! You're famous throughout Japan now."
"But I haven't really changed at all…"
"That's not true! After all, you won a prize in the Giovanni International Competition."
"Yeah, but I didn't even make the top three, let alone win it. Besides, I wonder if anyone even knows the names of the winners."
"But you were still in the highest position as someone from Japan. That will spark a fuss over here, obviously."
"That's not true. It's because I'm Youko's daughter. It's because my last name is Touma, that's all."
"No, that's not all. It's your own talent that brought you this far, Kazusa. Nothing else."
"It is true! You have so much."
"You have your piano, your trophies, your looks. Not to mention, you even have… you even have…"
"Before I knew it, everything became yours…"
"Oh, there he is! What's up? Having fun?"
As the two of us were drinking at the bar we always used to visit, a voice calls out to us in a familiar tone.
"I was just about to tell this guy how selfish and inconsiderate he is. How incapable he is of doing his job and how he is practically the worst person who ever lived."

"You're the last person who can judge someone for being inconsiderate, Macchan. Ah, well, I suppose it's only fair since you got the shortest end of the stick in all this. I'll have a beer too, by the way."
But for her to be the one who happened to join in, was far too unlikely…
"This whole thing was actually Suzuki-san's idea. My task was to drag you out here."
"Because if we asked you about an official farewell party, you'd go stubborn on us and say no."
"That's not what I wanted to ask…"
Ever since I said I was quitting, the air around the editing department has been heavy.
Hamada-san has become more irritable with his subordinates. And Suzuki-san, who's now in front of me, has stopped chatting.
"Obviously, this doesn't mean everything is settled. Because it's clearly not."
"You went ahead and quit without even saying why. It'd be odd if we didn't get mad at you for that. Had you been our superior and something like this happened, you'd chew us out the whole day."
Even so, these two seniors of mine who I rarely have conversations with are right next to me now, and they're making merry at my farewell party as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
"When we were out drinking yesterday, I cursed your name with every bad word in the book. That's why I can keep my mouth shut and see you off today."
He's accepting my selfishness, along with the senior who was always so strict with me.
"We don't want to end this with a bad taste in our mouths. If we count your time here as a part-timer, we've been working together as friends for over three years."
"That's precisely the reason I'm so pissed you're just leaving without saying a word…"
"But I'm sure you spent a lot of time thinking it over, with a fervor to last you a lifetime. You're that kind of guy, after all."
"This one is for Kitahara-kun, and his fortune in his future endeavors."
"What do you mean, 'what for'…? Well, you know…"
"Why do you look so hesitant? You're not acting like the beautiful genius pianist who's the hot topic of Japan right now."
"Then, I'll say it clearly… I'm sorry for taking what's yours, Setsuna."
"I'm sorry for being so bad at giving up. I'm sorry for betraying you in the worst possible way… I'm sorry for loving Haruki after all this time…"
"There really is no reason for you to apologize about anything. Hehe, ahaha…"
"I already knew. I knew that your feelings hadn't changed, Kazusa."
"I always knew, for these past five years. I knew that if you and Haruki-kun were to meet each other again, this would happen."
"But you know what? I've found a way for all three of us to be happy. So you don't have to worry."
"We can just… be together, all three of us, forever."
"So you don't need to apologize at all. After all, we're all going to become happy."
"…That's impossible, Setsuna. That's just a dream of yours."
"Why…? We managed it back then, so why not…?"
"What are you talking about…? We didn't manage at all back then!"
"I couldn't bear seeing you two together. That's why I ran away in the first place!"
"No matter how fun it was being with you two, before I knew it, I found myself jealous of you. I detested you."
"No matter how much I love you, seeing you with Haruki… seeing the two of you in love with each other just isn't something I can abide by…"
"That's why I can't be with you from now on either. I have no choice but to take Haruki away from you, even if that means…"
"Are you sure you're not just overthinking it?"
"…The Haruki-kun you desire, is he really the actual Haruki-kun?"
"Isn't the Haruki-kun you know something you constructed in your head during the five years you spent away from him? Like an idol?"
"All this time, I've known the real Haruki-kun."
"For three years, I was always looking at him from a distance. For two years, I was by his side."
"Setsuna… didn't you just say so yourself? That you knew my feelings wouldn't change?"
"Even if your feelings haven't changed, Haruki-kun has changed. Why can't you understand that?"
"Are you saying that my feelings are a lie…? Are you saying I'm just deluded…?"
"Then tell me, Kazusa, how many of Haruki-kun's weak points do you know?"
"I know all about his bad aspects, his weaknesses… And even more so, I know about all his good aspects, his wonderful aspects. I can't even count them."
"Unlike the man you carefully constructed in your dreams for five years… my Haruki-kun is real."
"Are you telling me… I don't know the real Haruki?"
"Are you joking? Do you think that the ideal man I made up in my head could make me feel so much suffering, to make me cry?"
"Would the ideal man hesitate so much before accepting me? Would he go through so much pain for choosing me!?"
"Even if these past five years have been nothing but a dream, these past few days I have been struggling against reality…"
"And I wasn't crushed between the gap of ideal and reality."
"I love Haruki as he is now…"
"I love Haruki-kun as he is now, too."
"I love how he still hasn't changed at all when it comes to being by the book in every little thing!"
"The way he only fights harder when he's suffering. How little by little, he becomes kinder and stronger… And every time he changes, I fall in love with him all over again."
"I already knew, but… we can never go back to how things were, can we?"
"So all I can do is to atone…"
"You have no reason to apologize to me. Hehe, ahaha…"
"Because after all, I found a solution that will make all three of us happy. So it's okay, it's all going to be okay!"
"We can just… be together, all three of us, forever."
"I won't deny your feelings… I approve of you two being together."
"After all, I'm the one in the wrong. I betrayed you five years ago, and I caused Haruki-kun pain…"
"I wasn't asking about that! We already finished talking about that!"
"Was I saying strange things? Was I incomprehensible?"
"Everyone's been telling me that the past few days."
"They say that I forget what I just said and repeat myself, or that I contradict my own words."
"I wonder what's going on. Maybe I've lost it…"
"Ahaha… you don't have to be so considerate. The truth is, I'm also somewhat aware of how I've been acting."
"Before I know it, I sometimes find myself completely forgetting what people just said to me, or what I just said to them."
"Just earlier, when I hung up a call I had with someone, I completely forgot what the call was about. I can't go to work like this."

"That's why they took away some responsibilities from me at work yesterday. They told me to take the day off and go visit a doctor, and that they wouldn't allow me to do anything important for a while."
"So… did you go? To the hospital, I mean."
"Hey, what do you think, Kazusa? Have I really lost it completely?"
"How could I possibly know that? Please, let's go to the hospital, okay?"
"I suppose I don't mind being so broken, though…"
"After all, if I break down completely… If I forget everything, I'll be unable to go on living without him."
"If I do that, do you think Haruki-kun will reconsider? Do you think he'll hesitate a little bit for my sake…?"
"Don't say that… Don't ever say that!"
"What do you think, Kazusa? Can I ever win against you?"
"I don't know, I don't know, I don't know…! All I know is that he'll suffer again if you do that."
"As if you had any right to say that… After chasing him into a corner in the first place?"
"He told me that there is no point in talking about what could have been. That those possibilities never came true, so there is no point in considering them."
"Then, in that case… If I really…"
"Not just him… I'll suffer too. I'll be frantically wondering about what I'm supposed to do!"
"Despite that, I'll never give up on Haruki again."
"Kept you waiting! Sorry, Karasawa-sensei always keeps me tied up for as long as he can."
A few minutes after our second toast…
"You're late! I almost thought you weren't coming!"
"You'll want a beer to start off, right? Excuse me, we'll have two more of this!"
And before we know it, we share our third toast.
"I'm really sorry, Kitahara. To think I'd be late for your farewell party."
Recently, he has been focused on nothing but his work, and even when we passed each other by, he never said a word.
Ah, perhaps these two gave you hell already?"
He gives me a light tap on the back like he used to, and looks at me with a vague smile just like he used to.
"Macchan's horrible, isn't he? By the time I arrived, he had already made Kitahara-kun cry. I got in between them and have been doing my best to comfort him."
"That's the complete opposite of what happened! The atmosphere got really heavy the moment you arrived. It felt like you held a grudge against him to last two lifetimes."
"Aa-ah, you two are the worst. How about some compassion?"
"That's not… what happened. I'm the one in the wrong."
"…Come on, you can't react so seriously or you'll kill the joke."
"…I forgot. This is Kitahara-kun we're talking about. He can't understand self-deprecating humor to save his life."
"Alright you guys, don't pick on him. In return, I'll cover the entire bill for tonight… is what Hamada-san told me to tell you."
"Alright, now that everyone's here, let's give a toast to Hamada-san!"
The person who should have been the most dismayed, after having an employee under his care quit without giving a single reason…
"He really wanted to come tonight too, but considering his circumstances, I hope you'll forgive his absence…"
He kept everything closed off in his chest, and now he does this without saying anything.
"Come on, now. Now you're the one picking on Kitahara right after you lectured us, Kizaki-san."
"You haven't even been here a minute and you already made him cry. I swear, the men in our department are such terrible bullies."
"Why don't you just go home? We're never going to agree on anything."
"No matter what you tell me, I'm probably just going to forget it in a few minutes."
"So you should go home now. Nothing will be solved here, anyway."
"Listen to me anyway! You can look the other way, ignore me; you can even forget about it later."
"I love you, Setsuna. I love you, and I respect you."
"You were the perfect person from the moment we met. You were strong and straightforward, just like… no, even more than Haruki."
"I was afraid of just how perfect you were, Setsuna. And I was dazzled by your radiance."
"After all, I'm the kind of person who does everything wrong. I'm the complete opposite of you, Setsuna."
