So I slowly reach out my hand, and stand up as if desiring her.
So I can cry in her chest.
"Let's do this again. …I'm Ogiso from the public relations department of Knights Records. I'll be under your care from here on."

"…Well, I suppose we've finally put proper pleasantries away for the time being. That aside, this really is an amazing room, isn't it～? How many tens of thousands of yen does this place charge per night?"
"I've stayed in a high-class hotel myself before, but I've only ever been given an average guest room… and I was still charged 20000 yen per night, you know?"
"Ah, I suppose this is just devolving into small talkーI'm sorry. My mother's very particular when it comes to costs and money like that, so I guess I've gradually taken after her as well."
"Why have you come here? Did you come here to look down on me?"
"Did you come here to laugh at me? To berate me? Or perhaps… are you saying you've come here because you pity me?"
"I came here… to talk. That's really all I'm here for."
"You're mad at me for what I did, aren't you? You have no intention of forgiving me, do you?"
"That's right… I'm still upset at you for how you've never tried to contact me even once despite having the rare opportunity to return here."
"…B-But you know full well that I couldn't possibly have done something like that…"
"Aa-ah, I really wanted to get in touch with you. Your old phone number doesn't work anymore, after all, and more importantly, you didn't even want to take the initiative to contact me at all."
"You're not even going to deny what I just said. Aa-ah, I'm actually a bit shocked…"
"So is this your way of getting your revenge? To see my miserable state for yourself… to mock my ugly self for retaining my feelings?"
"Why do you have to think about things so negatively…?"
"Because, because…! The one who told you where I'm staying was Haruki, wasn't it!?"
"…Correct. It wasn't hard to figure out, you know."

"In other words, the both of you had a blast laughing about me, didn't you!? About how ridiculous it was for a girl to agonize over a past she can't let go of, and how she's been acting like some stalker!"
"…If anything, I feel that Haruki-kun fits both of those descriptions better, though."
"See, you can't even respond to me! So it is true, isn't it!?"
"…Anyway, let's talk about what I came here to discuss. We won't get anywhere beating around the bush with this topic like that."
"…! What do you mean when you say we won't be going anywhere? Setsuna, you really are here to make a fool out of me…"
"Currently, our company is responsible for the production of the bonus CD 'Touma Kazusa Mini-Album' in Kaiousha's Ensemble's special issue."
"So today I've come to introduce myself and to confirm our schedule. Let's go over the track list in detail. After all, since you have a concert at the same time, our schedule is pretty tight."

"By the way, we will cover the entire cost this time, because to be truthful, our intention with this whole thing is to earn a favor with you for when your own CD is released here in Japan eventually."
"Your terms for this contract are really strict, Kazusa. I bet all the record labels that specialize in classical music are after a contract with you."
"For the sake of his own work… and to curry your favor, Setsuna… he sold me out, didn't he!?"
"A-After all… after all, if that wasn't the case, then this wouldn't be happening…!"
"…If that's what you believe, then you can go ahead and believe that… If you truly do believe your own words, that is."
"Still, it was Touma Youko-san… the president of the company you're affiliated with who decided this in the first place. So this is an official contract."
"Even… mom? You're telling me that even my mother's abandoned me…?"
"Why don't you ask her that yourself? …Youko-san was really worried about you, you know."
"She had her doubts, of course. It was Haruki-kun who managed to persuade Youko-san and make her give this job over to us."
"It'll be an impossible undertaking involving three friends… and three companies, Kaiousha, Knights Records, and Touma Youko Office."
"We sent out the proposal on Monday, and we got our go-ahead this morning. Even for a mere Mini-Album coming with a magazine, this really is something rare."
"I'm saying that when you're involved, common corporate logic goes out the window… That's the power you, Touma Kazusa, possess."
"I don't care about that… I don't want power like that…"
"You'd be happy by simply having the person you love look at you? …You'd be happy as long as Haruki-kun reciprocated your feelings?"
"Kazusa… you truly do love Haruki-kun, don't you?"
"Fufu… Did I guess right? …Not that I'd ever have to guess."
"…Oh, just stop it now. It's not fair that you're acting so adorably."
"No wonder Haruki-kun felt lost at the sight of that expression. No wonder he'd never want to let go of you again, Kazusa…"
"I assume you understand the gist of the scope of our work, then?"
"That's enough, just go home already! I'm not taking a job like this. It's impossible!"
"…I understand, I'll head home for the time being. I actually only wanted to introduce myself today anyway."
"Now, that won't do. The clock is ticking, after all, and we need to finish getting everything recorded before your additional concert."
"That's… that's just physically impossible. There are only two weeks left."
"Two weeks left… I do remember something like that happening in the past."
"Well then, good night. Ah, I'll leave this here. You can help yourself to it if you're hungry."
"I don't want it. Just take it and leave."
"I really didn't add anything weird in there, you know? Though I guess I can't guarantee that it'll taste good considering I made it myself…"
"Do whatever you want, just hurry and disappear already…"
"I understand… well then, good night. …See you tomorrow."
"I told you not to come back again!"
"Seems I'm up to a rough start."
"Is this really going to be okay? Am I really the right person for this?"
"…What am I saying? I can't sound resigned just after one day."
"Io and the others must be really mad at me, huh?"
"Isn't it supposed to be her birthday?"
"Why would she come all the way here on such an important day…?"
Setsuna is looking at me with a compassionate gaze.
So I slowly reach out my hand, and stand up as if desiring her.
So I can cry in her chest.
Setsuna is right in front of me right now.
My hands only need to reach out to her ever so slightly to touch her right now.
Setsuna's gaze is fixed upon me.
She watches me attentively, waiting for what I'm about to say next.
No matter what happens, and no matter how much I whine, she'll forgive it all right now. She'll envelop me in her warmth.
Those feelings of hers are conveyed to me.
"I'm begging you, Setsuna… please save Kazusa!"
I repress the urge to leap into her embrace, and only cling to her with those words.
I plead with her to save Kazusa.
"The way Kazusa is now, anything I say will only end up hurting her…"
Because she's the one and only person Kazusa considers to be her friend.
"That's why I… can only ask you for help."
So many things happened, and now I have no choice but to rely on her… but they did once swear eternal friendship to each other.
Before I know it, Setsuna hangs her head.
Both her gentle gaze and her hands preparing to take me into her embrace are now aimed at the ground.
Not even I am thickheaded or selfish enough to not understand how Setsuna is feeling right now.
Though by asking her this despite knowing her feelings, I'm probably proving that I truly am thickheaded, and selfish.
"…! Aa-ah, it's just as I thought!"
"Just as I thought, you value Kazusa over yourself, Haruki-kun! You don't feel as though you need to be saved at all!"
"You asked me to save Kazusa. You didn't ask me… to save you."
Setsuna raises both her head and her voice, and I can see her strong expression, one that suggests she's given up on something, one that suggests that she has gotten over something.
"I knew… The truth is, I've known from the very beginning. I know that you value Kazusa more than yourself… more than anyone, Haruki-kun."
Her expression looks as if she's fed up with me, as if she's used up all her patience, as if she's given up on me.
"And… I actually think that's true… Kazusa really is more important than anything else right now."
But her reaction still makes it unclear to me about how she truly feels about me.
"That's why, if you had decided that you value yourself most… and ended up asking me to spoil you, I would've slapped you. That was what I decided from the very beginning."
She simply remains bright and cheerful.
"Still, still, you know… although you ended up doing the right thing, I still feel frustrated about it!"
And she's not hiding the fact that she's holding back…
"It's frustrating to know that even after five years, even though you haven't even met her for five years… The person you love the most hasn't changed at all, Haruki-kun!"
"No… it won't change no matter how much time passes…"
"No… how could I… No, I'm sorry, Setsuna."
My feelings toward Setsuna, and what I think of herーthey're not insignificant at all…
"I won't tell you that there's no need for you to apologize, you know?"
But right now… I can't contradict her last statement, when I know the others are all true.
"I wouldn't show that much sympathy toward a person who refused to look at only me for five whole years, you know."
"I'll obey your decision after everything's taken care of. That's why…"
Setsuna has admitted it herselfーKazusa is more important than anyone else right now…
"Let's seriously think about what the two of us can do for Kazusa's sake, okay?"
That's why, for now… I seal away the conclusion that I finally came to.
It's not just me, but Setsuna too… and the two of us will now think of nothing but Kazusa's happiness.
"Mother and daughter of the Touma family, Youko and Kazusa… are right now perfect for Japanese record labels to use to up their sales."
"All of that is due to my mother's efforts. I'm simply riding on the back of her fame…"
"That's not entirely true… You're really leading when it comes to popularity, Kazusa. People aren't interested in you for your actual skill right now, you see."

"People simply know you as a beautiful and cool girl playing the piano. Even those who initially had no interest in classical music would be interested if that girl is the daughter of a once-famous pianist."
"Huh? Did I strike a nerve? Now that's odd. Both Youko-san and Haruki-kun said that you said so yourself…"
"No one ever said I was mad…"
"Or are you saying that you don't like hearing it from others? From me in particular?"
"I just said… I'm not mad at all."
"But you know, I don't mind that at all. Regardless of whether you're a true genius or whether you're just a fluke, I want to release your first Japanese CD, no matter what it takes."
"As a company… your skill as a pianist is not actually relevant to us."
"I work in the public relationship department of a record company, you know? We actually do survey public opinion on our products… so I'm pretty sure we're meeting the market demand with this one."
"A little while ago, the release of a manga managed to make classical music a small trend in Japan."
"Well, the people who were into it back then gradually had their passion wane bit by bit, given that the trend only started last year."
"And from there, after searching, we ended up chancing upon the beautiful descendant of a pianist who won a prize at the Giovanni Competition…"
"In other words, I'm the new panda at the zoo that will bring the customers in…"
"…Setsuna. You've been doing this on purpose all this time, haven't you…?"
"Still, being a zoo panda is quite an amazing job, don't you think?"
"How exactly…? Getting money off fame without doing anything is no different from scamming others."
"Still, if the panda happens to be popular, doesn't that mean that the zoo gets more visitors?"
"Like I said, what does that have to do with…"
"If we managed to gather a lot of guests for a classical concert, wouldn't that be pretty beneficial for a lot of people?"
"It could be helpful for professionals who can't fund their own performances, or perhaps students who can't study abroad despite wanting to…"
"You're really expanding the scale of this conversation… So you're not planning for me to be a panda in a zoo, but instead the cornerstone of Japan's classical music industry?"
"Sacrificing yourself to pave the way for truly talented people… that's another path you could take, is it not?"
"Are you saying that… I'm not talented at all?"
"Not at all… I'm simply saying that neither I nor my company know or care about your talent."
"…Your attempts at provoking me won't work. You think you could just say something like that and I'll get worked up and play for you?"
"Who knows? I was simply trying to lighten the mood, you know?"
"…Go home. I won't agree to do it no matter what you say."
"So, no matter how many times you come here…"
"I'll still be coming here tomorrow, though. This is still part of my job, after all."
"Well, then… that's just how it is, so let's wrap things up for today, shall we?"
"If you hate me, just be honest and say it… stop using work as an excuse."
"Just stop beating around the bush and just say it… Say that you despise me from the bottom of your heart. If you continue to keep things so vague like this, I…"
"Only if you tell me your true feelings first."
"You know, Kazusa… tell me that you won't take this job because you hate me, and I'll let you know my true feelings as well, alright?"
"If you want others to be honest with you, you have to be honest with others first, Kazusa. …You were really honest with Haruki-kun, after all."
"Ah, by the way… I'll be taking back the container I brought the cake for you in yesterday."
"Wow… you managed to finish it all in a single day. There was an entire cake in this thing, you know?"
"T-That's, um… I mean, it was made with fresh cream, wasn't it? It doesn't really last very long, so I felt I didn't have a choice…"
"Oh, Kazusa… hehe. You always were a bottomless pit when it comes to anything sweet."
"Yesterday… was your birthday, was it not?"
"Are you saying that… you want to congratulate me?"
"But then, why did you come here? Why didn't you celebrate it together with Haruki?"
"It was such an important day for you, Setsuna. It was supposed to be a precious day for the both of you, so why did you…"
"What's most important to the two of us right now isn't some party."
"It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Ogiso Setsuna."
"I'm sorry it took me so long to properly introduce myself. Still, I'm really happy that I finally get to meet Kazusa's mother in person."
"My name's Ogiso Setsuna. Please call me Setsuna."
"Then… nice to meet you, Setsuna-san. Um, about Kazusa… Thank you for constantly keeping an eye out for her, or perhaps I should say that I'm sorry for the trouble she's given you…"
"Not at all! I've been the one that's been troubling her, and since way back, too…"
"Ah, y-yes, umm… that's… hang on, Guitar-kun! What is the meaning of this!?"
"Ah, are you saying you're not feeling very well right now? If that's the case, we could just postpone this to some other time…"
"N-No, this is just cold sweat. My condition in itself is actually quite fine… I feel as if I've lost a couple of years, though."
It would seem that Youko-san and Setsuna's first meeting is proving to be an overwhelming victory for the latter.
In fact, Youko-san didn't even look this taken aback when she got the diagnosis on her illness…
"Ah, here's a gift from me… it's a moth orchid."
"T-Thank you… it smells lovely. It must've been expensive, huh?"
"You're not supposed to ask the price of a gift… Well, hehe, it was actually pretty cheap, though."
Youko-san is still unable to meet Setsuna's gaze; she instead tries to divert her attention to smelling the flowers.
I imagine that she hadn't expected that I would bring her along for this visit, much less the fact that I would bring her directly into her hospital room.
"I've heard about your illness. Perhaps this is a bit presumptuous of me, but I'll pray for you. So I hope that you'll do your best to recover… for Kazusa's sake as well."
In any case, given that everything Youko-san's done has been for Kazusa's sake, she doesn't really know much about Setsuna at all.
That's why it's probably difficult for her to digest the fact that Setsuna's right before her now, with a smile devoid of gloominess while saying these sincere words wishing her well…
"Are you two here to berate me?"
As I expected, Youko-san is now glaring at me as if asking for my help.
…In terms of how they express their feelings, they truly are mother and daughter.
"You've already talked to her about it, haven't you? About everything I've been doing for her up until now, that is."
"I see… so that's how it is. So that means you've chosen this girl."
"I understand, Guitar-kun. I respect the decision you've made. …Congratulations."
Self-deprecation, resignation, and a regret that cannot be restrained…
"I'll do something about my daughter… about Kazusa. I won't bother you with her anymore."
The very person who had once told me that I've been too meddling and said that I've been carrying too much on my shoulders is now unconsciously blaming me for my sudden retreat.
They truly are mother and daughter, given the similarity in their choice of words and in how they behave around others…
"As I thought, I am starting to feel a little tired. I'm sorry, but I think it's best that you two take your leave…"
That's why Setsuna's decided to take the first step.
"Nothing's over yet! Kazusa… I just know I'll be able to do something about Kazusa!"
She's realized that the person before her is very similar to Kazusa. She feels that she's worth fighting for.
"So please listen to my proposal. I'm sure Touma Youko Office will take interest in what I have to say."
"Allow me to introduce myself again. I'm Ogiso of Knights Records PLC."
"Touma Youko-san really is just as amazing as the rumors say. She was really overwhelming throughout our entire conversation."
"Still, unlike some other rumors, your mother is actually a really kind person who worries a lot about her child…"
"She missed you, you know? I suppose you haven't arranged a proper visit yet? If that's the case, we could go together tomorrow…"
"Oh, well. She said that she would be discharged by next week, anyway, so you could always visit her then."
"She looked quite healthy when I met her today, and she herself said that she's already feeling better, so I'm sure it'll all be alright, Kazusa."
"Yep, it'll all be alright! I'm sure someone like her will be able to overcome any illness she has."
"Ahaha… I suppose that did come off as a little rude. Still, she really does give off that kind of vibe, you know?"
"Ah, by the way, I see Youko-san calls Haruki-kun Guitar-kun, huh? Hey, is that something she picked up during the school festival…?"
"That my mom will always… that she'll live up until she's 100 years old?"
"That she'll make a complete recovery? That she'll take back what she said about retiring from playing the piano? That she'll go back to Vienna with me?"
"Can you promise that all that's going to happen, Setsuna? …On what basis can you claim that?"
"Do you even understand? Can you really understand what all this means to me, Setsuna? …Do you know what it would mean for me to lose my mother?"
"Lose…? That isn't set in stone yet."
"You're surrounded by your family, and you can laugh with them, enjoy meals with them, have parties with them, and talk to them about anything that's troubling you…"
"How could you possibly understand the fear of losing my only family member with all that you have, Setsuna!?"
"Your attempts at consolation are completely lost on me. It only irritates me to be pitied by someone who has absolutely everything."
"Come on, Setsuna… that's enough already, isn't it?"
"I know that I'm in the wrong here. So just stop trying to condemn me in such a roundabout way, okay?"
"I'll let you hit me as many times as you want, so just hurry up and get out of my sight already."
"And don't ever come back here again…"
"I suppose so… You're right, I might just be wrong."
"If I found out my mother had been stricken with a terrible illness… I bet I'd cry my heart out together with my dad and Takahiro…"

"And we'd keep on crying as we'd talk about it all night, even if we wouldn't be able to come to a conclusion. But when the time would come for us to visit mom in the hospital, we'd do so with smiles on our faces. Our eyes would be bloodshot and red, but we'd desperately try to smile for her…"

"Despite the fact she'd know full well how bad her illness is by then, and despite the fact that we'd know about it all the same… I feel like we would all keep on trying to play the part of, in your own words, Kazusa, 'a family.'"
"And maybe, just maybe, if that day should ever come… I'm sure that I'd feel as if it were the end of the world, just like how you're feeling right now, Kazusa."
"I'd feel sad, so sad, with my tears never stopping no matter how much I'd cry, and I wouldn't want to think about anything at all."
"If you really think so, then leave me alone…"
"But, for better or worse, it wouldn't actually be the end, you know?"

"We'd have to thank the medical staff that had been taking care of her, we'd have to consult the undertaker about where her funeral would be held… We'd have to reserve a funeral hall and contact all our relatives with the date of the wake and the funeral itself."

"And we'd be even busier on the day of the funeral itself, as we'd have to hear a word or two from each of our relatives and acquaintances that came… Then we'd have to make a list of everyone who attended the funeral to pay them back."
"I'd grieve really badly, you know? I'd really feel as though I wouldn't want to do anything. But even so, Iーweーsimply can't avoid having to connect with other people."
"And it's really more than just an unpleasant thing that we have to do."
"It's only through talking to other people that you'll be able to recover from the sadness that comes with the feeling that your whole world's been destroyed."
"And it's only when you're connected to others that, little by little, your world will start to heal."
"That's… only applicable to you, Setsuna. Things are different for me. I don't have anyone I can get close to."
"No, I don't! Once my mom is gone, there'll no longer be…"
"There's plenty of people around you that you can connect with, Kazusa. You simply never thought to look."
"No, there's no one left. I have no one left but my mother. And even she will end up leaving me before I know it…!"
"Neither of you are with me, and I don't need either of you! The two of you are living in a completely different world from mine!"
"Haruki has abandoned me. And you don't have any reason to stay by my side, Setsuna."
"I like you, Kazusa! Is me liking you not a good enough reason, Kazusa!?"
"…I see you still have that wonderful personality of yours, Setsuna. You think I'd ever believe such a convenient lie from you?"
"Why… do you have to think of it that way?"
"…Because I just know. I know just how filthy my own heart is."
"I fully believe that there's no one in this world that could ever come to care about someone as horrible as me!"
"But I do like you. I really do like you, Kazusa!"
"I don't believe you, I just don't. How could I ever!? There's no longer anyone who can promise to protect someone like me from the bottom of their heart!"
"There is someone here! And there's many more out there!"
"How could anyone even like such a horrible person like me!?"
"Who ever decided that it's impossible to like horrible people?"
"It's just impossible to like someone like that, isn't it!? After all… someone so deplorable… so cowardly…"
"Then why did you fall in love with Haruki-kun, Kazusa!? Someone so dishonest, deplorable and cowardly, why!?"
"You're… asking me that? And not her?"
As Setsuna momentarily left to plant the flower she'd brought, Youko-san suddenly stared at me with a bewildered expression for some reason.
"Yes, you… What are you to have managed to gain the love of such an amazing girl?"
In the end, what Youko-san truly wanted to know about wasn't about me, but about "that girl."
"I'm no one, really… I'm just an ordinary person. Setsuna just… has poor taste, that's all."
"Please don't criticize my own daughter's tastes with that statement."
"I understand now… Now I see why she felt that she was driven to the edge. She just doesn't stand a chance against that girl."
Despite the fact that I'm sure that statement was meant as a compliment, it ended up leaving quite the bitter taste in my mouth.
It's not embarrassment or humility. I actually agree with her deep down.
How in the world did I manage to end up with someone like her…?
"…It was our idea. We spent almost a whole day thinking about it."
"I see… In a good and bad way, the two of you are really just unbelievable."
Setsuna's presentation succeeded in surprising Youko-san, but it seems that it has yet to manage to convince President Touma to accept it.
Well, I suppose it's natural for her to want to think this through calmly.

The client which we're giving our proposal to is currently in the hospital. And the person who's giving that proposal hasn't really gone through any of the official procedures required; instead, he simply rode on the fact that Youko-san's the mother of her friend to push it upon her.
"Would someone usually go so far? For a girl you rejected… for a girl who's trying to take back the man she loves?"
Even so, it's only through such aggressive measures that we're somehow capable of conveying our passion to her.
"Do you really intend to do this?"
"Do you intend to let that girl meet Kazusa, the way she is now?"
"I do… I think so, at least."
"Did she say she'd do it on her own accord? That's the girl who tried to steal her love, you know?"
"She's still her best friend, though. And she has been for five years… Though they separated once because of me."
"That's just the type of person Setsuna is."
Even though she's been betrayed by me countless times, even though she has cried countless times because of me.
And even though the reasons behind all that were all related to Kazusa…
And even though she must bear some ill will and guilt toward Kazusa… Even though she's harboring countless emotions within her, emotions too complex to be described with words alone.
Setsuna still wants to meet Kazusa despite all that. She's wishing that she'll be able to get Kazusa back on her feet again.
"I wonder about that… she hasn't exactly said that she's forgiven me, actually."
"Well, I know I personally wouldn't have forgiven you. I'd first make you go down on your knees and beg, then I'd just walk away and leave you like that."
I imagine only Kazusa would forgive me in such a scenario…
"Still, this is my daughter we're talking about here, so you know this won't be easy, right?"
"I understand that. We don't think that we'd be able to solve this just by meeting with her once or twice."
"But you might not even get another chance. I imagine that Kazusa will feel that there's no hope for her anymore the moment Setsuna-san arrives at her doorstep."
"That's why we need your cooperation, Youko-san. We need to create a situation where the two have to meet up with one another every day."
Setsuna said that she's not confident. That's why she said we have to keep trying, no matter how long it takes.
In that case, I have to create a scenario that will allow her to do that.
"Well then, I wonder what I should do about this? I do have some acquaintances within Knights… We did produce a CD once in the past."
"Yes, I know about that. The person responsible for that arrangement is now the president of the company Setsuna's working at."
"I see you've even looked up on how you'd manage to persuade me… you let nothing slip by you, now, do you?"
"My superiors have consistently reminded me that I can't rely on a single strategy if I want to work with Touma Youko Office."
"Still, even though she said that there'd be no losses, I actually don't see any merit in her proposal either."
"True, you did turn down our plan immediately after you learned that it involves the special issue of our magazine…"
"I wanted to increase her market value. Don't you think that it sounds a bit cheap for her first ever CD in Japan to be a bonus for a magazine?"
"In exchange, a lot more people will get access to it. And I'm certain that this will pave the way to Kazusa gaining a new fanbase."
"Do you think a mere music magazine will manage to sell that well?"
"Given Touma Kazusa's current popularity… I expect sales of this volume."
"What you're proposing won't actually get amazing publicity. …We'd need this amount, at least."
"Well, if we have to go that far, I'll need to ask for the final decision of my superiors. In any case, the only thing I can promise you right now is…"
"Get permission immediately then. You're not just an errand boy…"
"The company I'm working for would be able to handle that, but given that we'd be involving Knights Records this time…"
"Like I care about that. If you don't want me to turn down this plan of yours… promise me that you'll be able to produce this amount of sales right now!"
"Well, I suppose I can buy some time and… that's it! That's the most I can promise you right now!"
"Oh, quit lying! You never had any rights to decide how many copies could be produced in the first place, now, did you?"
"If you know that, then stop making things difficult for me!"
"Hold on, don't get so excited now! What will you do if your blood pressure ends up rising?"
"You're the one… you're the one who doesn't understand anything, Kazusa. You have absolutely no idea how I've felt ever since that day!"
"Ever since you left… ever since you left everything unsettled between us… Do you know just how much I've worried, suffered and cried over it…!?"
"Don't shove the blame on me… none of that is my fault. And the fact that you and Haruki are so in love with one another is proof of that, isn't it!?"
"And for how long do you think we were apart before we came to this point!? How many times do you think we almost separated!? How many times do you think we almost gave up on each other!?"
"But you're still in love! And you two completely forgot about me!"
"Wrong! Haruki-kun never forgot about you! Not even once did he ever get over you, Kazusa!"
"Because you abandoned him for five years!"
"What!? Are you saying that this is all my fault!?"
"There's no other reason for it now, is there!? Everything happened because you were too cowardly!"
"…! Setsuna…? You're going that far? You, who now has everything you could ever want, are going to say all that to me, who's lost absolutely everything?"
"Stop being so selfish! You've always had his feelings all to yourself, so you have no right to even try to play the victim right now!"
"Why didn't you just take him away…"
"If you had only stayed in Japan, Haruki-kun would've belonged to you. So why did you end up running away…?"
"Because you… you took him from me…"
"That's right. I took him from you. …But you didn't say anything to me. You ran away without even putting up a fight."
"You gave me Haruki-kun back then. You gave up on Haruki-kun."
"And yet you suddenly become like this over meeting him again after five years… I don't care if you've suddenly decided to change your mind about him now!"
"You're an idiot, Kazusa! An idiot, idiot… an absolute idiot!"
"…Why are you apologizing, Setsuna? It was my fault, after all."
"No, it was all my fault. I ended up provoking you all of a sudden."
"The one in the wrong is the person who started the fight."
"The person who lost their temper first is even more in the wrong."
"That's also because of my cowardice all this time."
"You said it yourself that it was my fault, didn't you…? Our fight, me hurting your face, me hurting your heart, it's all my fault…"
"The fact that you keep convincing yourself that you're a bad person, and how you refuse to connect with other people and go straight to distancing yourself because of it."
"That's the sort of person I really am, and there's nothing I can do about it. I'm gloomy, reclusive, and only capable of being jealous of others…"
"Like I said, why do you decide that on your own…?"
"You're wrong… you're really not that kind of girl, Kazusa. You're kind, sensitive, and you're a wonderful person who's always considerate of others."
"I know myself better than anyone else. I don't need an outsider to make any unsolicited comments about who I am."
"An outsider…? Why are you putting it that way…?"
"An outsider is an outsider, or are you aspiring to be my mother or something?"
"Again, why do you keep trying to act out on purpose? Even though you're just going to regret it right after saying stuff like that!"
"I'm not going to regret a single thing! You're the one that's trying to decide who people really are, Setsuna…"
"…Why are you even apologizing, Setsuna? It was my fault, after all."
"How many times do we have to go through this…"
"Until you never come back here again."
"…I've been telling you from the start, haven't I? I can't go back to my company until I finish my work with you. I can't leave your side until that happens."
"Then I'll lodge a complaint to your superiors and have them fire you."
"If it comes to that, I'll just have your president mediate the situation. I'm sure she'll stand up for me."
"You really do hate me, don't you?"
"I like you… I really like you, Kazusa."
"So how did we end up like this…? That's a question I've been asking myself for the last five years."
"Like, dislike, love, hate… is our relationship not simple enough to be described with words like that?"
"…Go home already. You have work tomorrow, don't you?"
"Should I even be going with my face being the way it is…?"
"Yeah, this is the hotel Kazusa's staying in."
Onjuku Integral Hotel, a hotel so imposing that I could spot it even from the window of my apartment, towering over the other skyscrapers in the city's downtown area, right in the center.
"There's someone called Kudou-san waiting in the lobby. She'll take you to Kazusa's room."
The most expensive suite room on the highest floor of this luxurious hotel is where Kazusa has designated her very own Amano-Iwato.
…A far too expensive choice of residence for a person seeking to isolate herself from the world.
"I understand, then things are done for you here, Haruki-kun. I'll be fine on my own from here on out."
"Is it really alright? …For you to take such an awful role…"
"…How many times have you already said that line? I'm sure the number is over three digits by now."
We spent a lot of time preparing and pulled plenty of strings to reach where we are now.
Still, the very moment we're about to put our plan into action, I'd suddenly become very hesitant about it.
"This is all for Kazusa's sake, you know? …That means it's our sake as well."
I'm expecting Setsuna to become Ame-no-Uzume…
Despite the fact that she willingly volunteered for the role, the fact remains that I'm imposing an extremely cruel task on her.
"As I thought… I should be the one to go. I should try to talk to Kazusa just one more time."
"Everything will be alright. I won't waver anymore…"
"I'm really not worried about that. All I'm worried about is Kazusa right now."
Setsuna's not the one who needs to be saved right now, and neither am I, of course…
"Right now, I think neither you nor Youko-san are capable of this. After all, you both love Kazusa far too much."
"You can't scold her, and you're not able to push her away either. …The only thing you two are capable of is spoiling her."
And Setsuna's the one who knows that fact better than anyone else right nowーSetsuna, the one person who has kept getting betrayed until now.
"That's why I have to step in. The one who hasn't met her in five years."
How did I ever manage to get together with someone as amazing as her? Why is someone as wonderful as she is still willing to stay by my side even now?
"Setsuna, I… you know, up until now, I…"
"Ah, let's not talk about those things right now. Let's go back to that after all this is over, okay?"
When was it that Setsuna became such a strong woman?
"I want to only think about Kazusa right now. I want to put my full concentration into thinking about what I can do for her."
Has she always been like this since the first day we met? When we got together? …Or did she become like this following the one time when we separated from one another?
"I understand… I'll leave Kazusa to you, then."
"I wonder how I'm going to do this… maybe I'll only be able to vent on her despite everything I've said. Maybe I'll only manage to let out all my pent-up grudges when I finally see her."
"Gosh, I was just kidding! You could at least stop giving me such a sad look and play along!"
"I'm trying to tell you that there's no need to worry about us fighting or going at each other's throats or something."
"Hang on a second! Even if you are just joking, could you please not say stuff like that…?"
"Yeah, that's how it feels. Well, I suppose it wouldn't be particularly interesting this way… Still, maybe we will end up quarrelling a little."
Perhaps I was the one who made Setsuna strong by hurting her, and causing her pain over and over again.
"The fact that I'm right here at this very moment is all because you worked hard for it, you know?"
"Not at all… I simply sought you out for help and nothing more, Setsuna…"
"Still, you're the very person who's made me who I amーa person who won't break when someone's asking for my help."
"It's because back then… when you came to see me in Osaka… you gave me a lot of courage…"

"Good luck with your work. …If you happen to make a mistake, focus on finding the reason why you made it. So long as you can do that, you'll be able to perform better next time, even if only by a little."
When I went to depend on Setsuna, I could see that she was driven into a corner far worse than me.
"From the next day on, I spent all my time from dawn till dusk running from one place to the other and apologizing to everyone."
So in an attempt to cover up my own shortcomings, I ran away in that terrible, thoughtless and sanctimonious manner.
"It was my own mistake, but my means of making up for it were limited… I'm still just a new employee, after all."
"In any case, I made sure to keep my mistakes in mind, thinking about where I went wrong… and I did my best to improve, even if only by a little."

"Even so, I couldn't really get very much done by myself, so I decided to focus on getting better by familiarizing myself with the work, and to follow my instructions with the utmost effort, or at the very least a smile."
"And I found that, so long as I could do that, the atmosphere at work got so much better all of a sudden! It was like all the stuff from the day prior was no big deal at all."
"And in the end, they told me that they were looking forward to seeing me in future events, too… I know it was just a bit of flattery, but it still made me very happy!"
She's really, really done her best, all while she's trying to feel encouraged by words I'd said to deceive her, and all while knowing that there's a possibility that I might've betrayed her.
"The way you think about things and attempt to solve them all by yourself… you're very strong."
She's truly a strong person. Noーshe's become strong.
"Oh no, I owe all this to you, Haruki-kun."
"No. I've done absolutely nothing. There's nothing I've ever done that's warranted your gratitude, Setsuna…"
"But you came! The very moment I really wanted to meet you, you came back to my side."
"I'm not… I'm not the man you think I am, Setsuna…"
"Up until now, you've always shown me your own effort. You've always shown me the way."
"Even if you won't admit it, I will. I'll always believe in you."
The way she is now, Setsuna is truly strongーher heart, her emotions, everything down to her very core…
"That's why it's my turn to do my best now. You've always been working so hard up until now, Haruki-kun, so it's about time you had some rest."
"After all, I've accepted your wishーI've received the baton from your hands."
In that case, I… the best I can do right now is to repay that infallible strength of hers.
"I'll have you know that I'm not the anchor in this race, though."
I should think about how I should return the favor from now on after the limitless compassion she's given me.
"I'll do my best in the one lap I'll be running. And I'll make sure that I'll return the baton to you again."
"That's why when the time comes… the three of us will cross that final hurdle together, alright?"
I suppose I need to think about how I'm going to spend the rest of my life making up for everything I've done to her.
"Well then, I'll be heading in now."
Perhaps I was never needed by her in the first place.
"I'm begging you, Setsuna… please… please… do something about Kazusa."
Just like when I first met her. When she was Ogiso Setsuna from Class 3-A, school idol and Miss Houjou High. An unattainable flower in my eyes…
"Thank you for taking care of me all this time. I'm Ogiso… from Knights Records."
"I'm really sorry about yesterday. Does it still hurt?"
"I know that you really don't want to see me again after what I did to you…"
"But if you're willing, could you please open the door? I want to properly apologize for what happened yesterday."
"And if we're able to put aside our differences, I really want us to get back to business with our work again…"
"Or maybe you really just don't want to see me anymore?"
"If you really can't see me today, I'll come back some other time. So please at least answer me."
"…Are you really asleep? Or maybe you're not feeling well?"
"Could you at least… let me hear your voice?"
"Like I said, Kazusa's giving me no response! I can't hear anything from her room either, not her voice, and not even the ringtone of her cell phone!"
"What do I do, what do I do…!? It's all because of the horrible things I did yesterday that… I might've pushed Kazusa to the edge!"
"I'm sorry, Haruki-kun… I'm so sorry! If only I'd kept close watch on her… no, it's because I've been so pushy with her that this ended up happening!"
"Y-Yeah… I am calm, and I'm alright. Like I said, I am being calm! More importantly, we need to help Kazusa!"
"Yes, we should call for help. Maybe the police and an ambulance and… is there anything else? Ah, right, I should ask the front desk first!"
"Alright, I'll tell them to unlock her room immediately. I'll contact you as soon as I can after that!"
"Yes, Touma-sama left the hotel some time ago."
"…Um, could you perhaps be Ogiso-sama, by any chance? If that's the case, I do have a message meant for you."
"Jeez, don't scare me like that! I… I… I thought you were…!"
"You thought I'd cut my wrists in the bathroom? That I'd hanged myself in the closet? That I'd jumped out the window of my room?"
"That's… well, um… y-you know, I lost my head a bit at the time!"
"So you really thought of it that way…"
"Of course I would! Why would you suddenly have the urge to go out today? …Was it because you knew I would be coming today?"
"No reason, really, I just didn't want you to bother me, Setsuna."
"It's just that I started missing this thing."
"In any case, it's being a real piece of work. …Even the slightest downtime between us seems to have made it hard to work with."
"Though I suppose it's natural, given how much I've been ignoring it ever since I returned to Japan. It seems to be quite upset, judging by how it keeps slipping under my fingers."
"Does this mean that… you're willing to do the concert?"
"…I'm not going to work on the CD even if it kills me, though."
"That doesn't matter right now. More importantly… have you gotten the urge to play again?"
"I don't think I can produce my best performance in just two weeks. …I don't think my heart will return even if my skill does."
"But I can't bring myself to run away from everything just because of that anymore."
"Perhaps you've managed to become a little more optimistic?"
"Well, it's not like I enjoy seeing other people upset either… In fact, I'd even say that I hate seeing people upset."
"There's my mom, Miyoko-san, and… well, even you, Setsuna. It's been hard for me to watch everyone look at me as if they're praying for me…"
"…It seems you've intentionally excluded a certain someone from that list."
"Just when I was so absorbed in such a depressing atmosphere, I happened to receive a letter last night… from Shibata-san."
"Ah, you mean that helper you had back when you were still staying in Japan?"
"She wrote to me to thank me for the ticket for the additional concert I gave her. She said that she'd make sure not to miss it."
"I see… That's good to hear, or is it okay for me to say that?"
"It's odd, isn't it? I don't remember sending anything like that to her."
"As always, he has one hell of a knack for putting me in sticky situations and poking me where it hurts… I can't bear him."
"And there I was feeling relieved that he wasn't showing up anymore… How can he possibly be so bad at reading the mood every time?"
"It's amazing anyone can bear him… that coward."
"That's why I thought I'd at least move my fingers a bit. That would allow me to get in shape if I happen to get the urge to play again."
"Yes… yes! You really are getting more optimistic now! I'm so happy, Kazusa…"
"I just said I'm not doing the CD, you know? I haven't said a single thing that would be to your benefit, Setsuna."
"Hey, can I stay here and listen to your piano, Kazusa?"
"Let's see… as long as you don't fall asleep halfway through."
"Jeez, you know that I wouldn't possibly do something so wasteful, now, would I?"
"…By the way, Setsuna, did you really go to work today with your face looking like that?"
"Well, now that you mention it! Everyone was tiptoeing around me all day like I was one step away from blowing up, you know!? …Well, I was all swollen, so I suppose I did look the part."
"What is the meaning of this, Kitahara!? It's been almost a week and we still haven't heard anything from Knights whatsoever!"
"I've been receiving daily progress reports from them… Though they still haven't managed to record a single song yet."
"You idiot! You call that progress!? You know that the deadline's the end of the month, right?"
"And there's a concert to be held on that tenth day, now, isn't there!? Does Touma Kazusa even have any intention of taking this job!?"
Hamada-san's wrath left me lost for words for a little while.
It's not that I felt intimidated by him, but rather that I was left speechless by the truth in his words.
"This whole plan was just so forced to begin with anyway! Why did we not proceed with our initial arrangement? Ensemble's editing department is stuck in a mess because of it!"
"Well… I've been properly discussing things with the relevant colleagues. I've also acquired consent from the chief editor, in any case…"
"That means absolutely nothing if it's not putting anything on the table! Can you even promise that a recording will be available by the end of the month?"
"I will do everything I can… All that's left is for Touma Kazusa to play her part."

"You were the one who suddenly changed all our plans! And you were the one who announced your new plans without discussing it with us first! Given everything you've done on your own accord, you better take responsibility!"
"I'm fully prepared, of course. Even if it means I'll have to get fired over this."
"You idiot! I swear, I've never seen such an absolute idiot like you!"
Still, the very moment I resign myself…
I'm replied to by an even more furious Hamada-san, who's continuing to call me an idiot.
"Who in the world would fire you over a failure caused by ambition? It's your superior who's going to have to take responsibility!"
The way he's acting right now reminds me of a certain someone I've been looking up to during my days as a mere part-timer, someone who's strong and reliable…
"…Actually, I happened to get a scolding from Kazaoka over the international line this morning. You asked her to cover your back, didn't you?"
"Ah, so she's already given a reply?"
Who am I kidding, that's only natural. After all, I am her yes-man here.
I gathered my resolve and made an international call to a certain someone last night, and having not heard her voice in quite a while, we happily chatted for about two hours.
"I-If I may… Kazaoka's no longer part of our editing department anymore, so asking her to help us out is…"
"Yes, she's unrelated. That's why I'll be following your instructions now, Hamada-san."
"…You think that woman will actually abide by that idea?"
"She's no longer working with us, right?"
And as Hamada-san's strength and reliability fades, I come closer to my temporary victory.
"…You have a very obvious look that says you've won something by a landslide. You have no intention of reflecting on this situation at all, do you?"
"That's not true at all. I was just thinking that if we keep doing our best… we'll be able to achieve a desirable result in the end."
"…! Very well, then. Don't forget to ask about progress over at Knights afterward."
"Thank you very much. Well, I have some business to attend to now, so if you'll excuse me."
Just as Hamada-san said, a week has passed without any notable progress.
Meanwhile, Setsuna's daily texts have only amounted to dull, substanceless mentions of "no development."
There was that one time when she called me in a panic about how Kazusa wasn't responding to her at all, but that was an exception within an exception.
I'm not nervous at all about this, though. I'm only going to patiently wait for Setsuna's efforts to bear fruit.
That was what we promised one another. That we wouldn't meet one another until that very moment comes.
…Even if that very moment happens to be the night before our deadline.
That's why the only thing I can do right now is make the proper preparations involving everything except Kazusa.
It's all so that I can take in every last bit of music that she'll be giving out when her fingers are finally able to weave the strong melody she was known for once again.
"What? If you got something to say, then spit it out already!"
"Nothing, really. I'm totally not thinking about how I was this close to reconsidering my negative impression of you, Hamada-san."
"And I'm not thinking about how you got outplayed by a rookie who is only in his first year at all, no siree."
"I let him off the hook on purpose! It'd be such a waste to let him go over something like this, now, wouldn't it!?"
"We get that. I haven't even entertained the thought of how you're a pathetic, sore loser or anything of the sort."
"Still, Kitahara-kun really is loved by Mari-san, isn't he? There is a limit to how much special treatment one can get…"
"And that's the reason why she's still single, that Kazaoka."
"Saying something like that is going to get you sued…"
"Good work today～ I see you've been working late today as well, huh?"
"You should've just gone home. I don't see why you had to wait for me for so long…"
"Well, my current job is to make sure I'm always tailing you after all, Kazusa."
"That's not what the job of a public relations specialist is…"
"This job is a special mission for me. Since Touma Youko picked me personally, even my superior will pretend to not notice any negligence."
"Still, it's really chilly out here… my hands have already gotten so cold after waiting for you all that time…"
"Hey, that's cold! You shouldn't randomly touch another person's cheeks like that!"
"Ahaha… you're so warm. Well, let's get going. I'll walk you back to the hotel."
"Did you get back your appetite? Are you eating properly?"
"Well, I suppose. I keep forgetting to eat whenever I practice, so I've mostly only been eating once a day."
"A-Ah… I'm not sure if I should be happy that you're really concentrating or if I should be worried that you're going to end up malnourished."
"It's really nothing to worry about. That's how I've always gotten by back when I was still in Europe."
"I wouldn't call that something particularly admirable, though… Well, if you are only going to have one meal a day, though, you'll have to fill yourself up especially well during said meal, then."
"Hey, is it okay if I make you a bento starting tomorrow? I'll leave you your meal at the hotel before I go to work in the morning…"
"Hmm? Would you prefer the studio instead?"
"Why are you still coming over every day? I've told you many times that I'm not taking that job you're proposing, and more than that, I've hurt your face, haven't I?"
"Why aren't you fed up with me? Why aren't you willing to just leave me be? …You're really starting to act like him."
"Well, it's because… I like you. That is what makes me similar to him."
"…But you hate me, don't you? You're already seething mad and itching to slap me in the face, are you not?"
"I'd much rather you not obsess over that point so much. We haven't managed to settle everything yet."
"But you said it yourself, didn't you? All while slapping me."
"You really didn't need to say that last part…"
"You said it yourself… you said that Haruki's dishonest, deplorable and cowardly, didn't you?"
"Haruki-kun really is a cruel person, isn't he? He's been sitting on the fence for the past five years!"
"Then how could you of all people still keep on loving him?"
"The reason that you're concerned about me is because he himself is concerned about me, right? And you think you're winning his favor by trying to help me up on my feet again, don't you?"
"Not at all… that's really not all there is to it."
"So you're admitting that it's part of the reason you're doing this, then? That you're using this as an opportunity to devote yourself to Haruki?"
"Come on, you don't have to be so petty about details like that…"
"That's how much you love Haruki despite how cruel he is, don't you?"
"There, you never had the right to criticize me in the first place. You tell me to explain my feelings, yet you can't even explain your own."
"W-Well, the point of what I said back then was that you really don't need a reason to love someone…"
"Why do you love that guy so much, Setsuna…? Why haven't you given up on him even though he's already betrayed you so many times?"
"…Then what about you, Kazusa? Why did you manage to maintain such passionate feelings for someone you haven't even met in five years?"
"I'm the one asking the questions here right now. Give me a proper answer."
"B-But, Kazusa, you never answered my question earlier either, right? So my question came first!"
"…I haven't said a word about me being in love with him."
"What are you even saying after all this time? When I asked you if you loved him back then, you answered me with 'what's wrong with that,' didn't you?"
"When exactly did I say that, then? Tell me the exact date and time when I said it. Your answer will be wrong if you miss the mark by even a second."
"Doesn't that mean there is a right answer…?"
"Too bad… time's up. Will you look at that, that proves I said nothing of the sort."
"Jeez! You're not some elementary school student anymore! Why do you keep hiding your true feelings all the time, Kazusa?"
"Welcome back, Touma-sama. We hope you enjoy the rest of your evening."
"What do you even understand, Setsuna? What could you possibly ever understand about me!?"
"How many times have you said that already? I'm getting tired of hearing it!"
"The reason I have to repeat myself over and over again is because you refuse to understand."
"That's not true, I do understand! …Well, I can't say that with full confidence, but I'm at least doing my best to understand you, even if a little!"
"The amount of effort taken is irrelevant in a concert. The audience only cares about the result."
"But they're still listening and concentrating. They're doing their best to feel closer to the pianist."
"A true pro would be able to awaken the audience from their sleep, no? It's nothing but an excuse to blame the people who won't give you the light of day when you're the one lacking in skill."
"If that's the case, I'll just have to work harder! And I'll definitely come to understand you, Kazusa!"
"Alright, time's up. That's all I'm giving you for today."
"Good night, Setsuna. It must be tough on you working on something so futile every day."
"…Even so, I'll be coming back tomorrow."
"Even if you won't understand today… Even if this ends up being a concert that didn't touch anybody's heart, I still have another chance."
"Just wait until the additional concert. This time, I'll capture the hearts of your audience."
"So there won't be an encore, huh…"
"A little booing is all it took to make you leave? I suppose that's all your resolve amounts to in the end…"
"If you have something to say, let it out with all your passion. Why are you giving up so easily?"
"Ah, of course, you actually have work tomorrow. Must be hard being an employee. I'm sorry I can't relate at all given that I'm self-employed."
"…! If you're going to rile me up, I won't be heading back until morning. And here I was actually being considerate of you."
"You really don't need to force yourself. You still have work tomorrow, don't you?"
"I might yell at you throughout the entire night, but you're fine with that, right…?"
"You can be as loud as you want, but if your words don't touch the heart of your audience, it'll put them to sleep all the same."
"I won't let you sleep… not while I'm around."
Setsuna's recent text, which happened to come a few hours later than usual, conveys to me that there is still no favorable outcome, and that she's in an incredible hurry.
I imagine she initially wanted to type out "No progress yesterday"…
"Oh noooo～!? I sent the text while I was in the middle of writing it!"
"Please take me to the Knights Records Headquarters near Kirishima Bridge! I'm sorry, but I'm in a real hurry! I only have five minutes until my meeting begins!"
"Aaah! Actually, please drive carefully until I fix my makeup!"
"I guess I'll drop by the studio in the afternoon."
"I'm sorry about the late reply. I had been busy with a meeting at my company up until now."
"Also, I'm sorry for sending you that incomprehensible text this morning. What I wanted to write was that I was sorry because there was no progress yesterday."
"Oh, oh, and I'm very sorry it took me almost half a day before I could send you this text to clarify myself. A lot of things happened last night, so I ended up being busy."
"Yeah, last night was… a really busy night. So busy in fact that I couldn't even find the time to get some sleep!"
"Hey, Haruki-kun? Perhaps in due time I'll be able to…"
"No, that's not something I can say for sure right now. After all, I haven't actually accomplished anything yet."
"I'll probably end up texting you late tonight as well. Still, I assure you that it's not because something's gone wrong or anything. Please have faith and wait for me."
Setsuna has once again forbidden me to contact her on my own accord until Kazusa's managed to return to her usual self.
She herself has made sure to conduct herself in a business-like and concise manner and only leave me with plain daily reports of her own situation.
We promised that until Kazusa's been saved, until matters have been settled… we would no longer chat as friends, let alone as a couple.
Still, her text today suggests that she's quite invigorated…
"Hey, Kitahara! What are you spacing out for? If you're going to tell me that you've yet to start the work I've instructed you to do…"
"No problem! It's already 80% complete. I'll make sure I'll be ready by tomorrow morning."
"I don't care about you flaunting that! More importantly, how are things with the Ensemble issue? Don't tell me you're running away from reality by immersing yourself in work here…"
"The draft will be submitted by this week! The final checks will also be carried out completely within a week!"
That's right, I'm sure that everything will be finished by the week.
After all, it's only a matter of time before…
"Are you stupid!? Even if the publication can be completed, we still have no news whatsoever on the CD, do we!? What in the world are you going to do about that!?"
"Sorry about that, but I'll be working on that matter simultaneously!"
It appears that the excitement from Setsuna's text has managed to influence me so that I'm feeling quite pumped up myself.
"You idiot! What if you end up collapsing because you've taken on all the work at once!? Isn't it an editor's job to make sure they take care of themself too!?"
A week left until the concert… and our deadline.
Perhaps the final stretch is already drawing near…
"Could you stop being so loud! You're pissing me off!"
"I'm sorry! I'll keep that in mind next time!"
"Well, it's not like I can't understand how Hamada-san feels about all this. I guess now's as good a time as any to criticize him."
"Hey, Mom? Where is that thing? You know, that thing! I'm pretty sure it was stuffed into the closet last time I saw it."
"I can't possibly understand with that description…"
"Ah, here it is! Alright, I think my luggage is all prepared now."
"…Wait, are you really going to take all of that with you? And all by yourself, Nee-chan?"
"It'll be fine, I've already called for a taxi. It's not like I'm heading somewhere particularly far away for work, anyway."
"I've told you a dozen times already. After I've managed to solve the problem I'm dealing with."
"And what is the meaning of this…? For you to be tasked with some business trip that you don't know when it'll end…"
"You're a public relations specialist of a recording company, aren't you, Nee-chan? I suppose your job requiring you to leave home for a few days is somewhat common…"
"But she's a girl who's in her first year! I think your company could at least be more considerate…"
"I'm sorry, Mom, but I specifically requested to go on this business trip. …This is a job only I can do."
"I suppose it's an important job for you."
"Yeah, something really important. It's a massive project that will decide the future of three!"
"Ah, my taxi's here! Anyway, I'm sorry, but I'll have to be away for a while. Tell dad that I'll give him a call later."
"Be safe, alright? And don't go filling yourself with the wrong food, okay?"
"Yeah, I'll be careful. Well, then, I'll be off now～!"
"She's in oddly high spirits… Is she really that excited about this business trip of hers?"
"And she was just in Osaka not long ago…"
"By the way… when she mentioned a future of three… who was she referring to?"
"Well… what is the meaning of this?"
"I thought that I'd put myself in your care from today on… after all, there's so much we need to quarrel about."
"What's that you're holding in your hand?"
"Changes of clothes, toiletries, and other stuff… well, I suppose stuff that a girl would need when she's staying overnight somewhere?"
"No, I'm not talking about what's in your suitcase, but what you're carrying in your left hand…"
"Ah, this? An electric heater. I'm not allowed to use a gas heater according to the front desk."
"Well, of course. This is a hotel guest room."
"I've also brought a pot and a frying pan. There's also some ingredients I purchased on the way here such as meat, fish… and plenty of vegetables."
"I'm making up for the quarrel we had yesterday. I'll be treating you today, alright? …Here, I even brought some wine."
"You know, Haruki-kun has always, always… loved you all this time, Kazusa. Nothing's changed these past five yearsーyou're still the one he loves the most, Kazusa."
"…You expect me to believe that? After all, I'm not the woman he's looking at right now."
"I suppose that's because there's another girl who has been insistently clinging onto him despite knowing where his true feelings lie."
"And given how kind Haruki-kun is, of course he wouldn't be willing to abandon someone like that… And it was for that reason that he finally succumbed and accepted her."
"You really need to stop degrading yourself like that. It's only making me angry."
"You're the one he's truly loved since five years ago, Setsuna. I know that full well because I've been watching him all that time…"
"Even so, I'll never be able to become the one he loves most. …I know because I've always watched him, even if not for as long as you."
"His first love, the girl he loves more than anyone else in the world… I couldn't possibly catch up to a girl like that. The absolute best I could do was to tie with her."
"But you worked really hard, Setsuna. …You worked really hard while I couldn't."

"That's why you've become the one he loves the most in the world. …You were already a wonderful woman to begin with, but now you've become an even more amazing woman to the point that it's too much to handle."
"You win. The game is over. …There's no need for me to go out of my way to admit that, is there?"
"No, that was never really my intention…"
"Don't lie to yourself that the reason you bother with me… is because you like me."
"You really shouldn't be degrading yourself like that. It's only making me mad."
"I have no right to be forgiven by you… especially not by you. …You know that, don't you?"
"Still, still… I just can't bring myself to not worry about you, Kazusa. …I like you, and you're already so close to me!"
"I won't give up… I will never give up."
"I don't care at all what he thinks of me, but I utterly despise him…"
"What is it about him that makes you hate him so much?"
"The way he convinces himself that any choice that is made in earnest is correct by default."
"The way he's obsessed with the preconceived notion that people are right so long as they're serious about things… That every decision made after careful deliberation is bound to be the right one."
"Are you saying that Haruki-kun is wrong? Even though he's troubling himself so much, and doing his best?"
"Everything that comes out of his mouth is wrong. After all, that guy lacks common sense."
"Is it… really a matter of common sense?"
"No matter how seriously he thinks things through, no matter how much he tries to make the proper decision, he has never once been in the right."
"I suppose that's not something you can understand, Setsuna… No, perhaps anyone Japanese won't be able to understand…"
"Would a genius… an artist be able to understand that? Someone like you, Kazusa?"
"There, you hate me, don't you? I don't fit in with you two at all."
"I guess you're right, he really might be in the wrong. He's a liar, and incredibly stupid on top of that… I'd even go as far as to say he's hopeless."
"I've told you this from the very beginning, didn't I? You really have poor taste to have fallen in love with someone like that, Setsuna."
"Still, I don't think his mistakes can be attributed to his lack of sense. It's just that nothing was really ever fair from the very beginning."
"He thought about things really hard, and came to the correct conclusion, but he made the exact opposite choice with complete confidence."
"I guess that's why it looks like he's wrong. …No, it's clear that he is wrong."
"…I don't get what you're saying. Why would he do that?"
"Because he was influenced by his compassion for others. …Because he always prioritized you, Kazusa."
"I honestly hate that part of him sometimes. Haruki-kun's really terrible, isn't he?"
"Are you saying Haruki made his mistakes because of me? Are you blaming me for leading him astray…?"
"Do you… know what he told me a week ago?"
"That's a lie! After all, he… he doesn't…!"
"Everyone's been thinking that way all this time… It's not like even I didn't think that way five years ago."
"The reason you feel that way now is because you were rejected for the first time in your life… because he didn't pick you this time."
"Haruki-kun, who always held you in his arms, now all of a sudden decided to cast you aside… that's why you hold a grudge."
"I wonder why you're being so shocked over being rejected by someone you said you despised?"
"Stop… stop hitting me when I'm down…! It's unfair for the winner to go after the loser like this, isn't it!?"
"You don't have a clue how much he has put you first, how much his decisions have prioritized you to the point where I almost detest him for it."
"Like I'd be able to understand that! Like I'll be able to ever believe that!"
"I suppose it's not something you can understand, Kazusa… No, I suppose it's not something someone who's not Japanese can understand."
"…Yeah, I do hate you. I hate how you're trying to get back at me like a child would!"
"So you understand that I was just trying to get back at you… You really are the same as me, Kazusa. …We both love Japanese people who lack sense."
"I wonder if I… should just stop playing the piano."
"Come on… why would you say something like that?"
"I no longer have someone who I want to listen to my piano. Everyone's already gone."
"Being able to play the piano managed to make me happy until now. …Had I stayed in Vienna, I wouldn't have needed to move on from those five years."
"But the moment I came to Japan, the world of those five years past… my fantasies of happiness had been destroyed by reality."
"The one person that I've always gone for has disappeared… the one person who's always supported me all this time is no more."
"Youko-san hasn't disappeared. She's working hard to live on for your sake."
"And I realize now hearts can change and waver… all it takes is for time to pass without meeting and thinking of one another for any lingering feelings to fade away."
"What do you mean, 'fade away'… his feelings for you have not changed at all, as frustrating as it is to say."
"But the reality is that not even one of my wishes has come true. Even though I've known full well that they could never be a reality…"
"My tiny little world will fade away soon. All that's left after is for its creator to fade away as well…"
"That's… things aren't like that at all…"
"Good night, Setsuna. I'm sorry for talking about this. …When morning comes, perhaps I'll be able to look at the bright side, even if only a little."
"Let's just go to sleep. Thank you, Setsuna. Stay by my side tonight, too."
"Miyo-chan, head back to the office and contact all related branches. Please arrange a press conference for me afterward, as well."
"Since I just got out of the hospital, I might as well be the one to do it… I should be the one to announce the cancelation of Touma Kazusa's additional concert."
After her third admission and subsequent discharge from the hospital has finally come to an end…
As if the time it takes to get from the hospital back to the office is precious time wasted, Youko-san makes a single decision.
"A week before… perhaps it's a bit late, but with the way things are now, we should at least do what we can to minimize any losses to our guests."
"But that's… please, wait a minute, President!"
…She's made a decision that both Kudou-san and I have dreaded deep down, one that we've always tried to avoid until now.
"Wait any longer and you'll be the one in the worst trouble, you know? You're already doing enough for us as it is."
"B-But! That Ogiso-san from Knights is still working hard for this! She's really doing her very best to…"
"…I know that full well. I was the one who entrusted all this to her, after all."
"She's been coming every day without absence. Thanks to her, Kazusa-san's even managed to get back to practice again…"
"But she still hasn't given the okay. Not for the additional concert nor the CD recording."
"Her efforts are commendable, but practically speaking, we've already reached our deadline. We can't insist on continuing with this any further."
Her decision will likely end up being the end of the media's passionate parade and cause immense disappointment to Kazusa's rising fanbase.
The narrative of her triumphant return to Japan would also be erased, much like the time when Youko-san was ousted from Japan.
The reason Youko-san still came to this decision is…
"It's alright… we'll just start over, okay?"
Because she trusts her daughter's talents, perhaps?
Because she believes that Kazusa would be able to rise once more? Because she believes that Kazusa isn't someone so half-hearted that she would crumble over a scandal like this?
"That's how it is… I'm sorry, Guitar-kun. If I waste any more time, it will be detrimental for my company."
Has she finally given up on the situation…?
"I will neither resent you nor condemn you for this… Rather, I should be gratefulーgrateful that you've stuck with that foolish daughter of mine to the very end.
Has she finally lost confidence in the possibility that her daughter will be able to go on with her life as a pianist…?
Much like she's lost confidence in the light of her own life…
"Could you contact Setsuna-san for me? …I'll explain everything to her later."
Even so, I won't stand for such a resigned decision acquiescently.
"Just a little longer… please, just wait for one more day. I'm sure something's bound to happen."
Perhaps it's because of the text Setsuna sent yesterday…
Or perhaps it's because she hasn't sent me one today, or the fact that she hasn't even gone to work today…
"Even if you work hard now, it's just impossible. She hasn't practiced any of the songs listed on the program at all, and there's only one week left…"
"We'll be able to make it if we work hard throughout the week without rest. …Even you have done something like that before while you were in your prime, haven't you?"
It's as if it's providing my ignorant self with unease, and yet it's also giving me a strong sense of courage to continue on.
It's telling me that Setsuna is still fighting. That she still hasn't given up at all.
"You say that, but what if my daughter is unable to perform? Will you take responsibility for that?"
"I won't. I'm not affiliated with your company, after all."
"Then do you intend to do something about this? Are you saying that you can convince Kazusa to play again for certain?"
"…What a cheeky little kid you are."
But then, it's my job to get rid of any distractions.
I'll do that so Setsuna can put her full focus on Kazusa. I'll do that so Kazusa can't escape from Setsuna being involved in all this.
And all so that the two of them… will be able to fully clash with one another, up until the very end.
"Nnn… it's going to be 2 o'clock soon."
"Well, I ended up skipping work, too."
"Well… you can still head over now. You could go apologize."
"Hmm～ but it's so cold outside. I don't feel like getting out of bed～"
"I see, then… I suppose the two of us could just skip work for today. We'll just stay in bed like this, just the two of us."
"You're telling me that you won't take responsibility and that you won't convince her… and you're expecting me to be convinced by that?"
"Yes, because we won't fail. That's why we're not calculating the risks either."
I won't take responsibility. And I won't think about what will come after.
Because there's no need for any of that.
"Just… leave everything to me after Kazusa finally agrees to go through with it."
I'm certain that Setsuna will be able to return Kazusa back to her senses.
I'm sure that Kazusa will be able to get up on her own feet again.
And I, too… will make sure that the plan I set in motion will succeed.
"We'll definitely be able to succeed with the concert and the CD by their intended deadlines."
After all, the three of us…
Are capable of accomplishing anything so long as we put our hearts into itーsomething we've already proven five years ago.
"Bring my daughter before me before the clock strikes midnight today. …And I want her to kneel to Miyo-chan as she apologizes for everything she's done."
"If you manage to do that, I'll withdraw all plans to announce the cancelation. That's fair, right?"
This time… we will cast our final die.
"I wonder if it's okay for us to do this…"
"I wonder if it's fine for us to remain like this even though there's only a week left before the concert…"
"Ah, that… There's really no need to worry about that for now."
"For now…? Do you even understand what situation we're in right now…?"
"If I'm going to worry about that, it'll be only after you decide whether or not you'll be going through with it, Kazusa."
"Until you make a proper decision, we don't need to bother ourselves with it. Besides, we still have a whole week left."
"A whole week… That's ridiculous, isn't it? When you consider how many things we need to do in preparation, we're already past the point where we'd have enough time…"
"Is that so? I don't know very much about the schedule for your concert or the CD recording."
"You… can you even call yourself a public relations specialist of a recording company?"
"Well, I'm just a first-year newcomer. Any ignorance, lack of responsibility or failures from me are all part of my salary."
"…So you're saying that it's okay for you to fail, then? Are you saying that it'll be okay if I just turn you down flat?"
"The truth is, I don't mind either outcome. So long as it's what makes you happy, Kazusa, I don't mind what you choose."
"After all, any responsibility given to a newcomer like me is never anything big. …I imagine the same goes for Haruki-kun too."
"So it's okay if you only think about yourself, Kazusa. If no longer playing the piano will make you happy, then I'll support your new lifestyle with all my being."
"…You're saying that on purpose, aren't you? You're saying that while you're fully aware, aren't you?"
"You know that there isn't a path like that for meーa path where I could put an end to my piano playing and become happy…"
"You know that there's no other way for me to go about my life. You know that the only thing I've ever done was play the piano… And that I can't do anything other than that."
"Tell me, Setsuna… what am I going to do from now on?"
"Everything will be alright… there's really nothing you need to worry about."
"And after my world finally vanishes… will I also disappear along with it?"
"That won't happen. You won't end up disappearing…"
"Then what will happen if I remain? Am I supposed to live on in this dark and lonely world, with my arms forever around my knees?"
"That won't happen… I'm not going to let that happen to you, Kazusa…"
"I'm scared, I'm scared… Setsuna. I don't want to disappear… but staying is painful too. I don't want my world to be destroyed, and I don't want to be left alone…"
"Please, please… tell me, Setsuna. What should I do to make sure my world doesn't disappear? And what am I supposed to do once it won't disappear?"
"Uu, uu-uu… why, why… why am I the only one… why am I always the only one who ends up like this…!"
"You're wrong, Kazusa… that's really not true."
"How exactly am I wrong…!? I no longer have anyone there for me! Everyone I've ever loved is now…!"
"If they're no longer there for you, call out to them so they can come back to you! If your world ends up being destroyed, just make a new one again!"
"You'll be able to start over. I know you'll be able to do that. …God has already given you the strength to do so."
"You've been doing that all along, haven't you? Isn't the world around you one that you've managed to build with your own strength?"
"It's because your piano managed to reach Haruki-kun… to enamor him, so that he began to play the guitar. And it was my enamorment with the sound you both made that made me sing."
"It's because you brought Haruki-kun into your life that he managed to help you reconcile with your mother, who had once left your side."
"Everything you've done up until now is what's made the world surrounding you. You've accomplished all that with your own strength."
"And your piano has that strength. It has a powerful force that's capable of bringing people together."
"And from now on, you're going to connect with the world through your piano as it moves the hearts of many and provides them with strength."
"That's how you'll make connections with many people who'll be important to you…"
