As if stubbornly deciding that my limits are of no concern to her, she clings to me even harder and doesn't let go.
"It's… it's fine… like that… aah, aaah! Mhm… ah, ah, ah, aaaah!"
She probably never meant to let go of me from the start…
She's just as impulsive as she was back then. With a firm resolve, she decided to accept me…
"Haruki, ah, aah, ah…! Aaaah, ahh, aah! Mhm, nh, aah… aaah!"
I'm not sure who those last words were directed at.
Just as shoddy, just as bland, and just as rough.
Like I just learned to have sex for the first time, I stiffen my entire body, and ejaculate.
"Iaaaah, aah, ah… ah…! Hah, nhm… haah, aaah…!"
Into Kazusa's depths, over and over again.
"Aah, aah… aaah… ahn, nnh…! H-Haruki… aah, aah… aah…"
Even now, when I've reached my limit, Kazusa entwines around my entire body, and refuses to let go as we're still connected.
Still entwined, still overlapping our bodies.
And probably… also overlapping our hearts.
"…! Uu, uaah, haah… haah… ahaha… uuah… hahaha… aah…"
An expression, voice, and breaths containing a mixture of laughter, sobs… tears and smiles…
"Thank you, Haruki… for doing something despicable for my sake…"
"But you know, it's okay… I too am… no, I am the despicable one."
And those words spoken from the heart… pierce me like a knife.
"I heard they suddenly came back yesterday without any warning and without their phones, and they seemed not at all concerned about the ruckus it made."
"Though the truth is, there's actually a more pressing matter at hand."
"During her trip, Touma Kazusa fell down the stairs and got injured. Her right hand got a laceration and her left hand got sprained; it'll take two weeks to heal."
I see… that's how they explained it.
"The sponsor didn't take it well… Obviously there's no defending her going and doing whatever she wants and getting injured."
"I suppose things like this reaffirm that she is Touma Youko's daughter after all. You can bet the weekly magazines are going to have a field day with this."
Last night, when I finally managed to get into contact with Youko-san, I never got the chance to explain anything before she said "leave everything to me" and hung up.
I wonder how much she knows about us… She really is very mysterious when it comes to promoting her own daughter.
"I'm sure she'll be able to play her next concert, but I doubt it'll be in the best condition."
"…You're right. Even if she makes a full recovery, who's to say she'll be able to resume her practice immediately?"
"On top of that, her last concert got mixed reviews. The current situation is just pouring salt on the wound."
"You have no reason to apologize. It's not like it's your fault that she got wounded."
"But if only I had kept a closer watch on her… which I could have."
If only I could have seen it as part of my job… if only I had kept my wits about me when she was around.
"Don't blame yourself. There's nothing you could have done. It's her we're talking about, after all."
That's not the issue. The real reason is something completely different.
"Anyway, that covers all the things that have happened. Next, we'll cover what we're going to do from now on…"
"It's true that the recent trouble is a shame, but it's not like our plans have broken down because of them."
"The contract that allows us exclusive coverage on Touma Kazusa will last until her last concert."
Her additional concert will be at the end of this month.
"And the other person… that is to say Touma Youko, hopes that you'll continue to be responsible for this… Any objections?"
I'll only be able to be with Kazusa with the blessing of my workplace for one more month.
"I'm aware that you'll probably have less to write about, but that's not the only reason they want you."
What Youko-san desires from me is probably to act as Kazusa's manager.
But what Kazusa desires from me is…
"Anyway, continue with your regular work, and continue this special assignment. That will be all."
I feel like he took advantage of the situation to increase my workload, but for now, I have no choice but to nod obediently.
Because with the way the both of us are now… these conditions are absolutely vital.
Despite the chatter of countless people passing by the station, her voice reached my ears clearly.
The reason her voice wasn't drowned out by her surroundings was not because she spoke loudly, nor because of the way she spoke, but rather because of the emotions in her voice.
"Good job on another week's hard work!"
"Don't worry about it. I wasn't bored for a second while I was waiting."
That's right, her true emotions were in her voice.
The way Setsuna waved her hands at me the moment she saw me. The way Setsuna gazed at me coming closer.
…That smile of hers that shows complete trust in me.
"Hey, how about we do some shopping?"
"If we go to the supermarket by your place, we'll barely make it in time… so how about doing it here and going home after? The bags might be a bit heavy though."
A week after we last met in Osaka.
Today is the first time since that night when we have fulfilled our one week rule in Tokyo.
It's a meeting that should have made my heart jump for joy…
"Hey… do you want to eat somewhere?"
"Um… thing is, I kind of skipped lunch today, so I'm really hungry."
"I was planning on showing you some of my cooking today, so I've been really getting into it since this morning…"
"Well, I do look forward to that, but…"
"I'll make it right away. Let's get our shopping done quickly and we'll head straight home."
My apartment. The place Setsuna is supposed to spend the weekends.
But the apartment next to mine…
"It'll be my treat… so let's go for a drink. I heard from one of my coworkers that there's an establishment nearby that serves delicious wine."
"Making it your treat will make me even less likely to accept. We have to start saving up money soon. After all…"
What Setsuna just said wasn't inappropriate at all given our current circumstances; in fact, it's something that's more or less expected for us.
A slight blush appeared on Setsuna's cheeks the moment she made that forward statement, and the glint emanating from her left ring finger felt just a little more luxurious.
"…Did you dislike that? Do you like me less now?"
For a moment, I was unable to speak, and Setsuna looked at me with a lonesome look.
"But that wasn't really my intention… Ah, ehm… or rather… my intention was…"
"Why are you making this difficult for us? I told you I don't dislike it, and I don't like you less for it."
…Or perhaps the fact that she looked lonely is just another result of me overthinking things.
"I just felt a bit relieved… you were so much like your regular self."
But I couldn't bring myself to not try to brighten her mood.
"Yes, just like always. Stingy, family-oriented, and having a strong sense of responsibility, just like the usual Setsuna."
It wasn't out of a sense of duty or responsibility. I just wanted to.
"I-I don't think I'm that much like a housewife."
"What's wrong with being a housewife? It's just like you to be so family-oriented."
"C-Come on! Hey, you're being really mean today, Haruki-kun!"
"Come on, let's go to the supermarket already. I told you already, I'm hungry."
"J-Jeez! We can do that after I repair my reputation!"
I love how stingy Setsuna is. I love how she's overly familial. I love how she's just so rigid.
I love the family-orientated Setsuna who always puts my mind at ease. I love her from the bottom of my heart.
That's why I'm able to spend time with her in this peaceful manner…
"Ah, before that… I forgot to report something to my superior."
"Jeez, now you're in total deflection mode!"
I separate from Setsuna by half a step and put my cell phone to my ear.
As the name of Sakamoto Sumikiーthe person I'm callingーis being displayed on the screen.
"Connecting to voicemail. Please leave your message after the beep."
"Ah, it's me, Kitahara. Some time ago I got an email from Kimura-san at Yoshihama Engineering. On the matter of the appointment on Monday, we decided on 4 PM."
"I also sent you an email, so please check that. Have a nice day."
"…Never mind. Let's hurry and get our shopping done, then we'll eat!"
"Ah, wait, Setsuna. I'm in the mood for some Italian food today."
"Alright, then we'll have some Yosenabe. White cabbage and Shiitake mushrooms… and how about cod for the fish?"
"…Are you trying to get revenge on me?"
"…We decided on 4 PM. I also sent you an email, so please check that. Have a nice day, then."
Setsuna came out of the kitchen, and went out of her way to sit next to me instead of facing me, then slowly leaned on my shoulder.
She took off her suit and changed into more comfortable clothes. Setsuna was completely in her "stay-over" mode.
"Haruki-kun, good work this week. It must have been hard for you with all these things happening."
Far too many things happened, and every single one of them were completely unthinkable, not to mention, I can't talk about any of them to Setsuna.
"You don't have to hold it in. Let out everything you've piled up in your heart and your body. I'll accept it all."
Saying that, she brings her body closer to mine.
Of course, that's not a sign that would go over either of our heads.
After that, I embrace Setsuna gently but hard. Setsuna looks up at me ecstatically and closes her eyes…
…Before confirming my prediction from three seconds ago. Setsuna desires me.
I can feel Setsuna's warmth permeating through me. The scent that I've always loved tickles my nose.
In this peaceful moment where my heart should be dancing in joy… I find myself unable to feel anything but fear.
I wonder if my feelings aren't leaking out. I wonder if they're not reaching Setsuna.
But in the end, nothing changed.
After the mistake I made that night… I'm once again making another mistake in the opposite direction.
Normally, I would pull up her shirt and caress her as I'm still kissing her.
I'd embrace her as my lips are still attached to hers, and fall down on the bed with her under me.
I'd take off her shirt, make her take off mine, then gently yet fervently make love with her…
Once we were done and finished enjoying the afterglow, we'd take a shower.
But with the way I am right now…
After having turned this action I've carried out with so much affection before into a deeply sinful act…
…I embrace her as my lips are still attached to hers, and fall down on the bed with her under me.
Because there's no one here to reproach me for this sinful act, and there is no one here who is hurt by it.
Because Kazusa isn't in the apartment next door. She won't return all night.
That's what I told her to do… with the voicemail I sent earlier.
I left a single number in the text, and by comparing the number with a chart I gave her in advance, she can figure out the meaning of it.
0 is "I'll be home soon." 1 is "I'll be late." 2 is "I can't come home today."
"Haah, nh, nhm… Haah… aah… it's good… right there…"
And 4 is "Leave the apartment tonight." The keyword that represents the most despicable thing possible.
Kazusa isn't in the apartment next to mine now, so no matter how much Setsuna moans, no matter how many times she climaxes, there is no problem.
There is no problem at all. Because she… Kazusa herself accepted this.
That I would spend the weekends with Setsuna like I always have.
That I would make love to Setsuna.
"You made up, didn't you? In that case, it'd feel strange if you didn't meet, don't you think?"
"You always see her on the weekends, right? You're together until Saturday morning, right? And on Friday night… you always let her stay, right?"
"In that case, you'll do the same from now on too. It'll be no different from any other day."
"You'll call Setsuna every day, text her, be together all weekend, and then… once you both get in the mood…"
"Stop it! Something like that could never be forgiven…"
"What will never be forgiven is what I'm doing. I'm the one in the wrong."
"If you don't do this, Setsuna will get suspicious, and she'll be sad. Nothing good will come of it."
"Besides, you two making love is correct… unlike when you're doing it with me, it is a good thing."
"There is no good or bad when it comes to that…"
"That's what would bring the most happiness to everyone. You already know this, don't you, Haruki?"
"But I… right now, I belong… I belong only to you…"
"That can wait for when we're alone with each other… Wanting even only that is incredibly selfish of me."
"It might be painful for an upright man like you, but try to bear it for me… I don't want to break you, or Setsuna."
"I… I've… become much better at lying than I used to be… so we'll never get caught."
That's why… I enter deep within Setsuna.
"Aah, haah, ah, aah… I-I'm sorry… my voice is loud… again…!"
"It's okay… no one will hear you."
"Y-Yeah, ah… It's okay… you can do it like you did before…"
"Aaaah, haah, ah, aahn… nnhhh… chu, chu… aaah…"
In order to distract myself from my own sin, I put my faith in Setsuna's strength, spoiling myself with it, relying on it.
When I hold Setsuna in my arms like this, I'm only thinking of her. I'm loving only Setsuna.
…There's nothing difficult about this. Until last year, it was something I did as a given.
"…!? Eh? Ah, ah, sorry. What is it?"
"…I was saying that you look kind of tired, but I feel like I've got my answer already."
I spent the morning aimlessly with Setsuna, who always has trouble getting up on the weekends. We went shopping in the afternoon under the guise of going out on a date.
And in the evening, when I took her home, I took the opportunity to join the Ogiso household for dinner.
The lifestyle we had repeated almost every week last year has finally returned to us.
"You haven't been using your chopsticks a whole lot. Perhaps you're unwell? Setsuna, could you bring me that thing?"
"It's not a thing, it's called a thermometer."
"Ah, no, I appreciate the concern, but it's not that big of a deal…"
"…Could it be that Nee-chan didn't let you sleep last night?"
The food I had trouble swallowing up until a moment ago is now completely stuck in my throat.
"What am I going to do with you…? You're almost twenty, yet you talk like you're in middle school…"
"Could you cut it out? …We're in the middle of a meal here."
"How do you know that I'm asking something that's inappropriate to bring up during dinner? For all you know, I could have been asking if she was forcing Kitahara-san to play video games all night."
"Even the way you make excuses is like that of a middle-schooler. You'll have no one to blame but yourself if your girlfriend dumps you."
"H-Hold on a second! Just because I brought her over ten times doesn't mean she's my girlfriend!"
"U-Um, it's really nothing like that at all! I was just thinking about something, that's all."
Leaving aside what "nothing like that" is referring to, this family talks about things like that sometimes without any discretion, and it always leaves me baffled.
…Well, on the other hand, it's precisely because this family is the way it is that I can manage to stay in Setsuna's room overnight all the time.
"Thinking about something, huh? About the future?"
"Wait a minute, Takahiro, be a bit more…"
"What are you two on about? Even though you've been dying to ask that all evening."
Setsuna and I look at each other in confusion in an attempt to see if the other understands what's going on, but the effort is in vain.
Because out of the entire Ogiso family, who had all gone completely silent, Setsuna was the one who looked the most embarrassed, hanging her head.
"Ehm, Kitahara-san. Could it be that… you've proposed to Nee-chan?"
Over the table… Setsuna quietly hides her left hand with her right.
…In an attempt to conceal the sparkling ring on her ring finger.
"My sister won't give me a straight answer when I ask her about it. Dad's also been in a really gloomy mood this week, you know?"
Come to think of it… this is the first time I've been in the Ogiso household since I gave her that ring.
"T-Takahiro… you didn't have to do that… we're in the middle of a meal. Look, you're putting Kitahara-san on the spot."
"Aah! Why are you trying to save face all of a sudden? You were the one who just earlier asked dad and me about the best way to get them talking!"
"…Ehm, that doesn't mean you should be so blunt about it, and there is no need for us to find out over dinner."
I know that the bond between these family members isn't so weak that they won't notice a change on her ring finger when they see each other every day.
Though pretending not to know anything until someone points it out isn't exactly good for Setsuna, nor for anyone else.
"H-Hey, stop it! There's no particular meaning behind this ring…"
"…There isn't? It looks really expensive though, doesn't it? It looks completely different from the cheap trinket you had before."
"…I got that one from Haruki-kun too."
"Ah, oh my… is that so? That's uh… well, you know, right, Takahiro?"
"Basically, if you had only let us know about this in advance, Nee-chan, Kitahara-san could have avoided this utter embarrassment…"
"T-That's right! Oh, what will I do with you? Always so obstinate when it comes to the most important things."
"L-Like I said, you've got it wrong! This doesn't mean… that it'll happen immediately."
"Setsuna… if you put it that way…"
"Uhm… If it's not going to happen immediately, then…"
"In other words… you've talked about your future?"
"Aa-ah… the cat's out of the bag…"
"What did I tell you, Takahiro? It's precisely as I said! I knew something was up from the very start!"
"Calm down, Mom. You didn't even ask them yourself, so don't get carried away."
"Cut it out, both of you! They just said that nothing was set in stone!"
"No, they didn't. They didn't say that. They said that they've more or less decided!"
"Dear… I understand that you don't want to accept it, but don't get the wrong idea just because it's convenient for you."
"H-Hold on a second… Like I said, like I said… could you stop talking about it in front of us?"
Amidst this heavy atmosphere, and in this place where my once in a lifetime choice could be made…
I instead remain quiet and hang my head, unable to grasp the flow of the conversation or stop it entirely.
I can only desperately put on a fake smile with my feelings hidden deep inside.
"Sorry about today… things got really weird back there."
"Everyone is so eager about everything, getting all excited like we weren't even there."
"Like I said, don't worry about it."
There shouldn't be anything wrong with being eager. In fact, it was probably the best way to go about it.
After all, they were merely eager. What they actually said wasn't wrong…or at least it shouldn't be.
That's why I'm sorry. I'm sorry for being quiet. I'm sorry for not saying what I should have.
"I'm really sorry. But mom and Takahiro's hearts were in the right place. As for dad… I'll talk to him about it later."
Yet Setsuna makes it look like my unforgivable mistake was her own fault and keeps apologizing.
So as to not burden me. To not push any responsibility on me.
What she desires, what she wants me to do…
Sometimes those true feelings of hers leak out ever so slightly, but she passes them off as a slip of the tongue, and continues to conceal them deep within herself.
Dinner at the Ogiso household was more exciting than usual… though one family member left the dinner table halfway through.
Setsuna's mother started talking about the future of the household, putting her in direct opposition to the children who insisted on talking about that with only the family around.
Takahiro claimed the right to Setsuna's room for when she moves out, putting him in direct opposition to the women who wanted it left as is.
Her father didn't seem to want to join the conversation, but when I was about to leave, he muttered to me about needing to talk to my mother.
"You are now connected to voicemail. Please leave your message after the beep."
A kind of conversation that is natural in the Ogiso household, but does not exist in the Kitahara household.
I was supposed to be taken aback by this family, feel envious, and then I'd eventually join them.
I was supposed to become a part of that warm, gentle circle of people.
I grab onto another circle, one that only connects the hands of two people.
"You didn't have to come get me, you know."
"I wanted to be with you if only for a minute longer. I wanted to be with you, even outside, Haruki."
"Just kidding… haha! Did you actually believe that? I actually haven't been in my apartment since Friday. I was just on my way to the station right now."
"…On top of barely passing for a joke, it still puts the blame on me either way."
Because on Friday night… I was the one who forced Kazusa out of her apartment, even though she had no other place to go.
"I suppose that's only natural. You haven't done anything wrong, after all."
So I want her to stop speaking with that shaky voice… I want her to stop smiling with tears in her eyes.
I want her to finally stop using "I'm cold" to fool me someday.
"Alright, let's go home. Are you going to work tomorrow?"
"It's alright, I have a bit of work left to do, but I can manage it at home."
"I see, I see… haha, that means I'll have you all to myself this Sunday."
Saying that almost nonchalantly, Kazusa grabs my left hand with her right hand.
Her hands are warm, or at least warm compared to the cold winter night.
"Why did you take off your bandages? You haven't fully healed yet."
"…The way that's always the first thing you worry about is so much like the inconsiderate class representative I knew, Haruki."
The single bandaid on the back of her hand was useless.
"The doctor said it was going to take two weeks, right? What if you delay the healing time?"
"How could you even… ah, you mean the report. You know they were exaggerating on purpose, right?"
"If they say that, then they'll have an excuse if I mess up the next concert. Perhaps they'll even be able to cancel the additional concert entirely…"
"…Disappointed in me? Are you going to ask me what the fans would say?"
"I get that you're lazy in your private time, but never compromising on your piano is what defines you."
"But you know… I've already accomplished what I came to do in Japan."
"You already have the additional concert left. There are thousands of people still looking forward to it."
"Do you seriously think that the reason I came back to Japan was to play concerts?"
"What other reason could there be…? Stop degrading yourself already, and get it together."
"I love hearing your piano, and I firmly believe other people will too if you let them hear it once. That's how much I admire you as a pianist."
"That's why, that's why… you shouldn't go betraying their expectations…"
"But you ran away, Haruki. You ran away from my concert that you supposedly loved so much…"
"I… I didn't know what to do at the time with you so close to me."
"If I didn't distance myself from you, I felt that something unthinkable was going to happen… though in the end, it happened anyway."
"I get it, I get it already! I was just joking. Don't take it so seriously…"
In a loud voice, Kazusa redirects the flow of conversation when she realizes it is going in an unpleasant direction.
She puts even more force into her hand, which was already almost squeezing mine. She pulls my shoulder to her body, and we feel each other's warmth.
"It was all a joke, obviously. I'll play the additional concert, with every fiber of my being."
"I'll make use of all the strength I have. I'll work so hard that if someone is still not satisfied despite that, I'll simply pass it off as something beyond my ability."
"What are you talking about…? If you truly do your best, you're bound to get nothing but praise. If someone still decides to criticize you, I'll crush them myself with an opinion piece."
I know that my voice isn't shaking because of the cold.
"…Seriously, you're really bad at taking hints."
Because Kazusa's voice is only shaking more and more.
"You're right, I'm awful at catching jokes. That's why things turned out this way…"
Even though our bodies are so close and share so much warmth, and even though we should feel the passion burning within us from our hearts connecting with one another…
We can feel each other shaking… along with our lies, our stubbornness, and our sadness.
"I won't let it end as a joke. I won't ever embrace you without putting my heart into it. I've never seen being with you as a joke…"
"It's not a joke. It's not a joke at all."
"It's just a mistake. It's earnest, but wrong, that's all."
There is no end to our conversation.
"I don't mind being despicable… so please, make this winter a pleasant one."
"…I'm yours. From now on, I'm yours alone."
Our hands are connected, our hearts are connected, our bodies are connected.
So why are the words we share in our intimate moment so painful, and filled with sorrow?
"Up until now, you spent your weekend the right way. You belonged to Setsuna alone."
"…But from now on, you'll be spending your time the wrong way. You'll belong to me alone."
"Haruki… Haruki, Haruki, Haruki! Haah, haah, aaah…"
The fingers of my left hand and her right hand entwine, and before we know it, both our hands are entwined.
Just like that, we embrace with all our might, full of emotions.
My apartment is only five minutes away…
Yet, I can't bear to wait that long. I can't imagine being with her, without having her in my arms.
Because a month is all we have left.
"I'll rid you of it… I'll rid you of Setsuna's scent. I'll cover you in my scent…"
Just as the snow melts when spring comes…
When her last concert is over, this relationship will end like a fleeting memory.
"That can't be true. You can't lie to me."
"I've always looked at you, you know? I've looked at you longer than you have looked at yourself."
There's only an hour left until dawn.
I meant to let Kazusa fall asleep peacefully by offering my arm as a pillow, but it didn't seem to work.
"You were thinking about Setsuna, weren't you? You're troubled by the fact that you betrayed her."
"And you said you were 'much better at lying than you used to be'… If you ask me, you haven't improved one bit in these five years."
Because I couldn't follow up my denial with anything convincing, my bluff was called.
"If you keep it up like that, Setsuna will find out. You won't even last a month."
Five years ago. Two years ago. And now.
I told one obvious lie after the next, yet still managed to deceive her.
So why am I still unable to convincingly lie to people? Why is that the one thing I can never be good at?
"Haah… I feel stupid for even believing in your facade."
"…But that means I managed to deceive you. It means I lied to you."
Winning arguments through sophistry has always been my specialty…
"That's enough, I'll teach you how to lie properly. Listen carefully now."
"Are you… saying that you're good at lying?"
"I am, at least I'm better than you."
"And what do you base that on…?"
"Five years ago… until I told you myself in the end, you never found out."
What kind of lie was that? Who was it trying to deceive and for how long?
And when did the truth come out?
If I think about it, I feel like I'm drawing closer to the answer, but if I do find the answer, I'll be burdened by yet another sin.
"Haruki, you don't have to be troubled anymore. Don't think about anything anymore. Your tendency to anguish over every little thing is your weakness."
…Kazusa harshly attacks the very thing I was just doing.
"If you trouble yourself about it, Setsuna will notice. The things you hide from her, your lies, and your betrayal will all be known… And you'll hurt her."
She tells me that guilt in itself is a crime. She tells me that the very act of agonizing over it in itself is despicable.
"So don't think about anything. When you're with me, just lust after my body like an animal. When you're with Setsuna, forget about everything and love her."
"Are you stupid…? That would be the worst thing a person could do."
"That's all it takes for me to be satisfied. You'll be free from your worries, and Setsuna will be happy. I don't see any problems with that."
It's an absurdly forced argument. An attempt to reason that's completely full of flaws.
But to me right now, those words are something I want to cling to…
"That's why, Haruki… we need to practice first. When you're alone with me, don't think about anything and keep lying to me."
"But you'll know that I'm lying. Are you telling me to tell lies that you can easily see through?"
"It's okay… if it's a convenient lie, I'll believe it."
"If you were to tell me that you love me, that you love me more than anyone else, that your feelings for me haven't changed one bit…"
Kazusa's suggestion was, after all, completely unreasonable and forced.
"If that's the kind of lie you tell me, then… I'll be so happy, that I'll feel like I'm in heaven."
"It being a lie is the reason I'll be happy. Because it's a lie, I'll be able to relax."
What she's saying is already contradicting her words from just a few seconds ago.
"Because you'll still be able to love Setsuna. Because there'll still be a you who doesn't love me."
"It's because the three of us have our own places to return to that I can feel at ease being embraced by you like this."
The devil puts all her feelings into her whispers to me and seductively shackles me.
"So do your best, Haruki. Tell me a lie."
"Don't see the things you say to me, and the things you do to me as the truth. Your truth has always involved Setsuna and Setsuna alone."
Kazusa is clinging to me. She is pouring all her strength into embracing me.
"Once winter ends and my concert is finished, and you are separated from me, you'll go back to spending your days with Setsuna."
"You'll wake up from this dark nightmare and go back to your colorful reality…"
It's not just her words, her body gently binds me too.
A ceremony to separate our words and bodies from our feelings.
"Give it a try. Practice telling a lie."
What I'm about to say next won't come from my mind nor my heart. It will only be the product of neural signals making my mouth move.

"You know, I'm not against you and Kitahara-senpai being together. I just… want you to be happy, Setsuna."
"I'm sorry, Tomo… but as long as I'm with Haruki-kun, everything will be fine, I'm sure."
"…It's been a while since you last stopped saying 'I'm absolutely sure' regarding him, though."
By the time I made it to Kazusa's apartment, it was already past 3 AM.
Even though I've come back so late, and have communicated with her using nothing but numbers…
Even though I reek of alcohol…
Kazusa still greets me with a hug.
I found undressing too much of a pain, so I just collapsed on the bed barely still conscious. Kazusa embraced me with her whole body.
She pulls my head against her chest, gently strokes my hair, cheeks, and lips with her fingers.
"Hm…? Fuuu… I'll imprint your scent… in my memories."
She takes a deep breath, and smells me as if it excites her.
"That's fine, you don't have to care. You can just go to sleep and ignore me."
Kazusa's desire for me brings me more pain than usual.
"I'm sorry for coming home drunk, for not being with you…"
Kazusa was waiting for me to return all this time.
We don't have more than a few days together, so she anxiously kept waiting for me, not wanting to let a single second get away.
"I was the one who told you to continue living your life as always. You're not doing anything wrong."
But she still tries to put up a strong front as always.
However, since she was born as a very expressive person, I can directly feel how lonely she's feeling through her entire body.
"I was out drinking with Takeya. He just wouldn't let me go. He took me to three different places."
"…You're the only one who ever called him that."
Even after Setsuna prevented the party from moving to my apartment, I still continued to celebrate and drink with Takeya.
…Actually, I'd call it a series of personal proclamations by Takeya rather than a celebration. Most of the conversation was about his childhood friend.
It would seem that the engagement between Setsuna and me gave those two, who had spent more time with each other than with either of us, a lot of courage about facing one another.
He continued pouring in drink after drink, saying "I'll show you I'm being serious this time!"…
He kept drinking in a fashion almost typical of a middle-aged Japanese salaryman, and once he had enough he collapsed, which took yet another hour away from Kazusa.
"I see… so the two of them are still dragging things out, huh? Mizusawa, and the president too."
"I hope it goes well between them…"
For a long time, it looked like Kazusa felt sympathy for him.
"…Not that I have any right to say that at all."
But before long, she found herself sympathizing with Setsuna too, and her feelings became complicated…
"…For him, the problem is actually getting there. The path ahead is already decided, yet he keeps taking detours over and over again."
So I decided to guide the conversation to one about my best friend, to ease her mind.
…Or at least that's what I tried to do. In the end, every single word choice we make ends up backfiring at us.
It seems we can't do anything right…
"B-By the way… didn't he try to hit on you once back in high school? Back then he went from one girl to the next…"
"He did? I don't remember it at all."
"…That's my best friend you're talking about."
"But you know, I don't remember anything from high school other than the last six months."
"…I decided to forget about all the unpleasant things in my life, so I may have forgotten about it instinctively."
"…You're talking about my best friend, you know."
As far as unpleasant experiences go…
I'm sure that the last six months would have etched far more unpleasant memories in her than any other time.
After that, time slowly and uneventfully passed between us as we continued to talk about my best friend, who Kazusa had a rather poor impression of.
…Just like Kazusa wanted, I lied to her by not saying anything.
I told her that the reason Takeya invited me to drink was so he could talk to me about his troubles. There was no "engagement party" to speak of.
It was only Takeya and me drinking from beginning to end, while the women who were actually present thereーincluding Setsunaーweren't among us.
I don't know how much of my lies she saw through.
I just didn't want to hurt her with the truth, believing these lies might've eased her mind.
Whether my eyes are open or not, all I can see is darkness. I can see only the clock ticking past 4 o'clock.
…Thinking back to my last memory, I must've been out for 30 minutes.
"What do you mean, that's not it…?"
"It's nothing… to apologize for. It's really nothing you should be apologizing for at all…!"
I touch the warm tears flowing down my cheeks.
These tears are not from my own eyes… they fell on me from above.
"It's all my fault… Why would I even wake you up? I knew you have to go to work tomorrow."
Kazusa's voice, which was calm just 30 minutes ago, is now overwhelmed with emotion.
"But you know, I tried to fall asleep too, but I couldn't… so then, I started thinking about a lot of stupid things…"
Yet another fresh tear falls on my face.
I reach out both my hands in front of me so that Kazusa can see them clearly.
And in response, she timidly grabs my hands, entwines her fingers with mine and squeezes them tightly.
I'm still sleepy and drunk, but I knew what I needed to do.
"It's okay… it's okay. I'm awake now."
I slowly caress the back of Kazusa's hand with my thumb.
"Yes, I'm fully awake. So you can go to sleep if you feel sleepy, or you can stay awake if you can't fall asleep."
Even though the meaning behind it and the way I did it was completely different, this was supposed to be my own version of "Pain, pain, go away."
After all, right now, Kazusa's acting like a child who's crying in her mother's chest because she just woke up from a frightening nightmare at night.
…Though I'm actually the one being hugged right now.
I don't know if the way we're touching right now has any effect on her…
Even so, Kazusa's weeping slowly lessens, and her grip on my hand also gradually becomes more gentle.
"Don't say that. This happens to everyone."
"But… Setsuna wouldn't be this selfish, right?"
"Setsuna would be able to hold it in. Setsuna would be able to prioritize your needs."
And I can see the tender expression on her face, along with the weakness behind it.
"Yet all I care about… is my own feelings for you."
Despite having just calmed herself down, or perhaps due to having calmed herself down, she's now looking back on her own actions with composure.
"I can't contain my selfishness. I always cause you to suffer… that's why things ended up this way."
She reflects on the sins she's committed as well as the world she's betrayed.
"I'm an awful woman, I'm human garbage. I can never be a good woman… like Setsuna…"
As someone who bears the same sin as her, I understand her thought process perfectly…
"I'm sorry, Haruki… for not being the woman you wanted…"
That's why I can't let it reach its conclusion.
"All you have to do is to be the Touma Kazusa who is by my side, always looking at me, always loving me…"
"Be the girl that I adore and love… the cool, and adorable timid girl who always pretends to be tough… that's all I need."
"That's my pride and honor as the number one fan in the Touma Kazusa fan club."
We can only lick each other's wounds.
"Haaah… nh, aah… I'm sorry, thank you… I'm so…"
Kazusa's embrace around me grows stronger.
She supports my back with her chest, holds her arms around my head, and strokes my cheeks over and over again.
While losing herself in holding me, she takes a deep breath and lets out a warm sigh at the nape of my neck.
She hits me with her warm emotions.
"Do you still not understand just how much I love you?"
"I know… that I have to believe you. After all, I can't think of any other reason why you would obsess over me so much."
Looking at Kazusa's feelings for me through the process of elimination, I can't think of any other reason than the fact that she truly loves me.
Because I haven't made Kazusa detest me enough for her to seek revenge against me.
I'm not strong enough to be someone that the pianist Touma Kazusa needs in her life.
I didn't leave such a powerful imprint on her body to awaken the woman known as Touma Kazusa.
"But… it's because I have to believe you that I don't get it. Why would you even bother with someone like me?"
"Don't sell yourself short… don't look down on my man."
"You did that yourself just earlier. You insulted my woman."
"You're a professional pianist, you know? You won a prize in an international competition. You're a celebrity here in Japan, and known all throughout the world."
"So why would an exceptional person like you… get so serious about an ordinary man like me?"
"Not to mention you haven't even seen me in five years. It wouldn't be strange if you forgot what I looked like."
"You remembered what I looked like, right…?"
There was plenty of time for her feelings to fade.
As we went on living our lives without each other, a wall grew between us that could no longer be crossed with just our feelings alone.
The distance between us, our circumstances, and our futures…
We were supposed to have our hearts broken, to fall victim to our own circumstance.
"Five years ago… I didn't understand your reason either."

"I didn't know the reason why the very definition of a rule-abiding teacher's pet would persistently try and get close to an idiot who resisted everything and tried to distance herself from everything in the world."
That idiot and the teacher's pet met because they sat right next to each other in the classroom of Class 3-E.
"I didn't know the reason why you were so stupidly trying to get involved with me no matter how much I pretended to ignore you, snapped at you, or told you I hated you even though I didn't."
That teacher's pet did everything he could to win the favor of the idiot.

No matter how many strange looks he got from his friends, and no matter how many times the teachers seriously warned him about what he was doing, he responded to them amiably, but he also didn't care.
"I couldn't understand why someone who was doing so well for himself in society would ever feel so strongly about an idiot who was completely ostracized by society."
I was serious about her in the exact way the idiot had described me to be.
"Hey, Haruki… Back then, why did you…?"
"Why did you fall in love with me, when even I hated myself…?"
It's because I was interested in you. It's because I couldn't bring myself to leave you be.
"If an abandoned dog… opens up its heart once, it loses control of itself, you know?"
And the idiot I loved so much back then is now holding me in her arms.
"The owner might have plenty of other dogs to take care of. But to an abandoned dog like me, that person will forever be its one and only owner."
She's desperately pouring all her emotions into the words she throws at me.
"It will never be able to forget him, you know?"
The idiot, who is in fact a genius deep down, is showing the ordinary guy who's nothing more than a teacher's pet how serious she is.
The proud wolf is reducing itself into the form of an abandoned dog just so it can rub its beautiful fur against the people living in the town.
And in the face of her twisted, fragile, yet pure and beautiful feelings, I…
I had to admit to her the embarrassing truth I had always kept hidden… the truth that had no value as a secret.
"It's such an obvious and stupid reason that… I thought you might've sobered up in an instant from a love that lasted five years."
It's a completely blunt and unrefined reason. It'd even be apt to call it vulgar or stupid…
"Bring it on… If you think you can sober me up, then try it."
"Then you won't have to feel guilty. You'll be able to go back to Setsuna just like you want to."
"It was because of your appearance! I fell in love with you the moment I saw you!"
"I look stupid, don't I? …It wasn't fate or anything great like that…"
No matter how much the abandoned dog sugarcoats her memories, the owner can only see it as nothing more than something stupid he did on a whim.
"Still, what did you expect? I was still just a high school student back then. I didn't have any experience dating a girl or anything."
It was a reason I always refused to acknowledge. It was a standard for falling in love far too similar to the way Takeya evaluated women.
"You can get mad at me if you want. You can stop loving me if you want. You can even disdain me…"
"You don't have to say it… you don't have to say it… I feel so disillusioned…"
I couldn't tell if the force in Kazusa's arms was out of anger, or some other feeling…
"I always thought you were different from the other guys who thought about women all the time."
Given that she never relaxed her embrace even once, I couldn't possibly know.
"To think that an honors student like you… a class representative… would care about me so much for a reason like that."
"Why else would someone like me have joined a band…?"
"You judged me for how I looked… and that's why you bothered talking to me… and started turning to me for help?"
"I liked… how you looked when you were angry, too."
"Did you really see me… as a girl that much?"
"You were the prettiest girl in class by far…"
"Were you… Were you the kind of boy with ulterior motives like that?"
"Even looking at the whole grade, the only girl who had a shot against you was Setsuna…"
"So you just decided to get close to the two girls you thought of as number one and number two…?"
"Because I thought I might have a chance with you… You didn't seem to dislike me that much."
"…You're such a calculating, vindictive man… to think… to think…"
"I was desperate… I wanted to catch your attention. That's the reason I practiced playing the guitar so much…"
"But obviously that would attract other girls than just me! …Not just me, but Setsuna too."
After hearing my horrible confession, Kazusa's emotions swell to the brink of bursting even though she had just managed to calm down earlier.
"You're such a horrible man… You're the worst thing a woman could ever face."
In the end, I knew she would respond that way…
I knew Kazusa wouldn't budge from something like this. She wouldn't hate me for just this.
Because Touma Kazusa is a preposterous idiot who couldn't forget about me for five whole years. All she could do was…
"Too bad, Haruki… the woman you caught is really bad at giving up."
"Yeah, you're right… You're just like me five years ago."
…Breathe a sigh of relief, feel sadness, and happiness…
I slowly shut my eyes, not wanting anyone to notice that they're wet.
"Things didn't go as planned, did they?"
…Kazusa did the same, but she seemed incapable of closing them all the way, because more tears fell on my cheeks.
Until I shook her awake, Kazusa slept with such a peaceful look on her face.
The same peaceful look that the girl I loved used to have, when she would doze off in the classroom seat next to mine.
"The person you are trying to reach isn't currently available. Please leave a message after the beep."
"Oh, Haruki? Long time no see! …Remember me?"
"It's Hayasaka! Hayasaka Chikashi! We were in the same class back in third year."
"It's really been a while, dude! Five years, huh? You haven't called me once all this time. That's cold, man… Well, I haven't contacted ya in two years either."
"Ah, anyway, I didn't call to reminisce, let's cut to the chase. So Touma is in Japan, right? Ya know, the Touma Kazusa who was in the same class as us."
"…Well, I don't think ya need to hear the whole story, but I actually managed to get my paws on some tickets for her additional concert. I'm thinking of going over there by the end of February."
"So, since I'm coming back to Tokyo, I thought we could chill out with the rest of the gang together."
"…I'll call ya again this evening. Think about it, would ya?"
"Anyway, see ya… Oh right! I got a call from Takeya just the other day."
"I heard about you two, man! That's amazing!"
"Hey, Macchan, Haru-chan. Here's your share of the chocolate, filled with love from me!"
"The very fact that you're dividing it between us proves that it's 100% obligatory chocolate…"
"Well, nowadays even the obligatory ones are important…"
Suzuki-san lines up pieces of chocolate on the desk of us guys almost like giving away souvenirs from some business trip.
Basically, one ball of Hawaiian Macadamia Nuts Chocolate each.

…Even so, I can't really complain, as compared to a certain someone from one of my previous part-time jobs, who gave everyone one single tiny piece of Choco Baby each, this is actually quite generous.

"That's because I'm looking forward to next month. Right now I'm completely addicted to the baumkuchen they sell at Rokuya. It's in the basement of Seikyu, though there's always an hour-long queue there."
"Hey, Kitahara, I'll pay half the cost, so go get some for me, would you?"
"…Just be nice and say, 'Please buy me some, and I'll split the cost.' It'll leave a better impression."

It's a day where confectionery workers are rewarded for their hard work over the past few days, when places from convenience stores to the shops in the basement of department stores stock up on a vast variety of chocolate.
And it's also an important anniversary to me, for a different reason…
"By the way, Kitahara. How many do you think you'll receive this year? If you can, I'd prefer it if you answered with an error margin of one."
"…Why do I have to tell you with such precision?"

"Because Hamada-san doesn't brag about anything except for the chocolate he got from his daughter. Kizaki-san has been really stiff ever since his marriage was decided on. The only person I can compete against is you."
"What I was asking is why we even have to compete about this in the first place."
"That's just Macchan's pride as a senior speaking. I wish he could use that pride when it comes to work, though."
"What are you talking about? Like I'd be able to win against Kitahara, who was trained by none other than Mari-san herself."
"Is that something a second-year senior should be saying? Had you sucked up to Mari-san as much as he did, she'd have trained you too."
"Are you sure…? I get the feeling that Mari-san gave Kitahara special treatment, though."
"Well you know, I can't deny that she had a soft spot for him… She might even invite him to work with her in America some day."
"I'll get back to my work! Once I'm done, I'm going straight home!"
If I spend any more time with these people on a day as festive as today, I feel like I'm going to have a bad time, so I run away from my post.
And there is also another reason to leave work early.
I haven't bought a birthday present yet… even though I've been invited to the Ogiso household tonight.
"According to a related party, Kazusa-san's hand injury might not heal in time for her next concert."
"No, that's not true. She did indeed have minor pains in her hand after her last concert, but it is fully healed by now."
"It was reported that her condition was poor during the previous concert as well. Could it have something to do with that injury?"
"That is also incorrect. She hurt herself after the concert… Regardless, I promise you that she'll be in peak performance by the next concert."
"So you recognize that her previous concert was poor…?"
"I haven't said any such thing. Shouldn't it be obvious that one would always aim higher than the last time?"
"…I would have loved to talk about this to Kazusa-san directly."
"I'm sorry about that. I got a sudden call this morning that she was feeling under the weather."
"You may take anything I say as directly from Touma Kazusa. Do you have any issues with that?"
"…She seems pretty receptive to giving information to a certain other magazine, though?"
"Ah, so you're aware? Her special number will be released after the next issue of Ensemble. I'd be thrilled if you could write about it in your article."
"…Looks like it's about time. Thank you for going out of your way today."
"…I'm sorry for bringing you out here during such a vital time."
"…Mio-chan. I told you not to accept any interviewers looking for her by yourself, didn't I? You never know when things like this might happen."
"I'm really sorry. Up until yesterday, I thought it'd be fine if it was just for a short while."
"Anyway, did you get in contact with her?"
"Should I send someone to her apartment? If her health really does take a turn for the worse…"
"That won't happen, so don't worry. I have the perfect health manager assigned to her."
Now with work finally done… no, I was already finished by 5 o'clock.
I finally managed to get a present… though as expected, it took me about two hours to pick one.
Either way, I've taken care of all my business for today, and now I'll be heading over to take care of the most important business of all.
Setsuna's birthday party. The Ogiso home party.
As well as… my official meeting with her parents about our decision.
Setsuna didn't say a word about wanting that. Instead, she merely accepted my resolve with a smile and tears in her eyes.
And our friends spurred it on relentlessly… Even now, they send texts about the state of affairs every day.
But it's not like my resolve came from being forcibly pushed on by them.
It's just that since I left the Ogiso household last time with nothing but vague statements, common sense dictates that today I'm supposed to declare some intent…
Not to mention the fact that no one around Setsuna and me is showing the slightest sign of letting this topic go.
At least, not on the surface…
While indulging myself in these thoughts, I sent a text not to "Setsuna," but "Sakamoto Sumiki."
I had planned to go home today since it's a weekday, but today I have to text her a 2, meaning I can't come home today.
Because today of all days… I can't look Kazusa straight in the eyes.
I just can't look at her today, when Setsuna and I are about to take our defining first step…
It always took eight rings for me to get to the answering machine.
Yet now I got connected after just two rings.
And instead of the regular monotone voice of the operator, I heard a deep, quiet voice.
It sounds like she's trying to speak calmly, but failing utterly…
In other words, it's as if she's trying to laugh only to instead cry. It's a voice that directly informs me of how uneasy she is.
She had kept it bottled up for the most part these past few days.
"Uuh… Uah… I'm sorry, I know I shouldn't have answered."
"It's fine, don't worry about it… You had something urgent to tell me, right?"
She ate her meals. She laughed in her own way.
During the day, she had returned to playing the piano and going about her normal life. At night, we made love tenderly and kissed.
We swore that we'd enjoy our remaining time together, but…
"It's not… it's not… really urgent… I just thought I should… congratulate you…"
"I wanted to… congratulate you… and Setsuna… on your… engagement… ～～～! Uu… uaah… uaaah!"
How do you know about that?
How could you possibly know about that, when you have no bonds in Japan with anyone but me…?
That was a decision I made to turn away from you before things between us could end up like this.
Compared to back then, I'm no longer…
No matter how many excuses I make, not even I will be convinced, much less Kazusa.
"There is nothing to… talk about. You haven't done anything… wrong!"
I'm the one who has pressed forward this engagement despite my relationship with Kazusa, and I still don't think that I'm making a mistake in going through with it.
"Let's talk about it anyway. Where are you now? Are you still in my apartment?"
Even though I knew my lie could be found out, I made love to her in my apartment and left her there sleeping…
"After all, you're going to Setsuna's place now, right? You're going to celebrate her birthday, right?"
In other words… in the end, I'm the one who's made Kazusa sad again…
"I'm going back right now, so stay there. Do you understand? Don't move a step."
"Aren't you going to… get her parents' blessing for your marriage…?"
"I'm not going! Right now I'm going to where you are…"
I'm not sure if those last words made it to Kazusa or not.
I'm even less certain if my feelings made it over to Kazusa or not…
My mind understands perfectly that I'm losing my composure…
But when it comes to Kazusa, my arms and legs don't care one bit about what my mind thinks.
My mouth, only capable of spewing the most despicable falsehoods, is in complete control of my heart.
"I'm sorry, I… something came up at work that I can't set aside…There's an interview that I have to attend…"
"Hm… He said he'd be late. Apparently something came up at work that he can't set aside."
"Oh dear… and you even took a day off work for this…"
"I don't mind at all. This day off is compensation for my earlier business trip anyway."
"You're the one getting too eager, Setsuna. After all, it's Thursday today, isn't it? I'd personally trust a man less if he could come home early from work so easily."
"This isn't an era where working late is an admirable quality. I'd much prefer a man who can spend proper time with his family."
"Hey, you're just relieved that he's not here, Dad. You know you'll have to go through with it someday anyway…"
I stand up from my seat, and a middle-aged woman holding on to one of the hanging straps looks at me worriedly.
"…I'm fine. I'm getting off at the next station. Thank you very much."
This woman had given up her priority seat to me.
…It seems even people around me could notice how abnormally soaked in sweat I was.
"The next station is Minami-Suetsugu, Minami-Suetsugu. The exit is on the left side."
The moment I got on the train, lots of changes occurred in my body.
I had a headache, and I felt nauseous and cold… My heart started beating like an alarm bell, and the way my hand was shaking as it hung onto one of the hanging straps was almost comedic.
At first, I thought that the heating was just too strong and that I was going to get used to the warmth and feel better.
But my temperature wasn't caused by something so simple. As I looked around, I could see that the people around me were noticing just how pale I was.
"Minami-Suetsugu, Minami-Suetsugu. Please mind the door when exiting."
And as I got closer to my destination, my condition got worse and worse.
As I get closer to the station one stop before Suetsugu-chou, my true destination…
When I got onto the platform, I was overtaken by an awful numbness in my whole body.
My feet forced themselves to get off the train, but my head alone pretended to "not be there."
"The doors are closing. Please be careful."
I made my choice the moment I called Setsuna.
I chose to do the same thing I did five years ago. During Setsuna's birthday, during our most important anniversary…
I chose to betray Setsuna again.
I was sure that the ground below my feet wasn't moving anymore, yet now it feels like I'm floating above it.
I want to sit down on a bench and rest.
So I can let the wind blow against my body, so I can stop this sweating and headache, even if it means I have to endure this awful chill.
But I don't have time for that. I have no time to take care of myself.
I have to cross the ticket gate as soon as I can. I have to go home quickly… I have to catch Kazusa.
The cold wind I was waiting eagerly for on the train blows powerfully from above the platform stairs.
But because I had to go against that wind and get off the platform, I felt nothing but hatred toward the dry cold wind blowing in my face.
My chill is getting worse by the minute. And my headache and my sweating aren't getting any better either.
So… I could only pray that it won't be snowing when I get out.
I could only pray that the scenery wouldn't be like back then.
I considered calling a taxi despite the fact that going home on foot usually only takes five minutes, but that dilemma turned out to be pointless.
"Didn't I tell you to wait in my apartment…?"
Did she try to escape from me? Did she come so she could see me earlier?
Or was she overwhelmed by both desires, and found herself unable to remain in the apartment?
I can feel the sweat on my body drying off.
"I just wanted to congratulate you and Setsuna, that's all. There is nothing to talk about."
"You're not in the wrong… You're not in the wrong at all, Haruki…!"
The burning heat that engulfed my body begins to cool, and along with it my head begins to clear up.
"Wasn't it me who told you to lie in the first place? Wasn't it none other than me who told you to just love me, and keep everything else hidden from me?"
I begin to feel vigor in my limbs again little by little, and my mental faculties return to me.
"Wasn't it me who told you to… continue loving Setsuna…?"
"Still, I'm sorry. I knew that you didn't actually mean that…"
"I did mean it! All you did was to be the way I wanted you to be!"
I shouldn't be worrying about my own body right now. The one I should be protecting is Kazusa.
"All you did was choose the path where neither I nor Setsuna have to get hurt."
"I said it's okay… you don't have to say anything."
Putting myself down for the sake of protecting Kazusa's heart is nothing to me.
"I even found out about… something I shouldn't have, something you went out of your way to hide from me. I'm an inconsiderate person who can't even properly congratulate someone."
"I'm an idiot… I'm a massive idiot who can't even abide by the rules I made myself…"
And so, I obey the command coming from my brain. I remain honest to my own thoughts.
"Do I have to spell it out for you? Do I have to make it this obvious for you to understand? …You're such a spoiled child."
After embracing her, I finally understand. Kazusa has been waiting for this.
"Is there something wrong with being a spoiled child who lacks sense? Is there something wrong with being unable to wait for even five minutes?"
She couldn't stand waiting for me to return, so she left the apartment and came here to be embraced by me.
"I wanted you to deceive me completely… To be told that you only have eyes for me… That you love only me."
I can sense the stares of the passers-by.
Cold, judgemental stares directed at the couple who are embracing in the middle of the street, showing no consideration for others.
I am a bit bothered by the attention, but not enough for my arms around her to loosen.
"I won't look at anyone but you from now on. So please… let's make up, okay?"
"Of course it's not… Kazusa, do you hate me?"
"Then this is the symbol of our reconciliation…"
Kazusa stops me at the last moment… when I'm just a single centimeter away from her lips.
"Are you… okay with being seen here?"
"That's what I should be asking you."
